items.desc: Part-time | Ideally 18 hours per week over 3 days | Salary up to £60,000+ FTE depending on experience Looking for a role that fits around your life without compromising on clinical standards, support or job satisfaction? Eden Veterinary Centre is looking for an experienced Small Animal Veterinary Surgeon to join our friendly team in Carlisle on a part-time basis. With a supportive team, excellent facilities and a genuine focus on work–life balance, this is a great opportunity to find a role that works for you while continuing to enjoy your clinical career. What You’ll Be Stepping Into Ideally, we’re looking for someone to work 18 hours per week over 3 days, with flexibility to discuss a working pattern that suits you. Whether you prefer consulting, surgery or a mixture of both, there’s scope to shape the role around your interests, with a varied first-opinion caseload, clinical freedom and 1 in 4 Saturday mornings. We’re looking for a vet with at least 3 years’ post-qualification experience who is passionate about delivering high-quality, contextualised first-opinion care. You’ll enjoy building relationships with clients and their pets, working collaboratively with the team and continuing to develop your clinical skills. We’ll support you with certificate funding, tailored CPD, regular case discussions and a strong nursing team, giving you the freedom and encouragement to pursue your interests while delivering excellent patient care. The Team & Facilities You’ll be joining a collaborative team of 5 vets, including our Clinical Lead, 6 RVNs, 2 SVNs, a Veterinary Care Assistant, an experienced reception team and our Practice Director. We’re a nurse training practice and actively encourage development at every level, with regular case discussions and team meetings to share knowledge, support one another and continue improving our clinical standards. We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, purpose-built practice, designed to provide an excellent clinical environment for both our team and patients. Our facilities include: Two surgical theatres equipped with diathermy, laparoscopy, ventilation and a range of orthopaedic equipment. A dedicated dental suite with dental X-ray. An imaging suite with digital radiography and high-specification ultrasound. Comprehensive in-house laboratory and patient monitoring equipment. Patient warming facilities, a dog-friendly environment, ISFM Gold Cat Friendly Clinic status and a lovely staff room. Our ethos is simple: we treat every pet as if they were our own. We’re proud to provide compassionate, high-quality care in a close-knit practice where every team member feels valued, supported and encouraged to develop. Life in Carlisle Based on the edge of the stunning Lake District, Carlisle offers a fantastic balance of city convenience and outdoor adventure. With the fells and lakes, Hadrian’s Wall and the Scottish Borders all within easy reach, it’s a great place to enjoy the outdoors and make the most of your time away from work. How We’ll Support You At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from: Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership, and specialist roles Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC academy training centres & role-relevant courses £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches, and peer networks Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement What We Offer Our Team 6.8 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays Private medical insurance Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies) Retail discounts and cashback offers Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets Up to £30,000 (£66,000 FTE) We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. items.desc: About Mettler Toledo METTLER TOLEDO is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services. We are recognized as an innovation leader and our solutions are critical in key R&D, quality control, and manufacturing processes for customers in a wide range of industries including life sciences, food, and chemicals. We operate throughout the world with a culture shaped by innovation and international flair. Our Opening and Your Responsibilities As a DSP Engineer 100% (all genders), you will join our global, cross-functional, and highly innovative Smart Sensor Team at our operational headquarters in Nänikon-Greifensee. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, simulation, and validation of signal-processing algorithms that power our industry-leading smart sensors. You will lead the way as the industry transitions into digitalization and smart factories, combining a deep understanding of signal theory and physical systems with practical software development to improve measurement performance and customer value. Your Responsibilities: * Design and optimize new digital signal processing algorithms for multi-sensor weighing systems (filtering, disturbance compensation, condition monitoring, and noise mitigation) using our modular signal processing platform. * Analyze and model mechanical, electrical, and physical properties of weighing systems to guide algorithm choices and improve system accuracy and stability. * Develop proof-of-concepts and conduct performance analyses using MATLAB/Simulink and other simulation tools. * Collaborate closely with electronics, data science, and firmware teams to ensure seamless integration and product readiness. * Define and execute test plans, including lab measurements, environmental tests, and field verifications to validate performance under real operating conditions. * Prepare technical documentation, including requirements, algorithm descriptions, validation reports, and release artifacts. * Drive innovation by monitoring technology trends, reviewing signal-processing literature, and supporting IP/knowledge capture. What You Need to Succeed The following requirements are necessary for this role: * Master’s or PhD degree in Physics, Mechanics, Robotics, Fluid Dynamics, or a related technical field. * Strong theoretical background in physics, signal theory, and digital signal processing, including control theory, filtering (Kalman, adaptive filters), spectral analysis, system identification, system and noise modeling. * Proficient in MATLAB and Simulink for system modeling and algorithm development * Analytical self-starter with a proactive, solution-oriented approach to technical ownership and problem-solving. * Ability and willingness to work in a global, cross-functional team, including occasional travel for cross-site collaboration and field validation. * Background in embedded software and knowledge of data acquisition methods are considered strong assets. * Excellent communication skills in English; ability to explain complex concepts clearly. German language skills are a plus. Our Offer to You We are offering: * Where applicable flexible working hours, a hybrid work model and a wide portfolio of training opportunities * 40h week with at least 25 vacation days per year plus 4 to 7 additional days off (i.e. in between bank holidays) * Free parking spaces and direct access to public transport from our facilities * Healthy menus cooked onsite and special prices for employees at our own METTLER TOLEDO restaurant * We offer a dynamic and innovation-driven corporate culture that promotes teamwork, personal development, and a passion for excellence. * A range of additional attractive benefits like discounts for sport clubs and others You can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and realize your next career goal. items.desc: Climate Simulation & AI Scientist, Built Environment Company: infrared.city Location: Vienna (Hybrid) · Full-time · Stock options (ESOP) About infrared.city infrared.city is building the climate intelligence layer for cities and buildings . Spun off from the Austrian Institute of Technology (AIT), we replace legacy, compute-heavy simulation runtimes with near-instant spatial intelligence deployed interactively at the earliest stages of design. Our multi-scale platform models complex physical dynamics across the urban continuum: Microclimate & Outdoor Comfort: UTCI, mean radiant temperature ($T_{\text{mrt}}$), solar radiation, sky view factor (SVF), and AI-driven pedestrian wind comfort. Building Envelope & Daylight: Facade-level incident solar radiation, spatial daylight autonomy (sDA), daylight factor, and direct sun hours. Indoor Performance: High-speed interior building energy balance and transient thermal performance. Workflows, Auto-Reporting & Agentic Engine: A core pillar of our product is automated spatial intelligence. We chain multi-physics solvers, spatial analytics, and LLM synthesis into automated reporting pipelines that generate audit-grade documentation directly for cities, architects, and engineering practices. Our cloud APIs and SDKs are engineered for headless orchestration by autonomous AI agents. This is a hands-on role : your day-to-day is predominantly coding, validating, and architecting these physical and data pipelines. We build fast, leaning heavily on agentic tools like Claude Code. We are hiring a focused, rock-solid Senior Urban Climate Simulation Scientist to formalize our technical validation benchmarks, co-design next-generation automated workflows, author standard-compliant technical reports, and ensure our headless agentic engines operate with uncompromising physical fidelity. You will operate as an autonomous senior individual contributor working directly with our AI engineers and executive leadership (CTO, CSO, and CPO). What You Will Do1. Hands-On Coding, Validation & Standards Benchmark our multi-scale physical models across urban microclimates, facade radiation, daylighting, and interior building energy. Write production-ready code to resolve physical discrepancies, refine boundary couplings, and enforce energy/radiant flux balances. Author authoritative, publication-ready technical validation whitepapers and reports aligned with formal engineering standards (e.g., VDI 3787, VDI 3783, ASHRAE 140, ISO 52016). Define rigorous domain-of-validity statements and benchmark error envelopes that municipal authorities and enterprise clients can cite with confidence. 2. Co-Design Automated Workflows & Reporting Pipelines Partner directly with our AI engineers to conceptualize, co-design, and validate new multi-step automated workflows: chaining geometry ingestion, multi-physics simulations, spatial analytics, and LLM-driven synthesis into automated design reports. Think through pipeline architectures and implement automated sanity gates, physical boundary invariants, and evaluation checks so automated generation layers never output unphysical results. Build automated regression test harnesses within our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee physics integrity across continuous releases. 3. Generate Training Data for ML Surrogates Architect scalable simulation pipelines to generate clean, diverse, high-dimensional synthetic datasets used to train our real-time AI surrogate models. Establish automated physical verification protocols (conservation laws, radiant flux limits) that surrogate models must pass before deployment into production. 4. Enable Headless, Agent-Driven Simulation Structure computational engines, SDKs, and analytical routines for headless execution, allowing autonomous AI agents to trigger simulations, parse results, and iterate on designs. Build programmatic feedback loops and assertions that enable agents to independently evaluate spatial results and navigate complex trade-offs safely. 5. Build at Velocity with Claude Code & Agentic Tools Use Claude Code and modern agentic coding environments daily to research, prototype, test, and ship code at start-up speed. Bring solid software engineering discipline—clean git practices, modular code, and automated testing—while applying deep scientific scrutiny to verify every line of generated code. Who You Are Hands-On & Productive: You like being in the code. You spend your time building, testing, validating, and thinking through pipeline mechanics rather than sitting in endless meetings. Rock-Solid on Physical Fundamentals: You never ship sloppy physics. You know how to verify boundary conditions, radiant balances, and thermodynamic principles efficiently without getting paralyzed by academic minutiae. Pipeline & Systems Thinker: You intuitively understand how to connect discrete pieces—physics solvers, spatial data, analytical algorithms, and LLM steps—into robust, repeatable workflows. items.desc: Research Associate (m/f/d) Institute for Thermal Separation Processes Remuneration according to guidelines ofMarie Skłodowska-Curie Actions ID 24226WV8 Start of employment March 1st, 2027 Application deadline December 9th, 2026 Scope fulltime, fixed term until February 28th, 2030 This position forms part of the EU FAroGels research program on food-grade, bio-based, and biodegradable aerogels and their application in sustainable food systems. The selected candidate will be employed by and will be required to enroll as a PhD student at Hamburg University of Technology, in accordance with the relevant admission and enrolment requirements. The scientific project will focus on sub- section DC15 – Doctoral Candidate: Interaction of Aerogels with Complex Food Media The Candidate will investigate how food-grade aerogels interact with complex food environments such as syrups, oils, emulsions, sauces and semi-solid matrices. The project will establish mechanistic structure–property–function relationships describing dynamic processes including swelling, shrinkage, liquid uptake, softening and partial disintegration, which determine aerogel performance in stabilisation, controlled release, sensory modification and shelf-life enhancement. The candidate will combine advanced experimental characterisation with multiscale modelling. Surface and bulk properties, including polarity, hydrogen bonding, rigidity, pore structure, charge, sorption kinetics and viscoelasticity, will be analysed using ATR-FTIR, NMR relaxometry, DSC/TGA, BET analysis, rheology and dynamic sorption. Real-time changes in complex media will be studied using optical and X-ray imaging, swelling analysis, tribology and microfluidic tools. Modelling activities will include diffusion–sorption models, continuum mechanics, coarse-grained simulations and data-driven predictive approaches. The goal is to develop predictive tools and practical guidelines for selecting aerogels for specific food applications. Hosted at TU Hamburg within FAroGels, the project includes secondments at partners and projects as METU, Barilla and Aerofybers, providing complementary training in rheology, oral tribology and others YOUR TASKS Conduct research on development, characterization and validatation of food-grade, bio-based and biodegradable aerogels for sustainable food systems Plan, perform, document and analyse experimental work using relevant laboratory, analytical, processing and/or modelling methods Participate actively in FAroGels network meetings, workshops, training schools, seminars and transferable-skills activities Undertake planned secondments at FAroGels partner organisations, as specified for the DC project Work collaboratively with academic and non-academic partners across the FAroGels network ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA Researchers recruited within the Doctoral Network must be Early Stage Researchers (ESRs) and must not have a doctoral degree. items.desc: Ce poste n’existe pas encore : tu serais la première personne à l’occuper, et tu le construis avec nous. Dans un grand groupe, on ne peut pas imaginer une formation à l’IA sans savoir ce que l’entreprise permet vraiment : quels outils sont autorisés, à quelles données on a accès, ce que la DSI accepte de connecter. On cherche quelqu’un qui sait faire le pont : comprendre la technique assez bien pour parler d’égal à égal avec une DSI, et la transformer en parcours que n’importe qui peut suivre. Un exemple de projet qu’on a en ce moment : un bootcamp de deux jours pour une trentaine de collaborateur·ices non techniques d’un grand groupe, sur Microsoft Copilot. Le client récolte des idées de cas d’usage auprès de ses équipes. Ton rôle : trier ces idées selon ce qui est réaliste (pédagogiquement et techniquement), construire le déroulé, et faire en sorte que chacun·e reparte avec un petit cas d’usage qui fonctionne vraiment. Ce que tu feras : Tu interviens du début à la fin. En amont, avec les équipes de Pantomeno, tu aides à comprendre le besoin du client, à estimer l’ampleur du projet et à construire la réponse pédagogique, et tu mènes le cadrage avec les interlocuteurs côté client, y compris les équipes techniques. Ensuite, tu conçois les parcours (programmes, exercices, supports, e-learning, ateliers, bootcamps, en français et en anglais) avec nos formateur·ices, nos créateur·ices de contenus et des expert·es techniques quand le sujet l’exige. Pendant le projet, tu gardes le fil : tu intègres les retours, tu t’adaptes quand le périmètre bouge (ça arrive souvent) et tu préviens tôt quand quelque chose coince. Tu travailles avec un·e directeur·ice de projet qui coordonne l’ensemble. Tu n’es pas là pour animer les formations, mais tu assistes à certaines sessions pour voir ce qui marche sur le terrain et améliorer les contenus. Tu t’occupes aussi de mettre de l’ordre : poser un vrai système de knowledge management pour que nos référentiels restent clairs, à jour et réutilisables. Et comme la tech va vite, la veille fait partie du job : repérer et tester les nouveaux outils, avoir des idées, nous proposer de nouveaux formats. Qui on cherche D’abord, quelqu’un d’à l’aise en anglais, vraiment : une partie de nos clients et de nos projets fonctionne dans cette langue, et tu devras mener une réunion et écrire un programme en anglais sans filet. Tu as au moins deux à trois ans d’ingénierie pédagogique derrière toi, à concevoir des programmes de formation (pas seulement à les animer), et tu as déjà travaillé sur des projets pour de grandes entreprises, avec leurs nombreuses parties prenantes, leurs circuits de validation et leurs exigences qualité. Tu as une vraie culture technique : les stacks, les connecteurs et la sécurité ne te font pas peur, et tu aimes la tech pour de bon. Si tu as déjà conçu des formations sur l’IA ou le no-code, c’est un vrai plus, tout comme Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure ou l’automatisation (Airtable, Zapier, Make, n8n). Côté personnalité, on cherche de la rigueur (c’est ce qui compte le plus pour nous : poser un cadre, documenter, tenir un planning), de la curiosité, de la créativité, et de la transparence, parce qu’on préfère savoir tôt que quelque chose coince. Tu es autonome en télétravail et tu aimes construire dans un cadre qui évolue. Conditions CDI temps plein, convention collective Syntec, démarrage dès que possible Rémunération selon profil Basé·e à Nantes ou à Paris, télétravail au quotidien. L’équipe se retrouve à Nantes toutes les 6 semaines (trajet en train pris en charge), et il y aura des déplacements ponctuels chez les clients, notamment à Paris. Le contrat comporte une clause d’exclusivité : une activité freelance en parallèle n’est donc pas compatible. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Tu rejoins une jeune entreprise en forte croissance, au cœur d’un mouvement qui change la façon de travailler (no-code et IA), avec une petite équipe bienveillante où la collaboration est au centre. Tu travailles sur des comptes ambitieux, et tu as un vrai poids sur la façon dont se construisent l’offre et la méthode, puisque tout est à poser. Si tu aimes garder un œil sur les derniers outils, ça tombe bien : la veille fait partie du poste.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Your department 
 With a department of more than 100 biostatisticians, data scientists, and data managers located at Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Indianapolis, Mannheim and Sant Cugat del Vallès, we support global projects for bringing new diagnostics to patients.
 The Opportunity 
In this role within our Biostatistics & Personalized Healthcare team, you will contribute directly to the research, development, and validation of biomarkers and Companion Diagnostics (CDx).
Working in an environment that values open collaboration and innovation, you will receive structured mentorship from senior biostatisticians while applying data science principles to high-impact diagnostic projects. You will gain hands-on experience navigating regulatory frameworks and translating complex biological data into robust diagnostic insights.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Biomarker Development & Data Science: Support the development and validation of novel biomarkers and companion diagnostic assays. 
 Statistical Programming (R): Write, validate, and execute reproducible, high-quality analysis scripts in R to process analytical and clinical datasets. 
 Data Quality & Compliance: Perform code peer-reviews and rigorous quality control checks to ensure data accuracy and adherence to internal SOPs and regulatory standards. 
 Study Planning & Design: Assist in drafting Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and performing sample size/power calculations for analytical and clinical studies.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with interdisciplinary study teams to understand data requirements and present complex statistical findings clearly.
 Who You Are 
You are a curious, analytical thinker who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about using quantitative methods to advance healthcare.
 Your Profile: 
 Education: Degree ( M.Sc ., or Ph.D.) in (Bio)statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Physics, Epidemiology, or a related quantitative field. 
 Diagnostic Statistics: Foundational understanding of statistical methodologies relevant to diagnostic applications (e.g., ROC curve analysis, cut-off determination, logistic regression, survival analysis, or longitudinal modeling). 
 Technical Toolkit: Strong knowledge of R and report automation tools ( LaTeX , R Markdown , knitr , or Quarto ). Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools/workflows is a plus. 
 Communication Skills: Ability to break down complex quantitative concepts and communicate them clearly to non-statistical team members. Strong organization and technical documentation skills. 
 Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. 
 Preferred : Previous exposure to diagnostic/pharmaceutical research or clinical trial data analysis through internships, working student roles, or academic research projects.
 What do we offer? 
We offer competitive compensation and excellent social benefits like flexible work schedule and home office policies, medical insurance, pension plan, allowances for marriage and birth, training related to your career development, gym, meal allowance, flexible remuneration scheme with its fiscal advantages and other benefits
 https://youtu.be/Jtm7g7fBnlQ 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About Anthropic 
 Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About Beneficial Deployments 
 Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. Our goal is for Claude to close the loop on scientific discovery, and a significant part of this is helping Claude to drive scientific hardware and software. You'll help deploy the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) to labs doing the world’s most important research. You’ll scale what you learn in the field by contributing back to the standard, building scalable assets, and driving associated internal product and research direction.
 Responsibilities 
 Work with labs to automate their experiments end-to-end with Claude - from advising, to prototyping, to writing production code.
 Drive product, engineering and research direction based on field experience - e.g. building evals to measure limitations of our models in the physical world (capabilities and safety), developing new features on MHS, etc.
 Scale your impact to the long tail of labs through reusable cookbooks, documentation, and other assets.
 Be an EMEA ambassador for Claude in the lab - you’ll both inspire and build trust with scientific audiences, from small settings to large conferences.
 This role will require significant travel
 You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 
 Hands-on experience connecting software to lab robots and instruments (liquid handlers, plate readers, scheduling software, LIMS), ideally in an automated lab.
 Strong engineering skills: you can take an LLM-powered tool from prototype to production code, and write evals to measure its performance.
 A scientist's instinct for how experiments work: you can spot what's worth automating, and where AI might fail or be unsafe in the physical world.
 Experience working directly with external customers or partners in a technical role.
 Clear written and verbal communication: you’ll write docs other labs can use without you and give talks that inspire and earn researchers' trust.

Job Description: 
 Ready to join one of our Airbus Programs in Spain? 
 AIRBUS offers an internship (curricular practicum) program aimed at students who are in the last year of their degree with the main objective of acquiring professional skills through the development of a project in the company.
 What do we offer? : Internship (curricular practicum) program + Bachelor’s Degree Final Project (TFG).
 Mission: You will prepare a final year training project that will allow you to complete your official studies. 
 About practical training: 
 6 months of curricular practicum at AIRBUS from February to July 2027 
 Part time: 5h / day - 25 hours per week (8h-13h) 
 Tutor assignment for continuous monitoring 
 Final project (TFG) to be carried out by the student: 
 Background: 
 Simulation is an essential capability for aerospace engineering, system development and verification. However, defining meaningful simulation scenarios often requires substantial manual effort and domain expertise. 
 Recent advances in generative AI, constraint-based reasoning and automatic search offer new opportunities to support simulation engineers in scenario creation and exploration. 
 TFG Objetive: 
 The objetive of this TFG is to desing and implement a proof of concept that uses AI techniques to generate, validate and explore simulation scenarios from high-level requirements. 
 Main Activities: 
 - Review state-of-the-art approaches for AI-based scenario generation and simulation testing. 
 - Define a representative aerospace-inspired simulation use case and a structured scenario model. 
 - Develop and AI-assisted scenario generator and a deterministic validation mechanism. 
 - Integrate the prototype with a suitable simulation backend. 
 - Analyse simulation logs to evaluate scenario outcomes. 
 - Document the architecture, findings, limitations and opportunities for further research. 
 Required skills #AirbusDiversity 
 As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience: 
 We are looking for a student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Aerospace Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Interest or experience in Python, C++. generative AI, software development, simulation, automated testing, optimisation or data analysis would be valuable 
 The ideal candidate is curious, analytical and motivated to explore how emerging AI techniques can address real engineering challenges. 
 A minimum English level of B2 is required, with C1 preferred, as the TFG might involved technical documentation, research and collaboration in an international environment. A minimum Spanish level B1 is also required. 
 The candidate should demonstrate a strong team spirit, good communication and collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in multicultural and multinational teams 
 Why should you apply? 
 - Foster your development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects. 
 - Expand your network within the aeronautical industry. 
 - Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place. 
 - Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space. 
 - Get in touch with the industrial sector at a leading company in Spain

Job Description: 
 The Services Analytics Plateau (working mode: Agile Scrum) is searching for an experienced

 The project you will be working on represents Airbus Defence and Space's analytics capabilities for our largest customers and all our large aircraft. It delivers improved performance and customer experience and enables a rapid understanding of the potential of digitalization for our customers.

 We have well over 100 data products and operate more than 50 use cases in production. In addition, we already have a data pool of several terabytes.

 Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Ask the right questions to support the discovery process
 Identify the data-analytics problems that offer the greatest opportunities to the organization
 Perform exploratory data analysis using visualization and sense
 You are or will be familiar with our business and actively follow market trends
 You present your findings to stakeholders using visualization and other means
 Collating data and "data wrangling", i.e. transforming, cleansing and linking it with other data.
 Providing data sets for machine data models; determining relationships between data source attributes
 Apply data mining techniques to carry out statistical analysis.
 Create and validate models, also but not only using ML
 Exploratory analyses of data, extraction of specific content, patching, and statistical analysis
 Develop and implement programm prototypes and production code, mainly in Python
 Supporting the execution of proof-of-concept and ad-hoc requests within the community
 Development and handling of MCMC simulations, as well as output analysis.
 Driving new working methods and new data governance models.
 Presenting results to diverse audiences; from engineers to managers
 Sharing and exchanging knowledge with other teams and working closely with the different support teams, the design office et al.
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 M.Sc. (ideally Ph.D.) in statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace engineering or a related field
 Several years of relevant professional experience working in data-driven projects, preferably within an Agile environment
 Demonstrated expertise in processing and analyzing of: Aircraft sensor and maintenance data, or Aircraft or fleet data, including ILS (Integrated Logistics Support) or in-service data
 Hands-on experience in the development and implementation of health monitoring, predictive maintenance, or Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) models for the aerospace sector
 Deep knowledge and expertise in data analysis and statistical interpretations of data (e.g. probability distributions, statistical tests, anomaly detection, Bayesian inference)
 Experience working in Big Data Projects using Spark and Spark-Submit Jobs for building ELT pipelines and creating data products
 Working knowledge of Unix systems, including command-line operations and scripting (e.g., Bash)
 Expertise in DevOps and Python coding in a production environment, as well as excellent knowledge of SQL technologies and databases
 Experience in the development of visualization tools (e.g. Spotfire) and front-end applications (Streamlit, Django)
 Fluent in English and ideally also in German
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
 Take your career to a new level and apply …

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Role Overview 
 We are seeking creative professionals with expertise in structural dynamics to tackle challenging tasks in the mechanical analysis and testing of space structures and systems. The ideal candidate will bring initial professional experience in the mechanical design and verification of space components (satellites, instruments, structure and mechanisms) and is eager to apply and further develop their academic and practical expertise. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Requirements identification: Identify and understand relevant mechanical requirements. Especially concerning the mechanical environments, in order to identify and define the analyses necessary for design verification and validation. 
 Structural Analysis: Support the execution of static and dynamic structural analyses for space structures and systems, ensuring result plausibility through manual verification methods. 
 Performance Analysis: Conduct mechanical performance analyses for high-precision instruments and structures designed for space applications. 
 Testing & Simulation: Contribute to the simulation, oversight and post-test assessment and correlation of structures static testing, as well as vibration testing for satellites and their sub-components. 
 FEM Modeling: Develop mathematical structural models using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), focusing on application-oriented structural idealization and physical model validation using Hyperworks and NASTRAN. 
 Verification of Joints: Perform strength verification for joining elements in accordance with ESA standards. 
 Tool Development: Assist in developing internal tools for workflow optimization and the processing of analytical and test data. 
 Documentation: Write and maintain comprehensive documentation of all processes, specifically regarding mathematical models, analytical/test outcomes and compliance to requirements. 
 Requirements 
 Education: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 Experience: Prior professional experience in the design and verification of aerospace structures is highly preferred. 
 Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in static/dynamic structural analysis (FEM) and manual calculation methods. 
 Software Skills: Proficiency in Nastran and Hyperworks. Programming skills in Matlab, Python, VBA or C++ are desirable. 
 Specific Knowledge: Solid understanding of space-specific requirements; experience with composite structure design and calculation is a plus. 
 Soft Skills: A proactive, structured work style with the ability to work effectively both independently and within a team. 
 Communication: Excellent communication skills. 
 Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish (written and spoken) is mandatory.

About us
 Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence
PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

 As a Machine Learning Enginee r in Delivery , you are a problem solver and builder who is passionate about creating practical solutions that enable customers to make better engineering decisions. You are someone who can grasp advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries, and you excel at working directly with customers (and often side-by-side with them on-site) to build, deploy and maintain production-grade ML tools that are useful, and used.

You create analytics environments and resources in the cloud/on-prem that span data science, selecting the right libraries, frameworks and tools while making pragmatic product decisions that set delivery up for success. You thrive at the intersection of data sicence and software engineering, translating project outputs into tooling and products.
 With at least 1 year industry experience (post Masters or PhD) in a commercial, non-research environment, you’re ready to hit the ground running. You’re truly excited about growing your technical expertise and are naturally inclined to take ownership of MLE pipelines, continuously improving the systems and solutions you work on to ensure they are practical, impactful and meet the evolving customer needs.
 This Role 
 In this role, you’ll work closely with our customers, as well as our team of Simulation Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers, to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are solving.
 You’ll build the foundations for successful, impactful solutions by:
 Designing, building and testing data/ML pipelines, that are reliable, scalable and easily deployable in production environment.

 Work with a high-caliber, collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and operators who care deeply about doing great work, and about helping each other get better. items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE



We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on.

You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration

 - You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem

 - You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail

 - You measure whether what you built worked

 - Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.desc: Wil jij mee bepalen hoe AI een concrete plek krijgt in de dagelijkse werking van onze functionele analisten? Binnen het EverESSt-team zoeken we iemand die AI-initiatieven helpt vertalen naar praktische, herbruikbare oplossingen voor functionele analisten. Je staat dicht bij de teams en de functionele analisten, helpt hen experimenteren met concrete use cases, prompts en tools en brengt tegelijk structuur. Wat werkt in één team, help jij opschalen naar andere teams. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de Tech Lead en Product Owners en combineert AI-affiniteit met coaching, coördinatie en PMO best practices. Je coacht en ondersteunt proxies bij het inzetten van AI en helpt hen op weg met praktische use cases, prompts en relevante tools. Je stimuleert kennisdeling tussen teams door learnings en best practices samen te brengen en hands-on sessies te faciliteren. Je maakt succesvolle oplossingen herbruikbaar door wat goed werkt binnen één team te vertalen naar duidelijke werkwijzen die ook andere teams kunnen toepassen. Je brengt structuur in nieuwe AI-ideeën vanuit de teams en stemt samen met de tech lead af welke initiatieven voldoende potentieel hebben om verder op te nemen met de Product Owners. Je beheert de backlog van AI-initiatieven in Jira en zorgt ervoor dat goedgekeurde experimenten en features een duidelijke scope, eigenaar en status hebben. Je bewaakt mee de balans tussen het geplande sprintwerk en nieuwe AI-initiatieven binnen de verschillende teams. Je brengt structuur en PMO best practices in de opvolging van initiatieven, zodat experimenten gericht worden opgevolgd en vooruitgang zichtbaar blijft. Je verbindt teams en stakeholders rond AI, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat kennis en oplossingen optimaal over de teams heen worden benut. Wat breng jij mee? Je hebt ervaring als proxy en begrijpt daardoor goed hoe functionele analisten en teams in de praktijk werken. Je hebt een duidelijke affiniteit met AI en bent enthousiast om AI praktisch toepasbaar te maken binnen de dagelijkse werking. Idealiter heb je al AI-initiatieven geïmplementeerd voor functionele analisten of ervaring met vergelijkbare AI-use cases. Je bent sterk in het coachen en ondersteunen van collega's en weet mensen mee te nemen in nieuwe manieren van werken. Je kunt ideeën structureren en vertalen naar concrete acties, experimenten of backlogitems. Je voelt je comfortabel in een coördinerende rol en hebt feeling met PMO best practices en backlogopvolging. Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands. Je bent bereid om twee dagen per week vanuit Leuven te werken. Wat hebben wij jou te bieden? We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren. Je start bij een Top Employer! Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan. Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans. Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij. Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner. Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal. Mogelijkheid tot groei: afhankelijk van je eigen interesses en initiatieven, biedt Cegeka verschillende horizontale en verticale carrièrepaden.We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt. Wil jij instappen als freelancer? Geen probleem! Dan bieden wij jou een marktconform dagtarief en tal van voordelen aan. Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Neem contact met me op. Marlies Vanspauwen marlies.vanspauwen@cegeka.com +32 11 240234 LinkedIn

items.card: Vos missions au quotidien Vous êtes passionné par la Data Science, l'Intelligence Artificielle et les marchés financiers ? Rejoignez l'équipe Business Intelligence de SGCIB, une équipe récemment créée au sein des opérations de marché dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en informations exploitables pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel, accélérer la prise de décision et développer les usages innovants
items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous êtes passionné par la Data Science, l'Intelligence Artificielle et les marchés financiers ? Rejoignez l'équipe Business Intelligence de SGCIB, une équipe récemment créée au sein des opérations de marché dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en informations exploitables pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel, accélérer la prise de décision et développer les usages innovants autour de la Data Science et de l'IA. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous souhaitons renforcer notre capacité d'innovation autour du Machine Learning et des analyses avancées afin d'explorer de nouveaux leviers d'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle sur les activités de règlement-livraison et de prêt/emprunt de titres. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Identifier, étudier et expérimenter des cas d'usage Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée pour les métiers Concevoir et développer des Proofs of Concept de Machine Learning permettant notamment de détecter des anomalies, identifier des facteurs explicatifs ou construire des modèles prédictifs Participer à l'évaluation et à la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes autour de l'Intelligence Artificielle, des plateformes analytiques en mutation et des nouvelles technologies de traitement de données Réaliser des analyses exploratoires sur de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, corrélations et opportunités d'amélioration des processus opérationnels Contribuer à la construction et à l'évolution de notre Data Factory en participant à la collecte, à la transformation et à l'enrichissement de données provenant de multiples systèmes Participer à l'industrialisation des pipelines de données et à l'amélioration continue de notre environnement analytique Accompagner la production d'études, d'indicateurs et d'analyses destinés aux équipes opérationnelles et au management Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c'était vous ? Vous préparez un diplôme Bac+5 (École d'Ingénieur, Université ou Master spécialisé) avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, Statistiques appliquées, Big Data ou Informatique décisionnelle Vous disposez idéalement d'une bonne maîtrise de Python et de son écosystème Data (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) Vous avez des connaissances en SQL, manipulation de données, Machine Learning et méthodes statistiques Vous avez une appétence pour l'analyse de données complexes et le traitement de grands volumes d'information Vous avez de l'intérêt pour les architectures de données modernes et les environnements analytiques Une connaissance de technologies telles que Spark, Databricks, dbt, Azure ou Power BI constituera un plus Qualités recherchées: curiosité intellectuelle, goût pour l'expérimentation, esprit analytique, capacité de synthèse, autonomie et force de proposition, capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs métier, esprit d'équipe et sens de la collaboration Vous avez une aisance en anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral Une première sensibilisation aux marchés financiers est appréciée mais n'est pas indispensable Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos seniors qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s'offrir à vous, en France et à l'international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d'avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d'Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport...). Offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: Scope of the Role Exosens/Advanced Imaging specializes in the research, development and industrialization of opto-electronic products: IR sensors, image intensifier tubes, camera platforms for visible light, night vision, industrial inspection, thermal inspection etc. Exosens/Advanced Imaging is continuously improving the value of its cameras, both by hardware improvements and by SW and Algorithms. More specifically, these algorithms improve the image quality (denoising, contrast enhancement, …) and extract additional information from the image (detection of objects, …). Exosens wants to accelerate this activity and intensify its research in AI/ML to further improve the images to extract more and more complex data from the camera images. Objectives of the role As AI and Machine Vision Algorithms Engineer, you Are part of the SW and Algorithms team: You report to the manager of the SW and Algorithms team. Contribute to the AI technology roadmap of Exosens (co-define technical strategies, explore/identify interesting applications). Co-define roadmaps, plannings together with the manager of the SW and Algorithms team. Continuously innovate and improve the methodologies, tools, equipment. Ensure knowledge sharing inside the team. Keep track of the evolutions in your domain: Maintain relations with a broader ecosystem inside Exosens, and outside Exosens. Keep yourself up to date with new models, new approaches, … that can be relevant for Exosens. Propose new activities. Participate in funded research projects. Work on identified AI/ML applications: Depending on your seniority level, autonomously or under guidance of a senior engineer, design and implement AI/ML applications. Define solution architectures, including what algorithms to use (traditional algorithms or AI/ML models or a combination) Get familiar with the application domains of Exosens and its constraints. Explore available models and approaches to address the applications of Exosens. Select the most appropriate existing models for the applications. Define a training strategy. Train and test the models. Develop a prototype. Optimize the models for implementation on embedded devices. Develop production-grade code to be executed on embedded devices. Provide input to the camera team for hardware/power consumption/… requirements and constraints. This position is based in Leuven, Bensheim or Grenoble. Required skills and Experience: Experience Master’s degree in a relevant domain: Algorithms, machine vision, AI, … Experience in AI/ML/machine vision is a must PhD in AI/ML/machine vision is a plus Experience with embedded systems is a plus Programming experience Soft skills Conceptual thinking Analytical thinking Trouble solver mindset Self-critical Autonomous Pragmatic Excellent oral and written communication

items.desc: Ben jij klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van AI binnen ING? Via Young Colfield krijg je de kans om als Business AI Designer aan de slag te gaan bij ING. In deze rol werk je op het snijvlak van business, technologie en AI. Je denkt mee over hoe AI kan bijdragen aan het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken en vertaalt ideeën naar praktische oplossingen die echt impact maken. Je werkt in eerste instantie aan projecten binnen het Risk-domein, waar je samen met verschillende stakeholders onderzoekt hoe AI processen slimmer en efficiënter kan maken. De oplossingen die je ontwikkelt, kunnen vervolgens ook breder binnen ING worden toegepast. Zo draag je direct bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling en inzet van AI binnen de organisatie. Het team Je komt terecht in het Odysseus Team binnen de Tribe Data Management, Service & Operations van ING. Dit team richt zich op het ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen die complexe vraagstukken snel kunnen vertalen naar werkende prototypes en praktische toepassingen. De huidige focus ligt vooral op processen binnen het Risk-domein, waar AI wordt ingezet om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter te maken. Tegelijkertijd werkt het team aan een grotere ambitie: het bouwen van een schaalbaar AI-platform waarmee AI-oplossingen in de toekomst breder binnen ING kunnen worden toegepast. Je werkt in een omgeving waar business, technologie en innovatie nauw met elkaar samenwerken en waar nieuwe ideeën snel worden omgezet in concrete resultaten. Wat ga je doen? Als Business AI Designer werk je samen met product owners, business stakeholders, engineers, architecten en Risk-specialisten. Je bent de schakel tussen business en technologie en helpt bij het vertalen van vraagstukken naar slimme, werkbare AI-oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het vertalen van complexe vraagstukken naar concrete AI-oplossingen en slimme workflows. Het ontwerpen, testen en verbeteren van nieuwe concepten en prototypes. Het inzetten van moderne AI-tools en ontwikkelmethodieken tijdens ontwerp- en ontwikkeltrajecten. Het herkennen van oplossingen die breder binnen de organisatie toegepast kunnen worden. Je zoekt graag naar het ‘waarom’ achter een vraagstuk, neemt initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid en staat open voor feedback en persoonlijke groei. Bovendien krijg je energie van het maken van impact binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in innovatie. items.desc: The Department of Meteorology at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain. We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic. The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment. You can read more about us here: the Department of Meteorology. Project description Clouds and their responses to varying environmental conditions are particularly important determinants of current climate and future climate change. However, the resolution of a typical climate model is far too coarse to explicitly represent processes of relevance to cloud formation. Those processes therefore need to be parameterized, or represented as functions of large-scale state variables. Such sub-grid scale parameterizations are associated with large uncertainties, and are also computationally expensive. This project focuses on novel ways to bridge between micro- and global scales, to improve climate model accuracy, efficiency and generalizability, and leverage modern computer architecture. We will explore the use of machine learning (ML) models trained on combinations of observational data and high-resolution simulations, as alternatives to empirical parameterizations of essential, unresolved sub-grid scale processes related to turbulence, cloud formation and aerosol-cloud interaction. The tasks will include deriving and training data-driven models, coupling them to a large-scale climate model, evaluating the results against observations and traditionally parameterized models, and using the ML-enhanced model to estimate climate-relevant quantities like cloud radiative effects and forcing from aerosol-cloud interactions. The work will be carried out in close collaboration with data scientists within the Swedish e-Science Research Centre, and contribute to development of methods with applicability also beyond climate science. The successful candidate will thereby develop their skills in atmospheric science and climate modelling, but also in data science and machine learning, and in communicating and collaborating within and across disciplines. Qualification requirements In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be fulfilled before admission to the programme. You meet general entry requirements if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. The specific entry requirements additionally require a minimum of 90 higher education credits in any of the fields of meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry; and at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics as well as a degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. At least 60 higher education credits of these courses must be on the second-cycle level. In addition, proficiency in English language, equivalent to English B in Swedish high school, is required. The specific entry requirements may also be fulfilled by a person who has otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. General syllabus for doctoral studies in atmospheric science and oceanography. Selection The selection between candidates who meet the entry requirements will be made with reference to their ability to benefit from the training. However, the fact that an applicant is deemed able to transfer credits from previous training or professional experience may not alone give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Admission decisions are made in accordance with current delegation policies. Robotics & AI Group vid Luleå tekniska universitet söker en motiverad förste forskningsingenjör med fokus på hårdvaru- och mjukvaruutveckling för autonoma robotar. Robotics & AI-gruppen är involverad i många fältorienterade projekt, vilket kräver en mångsidig och proaktiv person som trivs i en miljö med högt tempo. Projektbeskrivning Du kommer att ingå i ett framstående team och samarbeta med en grupp människor med stor mångfald som arbetar inom robotik och artificiell intelligens. Arbetsuppgifter Översätta MATLAB -kod till Python/C++ . Skapa simuleringsmiljöer för olika användningsområden. Utveckla och optimera programvara för robotsystem med Python och C++ . Arbeta med ROS (Robot Operating System) för robotstyrning, navigation och perception. Integrera hård- och mjukvarukomponenter för realtidsapplikationer inom ROS . Ge stöd under experiment, både i labbmiljö och i fält. Samarbeta med ett multidisciplinärt team av ingenjörer för att förbättra systemprestanda. Utföra lödning och underhåll av robotar. Hjälp till att hantera lager av elektriska reservdelar och laboratorieutrustning. Hjälpa till att underhålla och uppgradera laboratorieutrustning. Kunskap om AI/ML applikationer i robotik Erfarenhet med hårdvarugränssnitt, sensorer och ställdon Kvalifikationer För förste forskningsingenjör krävs examen från högskola/universitet inom ämnet robotik, datavetenskap, automation, elektroteknik, mekatronik eller annat relevant tekniskt område. Examen i datavetenskap, robotik, elektronik eller annat relevant område (kandidat- eller masterexamen). Goda kunskaper i Python och C++ för robotapplikationer. Erfarenhet av ROS (ROS1 eller ROS2). Kunskap i MATLAB för simulering och analys. Erfarenhet av perceptionssystem för robotar, styrning och kinematik. Erfarenhet av Linux-miljöer och versionshantering (Git). Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga robotar och elektriska system med låg spänning. Villighet att resa och snabbt anpassa sig till nya utmaningar. Stark problemlösningsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta i en miljö med högt tempo. Information Tjänsten är på heltid under 12 månader, med möjlighet till förlängning. Arbetsort Luleå. Tillträde tidigast möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse. För varje tjänst anges ett preliminärt lönespann som baseras på befattningens krav, ansvar och marknadsläge. items.desc: Sälj en produkt branschen faktiskt behöver Heltid · Distans (arbeta var du vill i Sverige) Krav: tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning Byggbranschen är en av Sveriges största, men också en av de sista som digitaliseras på allvar. Varje vecka hålls tusentals byggmöten, där någon ska skriva protokoll, fördela åtgärder och hålla koll på besluten. Det som missas kostar tid och pengar. Lomex AI ändrar det. Byggmötet spelas in, och några minuter senare finns protokoll, åtgärdslista, riskanalys och vilka regler som berörs. Projektledare kan också ställa frågor om regelverket och få svar med källa på sekunder. Vi bygger plattformen för svenska byggbolag och söker säljare som vill vara med från början. Om rollen Du är med i ett tidigt skede och formar hur vi bearbetar marknaden. Du bokar möten och driver affärer från första samtal till signerat avtal, mot byggbolag, projektledningsbolag och tekniska konsulter. Allt sker på distans, och du har nära kontakt med grundarna hela vägen. Vad vi erbjuder Det här är en renodlad provisionsroll – med obegränsad uppsida för dig som levererar. Du arbetar på distans och säljer en produkt som är enkel att demonstrera och löser ett verkligt problem. Och du får chansen att vara med tidigt och forma både rollen och bolaget. Vem vi söker Du har tidigare arbetat med försäljning och vet hur det är att sälja och stänga affärer, till exempel inom telefonförsäljning, fältförsäljning eller B2B. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt mot tydliga mål, bygger förtroende hos beslutsfattare och räds inte ett nej – du ser det som information, inte ett stopp. Du är strukturerad, följer upp det du lovar, och kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift. Ansökan Skicka ditt CV och några rader om varför du passar för rollen. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

items.desc: Introduction UNIL is a leading international teaching and research institution, with over 5,000 employees and 17,000 students split between its Dorigny campus, CHUV and Epalinges. As an employer, UNIL encourages excellence, individual recognition and responsibility. unil.ch/work Presentation The Swiss Graduate School of Public Administration (IDHEAP) at the University of Lausanne invites applications for a PhD position in the "Information Management" research unit headed by Prof. Tobias Mettler. IDHEAP is the largest university institute in Switzerland dedicated entirely and exclusively to the public sector. We offer excellent research support in a dynamic public policy and public administration research community and are committed to promoting the careers of young scholars. Are you interested in the future of AI and the algorithmic state? Are you enthusiastic about developing research at the crossroads between Public Management and Information Systems? Join our research team in the project “Beyond the Gig Economy: Exploring the New Frontiers of Algorithmic Control”. The project examines the implications and different design alternatives of algorithms gradually replacing human decision-making. A core problem we will explore is how social norms can be encoded into algorithmic control while enabling meaningful exception handling. The ideal candidate is therefore sensitive to technical and social questions and interested in conducting challenging empirical work in a fast-moving environment. Job information Expected start date in position : November 1, 2026 / to be agreed Contract length : 1 year, renewable 2 x, maximum 4 years Activity rate : 100% Workplace : Lausanne, IDHEAP building Your responsibilities Their tasks will involve field research, design research, and publication in the field of Information Systems and related. They will spend between 10% and 20% of their time on administrative tasks. Your qualifications In order to complete our team, we are looking for someone with the following skills : Master's degree in information systems, management (with a minor in innovation, technology, or computer science) Interest in artificial intelligence beyond prompting Good knowledge of qualitative research and sensitive to interdisciplinary work Passion for writing and presenting research findings to a variety of audiences Ability to work both independently and as part of a team Innovative, accurate, reliable and persistent; Excellent knowledge of English; Excellent knowledge of French or German. What the position offers you Integration in a young, and dynamic research group in a leading institute of public administration with highly motivated and engaged members Funding for full time (100%) for four years, subject to approval of the PhD proposal by the end of the first year Attractive salary and additional financial support for conferences and methodological courses We offer a nice working place in a multicultural, diverse and dynamic academic environment. items.card: About the role Supported by funding from the BBSRC, we are seeking a talented post-doctoral research associate to join the team in the group of Professor Andrew Edwards at Imperial College London. items.desc: Job number MED05988 Faculties Faculty of Medicine Departments Department of Infectious Disease Salary or Salary range £50,733 - £59,484 per annum Location/campus South Kensington and White City Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 27 Oct 2026 About the role Supported by funding from the BBSRC, we are seeking a talented post-doctoral research associate to join the team in the group of Professor Andrew Edwards at Imperial College London. This role will investigate how polymyxin antibiotics kill Gram-negative bacteria. The position is available full time, starting by October 2026 (or as soon as possible thereafter) and is available for 12 months . Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) represents a significant and growing global health threat, with recent projections estimating that 39 million deaths will be directly attributed to AMR between 2025–2050. Of particular concern are Gram-negative bacteria such as E. coli. The emergence of multi-antibiotic resistant strains necessitates the use of reserve (last resort) antibiotics such as the polymyxins. However, this class of antibiotics are poorly efficacious and efforts to improve their use are hampered by an incomplete understanding of how they work. What you would be doing The Edwards group is based in the Department of Infectious Disease and the Centre for Bacterial Resistance Biology and encompasses scientists at all levels of experience. We are looking for candidates who can thrive in this dynamic and creative environment. The appointed candidate is expected to lead studies that aim to understand how polymyxins function, including experimental planning and execution, data analysis and presentation and writing of manuscripts. What we are looking for Essential criteria for the role include: A PhD in bacteriology or related field. Candidates who have not yet been officially awarded their PhD will be appointed as a Research Assistant within the salary range £45,399 - £48,876 per annum. Experience in genetic manipulation of Gram-negative bacteria. Experience in nanoscale imaging techniques including AFM. Ability to work collaboratively, experience in experimental planning, troubleshooting, data analysis, and safe laboratory working practices. Desirable experience for this role includes one or more of the following: Experience in studying membrane biology of Gram-negative bacteria, knowledge of antibiotics and resistance, evolution of resistance, assay development. What we can offer you Become part of a multidisciplinary team working on the major challenge of antibiotic resistance. The opportunity to develop your research career at a world-leading institution and be part of our mission to continue science for humanity. Grow your career: gain access to Imperial’s sector-leading dedicated career support for researchers as well as opportunities for promotion and progression. Sector-leading salary and remuneration package (including 41 days off a year and generous pension schemes). Be part of a diverse, inclusive and collaborative work culture with various staff networks and resources to support your personal and professional wellbeing. Further information This is a full-time, on-site post (35 hours per week). This role is for a fixed-term contract for 12 months. If you require any further details about the role, please contact: Professor Andrew Edwards – a.edwards@imperial.ac.uk. Available documents Attached documents are available under links. It is therefore advisable that you submit your application as early as possible to avoid disappointment. If you encounter any technical issues while applying online, please don't hesitate to email us at support.jobs@imperial.ac.uk. We're here to help.
