items.desc: Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de huisartsenzorg Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare : een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare. Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows. Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen. Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen. Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden. Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je: Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling. Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten. Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code. Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn. Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines. Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider. Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code. Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen. Wij bieden jou onder andere: Een marktconform salaris: tussen €2972 en €5507 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en niveau als Developer. 26 vakantiedagen + 8,33% vakantiegeld: o.b.v. een fulltime (40 uur p/w) dienstverband. Een goede pensioenregeling: met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%. Jaarlijks €500,- persoonlijk budget: wat je kunt besteden aan sport en persoonlijke groei. Hybride werken: hybride werken betekent bij ons dat je minimaal 3 á 4 dagen per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen interactie en flexibiliteit. Een uitdagende rol: met veel invloed en verantwoordelijkheid. De kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te bouwen aan AivyCare: een nieuw platform in de eerstelijnszorg. Sporten onder werktijd: bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag- en donderdagmiddag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s te gaan bootcampen. Een hechte, open werksfeer: ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en sterke teamspirit. Veel ruimte voor initiatief, ontwikkeling en ondernemerschap. Enthousiast? Wil jij bouwen aan AI-oplossingen die echt verschil maken in de (huisartsen)zorg? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

items.desc: Software Engineer / Business Systems (Python AI) London / WFH to £120k Are you a technologist Software Engineer with commercial AI experience who enjoys getting close to real business problems, building solutions quickly and taking them into production? You could be progressing your career at a rapidly scaling renewable energy business at the forefront of the transition to a more flexible, technology enabled energy system. With a growing portfolio of wind and solar assets across the UK, the business is expanding into energy trading and investing heavily in technology, automation and AI. As a Software Engineer, you'll work across the business, partnering with teams spanning Development, Project Delivery, Investment, Asset Management and Trading. You'll investigate real workflows, understand the underlying data and systems and determine whether AI, conventional software, automation or process change is the right solution. Collaborating with the AI Lead and domain specialists, you'll take ambiguous problems from discovery through rapid prototyping, testing and evaluation, before taking successful solutions into production. You'll work directly with users, prototype using real data and build production software across Python, APIs, data integration and lightweight frontends, incorporating LLMs, retrieval, tool use and agentic workflows where they add genuine value. You'll own your solutions through deployment and early production operation, including testing, security, permissions, monitoring and resilience. This is a high-autonomy role for a highly capable engineer who enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly from idea to PoC and takes genuine ownership of outcomes. You'll work with exceptionally bright people and have the opportunity to shape both the technology and engineering culture as the AI capability grows. Location / WFH: You'll be based in the London office with flexibility to work from home twice a week. items.desc: AI Innovation Engineer | Utrecht | €90K (Hybrid/SaaS). We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with a strong interest in AI to help shape the future of a proven SaaS platform in the real estate sector. The company develops an innovative SaaS solution used daily by hundreds of customers in the private and public sector. The product is well established, but AI is opening up new possibilities for automation and how users interact with the platform. The role: Your challenge will be to figure out what we can actually do with AI and turn those ideas into working solutions. You will build and experiment with AI agents that can understand what a user wants, work with the existing backend and databases, and take action on their behalf. A key part of this will be permissions and customer environments. An agent needs to understand not only what is technically possible, but also what a specific user is allowed to do. Think about replacing manual workflows with an AI agent that can understand a request and execute the right steps. The goal is to find opportunities where AI can simply take work off people's hands. This is a new area for the company, so you will have plenty of room to experiment. We are looking for someone who is willing to push boundaries, test ideas and ask: why are we still doing this manually if AI can do it? Requirements: We are looking for a Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience, a solid understanding of backend development and databases, and a genuine interest in AI. You don't need years of AI experience. What matters is that you understand how software works and are excited to explore how agents can be built and integrated into a real product. You will work closely with the engineering team to experiment, build prototypes and turn successful ideas into reliable features. Most importantly, you are curious, pragmatic and not afraid to try something new. Benefits: €90k Bonus Pension Hybrid working Initial 12-month contract, after that permanent. Interested? Apply or contact me via g.geefshuijsen@doghouse.nl.

Architect Internal Platforms: Build reusable backend services and APIs that let different agent products share infrastructure and grow together. Own the Full Journey: Take agents from early design through building, testing, launching, and improving them over time. Collaborate Across Teams: Work directly with every team to integrate agents and AI into products and processes across the company. We expect you to: 2+ years of solid software engineering experience. Node.js and TypeScript preferred, but not strictly necessary. Agent-building experience isn't required, but it’s a huge plus. If you've never touched an agent framework before, that's completely fine - what matters is that you're genuinely curious and ready to learn quickly once you're here. Be comfortable picking up new concepts on the fly, since things like retrieval systems, vector databases, and prompt writing don't need to be second nature yet. Be familiar with Git and general good engineering habits, like testing your work and setting up smooth ways to ship code. Have strong problem-solving abilities to troubleshoot and identify root causes of issues, whether in a traditional system or a brand-new agent workflow. Be fluent in Lithuanian and English. Our Benefits & Perks Office Location : A peaceful, green workspace in the heart of Antakalnis, Sapiegos Park. Perfect for focus and fresh air. Health Insurance: Private health insurance after 3 months to support your well-being. Parking Compensation: We cover your parking expenses, so you can commute stress-free. Work-from-Home Flexibility : Hybrid setup, 4 days in the office, 1 day from home. We stay flexible when life happens. Pet-Friendly Office : Bring your furry friend to work. Work Tools : We’ll set you up with a MacBook and all the tools you need to do your work. Grow Your Skills: We believe in learning and growth. If you need extra training or courses to level up, we’re here to support you. Daily Meals : Lunch is prepared in the office every day. On Fridays, we mix it up, sometimes we head out to San Diego Pub, other times we order in pizza, sushi, or other. Snacks & Refreshments : Unlimited drinks, snacks, fresh fruits, and veggies. Team Events : team buildings, summer/winter events, and activities to keep the vibes going. Birthday Surprise : We celebrate your birthday with a gift. Referral Bonus Program : Know someone awesome? Get rewarded for helping us grow. Salary Gross salary range is 3000-6500 EUR/month. *Salary is negotiable depending on experience.

items.desc:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. 
 In addition to great shows and movies, our membership now includes exclusive access to a growing portfolio of high-quality games. The Game Lifecycle Engineering team builds the systems, tools and capabilities that make Netflix the easiest place for anyone to create, launch, and operate high‑quality games at scale. Our work supports the entire lifecycle of games, from onboard to sunset, at Netflix scale. 
 This role is key to how we build the tools and experiences that game developers rely on - from developer-facing web applications to cross-platform desktop tooling. You'll help build and set direction for how the tools and the shared services behind them come together into a cohesive developer experience. You will excel if you are comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with innovation, can deliver scalable technical solutions, remove technical debt, influence and make strategic decisions for long-term effectiveness, and approach problems with a curiosity-driven lens. 
 Our ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer, who collaborates across teams extremely well, thinks beyond implementation details, can empathize with fellow developers, challenges assumptions, and helps shape the "why" behind what we build. They should bring a strong perspective on product direction, code reuse, and design, not just execution, and be comfortable working at the intersection of user experience, design, and modern web application development across both web and desktop. 
 What will you do: 
 Drive new technical solutions across teams, from system design to deployment. 
 Make impact across all layers of the software stack: backend services, insights systems, UI component libraries, documentation, or integration with other applications. 
 Revamp and update existing tools and services for integration into developer workflows. 
 Work with other software engineering teams, product management, and stakeholders across Netflix to gather insights, identify opportunities, and define solutions that will scope and shape our decisions. 
 Operate in a cross-functional and dynamic environment where you will collaborate and learn with stunning colleagues from a variety of technical domains and backgrounds to achieve the common goal of entertaining the world. 
 Participate in our support and on-call rotation and lead the incident reviews. 
 What are we looking for: 
 Proven professional experience with a track record of owning complex features from ideation to deployment. 
 Back-end excellence: expertise in building the backends behind the UI and designing clean, well-documented APIs that integrate with platform services. Familiarity with a backend language like Java, Go, or Python is a plus. 
 Robust front-end engineering: proficiency in frontend with a deep understanding of state management and the ability to build reusable component libraries that ensure consistency across tools. Experience working with design systems is a plus. 
 You're comfortable operating what you build, not just shipping it. 
 Adaptability: proven ability to master in-house frameworks and services, finding ways to leverage and extend them to create high-leverage solutions. 
 Curiosity and selflessness: bridging the gap between teams, prioritizing outcomes and impact in an ambiguous environment. 
 Passion for developer experience: you care about the engineers who use what you build, and you can take a feature from idea to a well-designed, intuitive UI, that works well with agents. 
 Experience with AI, AI coding tools and agents in day-to-day development/activites. 
 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. 
 We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Equity is a big part of how we reward the people building ElevenLabs, and the programme is growing fast across many countries. You'll own the day-to-day running of it: keeping our cap table accurate and audit-ready, and making sure every grant, exercise and leaver is handled correctly and on time.

You'll work with Finance, Legal and People to turn board-approved decisions into clean records and clear communication. That includes issuing grants, supporting 409A and local valuations, and answering employee questions about their equity.

We're looking for someone who is meticulous about the numbers and who treats employees as customers. You'll find ways to automate the repetitive work, using AI wherever it makes things faster and more reliable.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience administering equity in a cap table or stock plan platform such as Carta, including grants, vesting, exercises, terminations, settlements and reconciliations.

 - Experience administering equity across multiple jurisdictions, including tracking globally mobile participants and coordinating with Tax and Payroll.

 - Strong understanding of stock options, RSUs, vesting schedules and employee lifecycle changes, with working knowledge of relevant tax-advantaged schemes such as US ISOs and UK EMI or CSOP plans.

 - Experience reconciling equity data with People, Talent, Payroll and Accounting records.

 - Understanding of stock-based compensation accounting sufficient to provide reliable data and support Finance with US GAAP and local reporting requirements.

 - Experience building and documenting equity processes and controls, managing deadlines independently and resolving discrepancies.

items.desc: 35170 Bruz, Bretagne CDD A propos de Sogitec Venez faire décoller vos talents à nos côtés ! Société d’ingénierie en aéronautique, SOGITEC est leader dans la conception, le développement, la production et la fourniture de produits et services de simulation, pour la formation et l’entrainement au sol des pilotes et mécaniciens qui emploient et soutiennent les aéronefs réels. Filiale à 100% de Dassault Aviation, l’entreprise compte plus de 300 collaborateurs et s’impose comme un partenaire de premier niveau au service des constructeurs aéronautiques. Combinant sa longue expérience des exigences opérationnelles et ses compétences dans l’intégration des nouvelles technologies, telles que l’intelligence artificielle ou la réalité virtuelle, SOGITEC investit dans la recherche et l’innovation. Ainsi, SOGITEC intervient en tant que maître d'œuvre de programmes français et internationaux, complexes, pluriannuels et impliquant de multiples coopérations industrielles. SOGITEC s’appuie sur un socle d’affaires en forte consolidation grâce aux ventes du RAFALE et de ses moyens de simulation, dont il est le fournisseur exclusif. De plus, SOGITEC s’adapte aux besoins d’entraînement des Forces aériennes pour les derniers hélicoptères d’AIRBUS Helicopter par la fourniture des simulateurs de NH90 et prochainement du tout nouveau HIL (H160M). Enfin, SOGITEC développe de nouveaux produits de simulation dans les domaines des drones et des hélicoptères, y compris pour le personnel dédié à l’emploi du treuil et de l’armement. Ces succès reposent sur des équipes passionnées et dynamiques, d’un très haut niveau d’expertise technique, sur l’envie de repousser les limites et la capacité à faire face aux exigences d’une activité en constante évolution pour construire l’avenir. Votre mission THESE EN INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE : CONTRÔLE PAR INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE DES ENTITÉS VIRTUELLES D’UN SIMULATEUR DE VOL AFIN D’ATTEINDRE LES OBJECTIFS DE LEUR MISSION. A SOGITEC, VOUS SEREZ : Dans le cadre de ses activités de simulation d’avions d’armes et d’hélicoptères, SOGITEC souhaite renforcer sa capacité à modéliser et à simuler le comportement des forces en présence à partir de techniques d’intelligence artificielle. Les simulateurs développés par ses équipes s’appuient sur un serveur tactique pour animer les entités aériennes, terrestres et navales présentes sur le théâtre d’opérations virtuel. Pour un opérateur ou un moniteur simulation, paramétrer chacune de ces entités requiert un travail fastidieux pour obtenir le résultat souhaité en termes de déplacement ou réaction. Depuis plusieurs années, SOGITEC investigue des méthodes d’apprentissage machine afin d’envisager un contrôle plus intuitif des entités programmables. Les algorithmes employés ont jusqu’ici produit des résultats prometteurs mais l’entreprise souhaite poursuivre ses travaux de recherche afin d’identifier des solutions flexibles capables de gérer des situations plus complexes (grand nombre d’entités, diversité des missions/situations, etc). Dans ce contexte SOGITEC et ISAE-SUPAERO souhaitent travailler en collaboration, au travers d’une thèse CIFRE, pour lever les verrous technologiques correspondants :  Recenser les missions d’intérêt, identifier le meilleur moyen de modéliser ces missions et de les paramétrer par un utilisateur.  Identifier l’architecture algorithmique de contrôle des entités qui doit en résulter.  Statuer sur le niveau de contrôle.  Évaluer la scalabilité/portabilité de la solution. Votre profil AUJOURD’HUI VOUS ÊTES : Vous devez disposer d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Bac+5 avec un M2 recherche ou avec une expérience avérée de recherche (obligatoire). Cadre de travail : Vous serez rattaché(e) à la Direction des Simulations à SOGITEC, et serez sous la responsabilité de son chef de service. En tant que doctorant(e) spécialisé(e) dans l’IA, vous devez être en capacité d’imaginer de nouvelles solutions dans ce domaine, adaptées à nos problématiques. Vous serez également inscrit(e) à l’ISAE-SUPAERO, Université de Toulouse, qui sera votre laboratoire d’accueil doctoral. Vous serez rattaché(e) au département DCAS, sous la supervision de ses directeurs de thèse. Vous participerez également à des projets stratégiques intégrant (non exhaustif) le Deep Learning avancé, Apprentissage par Renforcement (RL) ou encore l’IA générative et modèles de langage (LLM), et serez en en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions algorithmiques performantes et industrialisables chez SOGITEC. Dans ce cadre, vous réaliserez des travaux d'études bibliographiques, d'études algorithmiques, de prototypage, de développement logiciel, de spécification logicielle, d'architecture et conception, de test des solutions (robustesse, performance, etc), de rédaction de publications (et participation à des conférences du domaine). Compétences scientifiques et techniques recherchées …

items.desc: Make your mark for patients UCB is an international biopharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of pharmaceutical and biotechnological products. It specializes in researching therapeutic solutions for patients suffering from severe diseases, treated by specialists, particularly in the fields of the central nervous system (including epilepsy) and inflammation (including allergies). The Braine-l'Alleud site specializes in chemical synthesis, development, manufacturing, and packaging of pharmaceutical products. More information at: www.ucb.com Description of the role Under the supervision of project leaders and senior scientists, support the development and implementation of cellular and biochemical assays for therapeutic projects in the neurodegeneration field. Independently perform routine laboratory tasks and conduct a variety of experiments including, but not restricted to, mammalian cell cultures (cell lines and primary neurons), immunocytochemistry, protein and RNA extraction, (capillary) Western blot, qPCR, ELISA, FRET and luciferase assays. Accurately document and report experiments in electronic lab notebook. Present data clearly and concisely during internal meetings. Join a dynamic, international and cross-functional team environment. This is a unique opportunity to engage in exciting science with cutting edge technologies while supporting therapeutic projects in a biopharmaceutical industry setting. Candidate Master’s degree in cell and molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry or related field with 2+ years of working experience in an academic lab or in the industry or, alternatively, recently graduated PhD in the same subjects. Experience in manipulation of mammalian cell cultures, immunocytochemistry, microscopy, image analysis, (capillary) Western blot, qPCR, ELISA. Experience in mouse primary neuron cultures and/or human iPSC-derived neurons are considered strong plus. Ability to analyze large-scale protein and RNA expression datasets using computational tools and statistical methods is considered a plus. Ability to quickly learn new techniques when required. Fluent written and spoken English is a must; French is desirable, but not required. Please note that this program is in partnership with Business France, and we follow the prerequisites required by Business France to carry out a VIE assignment. The main participation prerequisites are as follows: Be between 18 and 28 years old; Hold the nationality of a member country of the European Economic Area; Have not worked or lived in the country where the mission will take place; Be available to dedicate yourself to the mission full-time; If you have French nationality or dual nationality, be in compliance with the national service obligations of France (Numéro Identifiant Défense); Have a clean criminal record. items.desc: Make your mark for patients UCB is an international biopharmaceutical company primarily engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of pharmaceutical and biotechnological products. It specializes in researching therapeutic solutions for patients suffering from severe diseases, treated by specialists, particularly in the fields of the central nervous system (including epilepsy) and inflammation (including allergies). The Braine-l'Alleud site specializes in chemical synthesis, development, manufacturing, and packaging of pharmaceutical products. More information at: www.ucb.com We are looking for a dynamic and collaborative Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Laboratory Associate Scientist to join our global Biologics MSAT team based at UCB’s campus in Braine-l’Alleud, Belgium. In this role, you will perform laboratory work to support process development activities and address the needs of commercial manufacturing groups worldwide. You will also build strong technical and scientific partnerships with process development, manufacturing, and external partner organizations, acting as a laboratory expert in downstream processing (DSP). The MSAT Laboratory Associate Scientist will play a key role in: Conducting downstream processing studies to enhance process understanding. Providing laboratory support for technology transfers, process validation activities, manufacturing operations, and deviation/investigation support through the execution of DSP and analytical experiments within MSAT. Performing product quality analysis on cell culture and downstream process samples using a variety of analytical techniques. Planning and coordinating DSP and analytical laboratory activities. Supporting the implementation and transfer of analytical methods within the MSAT laboratory for late-stage and commercial products. Establishing small-scale DSP laboratory models for commercial products, including chromatography and tangential flow filtration (TFF) processes. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Experience in downstream processing (DSP) and/or analytical techniques is an asset. Prior laboratory experience is a plus. Fluency in English is required. Basic proficiency in French is required. Please note that this program is in partnership with Business France, and we follow the prerequisites required by Business France to carry out a VIE assignment. The main participation prerequisites are as follows: Be between 18 and 28 years old; Hold the nationality of a member country of the European Economic Area; Have not worked or lived in the country where the mission will take place; Be available to dedicate yourself to the mission full-time; If you have French nationality or dual nationality, be in compliance with the national service obligations of France (Numéro Identifiant Défense); Have a clean criminal record. If you do not meet all these conditions, we will not be able to consider your application.

items.desc: Your Work Context For this position good knowledge of the French language is a prerequisite.Jan De Nul Group focuses on complex projects and offers clients, private or public, a total customized package. This approach, plus the technical expertise and years of experience, ensures that we, also for civil works, belong to the absolute top.Are you (almost) graduated in accountancy or an economic field and do you want to make a solid start in project controlling? As a Project Cost Controller on our sites in Wallonia, you receive responsibility and trust from day one within a stable and substantively strong role. You build expertise at the heart of our projects and make a real impact on site. Your Role A job at the crossroads of finance and site reality. As a Project Cost Controller , you work from your office on site and closely follow up the financial processes, right in the middle of the project. You are often on the road and present on site, which ensures a lot of variety and a job full of action.You are the financial point of contact on site: colleagues rely on you for financial questions and decisions. You dive deep into budgets, costs and forecasts, identify deviations and clearly map risks and opportunities. You work independently, but at the same time you are a fixed link within the site team and see the impact of your work every day.Your main tasks and responsibilities: You prepare the budget control and financial reporting for your sites and draw up sharp forecasts, including updates of the order portfolio. You are jointly responsible for the follow-up of all costs and revenues of the assigned project and prepare reports of the results. You take responsibility for the correctness of the figures on a monthly basis and adjust where necessary. You report at regular intervals and in a structured and objective manner to management/the executive board, so that timely adjustments can be made to achieve the financial and strategic objectives. You provide project managers and site managers with insight into the (current and future) financial results of the project/department and support them when financial issues arise. You stay up to date with developments within controlling, keep your knowledge up to date and think along with the team to take controlling to a higher level. You work from our sites in Wallonia, build new expertise with each project and can count on an attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits. What you need You have a master’s degree in an economic field (Applied Economics, Commercial Engineer, Business Sciences) or a bachelor’s degree in Accountancy. Experience in controlling, accounting, audit or civil projects is a nice plus, but motivated starters are also certainly welcome.You are analytically strong, work accurately and get enthusiastic about correct figures. You take responsibility independently, but at the same time work smoothly together with site and project management as a fixed link within the site team. You like a job full of action and variety and can express yourself professionally in French, Dutch and English.You start on sites in Wallonia, where you quickly build experience at the heart of our projects. Working at Jan De Nul Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day, with the aim of ensuring the global quality of life for generations to come. A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional work from home). An open-ended contract with 42 paid vacations (20 statutory, 12 ADV and 10 public holidays). An attractive salary with thirteenth month and double vacation pay included: Meal vouchers and eco vouchers. Possibility to participate in the Flex Reward program including bicycle and car leasing including fuel card in Belgium. Intervention of public transport and bicycle allowance. Group and hospitalization insurance. Option of iPhone with telephony and data subscription (subject to contribution). Various staff discounts. You are part of an international growing family business where connect, respect, challenge and focus are key. Applicable with a Belgian contract. Je hebt ervaring met het verwerken, analyseren en rapporteren van data en werkt graag met cijfers. Je bent een Excel-expert en hebt kennis van Office 365, SharePoint en Power BI. Kennis van Aveva (PI), VBA of Python is een pluspunt. Je hebt interesse in milieu en duurzaamheid en bent bereid je verder te verdiepen in CO₂-emissies, milieuwetgeving en rapporteringen. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden en communiceert vlot in het Nederlands. Basiskennis van Frans en Engels is een pluspunt. Je draagt voortdurend zorg voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van jezelf én van je collega’s. Uit onderzoek is gebleken dat mannen al reageren op een functie wanneer zij voor 60% voldoen aan de wensen van de toekomstig werkgever. Terwijl vrouwen pas reageren wanneer zij zelf vinden een 100% match te zijn. Zonde! Mocht je nu niet aan alle wensen voldoen en wel interesse hebben, laat het ons weten. We komen graag met je in contact! items.desc: WE ARE LOOKING FOR EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER (AUTOMOTIVE) We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. You will start your journey in a consultant role in an international automotive software project for a major automotive client. You will join an experienced team working on in-vehicle software that reaches customers. The team makes sure the vehicle software runs reliably, adding features, investigating problems from test and customer vehicles, and delivering fixes into production releases. You will also have access to cutting-edge AI tooling in your daily development work. Your future colleagues are waiting for you to join our international team. Working with us is uncomplicated, there’s a good team spirit, low hierarchy and nonexistent bureaucracy. Our working arrangements are flexible, with occasional evening availability from around 18:00 Finnish time needed to collaborate with colleagues in California. We strongly prefer candidates who can work on site in Helsinki or Tampere , where the development hardware is located. Skills Required Kotlin C/C++ Android AOSP Git Linux Debugging Locations Tampere Helsinki WHAT YOU WILL DO: Develop, integrate and test complex embedded software for in-vehicle systems. Investigate and fix system-level issues such as crashes, restarts and performance problems. Test and debug on development hardware in the office and on remote test benches. Deliver changes through code review and the client’s build and release process. Work closely with client engineers and managers in the US, and with technology partners. Share clear written progress updates and keep tasks up to date. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 5+ years of experience in embedded software development. Good programming skills in one or more languages, such as C/C++, Java/Kotlin or Python. Experience with Android and/or Linux-based systems. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Familiarity with Git/GitLab, code reviews and continuous integration. Experience using advanced AI tools. Fluent English, written and spoken. Ability to work independently, take initiative and ownership of tasks, solve problems proactively and ask for help when needed. NICE TO HAVE: Experience in automotive, mobile or other complex embedded products. Experience with low-level topics such as boot, memory, drivers or virtualisation. Experience with AOSP, Android Automotive or QNX. Experience with vehicle data, telemetry or over-the-air software updates. Experience working with hardware vendors or subcontractors. WHY JOIN UNIKIE? Il apporte des solutions concrètes à leurs besoins dans quatre domaines principaux : transition énergétique, transition numérique, technologies pour la médecine du futur, défense et sécurité sur un socle de recherche fondamentale. Le CEA s'engage depuis plus de 75 ans au service de la souveraineté scientifique, technologique et industrielle de la France et de l'Europe pour un présent et un avenir mieux maîtrisés et plus sûrs. Implanté au cœur des territoires équipés de très grandes infrastructures de recherche, le CEA dispose d'un large éventail de partenaires académiques et industriels en France, en Europe et à l'international. items.desc: La cybersécurité est un enjeu stratégique pour toutes les organisations. Et pour vous ? Rejoignez notre centre d’excellence en innovation à Montpellier, un environnement où l’intelligence artificielle, les technologies émergentes, la création de nouvelles solutions et l’innovation sont au cœur de notre stratégie. Contribuez à transformer l'expérience digitale de nos clients en explorant des domaines en constante évolution, tels que le numérique responsable, le marketing digital, l'UX, la RPA, la data, le développement web et mobile, l’API management, ainsi que la cybersécurité. Stack Technique / Environnement Projet Linux ; Bash / Python ; Docker ; Kubernetes; Container Security, Network Security, GitLab CI/CD / Jenkins ; Terraform ; Ansible ; SAST / DAST / SCA ; Cloud ; OWASP; Monitoring, gestion des logs et alerting ; Git; Azure / AWS / GCP Security Fonctions et responsabilités Concevoir, déployer et maintenir des chaînes CI/CD sécurisées et automatisées. Intégrer les contrôles de sécurité SAST, DAST et SCA au sein des pipelines CI/CD. Automatiser l’analyse des vulnérabilités du code, des dépendances et des images de conteneurs. Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion sécurisée des secrets et des accès. Concevoir et maintenir des infrastructures automatisées selon les principes Infrastructure as Code. Réaliser des revues de sécurité des architectures cloud, conteneurisées et hybrides. Sécuriser les environnements conteneurisés et leurs processus de déploiement. Définir et automatiser les contrôles de conformité et de sécurité des infrastructures. Participer à l'évaluation de la posture de sécurité des environnements Linux, réseaux, systèmes et plateformes DevOps. Participer au durcissement des systèmes, des conteneurs et des environnements d’exécution. Mettre en place des mécanismes de supervision, de journalisation et d’alerting liés à la sécurité. Analyser les vulnérabilités détectées, qualifier les risques techniques et contribuer à leur remédiation. Automatiser les opérations récurrentes de déploiement, de configuration et de sécurisation. Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques DevSecOps et des processus de développement sécurisé. Accompagner les équipes de développement et d’exploitation dans l’intégration de la sécurité dès les premières étapes du cycle de développement. Contribuer à la définition et au maintien de standards techniques de sécurité et d’automatisation. Utiliser des outils CI/CD tels que GitLab CI/CD ou Jenkins. Maîtriser l’Infrastructure as Code avec Terraform et l’automatisation avec Ansible. Utiliser des outils d’analyse de sécurité SAST, DAST et SCA. Maîtriser les principes de gestion des secrets et des accès dans les environnements DevOps. items.desc: Delair Delair, leader mondial du drone professionnel, fournit des données basées sur l’imagerie aérienne pour aider les industriels dans leur processus de décision. Spécialiste de la fabrication de drones et du traitement des données collectées, Delair met à disposition des professionnels des solutions complètes depuis l’acquisition de données jusqu’à leur analyse opérationnelle. En intégrant Delair, vous participerez bien plus qu’à la commercialisation de drones industriels dans le monde entier. Nous croyons que le drone professionnel est part intégrante de la révolution numérique en cours et nous participons à son développement afin qu’il devienne incontournable dans les décisions stratégiques de demain. C'est dans l'excellence technique et ce processus d'innovation perpétuel que nous nous reconnaissons. Nous encourageons par conséquent les idées novatrices et permettons à la créativité de s'exprimer. Etes-vous prêt à rejoindre l'aventure et à participer à son développement ? Vos missions Rattaché à l’équipe Innovation sur les essaims de drones (basée à Grenoble), vous occupez un poste charnière et polyvalent à l’interface avec l’équipe en charge du développement de la station sol (basée à Toulouse). Votre mission principale consiste à élaborer les fonctions d’interface utilisateur permettant d’exploiter les essaims de drone. A ce titre, vous spécifiez, concevez et contribuez au développement des interfaces utilisateurs en lien avec les équipes Station Sol. Selon votre domaine d’expertise, vous pourrez également contribuer à l’élaboration des briques algorithmiques de perception, navigation et guidage des essaims ainsi qu’au développement de solutions de simulation. À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Conception & Architecture UI/UX : Définir les fonctions d’interaction homme machine pour les essaims de drone. Participer à la définition de l’architecture logicielle des applications UI, concevoir les mockups (UX/UI). Implémentation & Prototypage UI : Développer en autonomie les prototypes et nouvelles fonctionnalités de l'interface utilisateur dédiée aux essaims de drones, dans le respect de l'architecture logicielle établie. Intégration & Spécifications Essaims : Être le/la garant(e) des spécifications UI dédiées aux essaims de drones et assurer l'interface avec les briques logicielles bas niveau (C/C++). Contribution aux briques Robotique : Apporter votre expertise technique (automatique, SLAM, planification, simulation, IA, etc.) aux projets globaux de l'équipe Innovation de Grenoble. Expérimentation Terrain : Participer activement aux campagnes d'essais réels pour tester, valider et éprouver l'ensemble de vos développements sur le terrain. Votre profil Issu(e) d’une formation de niveau Bac+5 ou Doctorat en robotique, vision par ordinateur ou intelligence artificielle appliquée à la robotique, vous disposez d’un profil scientifique et technique polyvalent, alliant la maîtrise du développement d’interfaces modernes à une connaissance approfondie des concepts avancés en robotique autonome. Vous maîtrisez le développement d’interfaces homme-machine (IHM), appliquez les bonnes pratiques en matière de développement UI/UX et vous épanouissez dans des environnements technologiques complexes et pluridisciplinaires. Cœur de compétences UI & Logiciel : Développement UI : Solide expertise en conception et développement UI/UX (mockup, architecture et développement d'interfaces complexes et JavaScript). Systèmes & Langages : Python, C/C++, JS, React Appétence Terrain : Un goût prononcé pour l'expérimentation réelle et la validation technique sur le terrain. Expertise Robotique requise : En tant que membre à part entière de l'équipe Innovation, vous devez impérativement maîtriser au moins l'un des domaines suivants pour contribuer aux travaux sur les essaims : Automatique & Contrôle : Modélisation dynamique, contrôle-commande de drones, MPC (Model Predictive Control). Localisation : SLAM visuel ou autre Optimisation & coordination de missions : Optimisation opérationnelle, planification de trajectoire. IA appliquée : IA pour la commande de systèmes robotiques et/ou la perception (vision). Simulation : environnement graphique, émulation de capteurs, SITL. NB : le poste requiert l'obtention d'une habilitation de sécurité délivrée par les autorités compétentes.

items.desc: Contexte de la missionDans le cadre du déploiement d?une solution transverse à l?échelle d?un groupe international, plusieurs entités doivent être intégrées et connectées à une plateforme commune. L?intégrateur technique intervient à chaque étape de l?onboarding des nouvelles entités, de l?analyse des flux existants jusqu?à la mise en production. Il garantit la bonne configuration des environnements, la fiabilité des échanges de données et la sécurisation des démarrages. L?objectif est également de standardiser et d?industrialiser les procédures d?intégration afin de faciliter les déploiements futurs. Missions principales1. Cadrage technique Analyser les systèmes d?information locaux et les supports techniques existants. Cartographier les flux d?échanges entre les systèmes locaux et la plateforme cible. Identifier les dépendances, les contraintes techniques et les éventuels points de blocage. 2. Intégration et configuration Coordonner ou réaliser les opérations de reprise de données et de mapping technique, en lien avec les équipes Data et Métier. Configurer et déployer la solution sur les environnements de test et de préproduction. Vérifier la conformité des échanges et la qualité des données intégrées. 3. Tests et mise en production Accompagner les tests d?intégration de bout en bout (E2E). Analyser et préqualifier les anomalies, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées. Préparer et sécuriser les plans de bascule technique. Assurer le support technique renforcé après le démarrage et accompagner les équipes locales pendant la phase d?hypercare. 4. Documentation et industrialisation Rédiger et maintenir les guides et checklists d?intégration technique. Documenter les spécificités de chaque entité intégrée. Préparer le transfert vers les équipes RUN et Support. Capitaliser sur les retours d?expérience afin de fiabiliser et d?accélérer les prochains déploiements. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un intégrateur technique disposant d?une expérience concrète dans l?intégration de systèmes d?information, la gestion des flux de données et les mises en production dans des environnements complexes. Compétences techniques requisesArchitecture et intégration : architectures orientées services (SOA), microservices, API REST/SOAP, webhooks et mécanismes de messagerie ou bus d?événements. Flux et données : maîtrise des formats JSON, XML et CSV ; SQL avancé pour l?analyse, le contrôle et la validation des données. Diagnostic technique : lecture de logs, analyse et débogage de flux, utilisation d?outils tels que Postman ou cURL. Tests et mise en production : tests d?intégration, qualification des anomalies, préparation des bascules et accompagnement post-démarrage. Compétences appréciéesConnaissance des technologies de messagerie telles que Kafka ou RabbitMQ. Expérience sur un environnement Cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure). Utilisation de Git et compréhension des pipelines CI/CD. Connaissance d?outils de supervision et de monitoring : Datadog, Kibana/Elastic, Splunk ou équivalents. Expérience de déploiement de solutions ERP, Supply Chain ou Retail dans des contextes multi-pays ou multi-entités. Savoir-êtreExcellentes capacités de communication avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métier. Pédagogie et capacité à accompagner des équipes locales. Rigueur dans le suivi des étapes d?intégration, des plannings et des procédures. Autonomie, proactivité et capacité à anticiper les risques. Sens du service et adaptabilité face à des environnements techniques et organisationnels variés. Anglais professionnel requis, à l?écrit comme à l?oral, dans un contexte international. Livrables attendusEnvironnements techniques configurés et connectés conformément aux exigences. Flux d?échanges intégrés, testés et validés. Plans de bascule et chronogrammes de mise en production documentés. Kits, guides et checklists d?onboarding technique actualisés. Documentation des spécificités de chaque entité et éléments nécessaires au transfert vers le RUN/Support. Objectif de la missionGarantir une intégration technique fiable et reproductible des différentes entités, sécuriser les mises en production et contribuer à l?industrialisation du processus d?onboarding à l?échelle du groupe.

Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs. Data Analyst H/F C’est votre future équipe Fondée en 2012, l'agence Rhône-Alpes rassemble une équipe de 120 collaborateurs. Elle accompagne près d’une vingtaine de clients, allant des grands comptes aux ETI et PME. Elle s’appuie sur un Centre de Services spécialisé dans le stockage et la sauvegarde ainsi que sur un Centre d'Expertise en sécurité. L'agence accorde une importance particulière à un recrutement fondé sur l'humain et la transparence. C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par la qualité des données, l’analyse et les solutions décisionnelles ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant que Data Analyst , vous êtes responsable de la qualité des données, de la résolution des anomalies et de l’évolution des solutions décisionnelles Microsoft BI. Côté BUILD : Développer et faire évoluer les solutions décisionnelles sous Microsoft BI. Concevoir et optimiser les requêtes SQL, les modèles de données et les objets SQL. Développer et maintenir les flux SSIS, les cubes SSAS et les rapports SSRS. Concevoir des rapports Power BI avancés et développer des indicateurs de pilotage. Automatiser les traitements batch avec SQL Server Agent. Réaliser les tests unitaires, les validations de non-régression et préparer les livrables de déploiement. Côté RUN : Prendre en charge les incidents et anomalies liés à la qualité des données. Réaliser les investigations techniques et identifier les causes racines. Piloter les actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution. Automatiser les contrôles de qualité et le suivi des indicateurs. Cartographier et documenter les flux de données et les chaînes de traitement. Accompagner les équipes lors des mises en production et assurer le suivi des actions d’amélioration continue. C’est votre parcours Vous avez une expérience minimum de 3 ans en analyse de données, en développement décisionnel ou en environnement Microsoft BI. Vous aimez investiguer, résoudre des problématiques complexes et améliorer la qualité des données, sans jamais cesser d’apprendre. Vous cherchez un cadre où votre expertise technique contribue directement à la fiabilité des données et à la performance des solutions décisionnelles. C’est votre expertise : Maîtrise de SQL Server : requêtes, modélisation, optimisation et objets SQL. Connaissance des outils Microsoft BI : SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, Power BI et Visual Studio. Compétences en modélisation de données, DAX, création de KPI et visualisation avancée. Maîtrise des enjeux de Data Quality, d’analyse et de résolution d’incidents. Connaissance de SQL Server Agent, des traitements batch et des processus de déploiement. C’est votre manière de faire équipe : Esprit d’analyse et capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes. Rigueur, autonomie et sens du détail. Bon relationnel et capacité à collaborer avec les équipes métiers, projets et exploitation. C’est notre engagement Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte. items.desc: Job Description: We are currently looking for a Logistics Cost Analyst (d/f/m) to join our team in Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel . You will design and roll out financial key performance indicators (KPIs) that empower operational teams to boost cost efficiency. You will develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships across different departments, sites, and service providers in an international environment. items.desc: We are MOTOR Ai . Our mission is to make Level 4 autonomous driving a reality in Germany and beyond. By combining state-of-the-art AI with the expertise of our multidisciplinary team, we are poised to introduce the first solution of its kind in Germany that is eligible for certification on European roads. Since 2017, we have been steadfastly pursuing a single goal: to shape a future that is already in motion. What you will do Test our automated vehicles on public roads and in controlled areas, including manoeuvres, edge cases and regression checks after new software releases Prepare test sessions (software release, vehicle status, data recording) and turn logs and observations into structured reports Triage findings, identify root causes and hand them over as clear, reproducible tickets Create test plans and test cases, keep requirements traceable and check that they are testable Help improve our testing process, tooling and automation, using AI tools along the way What we are looking for 3+ years of experience in automotive or robotics testing, ideally hands-on with full vehicles Solid knowledge of vehicle systems and dynamics as well as a system-level understanding of ADAS/AD An analytical mindset and the ability to write precise, reproducible findings Experience with Jira, test management tools (e.g. DOORS) and AI tools; Python, ROS or vehicle data logging is a plus Fluent English; German is a plus Valid driving licence (class B), extensive driving experience and flexibility for field work A can-do attitude and the drive to deliver great results as a team Benefits Focus on people: Our strength lies in our diversity. We respect each other for who we are Genuine team spirit: working in teams that drive change forward - no matter how complex and extensive the projects are Your professional development is important to us - that's why we cover the costs of further education and training Flexible working hours - with room for the realities of life (parenthood, caregiving responsibilities, voluntary work, etc.) Whether it's fashion, beauty, travel or culture - you'll receive numerous discounts through our partner Corporate Benefits Social relevance: We work on solutions that have game-changing qualities Subsidy for public transport tickets Excellent transport links: attractive location in Wedding with very good public transport connections Excited about our vision and ideas? Do you see real value in autonomous driving for everyone? Then apply to MOTOR Ai and become an active part of a safe, explainable future of mobility. We particularly welcome applications from women and explicitly encourage them to apply for this position. At our new premises, we place great importance on getting to know one another and working together to drive our vision forward. Our international team is growing and working together on this exciting mission. Face-to-face collaboration is the key to success, which is why we have decided not to become a fully remote company. We ask recruitment consultancies and agencies not to submit candidate profiles without our prior express request. Any candidate profiles submitted without a prior written placement agreement signed by both parties shall be deemed to have been submitted unsolicited. No entitlement to placement fees or other charges shall arise from their use or from the subsequent recruitment of the candidate.

items.desc: Control Systems Engineer | Munters Corporation Join Munters and Help Shape the Future of Data Center Cooling Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical applications. Our Ireland team designs and manufactures advanced cooling technologies that help data centers operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. We are looking for a Control Systems Engineer to join our Research & Development team and help develop the next generation of high-efficiency cooling and heat-rejection systems. This is a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining software, automation, controls, and real-world equipment to solve challenging engineering problems. What You'll Do Design and develop industrial control strategies using Function Block Diagram (FBD) programming. Develop and test control software for data center cooling equipment. Integrate and test controls on prototype systems in the R&D laboratory. Work with mechanical and electrical engineers to define equipment sequences and operating modes. Develop and tune PID and cascaded control loops . Configure sensors, actuators, variable-speed drives, controllers, and automation hardware. Support testing, data collection, and analysis of control-system performance. Troubleshoot software, electrical, and system-level control issues. Maintain software documentation, version control, and revision history. Support the transition of successful R&D solutions into production. Contribute to product testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement. What We're Looking For Degree in Control Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, Automation Engineering , or a related discipline. 3+ years of experience developing software or controls for industrial systems. Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, cooling, process control, or industrial automation. Strong experience with Function Block Diagram programming . Understanding of control systems, PID tuning, equipment sequencing, and system dynamics. Experience with industrial sensors, programmable controllers, and automation hardware. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Comfortable working hands-on with prototype equipment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Nice to Have Experience with: Carel controls Automated Logic Controls (ALC) Siemens controllers BACnet or Modbus Data center cooling Refrigeration or thermal management Prototype development and product validation Software version control and structured release processes Why Join Munters? You'll have the opportunity to work on innovative cooling technology for the rapidly growing data center industry , where your work directly impacts energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability. You'll also gain exposure to the full product-development lifecycle—from concept and software development through prototype testing, validation, and production . Munters is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued. We encourage qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every listed qualification.

The salary and benefits are competitive; the people you'll work with are authentic, thoughtful, driven, and human; but the reason we chose Minerva is our strong belief in the company's mission: if we want to change the world, it's imperative that we improve education everywhere. As our first step to achieving that goal, we built Minerva University from the ground up, refining and improving every aspect of a traditional university. Minerva University boasts an unbiased admissions process (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/admissions/), seminars instead of lectures (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/), and a global experience over 4 years (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/students-life/); and has been named the most innovative university in the world - three times (https://www.minerva.edu/announcements/minerva-university-most-innovative-university-wuri-2024/). Our methodology, which emphasizes active class participation, deliberate practice, and other empirically-proven methods, is enabled by Minerva Forum. Built to address the central educational challenges of the modern era, Minerva Forum embodies the leading research on the science of learning to enable the rapid development of sophisticated, durable skills-based programs. The role We're looking for a product designer who can make complex software clear and usable, and carry a design from understanding the problem through implementation and review. items.desc: About this position TNO is the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research. As an independent research institute, TNO connects science and industry to accelerate innovation and translate knowledge into practical, scalable solutions. By combining in-depth technical expertise with a strong application focus, TNO supports companies and governments in addressing complex technological and societal challenges. Within integrated photonics and advanced chip packaging, TNO brings together expertise through the Photonic Integration Technology Center (PITC) and the Chip Integration Technology Center (CITC). This creates a multidisciplinary environment in which photonic design, micro-assembly, semiconductor processing and packaging technologies converge to turn promising concepts into robust industrial solutions. What will be your role? As a Process Engineer Photonics Packaging, you develop and optimize assembly processes that connect photonic integrated circuits to optical, electrical, mechanical and thermal interfaces. You translate new integration concepts into reproducible and scalable process flows and validate them through structured experimental work. You work hands-on in the laboratory, collaborating with scientists, design engineers, equipment specialists, and industrial partners. Your activities cover the entire development cycle: from process definition and tooling concepts to assembly, characterization, data analysis, and documentation. Your contribution helps bridge the gap between early-stage photonic packaging concepts and production-ready solutions. Key responsibilities: Developing, optimizing and documenting assembly and integration processes for photonic devices, sub-assemblies and modules; Setting up and executing processes such as high-precision die placement, adhesive bonding, flip-chip assembly, soldering, wire bonding, fiber or optical interface attachment, and passive or active alignment; Designing and conducting experiments, including Design of Experiments (DoE), to gain insight into process windows and improve accuracy, yield, reliability and scalability; Collaborating with industrial partners and customers on national and international R&D projects and clearly reporting progress and results; Supporting knowledge transfer from R&D development to pilot-scale manufacturing and sharing expertise within multidisciplinary project teams. What we expect from you You are a hands-on and structured engineer who enjoys transforming complex integration challenges into stable processes. You work accurately, take responsibility for laboratory activities, and communicate effectively with colleagues and external partners. What you bring: A BSc or MSc degree in mechanical engineering, applied physics, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; At least three years of relevant experience in photonics packaging, semiconductor assembly, micro-assembly, precision engineering or a similar high-tech manufacturing environment; Experience with structured process development, experimental design, data analysis and technical problem solving; Affinity with optical and electrical testing, metrology, inspection, and process qualification; The ability to read technical drawings and translate product requirements and tolerances into suitable process and tooling concepts; Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect: An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly. Flexible working hours, the possibility to work parttime (32 or 36 hours) and the possibility of working from home. Extensive relocation package for …

Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Qualifications: The position requires a University Degree in electrical / communications engineering, physics, computer engineering, or an equivalent course of study and a minimum of 3 years’ professional experience in digital and/or photonic test and measurement applications. Help keep systems running — coordinate troubleshooting and repairs for building systems like HVAC, lighting, and mechanical equipment. Deliver exceptional client and stakeholder service — be the trusted point of contact, build relationships with key partners and the landlord, handle escalations with care, and identify opportunities to improve service and efficiency. Contribute to resilience planning — help maintain business continuity plans, support risk management activities, and follow incident protocols. Language: Fluency in Polish and English is required. What we're looking for: A people-first approach — you're welcoming, approachable, and genuinely care about creating a safe, positive environment for everyone on site. Coordination and organizational skills — you can juggle multiple priorities, keep details organized, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Problem-solving mindset — when challenges arise, you stay calm, ask good questions, and work toward practical solutions. Willingness to learn — some familiarity with building systems (HVAC, electrical, mechanical) is a bonus, but we value curiosity and the ability to learn quickly just as much. Technical expertise can be built over time. Adaptability and flexibility — you're comfortable shifting between tasks (operations, reception, coordination) as the day demands and embrace change with a positive attitude. Clear communication — you can explain things clearly in writing and conversation, keeping stakeholders informed and documentation accurate. Comfort with technology — familiarity with facilities management tools like Service Now, Corrigo etc. is helpful, but the most important thing is a willingness to learn new systems. Self-motivation and initiative — you take ownership, spot opportunities to improve, and don't wait to be told what to do. items.desc: Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. Accenture’s Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content, flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns. This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accenture’s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being. Role Details and Key Responsibilities: Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and/or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work. Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas. Analyze the model's responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance. Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model's responses. Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy. Basic Qualifications/Skills Needed: Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills. Excellent comprehension, communication, and Arabic B2 min. skills. Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies Strong attention to detail Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills Preferred Qualifications: Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported What can we offer: Work fully from the office in Warsaw on mid-shift with flexible start between 8-11 AM Using foreign language and new technology solutions daily, cooperating with various global Clients Constant support and clear development path from your first day at office – dedicated Buddy, who will help you in adjusting to the new workplace Focus on your strengths and continuous feedback enable fast professional growth, as well as new skills building by various online and classroom trainings Inclusion and diversity in practice: truly multicultural environment; we support LGBT, people with disabilities and parents. In our culture of equality, people are truly valued for their differences and free to be who they are A flexible approach that allows an appropriate work-life balance where sports activities, outings, volunteering initiatives are part of our regular day-to day life Commitment to reducing our environmental impact in terms of carbon, water, and waste across Accenture facilities and in the communities in which we work and live by joining different initiatives Full work comfort – private medical care, life insurance, access to Worksmile platform, bonuses for referring new employees

items.desc: Location Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. The Opportunity We're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster. Responsibilities Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view. Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call. Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves. Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up. Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later. Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary. Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work. Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix. Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production. Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead Qualifications 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ. Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript. A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples. Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems. Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution). Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day. Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers. Fluent English, additional languages are a plus. Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship). Nice to have: Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification; Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience; experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems. Are you a Do'er? Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. #LI-Remote

items.desc: ADP is hiring a Global Solution Designer As a Global Solution Designer , you will serve as the strategic design authority for our clients' global Human Capital Management (HCM) transformation journey.
