items.desc: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Operations Manager __ Your Role & Responsibilities: Join our operations team at ABB Energy Industries, where you'll bridge the gap between business innovation and technical excellence. In this role, you'll transform operational requirements into impactful digital solutions, working collaboratively with diverse teams across project management, engineering, sales, and external partners. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference—improving how we work through thoughtful application management, process automation, and continuous digital improvement. The work model for the role is: on-site with 8 home office days per month. Manage and develop business applications through technical administration, system configuration, master data management, and user authorization frameworks Analyze business requirements and convert them into detailed functional specifications, coordinating seamlessly with internal and external development partners Ensure software quality through comprehensive test planning, functional and acceptance testing, release coordination, and thorough documentation Support operations and project management with data-driven reporting, process automation, and user training, fostering a culture of continuous improvement Our team dynamics: Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. What it takes to run what runs the world: Technical foundation with a strong understanding of document management systems and version control principles 1-2 years of professional experience in documentation management or a related technical field, ideally within project-driven or engineering environments Proven ability to work independently while following established processes An independent, open communicator with a friendly approach and collaborative mindset; comfortable working in structured team environments and contributing constructively to a positive atmosphere Professional fluency in English (min. level B2) and German (min. level C1) We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond: Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life. Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program , and a gender-neutral parental leave policy . Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances. Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance. Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. The minimum compensation in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement is 3.583, 02 EUR gross monthly for a full-time position as of May 2026, but we would be happy to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience. More about us: The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle. Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World. #ABBcareers #LI-Hybrid #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Capacity Remuneration Mechanism Operator Requisition ID: 11564 Posting Start Date: 12/10/2026 Function The introduction of a Capacity Remuneration Mechanism (CRM) on the Belgian market has been one of the key measures within the federal government's energy strategy in order to guarantee the country's security of supply in the long term. The CRM aims at supporting the needs for covering Belgian security of supply (“adequacy") by allowing market players to recover their “missing money” through a market-wide and technology neutral financing market mechanism. Through the CRM, capacities are contracted via auctions, while Elia oversees their monitoring and settlement throughout the contract lifecycle. The CRM Operations Team is part of Market Energy & CRM Operations, responsible for the operation of key market products such as Balancing, Flexibility, Black Start and CRM. The team delivers operational excellence, technical expertise and data quality across customer, market and adequacy processes. Within the CRM domain, the team manages the end-to-end operations of the mechanism, including prequalification, auctions, monitoring, settlement, reporting and transparency activities. As a CRM Operator , you play a key role in the execution of these processes, from prequalification to settlement. You develop strong expertise in CRM rules and operations to ensure high-quality service delivery, compliance and operational excellence, while collaborating closely with market participants and internal stakeholders. Initially, the role focuses on auction, contracting and settlement activities. Over time, you will gain a broader understanding of the CRM ecosystem and may contribute to other Customer Operations and analytical activities. Your responsibilities You will execute key CRM operational processes, including Prequalification, Financial Securities, Secondary Market, Availability Monitoring and Settlement. You will analyze technical, financial and operational dossiers submitted by Capacity Providers, review supporting documentation, calculations and assumptions, and translate technical findings into operational recommendations or decision proposals. You will develop expertise in specific CRM domains, by building knowledge of CRM processes, market rules and regulatory requirements, and sharing this expertise within the Customer Operations team. You will produce periodic or ad-hoc reports on the functioning and results of the CRM, for internal and/or external use (e.g. for the energy regulator CREG). You will contribute to the preparation, validation and reporting of CRM auction and settlement activities, including KPI reporting, performance monitoring, contestation follow-up and impact assessments for exceptional cases. You will proactively manage the operational questions from the CRM Actors and internal stakeholders in close collaboration with the Key Account Manager Adequacy and the Product Architect. You will ensure the accurate respect of the organized process (automated and manual tasks) and involve the requested persons / departments within Elia You will contribute to the evolution of the CRM product by sharing operational experience, lessons learned and practical feedback to improve rules, processes and solutions. You will support user acceptance testing, operational readiness assessments and validations of new functionalities, ensuring that future solutions are fit for operations. Your Profile You hold a Master’s degree, or a Bachelor’s degree with relevant experience, in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics or a related field. You have knowledge of the energy sector; willingness to learn complex market mechanisms is essential. Our headquarters in Copenhagen is a modern workplace offering different work zones, fitness facilities, cantina and café, and a rooftop terrace with ocean views - all just five minutes from train and metro connections. items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

The Systems & Options engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining Bluefors' largest and most complex product portfolio. items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Chez imagino, nous réinventons la manière dont les marques interagissent avec leurs clients. Notre plateforme SaaS low-code, propulsée par l’IA, unifie les données clients dispersées et permet aux équipes marketing d’activer en temps réel des expériences omnicanales personnalisées, sans complexité technique. Fondée en 2017, imagino dispose de bureaux à Cachan en France, Londres au Royaume-Uni et Boston aux États-Unis . Après une levée de fonds de 25 M€ en 2024 , nous accélérons notre expansion et recherchons des talents passionnés par l’innovation et la construction de produits. Votre stage chez imagino Vous recherchez un stage de césure ou de fin d’études en développement logiciel, DevOps, data, intelligence artificielle ou Product ? Rencontrons-nous au Forum CentraleSupélec ! Vous rejoindrez une équipe expérimentée et contribuerez à des sujets concrets sur notre plateforme, avec l’accompagnement d’un référent dans votre domaine. Le périmètre du stage sera défini selon vos compétences, vos centres d’intérêt et les besoins de nos équipes. Cette offre rassemble nos candidatures de stage : précisez le domaine qui vous intéresse et vos dates de disponibilité . Les sujets auxquels vous pourriez contribuer Développement backend : développer des services et des API en Go, optimiser les traitements et contribuer à la fiabilité de nos microservices. Développement frontend : concevoir des interfaces React et TypeScript pour rendre accessibles des fonctionnalités complexes de gestion et d’activation des données. Data : travailler sur l’intégration, la transformation et la qualité des données, ainsi que sur les performances des flux et des requêtes. Intelligence artificielle : contribuer à des fonctionnalités intégrant l’IA dans les usages de notre plateforme et à l’évaluation de leur qualité. DevOps et SRE : participer à l’automatisation, à l’observabilité et à la fiabilité de nos environnements Kubernetes. Product : analyser les besoins utilisateurs et les retours clients, contribuer au cadrage des fonctionnalités et collaborer avec les équipes Design et Engineering pour suivre leur réalisation et évaluer leur adoption. Qualité logicielle : développer des tests automatisés et les intégrer à nos pipelines CI/CD. Selon votre spécialité, vous collaborerez avec nos équipes Engineering, Produit et Design pour comprendre les besoins, proposer des solutions et contribuer à leur mise en œuvre. Profil recherché Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur, un master ou une formation équivalente et recherchez un stage de césure ou de fin d’études. Vous avez des bases solides dans votre domaine, illustrées par des projets académiques, personnels, open source ou une première expérience. Vous aimez comprendre les usages d’un produit, analyser des problèmes et proposer des solutions. Vous êtes curieux, rigoureux et appréciez le travail en équipe. Vous pouvez échanger en anglais dans un environnement professionnel international. La maîtrise de toute notre stack n’est pas attendue. Nous nous intéressons à vos acquis, à votre démarche et à votre envie d’apprendre. Pour les stages Product, une appétence pour les produits techniques et les enjeux data sera particulièrement appréciée. Notre environnement technique Frontend : React, TypeScript, TanStack. Backend : Go, API REST, microservices. Data : PostgreSQL, Snowflake. Infrastructure : Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, OVHcloud. Développement et CI/CD : Git, GitLab. Architecture : plateforme SaaS B2B multi-cloud et multi-tenant. Pourquoi rejoindre imagino ? Contribuer à un produit qui combine data, IA et activation marketing en temps réel . Travailler sur des enjeux de performance, de fiabilité et de simplicité d’utilisation. Apprendre auprès d’équipes expérimentées et bénéficier de retours réguliers. Comprendre comment les équipes Produit, Design et Engineering construisent ensemble une plateforme. Rejoindre une entreprise internationale en croissance, où vos contributions peuvent être mises en pratique dans le produit. Processus de recrutement Entretien RH pour échanger sur votre parcours, vos envies et vos disponibilités. Entretien en visio avec un Lead de votre domaine , côté Engineering ou Produit. Entretien final sur site , avec un test technique ou un cas pratique adapté à votre profil et une visite de nos locaux. Informations pratiques Lieu : Cachan, au sud de Paris. Contrat : stage conventionné de césure ou de fin d’études. Démarrage et durée : à préciser dans votre candidature. Gratification : selon le niveau d’études et le cadre du stage. Avantages : tickets restaurant, prise en charge des transports et télétravail selon les modalités applicables aux stagiaires. Partagez votre CV, vos disponibilités et le domaine qui vous intéresse. Vous pouvez aussi joindre votre GitHub, portfolio ou un projet dont vous êtes fier !

items.desc: As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users. You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices. You will have the opportunity to: Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities. Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation. Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together. Within 1 month, you will Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture. Become familiar with our R&D way of working. Understand the team’s processes. Within 3 months, you will Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm. Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes. Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance. Within 6 months, you will: Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability. Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure. Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data. Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support. Manage incidents and post-mortem. Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads). Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts. Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure Within 12 months, you will: Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability. Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default. The Skill Set 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role. Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration. Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un acteur de référence du conseil en Stratégie Data & IA ! Qui sommes-nous ? AI Builders est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en Stratégie Data et Intelligence Artificielle , fondé en 2019 par Stéphane RODER, auteur du Guide Pratique de l’Intelligence Artificielle dans l’entreprise . Notre mission : aider les entreprises à transformer leurs métiers et leurs processus grâce à la Data et à l’IA , de la stratégie jusqu’au passage à l’échelle. Aujourd’hui, AI Builders s’est rapproché de Wavestone , cabinet de conseil international, pour unir la profondeur de son expertise Data & IA à la puissance d’un acteur majeur du conseil en transformation . Une nouvelle étape qui nous permet d’accompagner nos clients sur des transformations toujours plus ambitieuses, au croisement des enjeux business, technologiques et organisationnels . Nous intervenons auprès de grands groupes du CAC 40 et du SBF120 sur leurs enjeux Data & IA les plus stratégiques. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? L’IA transforme profondément les entreprises. Chez AI Builders, vous êtes directement acteur de cette transformation en : Travaillant sur des projets Data & IA stratégiques , au cœur des transformations de nos clients ; Collaborant avec des Directions Générales, métiers et Chief Data Officers ; Développant une double compétence Conseil & Data/IA , à la croisée de la stratégie, du business et de la technologie ; Imaginant de nouveaux produits et usages , en réinventant les processus métier et l’expérience client grâce à l’IA. Une culture d’expertise qui conserve son ADN Rejoindre AI Builders, c’est intégrer une équipe de spécialistes passionnés par la Data et l’IA, tout en bénéficiant désormais de la force et des opportunités offertes par le rapprochement avec Wavestone : Une forte culture d’expertise et d’innovation autour de la Data et de l’IA ; Un environnement dynamique, collaboratif et bienveillant ; Des formations continues pour accélérer votre montée en compétences ; Des opportunités élargies grâce à la complémentarité entre l’expertise AI Builders et les savoir-faire de Wavestone . items.desc: À propos du poste Nous recherchons un(e) Spécialiste en Simulation de Chromatographie passionné(e) et innovant(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable du développement, de l’optimisation et de la validation de modèles de simulation chromatographique afin d’améliorer la compréhension et la prédiction des processus analytiques. Vous utiliserez des techniques avancées de data mining, d’apprentissage automatique et d’intelligence artificielle pour transformer des données complexes en insights exploitables. Si vous êtes motivé(e) par la recherche de solutions innovantes dans le domaine de la chimie analytique et que vous aimez relever des défis techniques, cette opportunité est faite pour vous ! Responsabilités Concevoir et affiner des modèles de simulation chromatographique en utilisant des outils de programmation tels que Python, C++, R ou SAS. Exploiter le cloud computing, notamment AWS, pour traiter et analyser de vastes ensembles de données issues d’expériences chromatographiques ou cliniques. Intégrer des techniques de machine learning et deep learning pour améliorer la précision des simulations et prédictions. Effectuer des analyses approfondies à partir de bases de données complexes pour identifier des tendances ou anomalies dans les résultats chromatographiques. Développer des scripts automatisés pour optimiser les processus d’analyse et visualiser efficacement les données à l’aide d’outils de data visualization. Collaborer avec les équipes R&D, cliniques et informatiques pour assurer une intégration fluide des modèles dans les workflows existants. Participer à l’amélioration continue en utilisant la data mining pour explorer de nouvelles approches analytiques ou technologiques. Profil recherché Diplôme en chimie, bioinformatique, informatique ou domaine connexe avec une forte orientation analytique. Expérience avérée dans la modélisation ou la simulation chromatographique ou analytique. Maîtrise avancée des langages Python, R, C++ et SQL pour le traitement et l’analyse de données. Connaissance approfondie du cloud computing, notamment AWS, ainsi que des outils liés à l’intelligence artificielle, au machine learning et au deep learning. Solides compétences en data analysis, data mining et visualisation pour interpréter efficacement les résultats complexes. Expérience avec les bases de données relationnelles et non relationnelles ainsi qu’avec SAS ou autres outils statistiques. Connaissance du contexte clinique ou pharmaceutique est un atout précieux pour travailler sur les essais cliniques. Rejoignez notre équipe pour contribuer à repousser les limites de la science analytique tout en évoluant dans un environnement stimulant où innovation rime avec excellence ! items.desc: Company AMPERE ENERGY Job Description Votre environnement L’évolution technologique est aujourd’hui au cœur de la performance de l’ingénierie AMPERE pour Renault Group. Dans un contexte en pleine mutation environnementale, numérique et économique, le monde de l’automobile évolue rapidement. La voiture s’électrifie, se connecte, s’automatise. Relever ces trois défis passe par la maitrise de technologies clés de l’ingénierie système. Elles sont stratégiques pour toute l’industrie automobile. Au sein de la Direction de l'ingénierie des GMP (Groupes Moto Propulseurs) électriques d’AMPERE et de Renault Group, le service logiciel eNERGY conçoit et valide les architectures et les logiciels des composants et systèmes des GMP électriques. Dans ce cadre, des validations sur véhicules prototypes sont réalisées au centre R&D du Groupe, le Technocentre à Guyancourt (78). Pour réussir ces tests, il est nécessaire de définir les plans de validation d’une part, et de mettre en place les bancs et outils nécessaires au bon déroulement de la validation d’autre part. L’équipe a notamment pour mission de piloter et d’exécuter les plans de validation pour les exigences des systèmes et infrastructures de charge, de traction électrique, de réseau haute tension, de stockage de l'énergie et de la gestion de la chaine de traction pour les véhicules électriques de Renault Group. Vos Missions Vous participez à la préparation et la mise en place des outils pour améliorer l’exécution des plans de validation selon des règles de l'art internes. Vous participez à l’analyse et à la rédaction des rapports de test pour capitalisation et discussion avec les pilotes de validation système. Vous mettez en place une chaine outillée pour l’optimisation du suivi des validations. Cette chaine aura comme objectif de simplifier l’extraction des résultats de validation et leur mise en forme sous indicateurs respectant un cahier des charges précis. Vous développez les interfaces nécessaires pour rendre la chaine compatible avec les outils internes déjà existants. Vous proposez et utilisez des méthodes basées sur l’automatisation, la programmation et l’intelligence artificielle. A la suite de ce poste, vous pourrez approfondir vos compétences en outillage informatique, ingénierie système, test et validation des GMP des véhicules électriques. Votre profil Vous préparez un diplôme d’ingénieur en informatique industrielle, électronique embarqué, mécatronique ou avec une composante automobile, électrotechnique. Vous avez des connaissances en véhicules électriques, en programmation (C++, Python), en modélisation/simulation et en systèmes embarqués. Vous aimez utiliser l’IA pour simplifier les tâches. Vous avez une grande capacité d’analyse. Vous faites preuve de rigueur et d’esprit de synthèse. Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais écrit et oral. Vous souhaitez participer à l'aventure de l'automobile de demain ? Rejoignez-nous ! items.desc: Lieu : Rennes, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien En nous rejoignant à Rennes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée Au sein de la direction APC (Automation Platforms & Cloud), vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique et passionnée par l’innovation, la sécurité et la performance. Vous aurez pour missions principales : Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir nos infrastructures cloud et hybride/on-premise Automatiser les processus de déploiement, de configuration et de gestion de l'infrastructure (CI/CD). Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de développement pour optimiser le cycle de vie des applications et garantir une livraison continue. Mettre en place des outils de monitoring et d'alertes Assurer la disponibilité et la performance des services. Identifier et résoudre les problèmes d'infrastructure de manière proactive. Participer à l' amélioration continue de nos pratiques DevSecOps et à l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Documenter les processus et les configurations. Être force de proposition pour l'évolution de l'infrastructure et des outils. Votre Profil Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 en informatique (École d'ingénieur ou Master) avec une spécialisation en DevOps, Cloud ou Systèmes et une expérience d’au moins 4 ans dans le domaine. Vous disposez des compétences suivantes : Maîtrise des systèmes d'exploitation Linux Solide expérience avec les outils de CI/CD (ex : GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps) Expérience significative avec les outils d'orchestration de conteneurs (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm) Connaissance approfondie des plateformes cloud GCP, AWS ou Azure Maîtrise des outils d' Infrastructure as Code et de gestion de configuration (Terraform, Ansible) Compétences en scripting (Python, Bash, Powershell) Connaissance des outils de monitoring et de logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) Leadership, esprit d'équipe, autonomie et sens de l'initiative Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques Une bonne maîtrise de l' anglais est indispensable pour interagir efficacement avec nos équipes internationales et nos partenaires. Une certification CSP serait un plus. Le mot du manager A la direction APC (Automation Platforms & Cloud), nous vivons une période passionnante de transformation technologique. Notre équipe cloud est composée d'experts talentueux et passionnés qui partagent une vision commune : construire les infrastructures de demain tout en garantissant le plus haut niveau de sécurité. Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité qui saura apporter sa pierre à l'édifice, partager ses connaissances et grandir avec l'équipe. L'environnement technique est exigeant, mais nous accordons une grande importance à l'accompagnement et au développement de chacun. Vous êtes passionné(e) par les défis techniques et souhaitez travailler dans un monde en mouvement sans jamais vous ennuyer ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Banque régionale et coopérative, la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes est un acteur économique incontournable de la région. Elle accompagne l’ensemble de ses clients et contribue au développement durable de son territoire. Son engagement social et solidaire se traduit concrètement à travers des actions fortes en faveur de l’égalité des chances, de l’inclusion et de la diversité. Dans une démarche d’amélioration continue de l’expérience collaborateur, la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes obtient, dès sa première participation, la certification Great Place To Work® , référence mondiale en matière de qualité de vie au travail. Cette distinction vient reconnaître l’engagement collectif des équipes ainsi que les actions menées pour favoriser un environnement de travail positif, au service de la performance. Poste et missions La Direction de l’Audit interne bénéficie d’un double rattachement, au Président du Directoire et à l’Inspecteur général du Groupe BPCE. Au sein de la Direction, vous intégrez une équipe de 21 collaborateurs basés à Lyon, à la Tour Incity. Les missions de la direction s’inscrivent dans le dispositif de contrôle interne au troisième et dernier niveau, conformément à la réglementation bancaire. Le principal objectif vise à s’assurer d’une bonne maîtrise de l’ensemble des risques et d’apporter des solutions y compris en termes de conseil aux différentes problématiques. Le modèle de la direction de l’audit de la CERA a été construit pour permettre l’acquisition de compétences multi-dimensionnelles durant ce parcours d’excellence à l’instar de ce que l’on retrouve dans les inspections générales de banques. Ce métier est depuis quelques années en évolution permanente. A l’instar des inspections générales des banques, l’audit interne de la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes a entamé sa transformation digitale et a commencé à déployer des outils de Data science et de DataViz. En effet, ces outils revêtent de nombreux avantages pour les auditeurs, tels que : permettre d’étendre les tests par échantillon à de l’exhaustif, de fiabiliser des reportings internes, d’apporter une meilleure robustesse dans les analyses et les constats élaborés, tout en assurant une meilleure productivité, ou encore d’élaborer des modèles prédictifs afin de mieux anticiper les risques à venir. C’est pourquoi la Direction de l’audit est à la recherche d’un Data Analyst (F/H) afin de renforcer l’équipe Data qui aura pour missions : De contribuer à l’implantation de nouveaux outils de gestion de données, D’extraire, de fiabiliser, de croiser et d’analyser les données requises pour les différentes missions, D’élaborer des synthèses et de restituer les résultats, De participer à la montée en compétences de l’ensemble de l’équipe d’audit sur le domaine de la data, D’interagir avec les équipes DATA de la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes et des entités du groupe BPCE Profil et compétences requises Curieux, adaptable aux environnements changeants et intéressé par la maîtrise des risques, vous démontrez une double capacité de travail en équipe et en autonomie. Vous disposez également d’une capacité d’analyse, d’un esprit de synthèse et d’un intérêt pour les métiers de la banque et du secteur financier. Compétences techniques : Logiciels de gestion de base de données, Maîtrise des techniques d’analyse de données, Développements en SQL, Connaissance d’outils comme Alteryx, powerBI, Connaissance du langage Python. Ce poste requiert confidentialité, capacité et rigueur d’initiative , mais aussi curiosité, capacité de synthèse et esprit d’équipe. Informations complémentaires sur le poste Poste basé à Lyon. La Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes s’engage en faveur de l’accueil et de l’intégration des personnes en situation de handicap.

items.desc: PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Réf ABG-140512 Sujet de Thèse 13/10/2026 Financement de l'Union européenne Sorbonne Université Lieu de travail Paris - Ile-de-France - France Intitulé du sujet PhD Position in EU Doctoral Network "PANDORA" Champs scientifiques Biologie Santé, médecine humaine, vétérinaire Mots clés Biological sciences, Biology, Medical sciences, Neurosciences, Immunology Description du sujet The position focuses on "Evaluating how complement dysregulation influences mononuclear phagocyte accumulation in AMD" within the MSCA Doctoral Network PANDORA (Discovering Pathomechanisms and Novel Drug Optimization for AMD). Subretinal mononuclear phagocytes (MPs) build up in the photoreceptor cell layer, a zone normally kept free of immune cells by the immunosuppressive retinal pigment epithelium (RPE). This build-up is a key driver of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). MPs include microglia and monocyte-derived inflammatory macrophages (MoMφ). Our team has shown that activated MPs evade RPE-mediated clearance. We have also shown that the AMD-linked CFH 402H variant impairs the removal of subretinal MPs independently of its role in the complement system. How complement dysregulation contributes to immune cell accumulation in the subretinal space in AMD remains poorly understood. The PhD student will first map where complement cascade components are found in the human retina. Using multiplexed immunohistochemistry on post-mortem retinal sections from AMD donors and age-matched controls, the student will localise components of the classical, lectin and alternative pathways, their activation products, regulators (CFH and Factor H-related proteins) and receptors. These components will be mapped relative to subretinal MPs, the RPE, photoreceptors and drusen. The student will then study how the Chromosome 1 (Chr1) AMD risk haplotype affects RPE, microglia and MoMφ and their interactions. They will use control and Chr1-risk iPSC-derived cells in a well-defined co-culture system developed in our laboratory. The student will also study the role of plasma-derived Factor H-related proteins (FHR1-5) using depleted human plasma and purified complement factors. Using single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing and proteomics, the student will analyse how complement dysregulation affects: microglia and MoMφ polarisation the interaction of these cells with the immunosuppressive RPE key inflammatory pathways and immune functions in the subretinal microenvironment, in health and in AMD Finally, the student will test whether complement inhibitors (anti-C5, anti-C3) can restore immune balance. The project is supervised by Dr. Florian Sennlaub (Institut de la Vision, Paris) It is carried out in close collaboration with other PANDORA doctoral candidates. Techniques and Training Include: Multiplexed immunohistochemistry on human donor retinal sections (AMD and age-matched controls), whole-slide/confocal imaging and quantitative image analysis Induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived RPE, microglia and macrophage models, and immune cell/RPE co-cultures Primary human monocyte isolation and differentiation, and work with human plasma and purified complement factors Single-cell and bulk transcriptomics, and proteomics Flow cytometry, qPCR, western blot, ELISA/multiplex cytokine assays Functional immune assays (phagocytosis, migration, survival/clearance) Prise de fonction : 01/02/2027 Nature du financement Financement de l'Union européenne Précisions sur le financement Horizon Europe – MSCA (Marie Curie Actions) Présentation établissement et labo d'accueil Sorbonne Université Founded by Professor José-Alain Sahel, the Institut de la Vision is an international research centre dedicated entirely to research into eye and vision diseases. It brings together researchers, doctors, patients and industry on the same site to discover innovative treatments for eye diseases and improve the quality of life of visually impaired people. It is being built on a site that brings together l’Hôpital national de la vision des 15-20 and its Clinical Investigation Centre (CIC), as well as the Centre for Rare Retinal Diseases. Designed as a place where people can come together and exchange ideas, the Institut de la Vision enables ideas to be shared, new questions to emerge and the transfer of research findings to patient care to be accelerated. Its innovative organisation, based around hospital patients, enables new therapeutic or technological solutions to be discovered, tested and developed in order to prevent eye diseases or limit their effects. More than 300 researchers are working in the 5 research departments of the Institut de la Vision: developmental biology of the visual system, genetics, visual information processing, pathophysiology and therapeutics, photonics. items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. items.desc: Cloud Data Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible: Cloud Data Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) (Part-Time: 25%) Location: Frankfurt Employment scope: 25% Part-Time Type of contract: Fixed Term Contract for 1 year Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13 The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine. The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow . The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will contribute to and consult on developing a web-based open-access tool on Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) for reproducible data and modelling workflows and transform biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. Your tasks Design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform: a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) over the full GBIF corpus (~3.9 billion occurrence records) and OBIS (~207 million records). Architect and operate the hybrid setup with the AWS side (S3 data lake, elastic batch compute, optional GPU profile), working with the institute’s internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, tiles, API) in cooperation with central IT. Build the batch pipelines: monthly full-corpus rebuild, per-species extraction and SDM training jobs; workflow orchestration (Nextflow/Snakemake), containerisation. Build an H3-based aggregation and map-tile generation pipeline. Manage cloud costs, infrastructure documentation and handover. Advise the project team on infrastructure and hosting decisions. Your profile Several years of professional experience designing and operating cloud data platforms (AWS: S3, Batch, Spot Instances; infrastructure as code). Hands-on experience with columnar / lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Spark or Dask) on datasets in the billion-record range. Strong PostgreSQL, including PostGIS. Experience with large-scale geospatial processing: spatial indexing (e.g. H3 hexagonal grids) and map-tile pipelines. Experience working with biodiversity occurrence data (GBIF, OBIS) and environmental layers (e.g. Bio-ORACLE). Knowledge of Python, Docker, Git/CI. Very good command of English. Desirable skills Familiarity with species distribution modelling and associated statistical/machine-learning approaches (e.g. GLM/GAM, MaxEnt, Random Forest). A track record in reproducible scientific computing or open-source projects. We offer access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, …

This role is heavily production‑floor based and focuses on inspections, documentation, nonconformance processing, and compliance with the Quality Management System. The Quality Specialist works closely with operations teams to ensure products meet internal, customer, and regulatory requirements. This role is ideal for a quality professional with strong attention to detail who excels in procedural execution and compliance. Production Quality & Inspections Perform in-process, final, and random inspections of assemblies, subassemblies, and finished products on the production floor, based on drawings, specifications, and procedures. Track and verify completion of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) under guidance of Quality Engineers or Managers. Communicate nonconformance status and containment actions to production teams. Data Collection & Continuous Improvement Collect and report quality data (scrap, rework, defects, yields). Maintain accuracy of quality metrics and dashboards. Support continuous improvement initiatives through data collection and execution of defined actions. Quality System & Compliance Support the Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 9001 and, where applicable, ISO 13485 and ISO17025. Assist with internal audits, document preparation, and objective evidence collection. Ensure strict adherence to procedures, work instructions, and documentation requirements. Promote quality awareness, and 5S/housekeeping on the production floor. Other duties as assigned. items.desc: Welcome to Allianz Allianz SE is the global headquarters of the Allianz Group. Our employees reflect the Group's geographic and functional diversity. Within Allianz SE, Group Risk is responsible for monitoring and reporting on the Group's overall risk profile, supporting management to foster Allianz's financial strength and value-focused company leadership.Within Group Risk, the Credit Risk Team is the global credit risk function, responsible for credit risk modeling reporting, credit analysis and counterparty limit management. This role focuses on the approval of reinsurance transactions and reinsurance counterparty analysis within the Single-transaction Verification (SVT) framework. What awaits you as Credit Risk Analyst (m/f/d) Take a central role in the Group credit risk closing process as one of the experts running it centrally for the entire Allianz Group, feeding quarterly and annual results as well as regulatory reporting, in close cooperation with Allianz entities and data stakeholders globally Further develop, monitor and validate the internal credit risk model under Solvency II and internal governance requirements, including the Allianz-specific calibration of credit risk parameters for a global insurer with multiple sources of credit risk Support local risk management teams in the regional entities on credit risk methodology and process questions, and act as a point of contact for other departments at Allianz SE on all credit risk matters Contribute to the Group's credit risk limit system and approval framework, in particular the reinsurance exposure collection and approval process What you bring as Credit Risk Analyst (m/f/d) University degree with strong academic results in a quantitative discipline such as Financial Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Econometrics or Quantitative Finance Solid quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to work on risk models and translate methodology into robust, controlled processes Confident handling of large data sets and modern analytical tools; an interest in developing your technical skills further (advanced programming not a prerequisite) Structured and reliable way of working, with the accuracy and ownership required in a regulated closing environment Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain quantitative topics to non-specialists (German is a plus) Preferred qualifications: Practical experience in credit risk modelling, quantitative risk management or a regulatory closing process (Solvency II, IFRS 9), ideally in insurance or banking Professional qualification a plus - FRM, or CFA / actuarial exams (also if still in progress) Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution Our highlights for you Health Wellbeing: Company health insurance, sports and wellness programmes, and preventive health measures lay the foundation for your physical and mental well-being. items.desc: Munich, Bavaria, Germany Sales Ref ID: JR-022574 Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. Who We Are In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. Job Summary As a result of our continued growth, we're hiring Domain Consultant / Solutions Engineer at Idira [CyberArk], to support our team in Germany. You will be at the forefront of demonstrating the value of our identity security solutions to both prospective and existing Enterprise customers. In this role, you will showcase how Idira [CyberArk] secures critical assets across hybrid cloud environments, distributed workforces, and emerging AI-driven workloads through product demos, presentations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs). You will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to guide clients through the technology evaluation phase. Working closely with the sales team, you will act as the primary technical resource, serving as the key technical advisor and advocate for Idira’s solutions, ensuring that clients understand the business, technical, and compliance benefits. Success in this role depends on clearly communicating complex technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders. We are seeking a solution-driven professional passionate about solving modern security challenges across global industries. Your Impact Execute ownership over assigned standard product opportunities, applying technical expertise and established frameworks to secure the Technical Win, collaborating with peers when navigating complex challenges. Define and execute core technical demonstrations and validate standard customer use cases, finalizing the Design of Record (DoR) to effectively validate solution fit. Orchestrate internal resources to identify and resolve lifecycle obstacles, proactively keeping proof-of-value (POV) projects moving forward to completion. Maintain steady execution velocity and resilience during standard POVs, efficiently troubleshooting technical roadblocks when parameters shift. Drive technical fluency across assigned subdomains, continuously expanding hands-on expertise to broaden domain coverage. Guide customer decisions by effectively communicating key technical capabilities and core platform features to technical stakeholders. Define the technical vision for customers by showcasing operational benefits and key features during engagements to highlight platform value. Drive alignment with internal stakeholders by maintaining accurate data hygiene for assigned opportunities and actively sharing technical discoveries with the broader team. Qualifications Proven track record working with customers, demonstrating strong problem-solving, communication skills, and a "can-do" attitude. Solid understanding of identity providers and directories (e.g., Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, LDAP, Ping). Strong background in enterprise technology stacks, including Windows Server administration and Unix/Linux environments. Strong background in enterprise Cloud environments across AWS, Azure or GCP. Ability to integrate third-party enterprise software within complex, distributed infrastructure environments. Ability to travel as needed for in-person customer meetings up to 50% Full proficiency in English and German. Preferred: 3+ years in IT Cybersecurity pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting roles. Experience with DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-agnostic architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Scripting and coding experience (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell, REST APIs) for workflow automation, platform integration and environment deployment. Familiarity with the modern developer lifecycle, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and microservices environments. items.desc: Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. Company Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what's possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. Role As a robotics and automation technician (Mechatroniker für Robotik und Automatisierung) at Intrinsic, you will play a key role in unlocking the full potential of our existing robotics labs in Munich. Ideal candidates are proactive and willing to tackle unexpected challenges as part of a team. You are a team player and take ownership of your responsibilities. You thrive in a dynamic environment and continuously develop your skills as the complexity of our work steadily increases. In this challenging and hands-on role, you will work on a wide range of robot automation solutions for customers as well as internal cell and experimental setups. You will be responsible for a broad spectrum of tasks. Your focus will be on the basic CAD design, procurement and manufacturing (e.g., 3D printing) of system components, mechanical/pneumatic assembly, and electrical installation of robot cells or laboratory setups. Furthermore, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of our laboratory facilities by performing regular maintenance regarding functionality and safety, managing warehouse logistics, and handling organizational tasks such as shipping, procurement, inventory management, and purchasing. By taking on these important daily responsibilities, you will make a significant contribution to the team's success. How your work moves the mission forward Working closely with mechanical engineers, product managers, software developers and researchers to design, maintain and refine our automation systems for electronic manufacturing from the ground up. Manufacturing mechanical and electrical assemblies for fast, innovative R&D robot automation cells. This includes visualizing concepts, creating CAD designs, and producing prototypes. Perform electrical tests and troubleshoot faults in existing automation cells. Manage daily laboratory maintenance, warehouse logistics and hardware-related office tasks (shipping, procurement, inventory and purchasing) to create a highly efficient working environment. Independent and timely completion of projects Reading and executing hardware specifications and circuit diagrams for assembling and wiring industrial control cabinets, robot peripherals, and HMI/PLC hardware Procurement and integration of best-in-class technology products into automation work cells Document and communicate your work clearly and understandably to internal stakeholders. Representation of the local laboratory manager in their absence. Skills you will need to be successful Completed vocational training with several years of relevant experience, ideally qualification as a master craftsman or technician (Mechatronik Meister oder Techniker) in the field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a related field. Demonstrable practical experience in mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, and troubleshooting of laboratory or production systems Experience in the installation and operation of common mobile or stationary robot applications Professional experience with CAD-Software for checking mechanical designs, layouts and electrical systems Understanding of plant and occupational safety, related occupational safety certificate is a plus Knowledge of the interpretation of electrical and pneumatic circuit diagrams, as well as the ability to assemble industrial control cabinets. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.) Job Description Thermo Fisher Scientific is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue exceeding $25 billion. No other company can match our range of customer touch points – technologically, geographically or commercially. We help our customers in finding cures for cancer, protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe and moving forward with thousands of important projects that impact our lives. Role: Field Service Engineer - Electron Microscopy Location: Cork, Limerick and Dublin How will you make an impact? Do you want to join a company known as a fast paced global leader in serving science? Are you passionate about making a difference and providing professional service for high-tech equipment? This is a great opportunity to work in a global company dedicated to improving the human condition and advancing research in industry. You will become a part of the UK Materials and Structural Analysis Field Service team, servicing Electron Microscopes. You enjoy being on the road and can expect to be travelling up to 30% of your time, primarily to our customer sites within Ireland. You will be expected to travel to key customers located in Cork, Limerick and Dublin. There will also be opportunities to support colleagues within the UK and Europe from time to time. This role suits someone who enjoys working in a high-paced environment. Your proactive approach, team spirit and eagerness to continuously develop your skills are what will ultimately drive our success. Our organization is developing, and we guarantee an interesting and exciting position in an international environment with opportunity for professional and personal growth. What will you do? Performing field service activities, including on-site installation, upgrades, preventive maintenance and system repairs Solving a broad range of hardware and/or software problems of varying scope and complexity Coordinating your own work schedule with direct colleagues, service operations and management Training customers in the use of our instruments to ensure safe and effective customer operations Providing proactive and responsive technical telephone and email support, ensuring that our customers are successful using their instrumentation Producing timely and accurate reports of your activities: e.g. service reports and expense reports Assuring highest level of Customer Experience to achieve customer satisfaction and loyalty Providing sales leads to account manager Providing feedback to support teams for correcting system documentation and updating procedures How will you get here? Typically requires a BEng or preferably a MEng degree in Mechanical or Electronic Engineering or other applicable experience in a high-tech environment. Analytical trouble shooting and problem solving abilities Excellent hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity Excellent communication skills in English, verbal and written. Independent, service-minded individual who can converse with customers at a very all academic levels Highly organised, self-sufficient and motivated individual who is adept at administration Knowledge of Electron Microscopes is an advantage Clean Driving license required

The Lab Technician is responsible for contributing to the overall running of the Process Sciences Laboratory and working across site as part of a diverse and interdisciplinary team to build capability and knowledge in the manufacture of biologics . Familiarity with lab operations and experience of lab administration is preferred. Understanding of Upstream and Downstream Unit Operations for biologics manufacturing and Analytical testing is preferred. Effective communicator with the ability to think logically and be proactive under pressure and work as part of a diverse cross-functional team.
