items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an exceptional Controls Design Engineer to join our Data Center Global Services (DCGS) Controls Design Engineering (CDE) team. This role will focus on Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design standards and coordination across AWS's global data center portfolio. The Controls Design Engineering team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing global data center design standards with a focus on controls, automation, and electrical power monitoring systems. As the primary owner of BMS/EPMS specifications, Controls Points Lists (CPL), Basis of Design (BOD) documents, and scope of work within AWS's infrastructure engineering organization, CDE ensures consistency and excellence across all data center control systems. In this role, you will serve as a single point of contact for multiple internal and external stakeholders across: New construction builds (Leased/Owned, Build-to-Suit, and Colocation facilities) Legacy site enhancement and retrofit projects Data center support projects Special initiatives and innovation projects You will drive significant cost reductions by minimizing change orders, eliminating scope gaps between contractors, reducing construction schedule delays, optimizing vendor pricing, and decreasing project management and engineering labor costs through standardization and clear documentation. The ideal candidate brings a comprehensive knowledge in data center environmental controls systems, IT infrastructure, networking, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, and project management, combined with strong leadership and collaboration skills. If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act with a global perspective, and want to contribute to sophisticated innovations in building controls and automation for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Key Job Responsibilities: Technical Leadership & Standards Development Develop and maintain deep expertise in building operations, mechanical plant strategies, BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC systems, electrical lineups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental and electrical concepts Apply knowledge of data center redundancy, mechanical failure strategies, Single Point of Failure (SPOF) analysis, energy and water conservation best practices, and data reporting analytics Create, maintain, and disseminate specification documents and Basis of Design standards for global projects Develop and maintain project-specific Scope of Work (SOW) documents incorporating global design standards Drive innovation of new solutions to support team initiatives and company goals Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the central point of contact for multiple internal and external groups regarding BMS/EPMS controls standards Lead and facilitate collaboration with construction teams, controls programmers, MEP/ACS engineers, Design Engineering, Colocation Regional Engineering (CRE), and project managers to accomplish initiative goals Coordinate personally with regional project managers to review and finalize project SOWs Manage and prioritize requests for information across new construction builds, existing facility support, and legacy site enhancement projects Vendor & Procurement Management: Lead vendor selection processes, bid reviews, and RFI support and coordination Evaluate and approve Modbus Device Templates (MDT) for items.desc: About Ekco Founded in 2016, Ekco has quickly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing cloud solution providers and your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider. IT leaders choose Ekco to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk – powered by local expertise, delivered at European scale. We specialise in helping organisations advance their cloud maturity guiding transformation, strengthening security, and maximising the value of their technology investments. ️ In simple terms: we help organisations modernise with confidence securing their systems, optimising their cloud, and keeping them resilient in a rapidly changing world. Today, we’re a thriving team of 1,000+ talented and supportive colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Benelux, South Africa, and Malaysia—and we’re continuing to grow. At Ekco, how we work matters as much as what we deliver. Our people live by four core values that shape everything we do: On It : We take ownership, follow through, and get things done. All In : We collaborate, support each other, and commit fully to shared goals. Connected : We build trusted relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners. Hungry to Grow : We stay curious, keep learning, and push ourselves to the next level. If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home here. The Role Day-to-day at Ekco: We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Architect to lead secure cloud transformation for enterprise and regulated clients, with a particular focus on AWS and strong capability across Microsoft Azure. You will assess complex environments, define security strategies and architectures, and guide the delivery of secure solutions across cloud, hybrid and on-premises platforms. As a trusted advisor, you will translate risk, regulatory obligations and business objectives into practical security designs, assessments and improvement roadmaps. You will lead client engagements from discovery and pre-sales through design assurance and delivery, provide technical leadership to colleagues, produce clear technical and executive artefacts, and help productise reusable Ekco architecture patterns and cloud security services. This hybrid role is based in Dublin and may include travel to client sites. What you’ll be responsible for: Security strategy and assurance: Assess cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments; define security strategies, target architectures, policies, risk registers and prioritised remediation roadmaps aligned to regulatory and industry frameworks. Secure cloud architecture: Design landing zones and guardrails aligned with the AWS and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Frameworks, with particular depth in AWS multi-account architectures and strong experience of Azure enterprise-scale landing zones. Apply Zero Trust principles, network segmentation, encryption, key and secrets management, data protection, sovereignty, and secure backup and recovery patterns. Identity security: Architect workforce, privileged and workload identity controls using AWS IAM and Microsoft Entra ID, including federation, Conditional Access, identity governance and privileged access management. Cloud-native security and governance: Design scalable organisation-level controls, security posture management, and policy enforcement using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, AWS Security Hub, and Amazon GuardDuty, alongside Azure management groups, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel. Threat modelling and design assurance: Lead threat modelling, architecture reviews and security decision-making for applications, platforms, data services and emerging AI use cases. DevSecOps and automation: Embed policy as code, security testing, secrets scanning, dependency, container and software supply-chain controls into infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD workflows across AWS and Azure. Detection, resilience and response: Define logging, monitoring, detection and cloud incident-response requirements; integrate cloud platforms with SIEM and SOC services; and improve ransomware and operational resilience. Client and team leadership: Lead workshops and technical workstreams, support pre-sales and statements of work, mentor and guide architects and engineers, and communicate architecture decisions, risks and recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders. Contribute to the productisation of repeatable cloud security offerings, delivery methods and reusable assets. Essential Experience Substantial experience designing and assuring secure enterprise cloud architectures, with deep practical experience in AWS and strong hands-on expertise across Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments. Strong knowledge of identity, network, platform, application, data, security operations and resilience controls, including Zero Trust and shared-responsibility principles. Hands-on experience with cloud governance, landing zones, multi-account or multi-subscription operating models, Infrastructure as …

items.desc: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Network Operations Technician, you will be directly responsible for operating the growing Starlink Network as we scale to millions of users around the globe as well as the world largest SuperCompute Datacenter Networks. You will execute operational response to real-time network events and anomalies – mitigating their impact before significant service degradation occurs. You will facilitate incident response, engaging and supporting engineering teams to triage and resolve major issues. You will work with engineers across disciplines and external partners to ensure that all problems are root-caused and mitigated to prevent future recurrence. You will manage changes and maintenance required to improve and sustain service for users, while ensuring minimal network downtime. As an embedded operator within the NOC you will work with operations engineering to improve operational processes, increase operational efficiency, and maximize operational capabilities. RESPONSIBILITIES: Detect and triage emerging anomalies on satellites, ground stations, terrestrial network interop, terrestrial network interconnections, network co-location sites, and internet points of presence Provide centralized awareness and management of routine and emergency maintenance performed by SpaceX personnel and partner contractors Execute rapid incident response for major network disruptions Own investigation, troubleshooting and resolution efforts for common network issues Provide advanced troubleshooting support and resolution for complex residential and enterprise escalations in coordination with internal teams Measure, preserve, and improve the uptime and performance of the Starlink Network Follow and improve processes used for operating the Starlink Network BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 1+ year of professional experience troubleshooting and operating computer systems in a network, IT, or security setting including but not limited to a Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), Data Center Operations etc. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Ability to take on projects that require taking initiative and developing new expertise Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with fast changing needs and requirements Experience in mission-critical operations items.desc: ASSO è una cooperativa sociale di tipo B specializzati nella gestione di servizi amministrativi, front office e call center per Aziende Sanitarie. COSA FARÀ LA NUOVA RISORSA? La persona selezionata si occuperà di: Seguire progetti IT e curarne l'implementazione. Gestire e supportare le infrastrutture di rete: LAN, VLAN, firewall, switch e tecnologie correlate. Gestire il pacchetto Microsoft 365 e la posta elettronica aziendale. Monitorare i backup e occuparsi della manutenzione generale dei sistemi IT. Operare in ambienti cloud, in particolare Microsoft Azure e AWS. Gestire e supportare i sistemi VoIP. Supportare, preferibilmente, attività di programmazione e gestione di database. Amministrare ambienti Windows Server e Active Directory. Fornire assistenza su postazioni di lavoro Windows e macOS. Redigere e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica. Fornire supporto helpdesk ai colleghi in caso di problematiche informatiche. Partecipare ad attività di formazione e aggiornamento professionale. REQUISITI Diploma o titolo superiore in ambito informatico. Preferibile possesso di certificazioni informatiche, ad esempio Microsoft, Windows o Cisco. Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Possesso della patente di guida e disponibilità a effettuare brevi trasferte tra le sedi della Cooperativa. CARATTERISTICHE PERSONALI Buone capacità di problem solving. Attitudine al lavoro in team. Autonomia organizzativa e capacità di gestione delle priorità. Flessibilità e disponibilità a brevi trasferte. Buone capacità comunicative e predisposizione al supporto di colleghi e utenti. SI OFFRE Inserimento diretto in azienda con contratto a tempo determinato di 6 mesi, finalizzato alla successiva trasformazione a tempo indeterminato. Inquadramento al livello B1 del CCNL Cooperative Sociali. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) iniziale indicativa: € 20.100, corrispondente al trattamento economico previsto per l'inquadramento indicato, su 14 mensilità. items.desc: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Cashmere Engineer Specialist Dehaired Fiber Quality Control Oversee the quality of dehaired cashmere fiber entering the supply chain, ensuring it meets Grade A specifications for micron, length, purity, and vegetable matter content. Establish and enforce clear acceptance criteria for dehaired fiber, including maximum coarse hair content and minimum yield thresholds. Inspect and approve incoming dehaired fiber lots before release to spinning mills, flagging any non-conforming material for return or rework. Partner with dehairing facilities to optimize processes that maximize Grade A output while minimizing fiber damage or waste. Grade A Standards Enforcement Define what constitutes Grade A cashmere for the organization. Conduct regular audits of dehairing suppliers to ensure consistent adherence to Grade A specifications. Work upstream with sourcing and herder cooperatives to improve raw fiber quality before dehairing, reducing Grade A rejection rates. Finished Yarn Quality Assurance Evaluate finished cashmere yarns against required quality standards, including evenness, tensile strength, twist consistency, and surface cleanliness. Test yarns for critical attributes such as pilling potential, colorfastness, and handfeel before approval for knitting production. Identify and reject yarn lots that fail to meet quality thresholds, documenting defects and communicating findings to spinning mills. Cashmere Material Library Build and maintain a physical and digital cashmere material library, cataloging dehaired fiber lots and finished yarns by key attributes (micron, origin, color, lot number, test results). Organize the library to support cross-functional teams (R&D, Product Development, Sourcing, Production) in referencing past and current materials for development and troubleshooting. Include reference standards for Grade A fiber and approved yarn constructions to serve as benchmarks for quality comparisons. Update the library regularly with new fiber lots, yarn developments, and supplier samples, ensuring traceability from raw material to finished yarn. Root Cause & Corrective Actions Investigate quality failures in finished yarns—such as neps, slubs, weak spots, or inconsistent dye uptake—to determine if the root cause lies in dehaired fiber, spinning, or finishing. Collaborate with dehairing and spinning partners to implement corrective actions and prevent repeat issues. Track quality trends across fiber lots and yarn batches to identify recurring supplier or process weaknesses. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. items.desc: PhD position in a novel cell secretome-based therapeutics for osteoarthritis Faculty: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine Department: Department of Biomolecular Health Sciences Hours per week: 36 to 40 Application deadline: 31 October 2026 Your job This PhD project will tackle key challenges in developing new therapies based on Extracellular Vesicles(EV)-enriched scretomes. The aim of the research is to develop innovative technologies that can be used to monitor batch-to-batch consistency of EV-based therapeutics, decipher EV- molecular cargo - functional relationships, and identify disease-related signatures in blood and synovial fluid from patients with osteoarthritis. Overall, the project aims to provide new insights and tools for the development of safe, effective, and consistent EV-based therapies. In this project hands-on analytical wet-lab experiments, including cell biological analyses, multi-omics mass spectrometry and nanoparticle analyses of EV samples, production batches and patients samples, as well as computational methods including AI-enhanced analyses are equally important. Throughout the project, you will develop core skills in fundamental cell biology and metabolism research, in mass spectrometry and integrated multi-omics analysis, and gain insights in the mechanism of action of EV-enriched cell secretome therapy in osteoarthritis. items.desc: Over de functie Als Software Quality Engineer ben je de kritische blik binnen het Scrum-team. Je ontwikkelcollega’s kijken of iets werkt. Jij kijkt verder: welke edge cases zijn er, wat gebeurt er onder druk, en waar zitten de risico’s? Je test handmatig, voert stresstests uit en zoekt gericht naar fouten voordat de klant ze vindt. Voor testautomatisering wordt Playwright gebruikt. Jij zet automatische tests op, onderhoudt ze en breidt ze verder uit. Je houdt de CI/CD-pipelines en testresultaten in de gaten en denkt actief mee over de teststrategie, de scenario’s en de testdata. Er is veel ruimte om het testen slimmer en efficiënter te maken. Heb je een idee voor een nieuwe tool of aanpak? Dan krijg je de vrijheid om die uit te proberen. Dat geldt ook voor het inzetten van AI-tools om je werk te ondersteunen. Jouw kwaliteiten Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig en een beetje wantrouwig als het om software gaat, in de goede zin van het woord. Je ziet details die anderen missen, je wacht niet af maar verbetert processen uit jezelf, en je vindt het leuk om nieuwe tools uit te proberen. Wat je meebrengt: HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau Ervaring met testautomatisering, bij voorkeur met Playwright Kennis van C# / .NET en JavaScript Analytisch sterk, oog voor detail en proactief Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Pré: ervaring met browser-testrecordingtools die naar Playwright exporteren Pré: kennis van E2E-testautomatisering voor mobiele applicaties De voordelen Goed werk verdient een goed pakket. Wat je krijgt: Salaris tussen €2.600 en €5.500 op basis van je kennis en ervaring 25 vakantiedagen Reiskostenvergoeding Goede pensioenregeling Flexibele werktijden Afwisselend thuiswerken en werken op kantoor 32 tot 40 uur per week Een afwisselende functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en groei Naast het werk is er volop aandacht voor gezelligheid. Met wekelijkse borrels, gevierde verjaardagen en regelmatig een uitje leer je je collega’s snel kennen, ook buiten de sprints om. Leer de organisatie kennen De tuinbouwsector is een van de meest innovatieve sectoren van Nederland. Achter de kassen draait een complexe organisatie van mensen, planning en processen. Om dat goed te regelen is software nodig die betrouwbaar werkt, elke dag weer. Deze organisatie ontwikkelt arbeidsregistratiesoftware voor tuinbouwbedrijven en werkt daarnaast aan moderne cloudoplossingen. Het is een organisatie waar de lijnen kort zijn en waar je elkaar kent. De teams voor development, customer support en sales werken nauw samen. Iedere twee weken laat het ontwikkelteam aan het hele bedrijf zien wat er is gebouwd. Zo weet iedereen waar de anderen mee bezig zijn en voelt het echt als één team. Je werkt op een mooi kantoor in het Westland en kunt afwisselend thuiswerken. Er is ruimte voor eigen initiatief en voor groei in je vakgebied. Ook naast het werk is er genoeg te doen: wekelijkse borrels, verjaardagen die gevierd worden en regelmatig een bedrijfsuitje. Klinkt goed? Ben jij geïnteresseerd in bovenstaand profiel? Good Company ziet graag jouw sollicitatie tegemoet! Solliciteer via onze website op de vacature van Software Quality Engineer.

Collaborate with software, controls, electrical, mechanical, systems, data, product, and service disciplines. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 1.11.2026 Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Arbeidsspråk Norsk Sektor Privat Vil du bruke regulatorisk kompetanse og dataanalyse til å videreutvikle løsninger for bankenes myndighetsrapportering? I SpareBank 1 Utvikling søker vi nå en dataanalytiker med en kombinasjon av teknisk og regulatorisk kompetanser som vil være med på å modernisere og videreutvikle løsningene som brukes til myndighetsrapportering og kapitalberegning i SpareBank 1-bankene. Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, data og komplekse forretningsbehov. Du vil få mulighet til å fordype deg i både bank- og risikodomenet, samtidig som du arbeider med datamodellering, store datamengder og moderne datateknologi. Om oss Du blir ansatt i Kredittrisikoområde og jobber i Team Risk. Teamet har ansvar for løsninger innen kapitalberegning og regulatorisk rapportering, blant annet COREP, FINREP og ORBOF. Vi står foran en omfattende modernisering. Eksisterende kode og løsninger skal videreutvikles og flyttes til en moderne dataplattform, samtidig som vi skal håndtere nye regulatoriske krav og utvikle fremtidens datamodeller. Du vil blant annet: analysere og strukturere krav til regulatorisk rapportering videreutvikle og modernisere kode og dataløsninger for sammenstilling av kredittrisikodata identifisere nødvendige datakilder og etablere gode koblinger mellom kildedata, forretningslogikk og rapporteringskrav utvikle og forvalte datamodeller for COREP-, FINREP- og ORBOF-rapportering bidra til implementering av nye regulatoriske krav og rapporteringstaksonomier utvikle og forbedre datakvalitetskontroller, analyser og avstemminger bidra til å dokumentere robuste og etterprøvbare dataleveranser samarbeide tett med regulatoriske spesialister, økonomi- og risikomiljøer i bankene og andre data engineers Hvem er du? Vi tror du vil trives i rollen hvis du liker å sette deg inn i komplekse problemstillinger, forstå hvordan data henger sammen og omsette krav til løsninger som fungerer i praksis. Vi ser etter deg som har: erfaring med eller kjennskap til regulatorisk rapportering for banker – COREP, FINREP, ORBOF Kjennskap til regulatoriske krav for banker (CRR3, IFRS9), EBA-taksonomier, rapporteringsmaler og datadefinisjoner god kompetanse innen SQL og datamodellering erfaring med å analysere og bearbeide store datasett, samt evne til å forstå sammenhengen mellom kildedata, forretningsregler og rapporteringsbehov evne til å formidle tekniske problemstillinger, krav og testresultater til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske fagmiljøer relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne innen teknologi, økonomi, matematikk eller tilsvarende. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med eller kjennskap til ett eller flere av følgende områder: bankregnskap, utlån, kapitalberegning eller kredittrisiko bank, finans eller revisjon av regulatorisk rapportering Snowflake, dbt, Python, Git eller tilsvarende teknologier Men, hvorfor skal du velge oss? Her får du arbeide i en kombinasjon som ikke finnes så mange andre steder: moderne datateknologi, komplekse regulatoriske problemstillinger og løsninger som skal fungere på tvers av selvstendige banker. Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Du vil få jobbe med dyktige og ambisiøse kollegaer, og bli en del av et sterkt faglig miljø som jobber smidig og målrettet. Du får jobbe i fine lokaler i sentrum av Oslo, med innendørs sykkelparkering og nytt treningsrom med gruppetimer og garderober. Vi er selvsagt konkurransedyktige på lønn og har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi har også sommertid, og flere fine firmahytter. Når det er sagt – vi hverken tror eller håper du velger oss kun på grunn av dette. Vi håper du vil jobbe hos oss fordi du verdsetter en arbeidsplass hvor samarbeid, kompetanse, deling og tillit danner grunnmuren i arbeidshverdagen. Slik blir vi bedre sammen! En del av noe større SpareBank 1 Utvikling gir personer, bedrifter og lokalsamfunn over hele landet trygghet, forutsigbarhet og nærhet til økonomien deres gjennom digitale løsninger som begeistrer. Vi er SpareBank 1-alliansens felles utviklingsselskap som gir bankene fart og styrke innen digital innovasjon og faglig tyngde på tvers av en rekke kritiske områder. Gjennom over 60 tverrfaglige team jobber vi tett sammen for å dele kunnskap og gjøre hverandre gode. Nysgjerrig? Dersom du ønsker å bli litt mer kjent med oss eller stillingen før du søker, eller hvis du har noen spørsmål, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt med Karina Folvik, leder modernisering og videreutvikling, karina.folvik@sparebank1.no. Du kan også lære mer om hvem vi er og hvordan vi jobber på karrieresiden vår eller på LinkedIn, Instagram eller Medium. Hos oss er det enkelt å søke - du trenger bare å laste opp en CV og skrive noen ord om hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss. Vi ønsker å fortsette å representere …

items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 05.11.2026 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Sektor Offentlig Utvikler for neste generasjons IMINT-plattform Etterretningstjenesten – Viten om verden for vern av Norge Etterretningstjenesten har som oppdrag å samle inn informasjon og varsle om forhold i utlandet som kan true Norge og norske interesser. Vi søker nå etter utviklere til vårt IMINT-miljø. Som medarbeider i Etterretningstjenesten vil du bidra i vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag, samt være en del av et miljø kjennetegnet av høy kompetanse og sterkt engasjement for fagfeltet. IMINT (Imagery Intelligence) handler om å trekke kritiske observasjoner og analyser ut fra bilder. Her får du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom satellittbilder, maskinlæring og store datamengder. I vårt utviklerteam jobber vi med en moderne stack som inkluderer blant annet Angular, NodeJs, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Python og GDAL, samt computer vision. For å møte økende behov og videreutvikle våre systemer, ser vi etter deg som enten er en sterk fullstack-utvikler, eller som har spisskompetanse og lidenskap for spesifikke deler av stacken. Vi tilbyr en spennende og variert hverdag i et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter. Vi oppfordrer både nyutdannede og erfarne utviklere til å søke. Vi er avhengige av mangfold i perspektiver og erfaringer for å løse våre oppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi å rekruttere medarbeidere fra ulike bakgrunner, med ulike livserfaringer til å jobbe hos oss. Kvinner oppfordres til å søke stillingen. Arbeidsoppgaver Hovedoppgaven din blir å utvikle og innovere systemene og verktøyene våre for bildeanalyse, som er helt avgjørende for våre IMINT-analytikere. Dette innebærer: Utvikling og videreutvikling av løsninger for prosessering og databehandling Utvikle funksjonalitet for å fremvise og interagere med data innenfor IMINT og remote sensing Kvalifikasjoner Stillingen har følgende krav som må innfris for å bli vurdert som aktuell søker: Overingeniør: Bachelorgrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (cand.-grader, tidl. Ingeniørutdanninger o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet Senioringeniør: Mastergrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (hovedfag, profesjonsstudier o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet For begge: God teknisk innsikt og sikkerhetsforståelse God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk Erfaring innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: Programmering med Typescript, Rust og/eller Python Moderne webutvikling med fortrinnsvis Angular, React, Vue eller Svelte Moderne backend-rammeverk og patterns SQL og databaser som f.eks. Postgres I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har: Erfaring med moderne DevOps/CICD/Kubernetes Erfaring med teamarbeid innenfor programmering/utvikling Erfaring og kunnskap innenfor remote sensing Særskilte krav for stilling i Etterretningstjenesten: Søkere må tilfredsstille kravene til høyeste sikkerhetsklarering. For ansettelse i Etterretningstjenesten kan man ikke ha annet enn norsk statsborgerskap ved ansettelsestidspunktet. Stillingen er underlagt beordringsplikt, jf. forsvarsloven og forsvarstilsatteforskriften, som innebærer at du kan beordres til internasjonale operasjoner. Dette skjer normalt på grunnlag av villighet. Beordringsplikt medfører krav til medisinsk og fysisk skikkethet og grunnleggende engelskkunnskaper. Dersom du ikke oppfyller kravene har du mulighet til å søke dispensasjon. Personlige egenskaper Personlig egnethet for en stilling i Etterretningstjenesten vil bli ilagt stor vekt: Holdninger og pålitelighet: Etterretningstjenesten krever høy faglig- og personlig integritet, pålitelighet og lojalitet av sine medarbeidere. Lærelyst og planmessighet: Vi søker personer som ivrer for sitt fagfelt, og som møter arbeidsdagen med lærelyst og et ønske om å levere. Samspill og samarbeid: I Etterretningstjenesten er vi opptatt av å ha et godt arbeidsmiljø. God lagånd, respekt og toleranse i møte med andre er av stor betydning. Stressmestring: Det er en forutsetning at våre medarbeidere har evnen til å stå i periodevis stor arbeidsbelastning. I tillegg ønsker vi at du: Er initiativrik Er kreativ Er sikkerhetsbevissthet Vi tilbyr Hos oss får du en spennende og samfunnsviktig jobb hvor du vil kunne utgjøre en forskjell. Etterretningstjenesten er opptatt av å øke kompetansen hos de ansatte, og det vil satses både på deg som person og din faginteresse. Våre ansatte har fleksitid, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden, samt gunstige lån- og pensjonsordninger gjennom Statens pensjonskasse. Du vil få en årslønn innenfor spennet kr 690 000 – 830 000 i stillingen som overingeniør (kode: 1087) eller kr 785 000 - 980 000 i stillingen som senioringeniør (1181) iht. gjeldende Hovedtariffavtale. items.desc: DevOps Engineer — Junior+ / Mid-Level We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience to join our team and gradually take ownership of day-to-day operational tasks. You’ll work alongside experienced DevOps engineers on CI/CD, application deployments, troubleshooting, monitoring, and automation. We expect you to handle routine tasks independently, with guidance and review available for unfamiliar or more complex work. Required skills 1. Linux and networking Practical Linux administration experience: processes, services, permissions, packages, and logs. Ability to troubleshoot common CPU, memory, and disk usage issues. Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS fundamentals, routing, and load balancing. Ability to investigate service availability and connectivity issues. 2. Bash and Git Ability to read, maintain, and write Bash scripts for automation, including error handling. Practical experience with Git: branches, merge requests, and resolving conflicts. 3. Docker and Kubernetes Ability to write Dockerfiles, build and run container images, and work with environment variables, volumes, and container networking. Hands-on experience deploying applications to Kubernetes using Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets. Understanding of health probes, resource requests, and limits. Ability to troubleshoot application startup and runtime issues using logs and Kubernetes events. 4. CI/CD Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins. Ability to independently modify existing build and deployment pipelines and troubleshoot failures. Understanding of pipeline variables, secrets, and artifacts. 5. Monitoring and troubleshooting Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana: finding relevant metrics, investigating alerts, and updating existing dashboards. Ability to find and analyse application logs. Nice to have GitOps principles and Argo CD Helm Terraform or Ansible Python scripting Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP Centralised logging tools such as Loki or ELK/EFK Kubernetes NetworkPolicies How we work We value ownership of routine tasks, a systematic approach to troubleshooting, and care when making changes. You should be comfortable verifying results, understanding how to roll back a change, documenting solutions, and asking for help when needed. As you become familiar with our infrastructure, you’ll take on more complex tasks and broader responsibilities, with support from the team. Project Description Gradually take ownership of operational tasks Maintain and improve existing CI/CD pipelines, troubleshoot build and deployment failures. Deploy and configure applications in Kubernetes using established workflows. Investigate infrastructure and application issues, escalating complex cases with relevant findings. Maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting rules, review metrics and logs to identify issues. Automate repetitive tasks using Bash and other tools. Perform routine Linux administration and infrastructure maintenance. Support development teams with deployment and environment issues. Document procedures, troubleshooting steps, and infrastructure changes. Validate changes and prepare rollback steps, following the team’s review and release processes. Personnel specialist: Svetlana Gavaga Email: sgavaga@ibagroup.eu

Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Project Controller (m/f/d), you will support all commercial aspects regarding driving large and complex Energy projects in various business models. You will be working together with the Commercial Project Manager and the project execution team to ensure a high project execution quality. Your daily work will include lots of collaboration with technical project managers, partners, and other team members. How You’ll Make an Impact Support the commercial project execution of contracts with customers, regional companies, consortium partners, sub-suppliers, and other Siemens Energy entities, in close collaboration with the Commercial Project Management. Support in the forecast and reporting. Support commercial activities that are conducted in accordance with Siemens Energy guidelines. Regular discussions and maintenance of the current cost calculation with project management. Handling of sub-supplier and contractor purchase orders, accurately check, timing and cost accuracy of supplier invoices, as well as cost controlling for the project. Support with all other financial and commercial aspects of the project such as tax issues, hiring out of personnel, bank guarantees, insurance claims etc. Support project execution teams with various administrative tasks, travel expense reports etc. What You Bring: Bachelor’s degree in business administration. At least 2 years of working in the commercial/finance area - preferably projects business. Basic Experience in project controlling, invoicing, purchase orders, hiring-out of personnel, currency management, tax topics, and month-end closing process. Ability to work in an international team and cope well with temporary high workloads. Experience of SAP (PS, FI/CO), MS Excel. Fluent communication in English and Polish About the Team SE FIN GS SO CPM2 is an international finance organization of approximately 70 Commercial Project Managers and Project Controllers supporting the successful execution of around 15 complex Category A and B projects within Gas Services Solutions. The team partners closely with Project Management and a broad cross-functional network across countries and regions. Its ambition is to combine strong commercial governance and project expertise with an inclusive people culture, continuous capability development, and practical AI-enabled ways of working that improve speed, quality, transparency, and decision support. items.desc: Company Description Eurofins is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across its companies around the world. Job Description Master Data & Data Quality Create, maintain and enrich master data records. Ensure data quality, consistency and compliance with global standards. Analyze data quality trends and identify areas requiring improvement. Support data governance initiatives and standardization projects. Business Analysis & Project Support Organize and lead meetings with business stakeholders worldwide. Gather, document and challenge business requirements. Translate business needs into practical solutions and process improvements. Coordinate activities with purchasing, finance, laboratories and other stakeholders. Independently manage smaller improvement projects from idea to implementation. Prepare business cases and recommendations based on data analysis. Reporting & Analytics Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports. Use Power Query and Excel to transform and analyze datasets. Identify trends, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities. Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and management. AI & Automation Leverage AI and Large Language Models (Copilot, ChatGPT or similar tools) to improve productivity and data quality. Identify opportunities for automation and process simplification. Participate in implementation of AI-driven solutions supporting Master Data operations. Qualifications Bachelor’s, Engineering, or Master’s degree Minimum 6 months of relevant experience working with data Intermediate knowledge of Excel English at a minimum B2 level, with the ability to conduct meetings with stakeholders Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a problem-solving attitude Experience working with ERP systems would be an advantage Customer-service mindset Familiarity with Power BI, Power Query, and/or VBA would be an asset Additional Information We support your development! Do you feel like you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development. We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique. Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 57 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

items.desc: Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility? Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. Supplier Risk Management Assets Professional Europe ensures visibility of supplier-owned production assets and coordinates their transfer between supplier sites to support project needs, mitigate supplier risks, and maintain production continuity. This role is based in our office in Kraków, Poland. Key Responsibilities: Control and maintain European scope for inventory audits Conduct onsite and remote inventory audits to identify assets leased by OPM to the Tier 2 suppliers. Activities to cover: data collection, photo documentation, tools tagging Maintain up to date data base of assets inventory in TEMPO including 3D models of tools and pictures confirming inventory results Fulfil KPI's related with inventory audits Support asset relocations between suppliers production sites Support and lead tools adaptation at supplier plant Participate to the try-outs at the supplier, evaluate the mold robustness Support technical assessment of the tools before and after relocations Sign transfer protocol for relocated tools Stay in close communication with Supply Chain, Operations and Quality for topics related with asset inventory and relocation processes Must have requirements Willingness to travel to supplier locations for on site assets inventory above 50% of time; Basic technical knowledge regarding assets; Good knowledge of tools and solution to define processes optimizations, automatization and efficiency increase Communicative English Attituded focused on delivering results in challenging environment Other requirements Experience in area of Purchasing / Assets Inventory / Tools & Processes; At least 2 years of automotive experience Shopfloor or technical experience nice to have; Knowledge of MS Excel; PowerBI, Power Automate, AI tools and analytical thinking are nice to have What we offer: Competitive salary Employment Stability Private Life Insurance Social Fund Healthcare (Luxmed) Other Social Services (Cafeteria system, e.g. Multisport card) Transport allowance Home office (2 days per week) Flexible working hours Company events 26 days of vacation. At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. This is a pivotal position supporting our partners , where you will help deliver critical Patient Monitoring solutions to hospitals across the region. You are responsible for End‑to‑end Order Management for the Nordics region, ensuring accurate and timely execution of customer orders Proactive monitoring and follow‑up of orders and customer requests, providing clear and timely updates on order status Managing credit notes, billing disputes , and related financial order corrections Processing and coordinating warranty claims and product returns Providing direct customer support and acting as a trusted operational partner for customers Supporting Key Account Managers with daily order‑related and operational activities Monitoring and supporting automated order processes Analyzing order data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify trends and improvement opportunities Driving continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes, reduce exceptions, and enhance customer experience Collaborating cross‑functionally with Sales, Logistics, Planning, Production, Finance, and Automation teams to ensure smooth order execution You are part of the Hospital Patient Monitoring (HPM) Order Management team , working in a fast‑paced, collaborative, and international environment. The team focuses on efficiency, automation, and customer satisfaction while supporting critical healthcare deliveries across the region. The base salary range for this role is PLN 71,200.00 – PLN 94,933.33. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for 10% short term incentive, with your rewards linked to company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Support contract management activities, including tracking contract status, service-level agreements, key performance indicators, pricing structures, and renewal timelines. Assist with supplier risk assessments, business continuity planning, onboarding requirements, and corrective action follow-up. Contribute to the development of global tools, templates, processes, and reporting methods to improve sourcing visibility and trade compliance support. Maintain strong communication and collaboration with global, regional, and local stakeholders. Understanding of logistics operations, international trade flows, customs clearance processes, or import/export support activities. Additional knowledge / nice-to-have skills / preferred qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: Experience supporting customs brokerage, customs clearance, trade compliance, or international freight-related sourcing activities. Experience using sourcing platforms, procurement systems, supplier performance tools, TMS, ERP, or logistics reporting systems. Experience supporting multi-country, regional, or global sourcing initiatives. Knowledge of supplier performance management, service-level agreements, key performance indicators, and contract administration. Ability to work effectively with trade compliance, logistics, procurement, legal, finance, and operations teams. Professional certification such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCMP, or similar is a plus. Podstawą działalności pozostaje hurtowa dystrybucja farmaceutyków, realizowana dzięki nowoczesnym i wysoko wyspecjalizowanym centrom dystrybucyjnym, zapewniającym niezawodność dostaw. Jest ekspertem w segmencie badań klinicznych, stając się jednym z liderów w dostarczaniu pacjentom dostępu do nowoczesnych terapii medycznych. Ponadto NEUCA jest doświadczonym producentem leków i preparatów aptecznych. Kluczowymi partnerami dla Grupy są niezależni aptekarze, których NEUCA wspiera w prowadzeniu aptek, dostarczając narzędzi do budowania konkurencyjności i rentowności. nr 1 największy dystrybutor farmaceutyków w Polsce 30 lat funkcjonowania na rynku zdrowia ponad 9000 zatrudnionych pracowników

items.desc: Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM) z siedzibą w Nashville, Tennessee, i Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA) z siedzibą w Brukseli, Belgia, działają wspólnie jako strategiczny region „Bridgestone West”. Ten region obsługuje strategiczne potrzeby biznesowe zespołów w obu Amerykach, Europie, na Bliskim Wschodzie i w Afryce. BSAM i BSEMEA są spółkami zależnymi Bridgestone Corporation, z główną siedzibą w Japonii. Bridgestone i jego spółki zależne opracowują, produkują i sprzedają szeroką gamę produktów i rozwiązań Bridgestone, Firestone i marek stowarzyszonych, aby sprostać potrzebom szerokiego grona klientów i branż. Bridgestone Poznań , Sygnatariusz Karty Różnorodności, jest jedną z najnowocześniejszych fabryk koncernu na świecie. Zatrudnia ponad 1700 pracowników i produkuje ponad 500 rodzajów zaawansowanych technologicznie opon, z których korzystają najwięksi producenci samochodów na świecie, w tym marki premium i prestige. Więcej informacji o Bridgestone Poznań można znaleźć na stronie http://bridgestone-poznan.pl/ W związku z powstałym wakatem poszukujemy osób na stanowisko: MAGAZYNIER / MAGAZYNIERKA miejsce pracy: Bridgestone Poznań Jeśli jesteś gotowy(-wa) do pracy fizycznej w systemie zmianowym, jeśli lubisz pracę w zespole, jeśli posiadasz prawo jazdy kat B, jeśli posiadasz uprawnienia do obsługi wózków widłowych – będzie to dodatkowy atut! Nasza oferta dla Ciebie, to: stabilne warunki zatrudnienia w oparciu o umowę o pracę, atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie - średnia miesięczna płaca to około 6800-7500 PLN brutto, system premii miesięcznych, w którym nagradzamy za osiągnięcia, prywatna opieka medyczna współfinanasowana przez pracodawcę, ubezpieczenie grupowe współfinanasowane przez pracodawcę, świadczenia świąteczne i wakacyjne, Pracowniczy Program Emerytalny finansowany przez pracodawcę, szkolenia pozwalające na podnoszenie kwalifikacji, w tym m.in. możliwość zdobycia uprawnień UDT do obsługi wózków widłowych po okresie próbnym, dofinansowanie do karty sportowej oraz startów w zawodach sportowych, zniżki na usługi telekomunikacyjne, dofinansowanie posiłków w zakładowej kantynie oraz świeże owoce, program rekomendacji pracowniczych. Co będziesz robić – główne obowiązki: przyjęciu palet z oponami do magazynu – praca na wózku widłowym typu reach truck, kompletacji opon zgodnie z zamówieniami naszych klientów – praca na wózku widłowym typu reach truck, ręcznym załadunku opon z palet na samochód z wykorzystaniem wózka widłowego czołowego. Czego potrzebujesz, aby objąć to stanowisko – nasze wymagania: wykształcenie minimum zawodowe, motywacja do pracy w magazynie, gotowość do pracy fizycznej w systemie dwuzmianowym czterobrygadowym (12/12) lub trzyzmianowym od poniedziałku do piątku, dobra świadomość BHP, zorientowanie na jakość, dobra współpraca w zespole, znajomość języka polskiego na poziomie średniozaawansowanym w mowie i piśmie, doświadczenie w pracy w magazynie, doświadczenie w pracy zmianowej, posiadanie ważnych dokumentów uprawniających do legalnego zatrudnienia w Polsce (np. wiza, karta pobytu lub inne odpowiednie dokumenty). Dodatkowym atutem będzie posiadanie uprawnień na wózki widłowe. Następne kroki w procesie: Wszystkie aplikacje zostaną rozpatrzone. Nasz zespół HR skontaktuje się z osobami, które chcielibyśmy zaprosić do kolejnego etapu rekrutacji. Nie wahaj się i aplikuj klikając przycisk Aplikuj/Aplikuj teraz Czekamy na Twoją wiadomość! Jesteśmy zobowiązani do stworzenia jeszcze bardziej inkluzywnej kultury, która promuje równość, obejmuje indywidualność i pomaga naszym coraz bardziej zróżnicowanym członkom zespołu, klientom i społecznościom rozwijać się, zapewniając równe szanse w zatrudnieniu. Oznacza to, że wszyscy kandydaci do pracy i pracownicy będą traktowani na równi i nie będziemy dyskryminować ze względu na płeć, stan cywilny, pochodzenie etniczne, kolor skóry, obywatelstwo, pochodzenie narodowe, niepełnosprawność, orientację seksualną, religię ani wiek. Jesteśmy pracodawcą zapewniającym równe szanse i uwzględniającym indywidualne potrzeby kandydatów, aby umożliwić wszystkim udział w procesie rekrutacyjnym na równych zasadach. Prosimy o poinformowanie nas, jeśli mają Państwo szczególne wymagania dotyczące zaproszenia na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną, bądź też kwestie, które chcieliby Państwo, abyśmy wzięli pod uwagę przy rozpatrywaniu Państwa aplikacji. Klikając przycisk Aplikuj/Aplikuj teraz potwierdzasz, że zapoznałeś się z Informacją o ochronie prywatności , akceptujesz jej treść i rozumiesz, że poprzez dobrowolne podanie danych innych niż imię (imiona) i nazwisko, data urodzenia; wskazane przez Ciebie dane kontaktowe jak również wykształcenie, kwalifikacje zawodowe, przebieg dotychczasowego zatrudnienia – w zakresie niezbędnym do oceny Twoich kompetencji na dane stanowisko będące przedmiotem rekrutacji, wyrażasz dobrowolną zgodę na ich przetwarzanie przez Bridgestone Poznań Sp. z o.o. w celu realizacji procesu rekrutacyjnego, na który aplikujesz. items.desc: Project description We are DXC Luxoft Financial Services - an award-winning provider of technology solutions, dedicated to the Financial Services sector. Join our international team and become a member of our open minded, progressive and professional team of financial services consultants. In this role you will be working on projects for biggest investment banks across the globe. You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise in the Capital Markets industry. On top of attractive salary and benefits package, we will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career. Responsibilities This initiative focuses on: Upgrading legacy applications to modern Spring Boot versions (2.x 3.x) Decommissioning and replacing Hazelcast across distributed systems Refactoring applications to align with modern, cloud-ready, stateless architectures Enhancing integration with event-driven systems using Apache Kafka Supporting applications connected to Murex batch and real-time processing flows This is a high-impact program in a low-latency financial environment, where system stability, performance, and correctness are critical. We are seeking a Java developer who can design and build with minimum supervision solutions for our team. The person needs to be knowledgeable on modern software development practices including Scrums, be up to date with the latest Java tools and frameworks and be able to work with the existing team to deliver solutions. The ideal candidate will be diligent, tenacious and delivery focused with a track record of building high quality solutions that are resilient and maintainable. Use of cloud technology is increasing, so experience working with AWS would be beneficial. Design and implement solutions for: Spring Boot & Hazelcast upgrades (including major version transitions) Analyze existing distributed system usage (caching, clustering, locking) Refactor applications toward stateless, scalable microservices Implement and optimize integrations using Kafka-based event-driven architecture Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and architecture teams on migration and rollout strategy Ensure high standards of performance, resilience, and fault tolerance Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and production support Post-project opportunity: Following successful delivery of this modernization initiative, team members are planned to be reassigned to other strategic programs within the client’s long-term roadmap, offering continued growth and exposure to new initiatives. Skills Must have Technical Strong commercial Java development experience. Strong knowledge of Java and the wider Java ecosystem. Experience with Spring and/or Spring Boot. Experience managing dependencies using Maven and/or Gradle. Experience upgrading Java libraries, frameworks and third-party dependencies. Experience identifying, investigating and remediating software security vulnerabilities. Good understanding of secure coding practices and common application security risks. Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience working with Git and CI/CD pipelines. Experience working with established or legacy Java applications. Experience assessing the impact of upgrades and remediation changes on existing systems. Experience with unit and integration testing. Nice to have Experience working with Calypso. Experience with code scanning, vulnerability scanning or software composition analysis tools such as Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx, Black Duck, Sonatype or similar. Familiarity with CVEs and CVSS scoring. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience working in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Knowledge of OWASP principles and DevSecOps practices. Experience working within financial services or other regulated environments. Other Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Lead Remote Poland, Poland Req. VR-124758 Java BCM Industry 13/10/2026 Req. VR-124758

items.desc: There are over 8 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber, and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW. John Deere Bank S.A. is the European Headquarters for John Deere Financial and maintains branch offices in the UK, Spain, Germany, and Poland. The primary activity is providing financial services to customers and dealers who want to finance John Deere equipment. In our financial department, you can expect an international team with a global presence in a highly collaborating network using benchmark processes and systems (e.g., SAP ERP) to support the business objectives. Our teams are working in an innovative environment where new ideas (e.g., artificial intelligence) and continuous process improvements are appreciated and promoted. We provide the best solutions and opportunities for our employees with high engagement toward creative thinkers with outstanding financial expertise. Our financial department is currently seeking candidates for the position of: Credit Operations Specialist Poznań, Poland Your responsibilities: Respond to customer and dealer requests (e.g. payment deferrals, early settlements, exchange of equipment, etc.) and provide them exceptional customer support. Review and control credit documentation for incoming credit applications. Monitor the customer financing repayment (Cash collection, Past due management, Write-off). Process customer claims. Provide credit processing support to the country credit underwriting teams. Prepare reports, exhibits (external and internal). Establish close partnerships with stakeholders from each of our retail portfolio countries to ensure timely and flawless completion of all quality control for client data. Continuously look for improvements in processes and how they are implemented in our systems. Our requirements: Basic Knowledge of financial products like loans and leases (2+ years). Fluency in English is essential. University degree preferably in a finance- or business-related field or equivalent work experience. Great communication, customer service skills and customer centricity. Ability to master customer interactions, handle complaints and keep calm in stressful situations. Ability to work to tight deadlines, while maintaining close attention to detail. Affinity to numbers. Nice to have: Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is an advantage. German or Spanish are considered as an advantage. What we offer: Employment contract. Strong support for work-life balance, including flexible working hours (start time between 7:00 and 10:00 AM) and a hybrid work model at Business Garden in Poznan. Opportunities for professional development within the company, with strong support for internal career growth. Employee referral program. Additional vacation days based on length of employment. Holiday allowance when taking at least 2 weeks off. Daily use of a foreign language in a friendly international working environment. Private medical care, life insurance, a sports card, meal allowance, language courses, a social fund budget, and various additional fun events in our office. Free access to our e-learning platform, featuring over 1,000 courses. Please attach an English version of your CV. John Deere is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to, among other things, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, status as a qualified individual with disability.

items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency. Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule. Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin. No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work. Excellent cultural fit as per …

In this role, you will play a key part in helping clients successfully navigate compensation surveys, data submissions and benchmarking processes. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Krakow office. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Support clients throughout compensation data collection, submission, mapping and integration activities. Validate and analyse compensation and survey data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and alignment with RMCD methodology. Provide guidance on data requirements, timelines, reporting and survey participation processes. Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve data, reporting and implementation-related questions. Build strong client relationships while supporting successful project delivery and a positive client experience. Contribute to reporting, benchmarking and continuous improvement initiatives across Data Solutions operations. How this opportunity is different: In the role of Client Success Coordinator, you will develop an outstanding blend of analytical and client-facing skills. Good interpersonal skills with the ability to explain technical and data-related concepts to different audiences. Experience in compensation, HR data, survey operations, data implementation or a client-facing environment would be an advantage. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail. A proactive and problem-solving attitude with a curiosity about data quality and process improvement.
