items.desc: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. Labcorp is seeking a remote Clinical Data Risk & Solutions Analyst (Global Monitor) to join our team in Poland. Job Responsibilities: Accountable for the monitoring and reporting of clinical study laboratory metrics. Ability to extract information from multiple data sources, converting the raw data into meaningful and actionable insights, and presenting key findings to all stakeholders (internal and external). Performing risk assessments on low complexity studies in coordination with the Global Study Manager and the Study Design Lead prior to study start and proposing monitoring solutions to mitigate the identified risks. Utilizing analytics/visualizations to review study laboratory data for your assigned studies to identify issues and to ensure risks are proactively addressed. Liaise with Developers to ensure development of monitoring tools are completed to the client’s specifications Ensure regular communication with your key stakeholders. Support Risk Management Plan creation and ongoing maintenance through monitoring and analysis Participate actively to Labcorp development through continuous process improvements. Be able to act efficiently in an environment with dynamic timelines and priorities. Participate in functional meetings and provide input, keeping processes up to date. Comply with internal strategy. Support a culture of continuous improvement, quality and productivity. Minimum Qualifications: University degree in science 3 or more years of experience in clinical project management or clinical data analysis 1 or more years of experience in the life science, healthcare or pharmaceutical industry Preferred Qualifications: PhD degree in science 3 or more years of experience in Excel 1 or more years of experience in client management Additional Job Standards: Fluency in English Curious, data driven analytical thinker High quality standards, attention to detail Strong motivation, flexibility and creativity Big picture thinker who suggests changes to process, identifies risks and potential opportunities for data improvement Strong problem-solving and customer service skills Comfort with ambiguity and fast switching across studies/portfolios as priorities change Able to operate with minimal guidance while owning deliverables end-to-end Proven ability to effectively communicate ideas/concepts and to motivate/influence others to accomplish challenging shared goals and objectives. Dedication for learning and self-improvement Robust self-organization; at-ease with managing conflicting priorities Ability to create and motivate a team around project deliverables Labcorp manages one of the largest networks of clinical laboratories in the world. In the Clinical Data Risk & Solutions Analyst (Global Monitor) role, you will be assigned a portfolio of clinical studies. When a new study starts, the Global Monitor works with the internal teams to identify study risks and develop mitigation plans. Global Monitors also look for issues in the study data and suggest actions internally and/or externally to rectify and prevent those issues and maintain study health. Additionally, you will be responsible for putting in place customized, study specific monitoring packages for studies based on study needs or in which clients are requesting additional oversight by Labcorp to ensure all their samples will be processed correctly. Overall, the Global Monitor must be in compliance with the CCLS Global Project Management strategy and deliver outstanding performance and customer satisfaction. items.desc: Job Title Junior Data Quality Assistant Job Description Summary The Junior Data Operations is a key operational role supporting the Business Development Services function for the Netherland market. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accurate capture, quality, and efficient use of real estate data, making sure the information used by business, analysis, and reporting teams is precise, consistent, and scalable. This position plays an important role in strengthening the data foundation needed to support decision-making across the Netherlands business. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to grow within the world of data by learning to scale data processes through automation and reporting. This role will work closely with research analysts, consultants, and business teams to ensure data is properly used and interpreted. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Data Management & Quality Collect information from internal and external sources (real estate portals, public records, technical reports, internal systems). Update and maintain databases on assets, prices, yields, occupancy, and other market KPIs for the Belux market. Run data quality controls (consistency, duplicates, formatting, temporal coherence) and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and structure datasets for analysis, studies, and specific projects. Support with cleansing and enhancing the dataset to assist with analysis requirements and enhanced analytics. Identify and catalogue new data sets that could support our analytical ambitions Ensure market data is ready ahead of reporting deadlines. Automation & Data Exploitation Identify repetitive data entry tasks and propose improvements or automations to optimize processes. Create and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and cross-referencing between different sources. Support basic data modeling for reporting and analysis. Collaborate on the creation and maintenance of Power BI dashboards, both operational and KPI-tracking. Support data reconciliations between systems and sources (source vs. reporting). Documentation & Collaboration Document data capture, validation, automation, and data flow processes. Work closely with research analysts and business teams to ensure correct use and interpretation of data. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and data process standardization. Key Requirements Fluent in English. Dutch language skills are beneficial but not required. 1 to 3 years of experience in data management, data entry, reporting, or similar functions. Common MS Office applications to excellent levels including SharePoint and OneDrive. Strong command of Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data validation; Power Query is a plus). Analytical mindset, focus on data quality, and strong attention to detail. Basic knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, filters). Experience with or interest in Power BI (datasets, simple models, visualizations). Interest in process automation and operational optimization. Basic understanding of data concepts: tables, relationships, KPIs, data flows. Prior experience in real estate, consulting, or data-related environments is a plus, not a requirement. A self-starter mindset, and a passion for making business improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Transition forecasting tools and activities from various European markets into the Europe Hub. You bring the same rigour and care to your discipline that our teams bring to every product, because how we work is as important as what we make. items.desc: Descrição da empresa O Grupo Bosch tem mais de 400 000 colaboradores em todo o mundo, presentes em 60 países, e temos orgulho em ter um impacto na vida das pessoas e em trabalhar para um futuro mais sustentável. Na cidade de Aveiro, a Bosch possui uma das suas maiores unidades de produção da divisão Bosch Home Comfort, bem como um Centro de Investigação e Desenvolvimento de novas e melhoradas soluções de aquecimento para o segmento residencial. Com mais de 1400 colaboradores, focados na inovação, sustentabilidade e colaboração, a Bosch Aveiro reúne especialistas em diversas áreas, desde a engenharia mecânica à conectividade e soluções de software, passando pela industrialização e qualidade. Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro ao criarmos produtos e serviços de alta qualidade que geram entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. A promessa que fazemos aos nossos colaboradores é sólida: crescemos juntos, desfrutamos do que fazemos e inspiramo-nos uns aos outros. Junta-te a nós e sente a diferença de mentalidades, culturas, gerações, identidades e perspetivas. Todos devem trazer a sua autenticidade e trabalhar juntos com respeito. A Bosch é um empregador que valoriza a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiências e incapacidades, podemos providenciar adaptações razoáveis no decurso do processo de recrutamento e no desempenho da atividade profissional. A inclusão de todos e a garantia de igualdade de oportunidades permite-nos atingir o nosso verdadeiro potencial. Descrição do emprego O teu contributo para algo maior : Apoiar de perto a liderança na identificação, desenvolvimento de talentos e avaliação de desempenho da equipa de eletricistas, garantindo a sua motivação e máxima eficiência de trabalho. Propor, participar e implementar ações de melhoria contínua ao nível de sistemas de automação industrial, elevando a disponibilidade operacional de equipamentos de produção críticos. Desenvolver estudos técnicos de engenharia focados na modernização, automação, controle e integração de software em instalações industriais em operação. Garantir a conformidade interna do departamento e liderar os processos de inventário de ativos. Assegurar a implementação rigorosa dos procedimentos de qualidade central, garantindo que todos os softwares estejam devidamente documentados, controlados e rastreáveis. Elaborar documentação técnica de suporte para garantir intervenções rápidas de manutenção. Suportar o desenvolvimento de conteúdos formativos com o objetivo de reforçar e elevar o nível de conhecimentos técnicos das equipas de manutenção. Supervisionar o arquivo de dados industriais de máquinas e equipamentos (softwares, receitas e parâmetros), viabilizando uma rápida reposição de cópias de segurança ( backups/restore ). Validar e aprovar a introdução de novos equipamentos fabris sob a ótica da manutenção, garantindo a estrita normalização de peças, módulos e componentes. Prestar suporte técnico especializado de segunda linha na resolução de problemas complexos de equipamentos de fábrica, com forte base documental. Qualificações O que te diferencia: Educação: Formação académica superior (Licenciatura ou Mestrado) em Engenharia de Computadores e Telemática, Engenharia de Automação Industrial, Engenharia Computacional ou áreas similares. Experiência: Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software aplicado à indústria, automação industrial ou em funções de engenharia de manutenção de sistemas digitais. Know-how: Conhecimentos de programação em Visual Studio C# , .NET Framework, Python . Conhecimentos teóricos ou práticos em sistemas de Visão Artificial ( Computer Vision ) e modelos de Machine Learning . Experiência de trabalho e manipulação de Bases de Dados (SQL ou similares). Idiomas: Bons conhecimentos de Inglês (falado e escrito). Trabalho e Método: Orientação para a melhoria contínua, facilidade de planeamento sistemático, espírito de equipa e foco na resolução de problemas com rigor metodológico. Informação adicional Work #LikeABosch inclui: ️ Condições de trabalho flexíveis Sistema de trabalho híbrido Partilha de experiências com colegas de todo o mundo ️ Seguro de saúde e consultório médico no local (cirurgião geral, psicologia, fisioterapia, clínica geral) Oportunidades de formação (p.e., formação técnica, formação em línguas estrangeiras) & certificações Oportunidades de progressão de carreira e desenvolvimento profissional contínuo Acesso a grandes descontos em parcerias e produtos Bosch ️ Atividades desportivas e relacionadas com a saúde Plataforma de benefícios flexíveis ️ Parque de estacionamento gratuito ️ Cantina Histórias de sucesso não acontecem por acaso... Faz com que aconteçam. Estamos à espera da tua candidatura!

items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania As a System Product Owner within Thales, you will act as the primary interface between product stakeholders and the engineering team, ensuring that development activities remain aligned with product objectives, customer needs, technical constraints and delivery commitments. 1. Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment Contribute to the product vision and roadmap in alignment with the CPO, Initiative Owner and relevant stakeholders. Understand customer and operational needs and translate them into clear functional and technical objectives. Ensure alignment between system-level requirements, product priorities and engineering activities. Act as the main functional and technical point of contact for the team, facilitating access to relevant experts when required.Collect and incorporate feedback from stakeholders, demonstrations and operational users. 2. Backlog Management & Requirements Decomposition Own, maintain and prioritise the Team Backlog based on inputs from the CPO and Initiative Owner. Support the decomposition of Initiatives into Epics, Epics into Features, and Features into coherent, actionable User Stories. Ensure completeness, consistency and traceability of requirements across the development lifecycle. Define and review User Stories and Acceptance Criteria in collaboration with engineering teams. Continuously refine and prioritise backlog items according to business value, technical dependencies, risks and available capacity. Accept or reject completed User Stories based on agreed Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done. 3. Engineering Team Support & Agile Delivery Provide continuous functional and technical clarification to the engineering team throughout the development cycle. Collaborate with the Scrum Master to facilitate co-engineering activities, backlog refinement and Agile ceremonies. Participate in team and Agile Release Train (ART) events, including planning, reviews and demonstrations. Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment and the evolution of the Architectural Runway. Identify and address functional dependencies, risks and impediments impacting delivery. Promote Built-In Quality and ensure delivered solutions meet functional requirements and customer expectations. 4. Budget Ownership & Delivery Performance Manage and monitor allocated budgets at Epic and Feature levels within Jira. Ensure development scope and associated budgets remain aligned with agreed commitments. Monitor functional and financial progress using EVM indicators and relevant delivery KPIs.Analyse deviations between planned and actual progress, identifying scope, cost and schedule impacts. Conduct regular end-of-sprint reviews with the Initiative Owner to assess progress, budget consumption and potential scope adjustments. Report delivery performance, financial status, risks and deviations to the IO, CPO and RTE.Contribute to corrective actions and prioritisation decisions to maintain delivery predictability. 5. Continuous Improvement & Feedback Facilitate product and system demonstrations to gather feedback from internal and external stakeholders. Incorporate lessons learned, customer feedback and operational insights into backlog priorities. Promote continuous improvement in requirements quality, engineering collaboration and delivery practices. Contribute to improving team autonomy, knowledge sharing and overall product quality. PROFILE You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field. You have significant experience in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering or complex technical product development. You have previous experience in Product Ownership, technical project management or system-level product development, ideally within an Agile environment. You have a strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate them into clear technical and functional requirements. You demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex systems and competing priorities. You are an effective communicator, able to engage and align engineering teams, product stakeholders and management. You are autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of technical and functional decisions within your scope. You demonstrate a collaborative mindset, a customer-oriented approach and a commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to analyse complex systems, understand dependencies between components and assess the impact of technical decisions. Knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), UML and system modelling practices. items.desc: AI Solutions Engineer Hands-on AI research, engineering, integration and delivery GRSee is building an internal AI capability focused on turning practical business needs into working AI-enabled solutions. We are looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Engineer who enjoys learning, experimenting, building and taking solutions from initial investigation through production use. Role Overview The AI Solutions Engineer will work closely with the CAIO to investigate business problems, evaluate available technologies, prototype solutions, and implement them in real environments. The role combines software engineering, AI, automation, system integration, practical technical research and lightweight product / requirements ownership. The ideal candidate is comfortable learning new tools quickly, structuring an open-ended problem, and choosing the most appropriate approach for each problem. Projects may range from a focused internal Utility or workflow automation to an AI-enabled integration or a larger internal application. What You Will Do · Investigate business problems, clarify requirements with stakeholders, and identify practical AI, automation or software solutions. · Research unfamiliar technologies, APIs, platforms and tools independently. · Build prototypes and Proofs of Concept, define a practical path to implementation, and convert successful concepts into usable internal or client-facing solutions. · Develop internal Utilities, integrations and AI-enabled applications. · Work with AI APIs and platforms such as OpenAI, Claude and similar services. · Develop in .NET / C# or Python, depending on the problem and solution fit. · Integrate with business systems, APIs, databases and SaaS platforms. · Use automation platforms such as n8n and others when they provide a faster or more appropriate path than custom development. · Build or adapt WordPress plugins, scripts or lightweight tools when required. · Build or adapt CRM / Monday MCP Servers, plugins, scripts or lightweight tools when required. · Test solutions in Lab / Dev / QA environments and support deployment into production. · Troubleshoot issues across application, API, integration and deployment layers. · Work with the CAIO and relevant business stakeholders on solution design, requirements, priorities and architecture decisions. · Document requirements, key decisions and implemented solutions sufficiently for handover, support, maintenance and future development. · Continuously explore new AI capabilities that may create practical value for GRSee. Technical Skills Practical software development experience is required. Strong capability in at least one modern development language is expected; experience with the following is particularly relevant: · C# / .NET - preferred for GRSee internal development · Python - highly relevant and a strong alternative / complement; TypeScript / JavaScript experience may also be relevant for AI-enabled applications and integrations Experience with several of the following is desirable: · REST APIs, JSON and HTTP-based integrations · Databases and SQL · Backend services and lightweight web applications · Authentication and authorization concepts · Git / source control · Debugging, logging and error handling · Third-party APIs and SaaS integrations · Basic frontend or web development · Deployment and environment configuration Current Technological Stack Following GRSee current technological platforms: · Zoho CRM · Monday · Google Workspace · GCP & Azure & AWS · Word/Excel and Google Spreads sheets and Google Docs · Deel · Amplemarket (Marketing) · JotForm & Make AI, Automation and Integration Hands-on experience and active experimentation with modern AI systems is important for this role. Relevant exposure may include: · OpenAI, Claude or other major LLM platforms · AI APIs, prompt design and structured outputs · AI-assisted software development · Agent or workflow automation patterns · Document processing, extraction, classification or generation · Model selection, token usage and AI reliability considerations · Automation platforms such as n8n, Power Automate or similar tools · WordPress, CRM, Monday or other business-system integrations Deployment and Infrastructure This is not a dedicated DevOps role. items.desc: If you are a technical professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you as an Application Specialist (24 months) in Cluj-Napoca. In this role, you will provide technical and application expertise across a diverse portfolio of measurement solutions, supporting customers and internal stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle. You will help identify, develop, configure, and implement solutions that address customer needs while contributing to innovation, continuous improvement, and business success. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, strengthen technical knowledge, and make a meaningful impact through customer-focused problem solving. We look forward to seeing your application! In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand application requirements and recommend effective technical solutions. Evaluate technical requests, identify appropriate product configurations, and support solution development activities. Provide application, product, and technical support throughout pre-sales and post-sales processes. Collaborate closely with project, sales, service, manufacturing, quality, product management, and customer support teams to deliver successful outcomes. Support commissioning, troubleshooting, startup activities, and issue resolution efforts as needed. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance processes, product quality, operational efficiency, and customer experience. Maintain technical expertise across products, applications, and industry trends to support informed decision-making. Participate in knowledge-sharing activities and provide technical guidance to colleagues and customers. Develop and deliver technical training, presentations, workshops, and learning resources for a variety of audiences. Gather customer feedback and market insights to help identify opportunities for product improvements and innovation. items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. items.desc: Purpose and Scope: The Supply Clerk orders, receives, stores, and issues equipment, material, merchandise, or tools, and compiles stock records in stockroom, warehouse, or storage yard by performing the following duties. Essential Responsibilities: Utilizes AMRO and ILS-S computer systems to order parts and equipment. Compiles reports on consumption of stocked items, adjustments of inventory counts and stock records, spoilage of or damage to stocked items, location changes, and refusal of shipments. Counts, sorts, or weighs incoming articles to verify receipt of items on requisition or invoices and examines stock to verify conformance to specifications. Maintains inventory and other stock records of assigned supplies and equipment. Performs inventory, pack and unpack of Mobility Readiness Spares Packages. Requisitions articles to fill accounts and marks identifying codes on articles. Fills orders or issues supplies from stock while keeping records of material issued. Uses Material Handling Equipment as required to move material to other departments. Makes adjustments or repairs to articles carried in stock. Determines methods of storage, identification, and stock location, considering humidity, temperature, height and weight limits, turnover, floor loading capacities, and space. Cuts stock to size to fill order. Accepts recommended additions to bench stock from workers, provided history with recommendation to supervisor for consideration. Maintains shop tools are in working condition, reports damaged tools and requisitions replacements. Builds up individual tool kits for various crafts using established tools list. Inventories, signs out/in tools kits and maintains records. Stocks replacement tool items to replenish kits as approved by supervisors. Tracks shelf life of inventory. Receives and stores HAZMAT May be required to operate a forklift. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required: High school diploma or equivalent One (1) to Three (3) years of related experience Experience with USAF Supply functions preferred. Must be proficient in Office software applications to communicate through e-mail and various software applications.; especially Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel. Ability to meet required deadlines and maintain necessary workflow Ability to read and write and comprehend/interpret data. Forklift experience may be required. Must be able to speak, read and write English. Must have authorization to work in host country. The employee frequently is required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities. Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job. items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: Why this role We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you’ll be the person clients and project teams turn to when the data questions get hard. We welcome people from two backgrounds: master data management (MDM) or data platforms. You don’t need to cover both. We’re looking for real depth in one. What you’ll do Act as the subject matter expert on MDM or data platform pre-implementation or implementations for life sciences clients, depending on your background Tackle the data challenges typical of customer engagement, such as HCP/HCO data quality, CRM master and reference data Bring third-party reference data (IQVIA, Veeva) together with client data Work with architects, functional consultants and client stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions What you bring A proven track record as a subject matter expert in either: MDM implementations (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM), or data platform implementations (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC) A solid understanding of data management and its typical challenges in the customer engagement (CE) domain A general understanding of CE processes within CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData Clear communication, spoken and written Excellent English A plus if you have Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica) GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience This position is offered in Denmark and Spain. Who is BASE life science? Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry. With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies. Why join BASE Life Science? At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact. You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where: Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow Alongside this, we offer: Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com Interested? If you find this position intriguing, don’t delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application. At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy. Apply Location Spain or Denmark Application Deadline As soon as possible Contact People & Culture, recruitment@baselifescience.com Apply Location Spain or Denmark Application Deadline As soon as possible Contact People & Culture, recruitment@baselifescience.com Apply

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges that directly impact customer experience? Do you thrive in a role that combines analytical rigor with hands-on execution? Join Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) as an Inventory Planner where you'll define and lead placement initiatives that optimize our inventory network. This role offers an exciting blend of analytics, execution, automation, and stakeholder management. You'll work on optimization exercises that improve how we position inventory across our network, ensuring customers receive their large items efficiently. Your work will directly influence operational performance and customer satisfaction, making a measurable impact across the entire customer journey. Key job responsibilities Define and lead the execution of placement initiatives that optimize inventory positioning across the AMXL network Design and implement automation solutions to streamline inventory planning processes and improve operational efficiency Conduct complex optimization exercises analyzing inventory flows, demand patterns, and capacity constraints to drive data-informed decisions Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including operations, transportation, and fulfillment teams to align on placement strategies and resolve inventory challenges Develop and maintain analytical models and tools that enable proactive inventory management and support strategic planning initiatives A day in the life You'll start your day analyzing inventory performance metrics and identifying opportunities for optimization. You might spend time building automation tools to streamline repetitive processes, then shift to collaborating with operations partners on implementing a new placement strategy. Throughout the day, you'll tackle customer-facing challenges that require deep analysis, run optimization models to test different scenarios, and work with stakeholders to execute improvements that enhance the customer experience. About the team AMXL is Amazon's first true end-to-end organization for extra-large items, with visibility and impact across every mile of the customer journey. From the moment an order is placed to final delivery, our team orchestrates the complex logistics of getting bulky items to customers efficiently. Our team culture thrives on knowledge sharing, mutual support, and continuous learning. We tackle unique challenges in the large-item space, innovating solutions that haven't been solved elsewhere. You'll work alongside passionate professionals who are committed to improving operations while supporting each other's growth and development. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams Experience in team management Experience in cross functional project delivery Experience in program or project management Experience in transportation or supply chain Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Infrastructure Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48358 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Profile "Developer First" Mindset & Sensitivity to Developer Experience (DevEx): Understands that their primary users are dozens of software engineers across internal squads. Listens, understands, discusses, and prioritizes developer needs within product and technical contexts. Designs APIs, boilerplates, and platform solutions focused on reducing cognitive load, abstracting infrastructure complexity, and enabling team autonomy. "Platform Engineering" Vision: Investigates developer pain points across squads and delivers high-value self-service capabilities. Automates platform processes and provides clear, comprehensive documentation. Hands-On Approach & Pragmatism: Delivers practical, value-driven engineering solutions. Enjoys solving real operational bottlenecks while avoiding unnecessary abstractions or over-engineering. Communication & Autonomy: Communicates architectural decisions effectively, leads internal technical workshops, and writes high-quality integration guides. Proactively identifies bottlenecks in developer workflows and tools, implementing quick wins without requiring micromanagement. Your Skills Backend & Integration Ecosystem: Node.js & TypeScript (Portal Extension): Proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript tailored specifically for governing, building, and extending our Developer Portal (Backstage backend plugins, custom integrations, catalog processors, and Scaffolder actions). .NET Ecosystem: Strong experience developing robust, scalable services using .NET Core / C#. API Design & Resilience: REST API design and consumption using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting) with libraries like Polly. Workflow & Event Orchestration: Experience with event-driven architecture, webhooks, or workflow engines (e.g., Temporal, Argo Workflows, KEDA) to handle long-running, asynchronous infrastructure tasks and reliably interact with external APIs. Frontend Ecosystem: Core Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of React and TypeScript for building modular, high-performance portal interfaces and custom Backstage UI plugins. UX for Developers: Ability to translate complex infrastructure workflows into intuitive, low-friction user interfaces for engineering teams. Containers & Orchestration: Docker: Hands-on experience with container management, image optimization (multi-stage builds), and container security. Kubernetes (K8s): Experience deploying, managing, and orchestrating applications in Kubernetes clusters (deployments, services, ingresses, configmaps). CI/CD & GitOps: CI Pipelines: Building and managing Continuous Integration pipelines for automated builds, testing (unit/integration), static code analysis, and container registry management (Harbor). GitOps & Delivery: Practical experience with GitOps workflows and Continuous Delivery, preferably using ArgoCD. Nice-to-Have: Platform Engineering, IDPs & Control Planes: Internal Developer Platforms & Control Planes: Experience with tools like Crossplane, Humanitec, Kratix, or custom Kubernetes Operators/CRDs for infrastructure provisioning and abstraction. Backstage Ecosystem: Advanced experience building custom Backstage templates and integrating complex software catalog structures. Configuration Management: Familiarity with Helm, Kustomize, or declarative configuration tools for managing application environments. Cloud Computing & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Cloud Platforms (GCP/Multicloud): Knowledge and practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager) or cross-cloud migration projects (Azure to GCP). Terraform / OpenTofu: Experience provisioning and automating cloud infrastructure using IaC. Observability & Telemetry: Familiarity with OpenTelemetry standards and building/querying observability dashboards using the Grafana Stack (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo). AI-Assisted Development: Interest or experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor) to automate platform and workflow tasks.

items.desc: About Us / Who you will join: 130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it. Role Overview: Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) is a critical component of our Digital Resilience efforts. Developed through joint efforts among various Allianz entities, with Barcelona playing a crucial role, the TPRM framework is particularly guided by the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA). We are building a TPRM team in Barcelona responsible for offering, delivering, and managing the TPRM lifecycle as a service to Allianz Operational Entities. In doing so, we are looking for candidates with relevant experience in Outsourcing or TPRM, although other related experiences (i.e., ICT Security, Contract Management, ERM) may also be considered. ) Key responsibilities / You will get to: Serve as a point of contact within the delivery center for risk queries, support, and guidance. Cover specific risk domains and ensure up-to-date and effective support. Manage and oversee the efficient and effective implementation of the AZ Outsourcing Third-Party Risk Management Policy across assigned entities within AZ Group. Perform TPRM/Outsourcing assessments, including alignment with Risk, Data Privacy, Legal, and Security. Contribute to and follow up on internal and external audits regarding Third Party Risk Management. Prepare Third Party Vendor management-related reports/dashboards and report to senior management. Ensure the TPRM/outsourcing inventory of all third-party/outsourcing agreements and key supporting documentation of the TPRM/outsourcing process (e.g., Risk Assessment, Business Plan, Due Diligence, BoM approvals) is managed and adequately in place. Plan and facilitate the completion of all Risk and Control Assessments (RCA) for TPRM Service Providers across the TPRM / Outsourcing Lifecycle; own the System of Governance control for the TPRM/Outsourcing Function. Manage the Quality Assurance process over third-party RCA, control documentation, and testing results; ensure adequate reporting. Key requirements / What we hope you bring: 1 year of professional experience in different areas of risk management: operational risk, IT risk, project risk, outsourcing/vendor risk, business risk. Relevant experience in Third-Party Risk Management / Outsourcing Management, Contact Management Vendor Management or Procurement would be a great plus. University degree in Engineering, Legal, Business, Economics, or similar fields required. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Be able to adapt to change and to manage goals in hypothetic situations with unclear formal structure. Proactive initiative to perform research and find solutions/recommendations to issues or problems. Ability to develop and execute plans to deliver quality results on time. Team player with the ability to work individually and in virtual international teams, share information, and support colleagues; international experience is a plus. Enthusiastic, self-motivated, effective under pressure, and open to new learning opportunities. Strong communication and conflict management skills. Proven ability to work with multiple stakeholders across functional groups. Advanced skills in MS Office (especially Excel and Power Point); knowledge of ORGS/Open Pages, ServiceNow is a plus. What we offer: We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location) From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to …

items.desc: The Department of Biochemistry and Biophysics is mainly located with the other Departments of Chemistry and Life Sciences in the Arrhenius Laboratories for Natural Sciences, which are situated in the northern part of the University Campus at Frescati. Some 270 people of which about 60 are PhD students work at the Department, engaged in internationally highly recognised research covering a broad range of subjects. More information about us, please visit: the Department of Biochemistry and Biophysics. Project description Your studies in Biochemistry will be in the project "Mechanistic Studies of Bioenergetic Protein Complexes". We search for outstanding PhD candidates (1-3) to join our ERC-Advanced Grant Project ‘ bioEnergetic ’, with a focus on mechanistic studies of bioenergetic protein complexes catalyzing biological energy conversion. The project is focused on how membrane-bound enzymes in respiratory chains capture redox energy, and catalyze long-range proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactions across biological membranes. The project has a special emphasis on electrical field effects in protein function, and how these effects are linked to the structure and dynamics of the protein complexes. The systems are explored by integrative methods, including, but not limited to biochemical, biophysical and structural experiments (cryo-EM, spectroscopy, proteoliposome experiments, site-directed mutagenesis) and/or multiscale molecular simulations (QM/MM and atomistic molecular dynamics simulations, free energy methods, and machine learning). Candidates with either an experimental and/or computational training are encouraged to apply. The PhD candidate will closely work with other PhD students, postdocs and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary team within a large collaborative project. Qualification requirements In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the time the applicant is admitted to the PhD program at the Department of Biochemistry and Biophysics. You meet general entry requirements if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. Specific entry requirements – for acceptance in the Biochemistry program the applicant must have passed courses within the first and second cycles of at least 120 credits in Biochemistry/Life Science, including at least 15 credits Biochemistry at the second cycle level and a Degree Project (thesis) also in Biochemistry of 30 credits. Selection The selection among the eligible candidates will be based on their capacity to successfully complete the program. Important criteria when assessing this capacity are; documented knowledge and skill in the field of the thesis project, written and oral proficiency in English, the capacity for analytical thinking, the ability to collaborate, as well as creativity, initiative, and independence. The assessment will be based on previous experience and grades, the quality of the degree project, references, relevant experience, interviews and the candidate’s written motivation for seeking the position. We seek outstanding and highly motivated PhD candidates, with ambitions to develop into a future field leader to join our lab. The candidate should have prior training in either experimental biochemical methods or computational methods applied to proteins/biological membranes. Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University. About the employment We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %). A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time. Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all. Contact For more information, please contact Professor Ville Kaila, ville.kaila@dbb.su.se. General information about the PhD programs can be given by the Director of Doctoral Studies, Andreas Barth, andreas.barth@dbb.su.se. Application Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. Om rollen Som
items.desc: IT-arkitekt till Keolis Bli go-to-personen för hur Keolis bygger morgondagens IT-lösningar! Keolis ansvarar för kollektivtrafik som varje dag förflyttar tusentals människor i Stockholm. Nu stärker vi teamet för Digital Infrastruktur och söker en IT-arkitekt med fokus på lösningsarkitektur, någon som vill knyta ihop helheten och vara med och forma hur vi designar och utvecklar våra lösningar framåt. Om rollen Som IT-arkitekt blir du navet när nya lösningar ska tas fram. Oavsett om det gäller en ny molntjänst, en integration eller en machine learning-modell för bussunderhåll är det du som leder samtalet kring designen: Var ska data bearbetas? Hur ska systemen kommunicera? Vad är mest hållbart utifrån säkerhet, skalbarhet och förvaltningsbarhet? Rollen är bred och tvärfunktionell. Du kommer att stötta leveransansvariga, plattformsingenjörer, utvecklings- och förvaltningsledare och data engineers i olika projekt och initiativ över hela IT. Du äger designen, medan leveransansvariga och plattformsingenjörer ansvarar för implementationen, men du är med hela vägen. Inledningsvis lägger du ungefär 60 % av tiden i projekt, där du hjälper till att bena ut krav och omsätta dem i konkret lösningsdesign, och 40 % på övergripande arkitekturarbete. I början blir fokus framför allt Azure och molnlösningar. På sikt vill vi lyfta blicken ytterligare med arkitekturprinciper, ramverk och en tydligare arkitekturstyrning. Här har du stora möjligheter att sätta din prägel på rollen! Dina ansvarsområden Ta fram lösningsdesign, arkitekturförslag och tekniska specifikationer för nya eller förändrade tjänster och system. Översätta verksamhetens behov och krav till tekniska lösningar med tydliga komponenter, dataflöden och integrationer. Designa hur system och plattformar ska kommunicera, inklusive API:er, datamodeller och informationsflöden i samråd med integrationsteamet. Ge teknisk rådgivning i projekt och stötta projektledare, team och beslutsfattare kring teknikval och lösningsdesign. Säkerställa att lösningar följer våra arkitekturprinciper, standarder samt säkerhets- och compliancekrav. Kartlägga verksamhetens förmågor mot befintliga system, identifiera gap och bidra till teknisk roadmap och kostnadsbedömningar. Vi söker dig som Har eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller annan relevant inriktning, gärna på universitetsnivå. Har 1–2 års erfarenhet av lösningsarkitekturarbete, formellt eller informellt. Har en teknisk bakgrund från en hands on-roll, till exempel inom plattform, cloud, infrastruktur eller utveckling. Har erfarenhet av molnmiljöer, helst Azure. Har du främst arbetat med AWS är du också välkommen, så länge du är nyfiken på Azure. Har god förståelse för hur integrationer, API:er och dataflöden hänger ihop Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från en konsult- eller leverantörsroll där du arbetat med rådgivning och implementation hos kund, kännedom om arkitekturramverk såsom Well-Architected Framework eller TOGAF, samt erfarenhet av dataplattformar, microservices eller machine learning ur ett arkitekturperspektiv. Vem är du? Du är nyfiken, kontaktsökande och initiativtagande. Du drivs av att förstå verksamheten och trivs med att röra dig mellan detalj och helhet och är den som ställer frågan ”har vi tänkt på det här?”. Du tycker om att få med alla på banan kring en lösning. Varför Keolis? Hos oss får du komma in i ett team med högt i tak, familjär kultur och stort utrymme att påverka. Här designar du inte bara en lösning för att sedan lämna över, du är med i helheten, från idé till genomförande, och får se resultatet av det du varit med och format. Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där vi moderniserar vår infrastruktur och blickar framåt mot en ny tech-strategi, och rollen är ny i sin nuvarande form, vilket ger dig goda möjligheter att forma den. Placering Rollen är placerad på vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi arbetar hybrid och ser att du har möjlighet att vara på plats tre dagar i veckan. Ansökan Du ansöker genom att skicka in ditt CV. Personligt brev behövs inte. I urvalsprocessen använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut. Observera att tjänsten omfattas av en bakgrundskontroll som genomförs i slutskedet av rekryteringsprocessen efter ditt godkännande.

items.desc: The Department of Meteorology at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain. We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic. The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment. Read more about us here: the Department of Meteorology. Project description Clouds regulate how much sunlight reaches the Earth’s surface and how much thermal radiation escapes to space, which ultimately influences how hot or cold the planet is. How much each cloud cools or warms the Earth depends in part on its composition. Is it made up of liquid particles, ice particles, or both? How densely spaced and how large are these particles? The answers to these questions lie partially in the dynamics occurring within the cloud. Even clouds that look calm from the ground may generate motions strong enough to shake an airplane. These motions can form new cloud particles and combine or shatter existing ones. However, these motions are difficult to represent completely in computer models of the atmosphere and in laboratory experiments, and we have yet to understand their full impact. The PhD student will build this understanding using over 800 hours of wind and cloud particle measurements that have been recorded by specialized research aircraft during field campaigns run by government agencies in the US and Europe. Data have been collected over the midwestern US and the Caribbean, off the northwestern coast of Africa, between Australia and Antarctica, and in the vicinity of Svalbard. Quality-controlled versions of all data are already available, so analysis can begin at the project start.The PhD student will develop a detailed understanding of aircraft instrumentation through literature review and apply that expertise to the analysis of measurements from dozens of different aircraft-mounted instruments. All analysis will be done in Python. The scientific scope initially spans micrometer-scale cloud particles to the dynamical processes that affect clouds, including turbulent eddies and kilometer-scale atmospheric waves. Initial science questions are well defined and focus on identifying statistical relationships between cloud particle properties and cloud-scale dynamics, and investigating how these vary across cloud types and geographic regions. After the initial stage, the project is more open-ended. The PhD student may choose to focus on the same micrometer–kilometer scales, or to make connections between these scales and the regional or global climate. They may also choose to branch into atmospheric modelling and/or to use machine learning to model observed relationships between cloud dynamics and cloud particles. Qualification requirements In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications. You meet general entry requirements if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. The specific entry requirements comprise a minimum of 90 higher education credits in one of the subjects meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry, at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics, as well as an independent degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. Furthermore, English language proficiency equivalent to English 6/English Level 2 at upper secondary school is required. The specific entry requirements may also be met by those who have acquired equivalent knowledge through other means, either in Sweden or abroad. Migrationsverket genomför just nu en långsiktig förflyttning från en högt integrerad arkitektur till en mer löst kopplad och skalbar arkitektur. Ditt uppdrag blir att vara en del av ett team som, tillsammans med övriga utvecklingsteam, driver denna transformation framåt – mot ett mer flexibelt, modernt och effektivt sätt att utveckla system och tjänster. Som kollega på Migrationsverket får du arbeta i en tekniskt utmanande miljö där vi kontinuerligt förbättrar våra lösningar och arbetssätt. Här kombineras samhällsnytta med modern systemutveckling – du bidrar till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad, samtidigt som du har en trygg och stabil anställning. Vad gör en systemutvecklare på Migrationsverket? Som systemutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett plattformsteam som arbetar tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklingsteam. Vi jobbar med hög grad av autonomi i teamen, moderna tekniker och ett kontinuerligt fokus på att leverera värde. Vi lägger stor vikt vid en stark teamkultur – vi delar kunskap, lär av varandra och värdesätter olika perspektiv. Vi arbetar agilt med stort fokus på automatisering och rör oss mot en löst kopplad, eventbaserad arkitektur. Just nu bygger vi också upp en modern, cloud native-plattform baserad på Kubernetes och Docker. Du kommer att, tillsammans med dina nya kollegor: utveckla verktyg, tekniker och ramverk som förenklar och effektiviserar utvecklingsarbetet – både för er själva och andra team skapa tekniska förutsättningar för stabila och kontinuerliga leveranser arbeta med test som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen samarbeta nära teamens användare, förvaltning samt drift- och supportorganisation Vi har ett starkt fokus på ständiga förbättringar – både i hur vi arbetar och i det vi bygger. Du blir en del av en organisation där tekniska utmaningar möter samhällsviktiga behov – och där din kompetens gör konkret skillnad. Läs mer om att jobba med IT hos oss: Jobba med it Vem är du? Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle. Jobbeskrivning Vi söker nu en Kravanalytiker som vill vara med och skapa verklig förändring hos våra kunder inom bland annat offentlig sektor, energi och försvarsindustrin. I rollen ansvarar du för att fånga, analysera och dokumentera både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav genom exempelvis workshops, användarintervjuer, observationer och dokumentstudier. Du säkerställer att kraven är tydligt formulerade, utvecklingsbara och testbara samt bryter ned dem i hanterbara och värdeskapande leveranser med definierade acceptanskriterier. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med användare, produktägare, verksamhetsexperter, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att kraven är tydliga, prioriterade, förankrade och väl förstådda av samtliga intressenter. Du ansvarar även för att upprätthålla spårbarhet genom hela utvecklingskedjan och säkerställa att krav kommuniceras och förankras mellan olika kravställare och intressentgrupper. Vidare bidrar du till kontinuerlig utveckling av teamets arbetssätt, dokumentation och kravprocesser. Du stödjer test- och kvalitetssäkringsarbetet genom kravvalidering och granskning av testfall samt fungerar som ett metodstöd inom kravhantering för verksamhetsspecialister och andra kravställare. Rollen innefattar även att utforma och vidareutveckla arbetsprocesser för mottagande organisation för att säkerställa effektiva och hållbara arbetssätt. Du kommer att ingå i ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som idag består av kravanalytiker, scrum master, systemutvecklare och testare. Kvalifikationer Vi tror att du är en analytisk och kommunikativ person som tycker om att samarbeta, skapa struktur och bygga goda relationer. Du drivs av att förstå verksamheters behov och omsätta dem till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
