items.desc: PhD student in Geophysics: Enhancing exploration drilling efficiency through integrated analyses rock formation and drilling data Are you interested in working with sustainable and responsible exploration drilling of critical raw materials, with the support of competent and friendly colleagues in an international environment? Are you looking for an employer that invests in sustainable employeeship and offers safe, favourable working conditions? We welcome you to apply for a PhD position at Uppsala University. The Department of Earth Sciences is Sweden's most comprehensive academic environment for research and education in geoscience. It offers a broad range of expertise that can contribute to solving important societal issues. Earth is a dynamic and constantly changing planet. To understand how this planet works, our researchers seek answers in the field, through laboratory experiments and advanced models. Our research and education cover a wide range of disciplines, including rocks and minerals, weather and climate, the evolution of life, natural disasters, wind power and energy, environmental and water engineering, and sustainable development. Our research combines natural sciences and technology with social sciences and is often interdisciplinary. More than 300 people from over 30 countries work at the department, both in Uppsala and at Campus Gotland. Our six research divisions: Geophysics • Air, Water and Landscape Science • Mineralogy, Petrology and Tectonics Natural Resources and Sustainable Development • Palaeobiology • Wind Energy For more information see: www.uu.se/earthsciences Geophysics is about "looking into" and understanding the Earth’s structure, its history and processes-based on measurements of the Earth’s physical properties. In geophysics we use quantitative physical methods to investigate the Earth and its environment. In addition, physical property measurements, rock mechanical field testing, scientific drilling and numerical modelling are employed to investigate the subsurface structures and processes. The Geophysics program currently runs several national and international projects and has a wealth of world-class infrastructures. It also leads the Smart Exploration Research Center (SERC) (www.smartexploration.se). SERC is funded by the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research, with members from four Swedish universities, three mining companies, four technology companies, and one development company. The PhD project will be conducted in close collaboration with Epiroc, Nordic Iron and Lund University. In this PhD project, you will be enrolled as a PhD student at Uppsala University in close collaboration with Epiroc Rock Drills AB in Örebro. You will mainly be placed at Uppsala University, Uppsala. During shorter periods, you will also be placed at Epiroc Rock Drills AB in Örebro and participate if field work. Access to certain technology or data associated with industry partners within the project may be subject to applicable export control legislation and will be managed in accordance with current regulations. Duties The PhD candidate will conduct research within SERC, focusing on sustainable and responsible exploration of critical raw materials. The overarching aim of the PhD project is to develop a framework for integrating rock formation and drilling data to improve exploration drilling efficiency, thereby contribute to more sustainable and responsible exploration drilling. The project combines geoscience and drilling technology, with a focus on diamond core drilling in crystalline rock. The PhD candidate will develop advanced theoretical, technical and practical expertise in the technical and operational challenges of the drilling process, as well as geoscientific methods for subsurface characterization. The work involves data acquisition in connection with exploration drilling, borehole logging, in-situ testing, drill core analyses, and laboratory testing. Separate and integrated analyses of these datasets will be used to investigate potential relationships between rock formation properties, drilling data, and exploration drilling efficiency. The doctoral student will work in close collaboration with academic and industry research groups contributing to stronger collaboration and knowledge exchange between these communities. The PhD candidate is expected to combine theoretical and practical work, work both independently and collaboratively, spend parts of the project period with industry partners, and participate in field and laboratory work. Requirements To meet the entry requirements for doctoral studies, you must: hold a Master’s (second-cycle) degree in geophysics, geology, rock mechanics, drilling technology, physics, earth sciences or a similar field, or have completed at least 240 credits in higher education, with at least 60 credits at Master’s level including an independent project worth at least 15 credits, or have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some …

items.desc: The Department of Physics is located in the AlbaNova University Center and has approximately 230 employees, 250 students at undergraduate level and 80 graduate students. There are four research subjects within the postgraduate program: Physics, Theoretical Physics, Chemical Physics and Medical Radiation Physics. These subjects span over several research groups with different research activities. For information about the Department of Physics, see: www.fysik.su.se/english. Project description Subject: Chemical Physics The theoretical description of X-ray induced electronic transitions in liquid solutions and solid materials is complicated by the strong influence of the environment and the dynamical response for core-excitations. Recently the development in high-resolution spectroscopy, in particular resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS), allows for detailed investigations of molecular interactions and electron-correlation. However, X-ray spectroscopy in condensed phase requires improvements in theoretical modelling for reliable interpretation of the experimental data. Depending on background and interests, you will primarily develop accurate methods either for treatment of X-ray induced transitions in extended systems using advanced embedding techniques or for the treatment of low energy excitation phonons and vibration. You will work in a European collaboration involving theoretical and experimental groups, and be involved also in experiments. The project ”Theory Development for High-Resolution RIXS Experiments on Liquid Solutions and Solid Materials” is a collaboration with Prof. Marcella Iannuzzi (University of Zurich) and is financed by the Swiss National Science Foundation. Partner organisations include Dr. Teodoro Laino (IBM Research), Prof. Thorsten Schmitt (Paul Scherrer Institut), and Prof. Lothar Weinhardt (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, KIT Light Source). We seek a motivated and creative candidate with a strong collaborative mindset eager to learn new skills. The position offers opportunities for international collaborations and participation in international conferences. You will be supported in developing your science communication skills. You will develop an understanding in quantum chemistry and simulation techniques to accurately model photo-induced processes. You will work in the division of Chemical Physics at the Department of Physics, in which the research spans over a wide range of experimental and theoretical projects. The research interests in the Molecular Dynamics Quantum Chemistry group range from accurate quantum mechanical studies of molecules to realistic simulations of electrolyte solutions and energy materials. Atomic, Molecular and Complex Quantum System Physics is one of the leading research areas at Stockholm University and also an area at the Faculty of Science that have been selected to profile the University. Preliminary start date Jan/Feb 2027. This and other positions in the project are also announced at https://www.cp2k.org/positions under the heading "Four Doctoral Positions in RIXS Theory and Experiment". For more information about the research group, see: www.su.se/english/profiles/odelius Qualification requirements In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications. You meet general entry requirements if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. Specific entry requirements. In order to be accepted as a PhD student in Physics or Theoretical Physics a BSc in Physics (or equivalent) is required. The studies must include 60 credits of second-cycle courses in physics out of which at least 15 credits correspond to a second-cycle degree project. The degree project does not have to have been examined at the application deadline, but work corresponding to half a semester of full-time studies should have been devoted to it. For the subject Chemical Physics courses in chemistry may replace the required physics courses. The subject Medical Radiation Physics requires a second-cycle degree project of 30 credits in the subject area, or with 60 credits of physics, a second-cycle degree project of 30 credits in another subject area. In addition, proficiency in English language, equivalent to English B in Swedish high school, is required, or Previously completed University degree taught in English IELTS score (Academic) of 6.0 or more (with none of the sections scoring less than 5.0) TOEFL score of 550 or more (computer based test 213, internet based 79) Cambridge/Oxford - Advanced or Proficiency level Selection The selection among the eligible candidates will be based on their capacity to benefit from the training. items.desc: As a Data Engineer focused on data quality in NOBA Bank Group, you'll make sure the data our bank relies on is accurate, consistent and trusted. You'll build the checks, tests and monitoring that catch problems early, and work with teams across the bank to fix them at the source. About the role: The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is in the Data Management & New Initiatives team. You'll design and implement data quality frameworks across our Databricks and dbt environment. This includes automated testing, validation rules, anomaly detection, and monitoring of data quality metrics. You'll partner with data owners, analysts, and engineers to define what "good data" means for each domain. You'll investigate quality issues, find root causes, and drive lasting fixes rather than quick patches. We use AI extensively in our daily work, from writing and reviewing code to documentation and analysis. You'll be encouraged to use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and to help us find new ways to apply them. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You'll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work. We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together! Main tasks: Design and implement data quality checks and automated tests in Databricks and dbt pipelines Define, measure, and report on data quality metrics together with data owners and stakeholders Build monitoring and alerting to detect anomalies, schema changes, and freshness or completeness issues Investigate data quality incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes Contribute to data governance work such as data contracts, lineage, and documentation Use version control and CI/CD to integrate quality checks into the development workflow Use AI tools to speed up development, testing, and documentation, and explore how AI can support anomaly detection and quality monitoring Ensure security and compliance throughout the data lifecycle, in line with banking requirements Document processes and contribute to best practices We are looking for you who: Takes pride in data that people can trust. You have a sharp eye for detail and a curious, investigative mindset, and you enjoy digging into why something looks wrong and making sure it doesn't happen again. You're proactive and collaborative, you communicate clearly with both technical and business colleagues, and you approach challenges with a "can-do" mindset. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to grow in the areas that interest you. You're open to using AI as part of how you work and stay curious about how it changes modern data engineering. For this role, you'll need: Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, with a clear focus on data quality, testing, or validation Fluency in English, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science or a related discipline Practical experience with both Databricks and dbt in a production environment Experience with data observability or data governance tools (e.g., data catalogs, lineage) Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data logic Experience implementing data tests and validation (e.g., dbt tests, Great Expectations, or similar) Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure's data stack Solid understanding of version control and CI/CD practices It's positive if you have: Python experience Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and a pragmatic, curious approach to using them in your work Previous experience in data-focused roles within the financial sector Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies Our offer to you: Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style and a high degree of self-responsibility. Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role, and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication. Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey. A caring company culture: We genuinely care about each other! You'll also have the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies and be part of shaping the future of NOBA's data landscape. It's important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead. items.desc: The Department of Meteorology at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain. We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic. The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment. Read more about us here: The Department of Meteorology. Project description The project focuses on understanding boundary layer cloud processes through Large Eddy Simulation (LES). A novel aspect is to represent cloud microphysics using a Lagrangian technique implemented in the turbulence solver Neko. The successful candidate will contribute to code development work and simulate cloudy marine boundary layers observed in detail over the Baltic Sea. The project, funded by the Swedish e-science Research Centre, is a collaboration between the Department of Meteorology at Stockholm University, KTH Center for Scientific Computing and KTH Engineering Mechanics. Qualification requirements In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications. You meet general entry requirements if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere. The specific entry requirements comprise a minimum of 90 higher education credits in one of the subjects meteorology, oceanography, physics or chemistry, at least 15 higher education credits in mathematics, as well as an independent degree project of at least 15 higher education credits. Furthermore, English language proficiency equivalent to English 6/English Level 2 at upper secondary school is required. The specific entry requirements may also be met by those who have acquired equivalent knowledge through other means, either in Sweden or abroad. General syllabus for doctoral studies in Atmospheric Sciences and Oceanography. Selection Selection from among applicants who meet the entry requirements shall be made with regards to their ability to benefit from the programme. That fact alone that an applicant is assessed to be able to receive credits for previous educational or professional/vocational activities to be credited to the educational programme may not give the applicant priority over other applicants in the selection process. Decisions on admission are made in accordance with the applicable delegation regulations. The assessment criteria for admission to the postgraduate programme in atmospheric sciences and oceanography are familiarity with the theory and applications of the subject, subject knowledge relevant to the research project, the ability to express oneself orally and in writing, proficiency in English, analytical ability, creativity, initiative, independence and the ability to work collaboratively. The assessment of the applicant’s ability in these respects are based on the relevance and results of completed higher education courses, the quality and scope of the independent project, references, interviews and a personal statement from the applicant describing their expectations of, and intentions regarding, the programme. items.desc: Meteorologiska institutionen vid Stockholms universitet (MISU) bedriver forskning och utbildning som rör atmosfären, oceanen, och fysikaliskt-baserad klimatvetenskap. MISU erbjuder utbildningsprogram på kandidat-, master- och forskarnivå. Vår forskning söker svar på grundläggande frågor om atmosfärens och havens dynamiska, fysiska, kemiska, och biogeokemiska egenskaper av relevans för väder och klimat. Vi strävar efter en bred forskningsverksamhet inom vårt vetenskapliga område. Vi studerar frågor som sträcker sig från djuphavet till den övre atmosfären och från tropikerna till polerna. I vår forskning utnyttjar och utvecklar vi teori, statistiska metoder och numeriska modeller i nära samspel med observationer. Dessutom utvecklar och leder institutionen observationsbaserad forskning med stöd av satelliter, arktiska isbrytarexpeditioner och landbaserade instrument. MISU har cirka 60 anställda och ingår i en större forskningsmiljö som inkluderar Bolincentret för klimatforskning, Östersjöcentrum och Swedish e-Science Research Centre. Institutionen har stark internationell prägel, över hälften av medarbetarna har en bakgrund utanför Sverige och både svenska och engelska används som arbetsspråk. Vi välkomnar och värdesätter mångfald i vår arbetsmiljö. Mer information om oss finns att läsa på: Meteorologiska institutionen. Projektbeskrivning Samspelet mellan aerosolpartiklar och moln utgör en potentiellt betydande, men fortfarande mycket osäker, faktor i klimatförändringarna. Projektet syftar till att öka förståelsen för hur aerosolföroreningar påverkar moln som består av vattendroppar. Inom projektet ges möjlighet att undersöka detta genom att testa en ny teori som förutspår att aerosolföroreningar förstärker uppvindarna i konvektiva moln, vilket kan göra molnen tjockare och mer reflekterande. Det finns även möjlighet att studera trender i jordens strålningsbudget kopplade till aerosol-moln-interaktioner under satelliteran. Forskningsarbetet kan omfatta både numeriska simuleringar och analys av satellitdata. Behörighetskrav För att bli antagen till forskarutbildning krävs att den sökande har grundläggande och särskild behörighet. Behörigheten ska vara uppfylld senast sista ansökningsdag. Grundläggande behörighet har du, om du avlagt examen på avancerad nivå, eller fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng (hp), varav minst 60 hp på avancerad nivå, eller på annat sätt inom eller utom landet förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper. För särskild behörighet krävs minst 90 hp i något av ämnena meteorologi, oceanografi, fysik eller kemi, minst 15 hp i matematik och ett självständigt arbete om minst 15 hp. Av detta skall minst 60 hp vara på avancerad nivå. Vidare krävs språkkunskaper i engelska motsvarande engelska B på gymnasiet. Allmän studieplan för studier på forskarnivå i atmosfärsvetenskap och oceanografi. Urval Urval bland de sökande som uppfyller behörighetskraven ska göras med hänsyn till deras förmåga att tillgodogöra sig utbildningen. Enbart det förhållandet att en sökande bedöms kunna få tidigare utbildning eller yrkesverksamhet tillgodoräknad för utbildningen får inte vid urval ge sökanden företräde framför andra sökande. Beslut om antagning fattas enligt gällande delegationsordning. Vid bedömningen tas hänsyn till förtrogenhet och skicklighet inom ämnet, förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på engelska, analytisk förmåga, kreativitet, initiativförmåga och självständighet, och samarbetsförmåga. Till grund för bedömningen ligger tidigare studiers relevans, betyg på genomgångna högskolekurser (särskilt de på avancerad nivå), kvalitet och omfattning på det självständiga arbetet, referenser, intervjuer samt skriftlig avsiktsförklaring. Antagningsordning för utbildning på forskarnivå vid Stockholms universitet. Om anställningen Tillträde den 1 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi erbjuder en tidsbegränsad anställning som doktorand enligt 5 kap. högskoleförordningen (1993:100). Anställningstiden får inte vara längre än vad som motsvarar utbildning på forskarnivå på heltid under fyra år. Som doktorand ska du främst ägna dig åt din egen utbildning på forskarnivå, men i anställningen kan arbete med utbildning, forskning och administration ingå i begränsad omfattning (högst 20 %). En ny anställning som doktorand gäller för högst ett år, anställningen förnyas därefter med högst två år i taget. items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

Both the training provided by our SKAN Academy and your several years of professional experience as a Field Engineer will help you quickly
items.desc: Founded in 1968, SKAN is a pioneer in cleanroom equipment and the development of isolators for the pharmaceutical industry. Innovative products, tailor-made solutions and an effective service organization have made SKAN a market leader and a key partner to industry and research laboratories. Overview In this role as a Field Engineer at SKAN, you will be part of a great team with a strong sense of camaraderie that handles the maintenance, qualification, and calibration of our systems in the field. The range of systems spans from older models to state-of-the-art filling lines. Both the training provided by our SKAN Academy and your several years of professional experience as a Field Engineer will help you quickly find your footing in our environment. With a high degree of travel within Europe, you can expect exciting challenges, new cultures, and the opportunity to apply your expertise on an international scale. Assignments are on a weekly basis (Mon–Fri) and sometimes span two to three weeks. This position requires a high degree of flexibility in terms of time and a willingness to travel. Service assignments throughout Europe are scheduled according to customer needs and are subject to change on short notice. You must be willing to adapt flexibly to varying work schedules, travel durations, and last-minute schedule changes. Responsibilities Performing maintenance on our systems Qualification, re-qualification, and inspection of SKAN systems and products in the pharmaceutical sector GMP-compliant documentation of test reports Calibration and adjustment of sensors Filter integrity testing and ventilation qualification Replacement and repair of components as well as troubleshooting and repair services for isolators Hardskills Basic technical training and/or a higher technical degree (mechanical engineering, mechatronics, polymechanics, or similar) Several years of experience in a service engineering environment are highly advantageous Experience in a GMP environment or in the field of isolator technology is highly desirable but not required Very good English skills are required; knowledge of German is an advantage Due to travel requirements, residence in the Basel/Allschwil area or a willingness to relocate there is recommended Softskills Enjoy working in a team Precise and meticulous work style High level of personal responsibility Significant flexibility with regard to schedule and a strong willingness to adapt to last-minute changes in work assignments, as well as a high degree of flexibility regarding travel times, duration of assignments, and client assignments scheduled on short notice High flexibility due to occasional last-minute changes in the work schedule Confident and professional demeanor when interacting with customers Willingness to travel throughout Europe 75%–85% of the time We offer you An open and collaborative corporate culture Freedom to contribute and develop ideas Opportunities to participate in sports and social activities Professional development and continuous learning opportunities, especially at our SKAN Academy Comprehensive and career-focused onboarding Quick decision-making paths and flat hierarchies Transparent and open communication 5 weeks of vacation, with the option to take additional leave Additional information We look forward to receiving your complete application documents (CV, diplomas and employment references) via our career page. For this position, we are focusing on direct applications and are not working with external agencies. Any dossiers submitted by agencies will not be processed. For questions please contact Viviane Braxton.

items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

Kickstart Your Global Career With Caterpillar® At Caterpillar, we do more than build machines — we build the future. When you join us, you become part of a global community of creators, problem‑solvers, and innovators committed to shaping stronger, more sustainable communities around the world. If you're driven, curious, and ready to make an impact early in your career… this is where your journey begins. About the Program The Field Representative Development Program is your launchpad into a high‑impact career at Caterpillar. Over 1 to 2 years, you’ll get hands‑on experience, world‑class training, and a front‑row seat to how we partner with our Cat® Dealers to serve customers worldwide. Program Details: Start Date: February 1st, 2027 Location: Geneva Work Format : Full time (40 hrs / week), onsite 5 days per week What to Expect / Structure of the Program: 1. Training in a cohort — Your First 3 Months: You’ll kick off your career in an immersive learning experience where you will: Dive into Caterpillar products, services, and industry strategies Build influential communication and leadership skills Connect with a global network of peers + mentors Visit dealers across the EAME and Central Asia region Gain a deep understanding of what makes Caterpillar… Caterpillar 2. Rotational Assignments (12-18 months): Jump into meaningful roles across the organization to: Learn how our business operates from different angles Develop a broad technical and commercial skillset Work on strategic projects that go beyond the classroom Prepare for a customer‑facing field role 3. Your Next Step — Field Rep Opportunities : Once you graduate from the program, you’re ready to step into a field‑based role supporting Cat Dealers and customers. Opportunities at the end of the Program: Sales Representative: As a Sales Representative you will have responsibility for the support, marketing, and sales of machines or engines throughout the machine/engine sales cycle as well as driving revenue and growth for the aftermarket solutions business in line with industry strategy in the assigned territory. You will counsel dealers to develop and increase their performance, provide guidance on existing and potential customer service issues and improvement measures within an industry as well as assist dealers on forecast, sales strategy planning and sales techniques. You will also support the rollout of new products, analyze and communicate marketplace and competitive activity and analyze product application, configuration and utilization. Why You’ll Love This Program: A personalized development plan tailored to your strengths & ambitions A dedicated coach guiding you throughout your journey Hands‑on technical, commercial, and soft‑skill training International exposure + opportunity to live abroad for a rotation A clear path to impactful roles across the business A chance to shape the customer experience for one of the world’s most iconic brands Who We’re Looking For: Program Qualifications: A degree in Engineering, Marketing, Business, or a related field — or equivalent experience Ability to travel up to 30–70% depending on assignments Willingness to live abroad for up to 3 months for training/rotation Fluent in English Valid passport through August 2027 Skills That Make You Stand Out Critical Thinking & Problem Solving – Ability to analyze complex situations, identify root causes, and develop effective, actionable solutions. Communication & Stakeholder Management – Skilled at conveying information clearly and building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders from diverse backgrounds to ensure alignment and engagement. Learning Agility & Adaptability – Quick to learn, open to feedback, and able to adapt effectively to changing priorities, environments, and technologies. Digital & Data Literacy – Ability to leverage digital tools and interpreting data to support decision‑making and drive efficiency. Proficiency in MS Office / O365: Ability to build simple dashboards or visualizations (e.g., Power BI, Excel advanced features) and comfort cleaning, interpreting, or summarizing data sets. Teamwork & Collaboration – Strong collaborator who fosters trust, contributes to shared goals, and works effectively across diverse teams and functions. What you might have: Proficiency in a third language would be a plus Experience supporting or leading small projects (university, internship, or extracurricular). items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients. Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities. What You’ll Do Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

items.desc: Company Description Vitol is a leader in energy and commodities. Vitol produces, manages and delivers energy and commodities to consumers and industry worldwide. In addition to its primary business of trading, Vitol is invested in infrastructure globally, with $13+billion invested in long-term assets. Vitol’s customers include national oil companies, multinationals, leading industrial companies and utilities. Founded in Rotterdam in 1966, today Vitol serves its customers from some 40 offices worldwide. Revenues in 2025 were $343bn. Job Description This role is ideal for a passionate, entrepreneurially minded developer who thrives on ownership , impact , and a dynamic environment. You will have end-to-end ownership of the solutions you deliver, from the first conversation with the business to final rollout and beyond. You will be trusted to shape the best approach to delivering against business priorities and timelines, in a flat, team-oriented environment that values ideas and individual contributions. Your role We have developed our own Commodity Trading Risk Management (CTRM) system that covers all aspects of our business activities across the globe: from trade entry through middle-office, with P&L reporting and price risk management, down to invoicing – for every commodity we trade, including electricity, renewables, gas, crude oil, refined products, biofuels, or carbon certificates. We place our CTRM at the heart of how the company operates; it is used daily by teams across trading, middle office, finance and operations. Our most critical systems are built in-house by teams like ours, helping orchestrate global energy flows. What defines success in this role: Technical excellence : design and implement clean, well-documented and extensible features. Write maintainable, high-performance code. Ownership: work with a high degree of autonomy and take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your deliverables: requirements, design, development, testing, rollout, training and ongoing support. Business partnership : engage directly with trading desks, finance and senior management to identify and prioritise requirements. There is no intermediary: you are both the business analyst and the developer. You go beyond what users explicitly ask for: understanding the context, spotting pain points they may not articulate directly, and building what truly serves the business. Teamwork : end-to-end ownership does not mean working alone. Your work integrates into a much larger system, and you stay closely connected with other development teams. You will become a trusted partner to colleagues and stakeholders across the firm. As we work as one united team covering PnL, Risk, VAR and options, the projects may be as diverse as: Helping redesign our CTRM reporting architecture to enable fast, scalable access for the demands of an AI-driven world Modelling cash-for-product loan repayments in our Finance P&L Building a valuation engine for complex options that we trade Running a systems integration with a company we have acquired For large projects, you may travel to other Vitol main offices – Houston, Singapore, London, Rotterdam – to ensure smooth integration and adoption on the ground. Our technology Our core technologies, PL/SQL and Oracle Forms Builder, form the foundation of our core trading platform and have been central to Vitol's success story. When you join, you will work with these established technologies to quickly get up to speed with our data model and business logic, and start adding value from day one. As our platform continues to evolve, we are progressively embracing a more contemporary technology stack, creating opportunities for those interested to be part of shaping what comes next. Qualifications Required University degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or an equivalent field At least 3 years' experience as a software engineer, ideally in a role combining technical and functional responsibilities Proven data modelling skills to translate business situations into data structures Proficiency in SQL Team player with strong entrepreneurial drive and ability to work independently Proactive and user-focused "make it work" mentality with a genuine interest in both the functional and technical aspects of each challenge Comfortable with a daily release cycle and a fast-paced, results-oriented environment Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging with non-technical and senior stakeholders Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken Nice to have Experience with PL/SQL (preferred) or a similar procedural DB programming language (e.g. T-SQL) Practical experience with Oracle Forms builder Previous experience in the commodities and/or trading industry Familiarity with PnL, accounting, or risk concepts French is a plus Additional Information Our Geneva Office Our office is located very centrally, 5 minutes from the main train station and 1 minute from the …

items.desc: Finance Data Business Analyst (limited contract for 6 months, start asap) About us Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms. Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies. Who we’re looking for The Finance team plays a critical role in driving business performance by ensuring financial outcomes are clearly understood key performance drivers are transparent, and strategic decisions are grounded in robust commercial insight. The team works alongside senior stakeholders to influence decision-making, optimise resource allocation, and ensure the Wealth Management business is aligned with the Bank’s and the Group’s strategic objectives, governance standards and risk management framework. The Finance Data Business Analyst will act as a trusted advisor to the business, combining strong financial insight with commercial acumen to provide forward-looking analysis, challenge performance, and support key strategic initiatives within a regulated Swiss private banking environment. The team Based in Zurich and connected to the FP&A and Finance Business Partnering network of the Wealth Management Division, the team is integral to driving the performance of the Swiss private bank by assisting senior stakeholders with planning, strategic decision-making and performance evaluation. The team operates across two complementary capabilities: FP&A (Performance & Planning) – responsible for management reporting, forecasting, and financial processes Business Partnering – focused on commercial insight, stakeholder engagement, and decision support Together, the team delivers end-to-end financial support to the business, ensuring that financial information is accurate, insightful, and actionable. We are a collaborative and high-performing team, with a strong focus on continuous improvement, commercial impact, and delivering high-quality insight to senior stakeholders. items.desc: Doctoral Student in Glaciology and Glacial Hazards 100%, Zurich, fixed-term We are looking for a Doctoral Student to join the team of the Professorship of Glaciology for four years. Our group is affiliated with ETH’s Laboratory of Hydraulics, Hydrology and Glaciology (VAW) as well as the Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research (WSL). Project background The Doctoral Student is offered within the project Stability of cold hanging glaciers under climate warming in the French and Swiss Alps (ICEFAL). ICEFAL is composed of a Swiss-French consortium studying the effects of rising ice temperatures on the stability of cold hanging glaciers and their likelihood to be the source of large ice avalanches. The overarching goal of the project is to provide a data-driven method to create an index of hazard potential for all hanging glaciers in the French and Swiss Alps, with applicability beyond the study region. The index combines geometric and thermal considerations. To achieve this goal, the project combines fieldwork, state-of-the-art thermo-mechanical modeling, and regional-scale geospatial analyses. Job description To achieve the project goals, the successful candidate will: Create an inventory of hanging glaciers using manual mapping and possibly machine-learning aided approaches Perform field measurements at high-elevation sites in Switzerland The goal is to collect measurements of ice temperatures, which will be complemented with mass balance measurements, firn cores, and analyses of long-term ice-avalanche monitoring data Leverage the collected field data as well as available meteorological data to drive a state-of-the-art thermo-mechanical model (Elmer/Ice) to investigate the past and future evolution of the temperature field of the investigated glaciers and possible repercussions on stability Predict basal temperatures of hanging glaciers from approaches developed at VAW-Glaciology and by project partners, and intersect these with stability criteria to derive a hazard index for hanging glaciers in the study region The work will be supported by postdoctoral and senior researchers of VAW-Glaciology and is based in Zurich. Profile The successful candidate brings a combination of the following skills and experiences to the project: Required : A Master’s degree in geophysics, physics, environmental or earth science, environmental engineering, or related fields Excellent knowledge of English, both in oral and written form (C1 to C2) Desired background and interest in the following topics: A keen interest in high-mountain hazards A solid foundation in math and physics Glaciologic training or expertise A willingness to conduct fieldwork in a high-mountain environment Geospatial analysis and processing skills (e.g., QGIS) Experience with hazard and risk management concepts Prior experience with physics-based numerical modeling Familiarity with a scripting language (e.g., Python or Matlab) Outdoor or mountaineering experiences Interest and experience working in teams Knowledge of German and/or French We stress that successful applicants do not need to come with all desired skills/experiences. Furthermore, candidates with non-traditional academic backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Workplace Workplace We offer We are a dynamic and international research group, fully dedicated to the study of glaciers, ice sheets and the impacts resulting from their changes. We value a welcoming, friendly, and supportive working atmosphere and strive for excellence in all we do. The working languages in our group are English, (Swiss) German, French, and Italian. For more information on our group and activities, please visit the following website and/or our social media channels (@VAW_glaciology). We value diversity and sustainability In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future. Curious? So are we. items.desc: Dysregulation of lipid metabolism plays a key role in development and progression of metabolic disorders including obesity, type 2 diabetes and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We are seeking a highly motivated and talented PhD candidate to join our multidisciplinary research team to investigate underlying mechanism associated to dysregulation of lipid metabolism in MASLD. The project aims to elucidate the mechanistic role of lipid signaling molecules in driving hepatic inflammation and fibrosis, and to identify novel therapeutic intervention. What you can expect This research will provide multi-disciplinary training as require a combination of complementary approaches, including molecular biology, biochemistry, analytical chemistry and computational biology Your Profile Master's degree or equivalent in biochemistry, system biology or analytical chemistry Experience working with mass spectrometry is essential and knowledge of working with mass spectrometry imaging in plus Highly organized and capable of working both independently and within the team Good interpersonal and communication skills as well as fluency in both spoken and written English is essential What we offer A supporting and state-of-the-art research environment to develop scientifically and professionally The opportunity to work and get training on a multi-disciplinary research project; with pre-clinical models as well as clinical studies The position is fully-funded by Swiss National Science Foundation and available from November 2026 (or upon agreement) Please send your CV, motivation letter, reference letter with name and contact of two referees. items.desc: About Fabrican Fabrican is an innovative materials technology company developing a unique spray-on textile and material platform with applications across medical, industrial and consumer markets. We are looking for a Laboratory Technician to join our team for a R&D project focused on developing a novel spray-formed, porous material structure for a potential medical application. The Role This is a hands-on laboratory position working alongside our scientist and technical team . You will support formulation development, material preparation, spray trials, prototype production and preliminary laboratory testing. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys practical experimental work and wants to gain experience in polymers, biomaterials, coatings and spray technology . Key Responsibilities Prepare polymers, fibres, solvents and experimental formulations. Carry out laboratory spray trials and assist with optimisation of spray parameters. Produce and prepare prototype samples for testing. Assist with measurements of thickness, pore size, porosity, weight, flexibility and mechanical properties. Prepare samples for microscopy and external laboratory analysis. Operate, clean and maintain laboratory and spray equipment. Maintain accurate laboratory records, sample identification and traceability. Record experimental results and assist with data collection and reporting. Follow laboratory safety, COSHH and chemical-handling procedures. Support the senior scientist with experimental troubleshooting and optimisation. About You Essential: Laboratory experience in chemistry, materials science, polymer science, biotechnology or a related field . Practical experience working with chemicals and laboratory equipment. Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping. Ability to follow procedures and work safely and methodically. Good organisational and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a small multidisciplinary team. Desirable experience: Polymer or formulation development. Biomaterials or medical materials. Coatings or spray technology. Microscopy or mechanical testing. Sample preparation and laboratory analysis. R&D or product development environments. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is a hands-on problem solver, who is reliable and organised , with a genuine interest in experimental research and developing new technologies. You should be comfortable working in a small, fast-moving R&D environment where practical problem-solving and initiative are highly valued. The Project The initial phase will focus on material screening, solubility, sprayability, layer formation, and setting time . Later stages will involve formulation optimisation, prototype development and preliminary characterisation. This is a non-clinical R&D project and does not involve patient treatment, implantation or clinical testing. Schedule: 8 hour shift Job Type: Full-time Pay: From £27,000.00 per year Application question(s): How many years of Material Science/Chemistry/Polymer Science/Biotechnology experience do you have? Education: Bachelor's (required) Work Location: In person

We’re a lean, high-growth team working at the intersection of data, technology and business strategy, partnering with enterprise organisations to solve complex data challenges through modern Lakehouse architectures on Databricks. At Unifeye you’ll be trusted to take ownership from day one, challenge conventional thinking and make a genuine impact on clients and on the growth of the business. The Role We’re looking for a Data Engineer with a background in application or web development to join our delivery team. You’ll help build data platforms and, importantly, applications on Databricks, including Databricks Apps that put data and AI directly in the hands of business users. This role suits someone who started out building software (web apps, front end, full stack or similar) and has moved, or is moving, into data engineering. If you think like a builder and enjoy turning ideas into real, usable products, your development background will be a real advantage here. You don’t need previous Databricks experience. Develop integrations and ingestion from APIs, files and other data sources. Apply good engineering practice to data work: testing, version control, CI/CD and deployment automation. Collaborate with architects, AI specialists and client stakeholders to turn business requirements into working solutions. Share knowledge across the team and contribute to how we build. What We’re Looking For Essential Recent commercial experience in application or web development, e.g. TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, Node or similar. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, testing, CI/CD. Good communication skills and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable Exposure to Spark, PySpark or Databricks. A Databricks certification, completed or in progress. Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience building internal tools, dashboards or data-driven applications. Exposure to AI or Generative AI applications. Client-facing or consulting experience. Why Join Unifeye? Work exclusively with Databricks technologies, alongside some of the UK’s most experienced Databricks specialists. Build real applications, not just pipelines, at the point where software and data meet. Close collaboration with Databricks teams. Continuous learning, with funded certification and career development. High levels of ownership and autonomy from day one. Competitive salary, bonus, generous benefits and flexible hybrid working. If you’re a developer who has fallen for data, or a data engineer who still loves building products, we’d love to hear from you.

Bring your passion for innovative technology solutions to a role where your skills will make a real impact on organizational success through sophisticated SAS programming combined with the latest in cloud computing, machine learning, and natural language processing techniques. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). We are now recruiting the below position. Pre-Construction Senior Project Manager Reporting & Analytics Location: Hybrid with travel to Suffolk, Ipswich and Leiston Contract: Permanent, full-time. This role sits within our dedicated careers provision for the UCL School of Management, one of the UK’s leading business and management schools. Home to more than 2,000 students from across the world, the School has particular strengths in innovation, technology, business analytics and entrepreneurship and is currently delivering an ambitious programme of growth. Our postgraduate students have ambitious career goals, with many looking to build careers across technology, data, AI, business analytics and marketing science. We are looking for a careers professional with strong knowledge of these areas who can help them understand the opportunities available, develop their skills and translate their academic experience into successful careers. About the role As Careers Consultant: Technology & Analytics Specialist, you will be our lead careers specialist for students interested in careers across Technology, Data Science, AI, Business Analytics and Marketing Science. You will work primarily with postgraduate students, joining a collaborative team of Careers Consultants and Employer Engagement professionals to design and deliver a comprehensive careers and professional development programme. Through workshops, group sessions, one-to-one coaching and application support, you will help students explore their options, develop their career management skills and prepare effectively for competitive recruitment processes. You will bring specialist insight into the technology and analytics labour market, helping students understand different career pathways and the skills employers are looking for. This could include careers such as Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, Business Analyst, Product or Customer Insights Analyst, Quantitative Analyst and Analytics Consultant. A key part of the role will be keeping close to developments in the sector. You will use labour-market information, graduate outcomes and student insight to shape careers activity, while maintaining an up-to-date understanding of recruitment practices across technology, analytics, data and related areas. You will also build strong relationships with academic colleagues, employers and other stakeholders, working collaboratively to embed relevant employability support across the School. Our students are highly international and pursue careers across the UK and major global graduate markets, so you will also help them understand how recruitment practices and opportunities differ internationally. Please note this role is offered on a full-time basis with hybrid working available. As a student-facing role, attendance on campus (Canary Wharf School of Management) is required for currently a minimum of one day per week during term-time but may be more according to workload and business need. Job Ref: B06-00214 Closing Date: 3-11-2026 – 23:59 (UK time) Interviews: Interview are likely to take place onsite at our Canary Wharf office from mid-November About you You may already be working in university careers or employability and have developed specialist expertise supporting students pursuing careers in technology, data or analytics. Alternatively, you might bring experience from recruitment, talent development, coaching or industry and be looking for an opportunity to use that expertise to support the next generation of talent. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Psychologist to join the Enfield Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team to cover maternity leave. This post will support the delivery of high-quality neuropsychological assessment and intervention for stroke survivors in Enfield. The postholder will support and enhance the professional neuropsychological input and psychologically informed care for patients referred to the Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team. This includes providing structured neuropsychological assessment and brief protocol-based interventions under the close supervision of qualified clinical psychologists/neuropsychologists. You will be based at St Michaels Primary Care Centre in Enfield and seeing patients in their homes and/or clinic. A car driver with own car for work purposes is required for this post. **Please note that due to expected high volume of applications this post will close early once enough applications have been received. ** Assessments and brief interventions for mood, adjustment, behavioural and cognitive functioning will be delivered independently but working according to a plan agreed with a qualified clinical psychologist/neuropsychologist. All clinical activity will be carried out under a matched care model, with responsibilities and level of autonomy clearly defined and regularly reviewed by the supervising psychologist. While assessments and interventions will be delivered independently, these will always follow a formulation and care plan agreed in supervision, and within the scope of competence for a Band 4 Assistant Psychologist. The postholder will also be working closely in collaboration with the wider multidisciplinary team (MDT) to support psychological elements of patients’ rehabilitation goals. The role will always adhere to Trust and team policies on clinical governance, safeguarding, and documentation. The post-holder will be expected to produce high-quality documentation in a timely manner and in accordance with Trust policies and team processes in line with Trust standards. Wider responsibilities include participation in clinically related administration, routine data collection and service evaluation, and support to audit, teaching and research projects. The postholder will also assist in the development of psychoeducational materials and contribute to local service improvement initiatives. The Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust is one of the UK’s biggest and most innovative trusts. Across three main hospitals, our dedicated army of staff care for over 1.6 million patients, treat more than 200,000 in A&E, deliver over 8,000 babies and carry out more than 17 million tests. Our size, scale and influence offer you unrivaled career opportunities and a forward-thinking approach to working that works around your lifestyle. From flexible hours and generous benefits, to next level training, we make it easier to take your career to the top. See attached documents for full details including job description and person specification documents. Whilst working autonomously within the stroke team, the postholder will also be joining an expanding and supportive neuropsychology team. items.desc: App Developer - Stride Manchester (Hybrid) | Reporting to CTO Free StrideOne membership plus family and friends discount About Stride ‘Normal’ health is no longer good enough. Normal is code for tired, stressed, barely functioning and slowly declining, and calling that a life. We think everyone has a right to better than that. Stride is turning tracking your entire internal biology into a lifestyle, with a next generation preventative health membership. Every member builds a multi-omic health profile covering DNA, microbiome, blood biomarkers, epigenetics and oral health. That’s over 500 biomarkers, tested at least twice a year, so we can see direction of travel and not just a single point in time. Then we turn it into what to actually do: what to eat, how to train, what to supplement, what to watch, with a coach, dietitian or physiologist alongside you. Imagine an elite longevity concierge, at an everyday price, with no stuffy clinics to attend! The Role This is a zero-to-one build. Stride doesn’t have an app yet. Members currently log in through a web portal, and your job is to turn that into an installable app on iOS and Android, launched on both at the same time. What You’ll Be Doing: Build and ship Stride’s first app across iOS and Android, from architecture to App Store and Play Store approval Decide where native is essential (login, HealthKit, push, store compliance) and where web views do the job faster Integrate with our existing REST API and data model, and help shape the API as the app’s needs become clear Build engagement into the product: notifications, check-ins and reasons to come back every week The Biological Age Platform Build the member-facing experience of a genuinely novel, multi-source biological age score Turn huge volumes of biomarker and trend data into screens that inform without overwhelming Work with our scientific team so the app stays rigorous while staying simple Cross-functional Partnership Partner closely with our Product Designer, from first sketch to shipped feature Work with the CTO on technical and UX decisions, and with the founders on functionality Back your decisions with data. Nobody here is precious, and the best evidence wins Building with AI Use AI natively across scaffolding, code review, testing and documentation Bring the experience to know what you’re asking AI to build, and to spot when it gets it wrong How We’ll Know It’s Working Both apps live, approved and launched together Members opening the app weekly, not just when results arrive A codebase that’s simple, scalable and easy to adjust, with nothing more complex than it needs to be Features built with commercial outcomes in mind, not just technical elegance What You’ll Bring A track record of shipping consumer-facing apps that real users relied on, going back several years Experience taking an app from zero to live, ideally owning the build end to end Practical experience getting apps through App Store and Play Store review Experience presenting large amounts of data in a way that’s clear and engaging Fluency with AI tooling, built on fundamentals you learned before it existed Commercial awareness: you build for scale and adaptability, not for its own sake Comfort in a small, very fast-moving team where things change quickly and you’ll help shape the process Bonus points: A successful wellness, health or fitness app, native iOS or Android depth, cross-platform frameworks (Flutter, React Native), HealthKit or Health Connect integrations, data-heavy apps (fintech, trading, gaming), or being an early or first engineer at a startup. Why Stride Preventive health is where consumer health is heading, and your work helps people find out earlier, not too late Own the app outright, and shape the architecture rather than inheriting someone else’s decisions Work directly with an experienced CTO and a founder who took DNAfit through an eight-figure exit to Prenetics before a Nasdaq listing 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, pension, annual learning budget and your own kit

The post-holder must have experience of working with service users experiencing mental health problems and the skills and abilities needed to form effective and safe therapeutic relationships. They should have excellent written and verbal communication skills. The post-holder will work with people of different cultural backgrounds and ages, using interpreters when necessary and should be committed to equal opportunities and the organisation's anti-racist commitment. The post-holder must be able to attend the required training training over a 2-year course. They must be able to complete all the academic components of the course and have the ability to integrate training into practice under supervision. The post holder will be following patients from TIA clinic and discharged patients from ASU and Stroke Rehab ward in a follow-up clinic once week.
