items.desc: AI & Automation Analyst Location: Greater Manchester (hybrid working) Salary: New role - dependent on experience Are you working in Application Support, Business Systems or Technical Business Analysis and looking for an opportunity to move into AI and Automation? Well Street are proud to be exclusively partnering a major European organisation in an exciting part of their growth journey to recruit an AI Analyst. Our client is at an exciting stage of its technology journey. Having invested in AI and automation tools, the business is now looking for someone who can help turn that investment into meaningful improvements in how people work. This isn't a traditional AI Developer position. We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how businesses operate, solving problems and finding smarter ways of doing things using technology. You'll work closely with the IT Director and teams across the business, identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce manual tasks and introduce practical AI and automation solutions. It's an opportunity to take ownership, experiment with new technologies and play an important role in shaping how AI is adopted across the organisation. What you'll be doing Working with colleagues across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing and Customer Service to understand how they work and identify opportunities for improvement. Reviewing existing business applications, workflows and processes to identify inefficiencies and repetitive tasks. Designing and building practical automation and AI-enabled solutions that make everyday activities easier and more efficient. Supporting the adoption of AI tools, helping colleagues understand how they can use them effectively. Working with data across business applications, including ERP, CRM and Excel, to improve reporting, accuracy and accessibility. Using tools such as SQL, Python, APIs and automation platforms to connect systems, manipulate data and streamline processes. Developing reports and dashboards, including Power BI, to help teams make better-informed decisions. Testing, documenting and improving solutions to ensure they're reliable, secure and easy to use. Becoming a key point of contact for colleagues looking to explore how AI and automation could improve their work. What we're looking for We're open to candidates from a range of technical backgrounds, particularly Application Support, Business Systems, Technical Business Analysis or Automation. More important than your job title is your ability to understand problems, work with people and use technology to develop practical solutions. Ideally, you'll bring: Around 2–5 years' experience in Application Support, Business Systems, Business Analysis, Data Analysis or a similar technical role. Experience supporting or working with business applications such as ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to understand how technology supports business processes. Some hands-on experience with scripting, SQL, Python, APIs or workflow automation. Practical experience experimenting with or applying AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar in a business environment. Confidence working directly with non-technical colleagues to understand requirements and explain solutions. An interest in improving processes rather than simply maintaining existing systems. A proactive attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies. Experience with Power BI, automation platforms or integrating AI into business workflows would be advantageous, but you don't need to be an expert in everything. Interested? If you're a technically minded problem-solver who enjoys finding better ways of doing things and wants to build a career in AI and automation, we'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have AI in your current job title. We're equally interested in people who've taken the initiative to automate processes, improve systems or experiment with new technologies in their existing roles. Please ‘apply within’ or email your CV to Charlie@well-street.co.uk .

items.desc: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office) Pricing at Marshmallow This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new? We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency. We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements. We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors. All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with! What You’ll Be Doing Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing. Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers. Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python. Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python. Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing. Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value. Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals. Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products. Who are you? Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models Commercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact Curious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further Owner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area Opinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way Explainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts Networker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business What skills are we looking for from you? Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R At least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. items.desc: About Crystalloids Crystalloids was founded in 2006 and consists of a team of experienced software and data specialists who help organizations innovate and grow by developing data-driven solutions. We are a Premier Google Cloud Partner. We believe successful solutions are built on three pillars: people, processes, and technology. At Crystalloids, we consider all three dimensions in everything we design and build for our clients. Over the years, we have built an impressive client portfolio across industries including retail, e-commerce, consumer packaged goods (CPG), media, travel, and leisure. Our clients include Rituals, KNVB, Body & Fit, FD Mediagroep, and ACSI. What Will You Do as an Analytics Engineer? At Crystalloids, we help organizations become truly data-driven and AI-driven by building scalable and efficient data platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). As an Analytics Engineer , you will work at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and AI. You will transform raw data into valuable insights using dbt and SQL , build reliable data models, and actively contribute to data engineering within the GCP ecosystem. AI is part of how you work At Crystalloids, AI is not a separate initiative or an occasional experiment. It is part of your daily engineering workflow. You will use modern AI tools to increase your development speed, automate repetitive work, accelerate debugging, generate and improve tests and documentation, explore solutions, and challenge your own technical approach. We expect our Analytics Engineers to continuously develop their ability to work effectively with AI — while critically validating AI-generated outputs and remaining fully responsible for the quality, security, and maintainability of what they deliver. You will learn how to combine strong engineering fundamentals with AI-assisted development to deliver better solutions faster. You will also contribute to creating AI value for our clients. Upstream, you will help validate AI use cases by testing assumptions, developing prototypes and Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and demonstrating potential business value. Downstream, you will help turn successful concepts into production-ready solutions by providing robust data models, reliable pipelines, governance, testing, documentation, and scalable implementation within Google Cloud. Are you excited about building well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets that create direct business value? Do you enjoy working with both technical and business stakeholders? And do you want to master how AI is changing modern analytics engineering? Then we would love to meet you. Your Responsibilities Data Modeling & Transformation Design and implement robust data models using dbt. Build conceptual data models using different modeling frameworks and methodologies. Work with business and technical stakeholders to identify, classify, qualify, and clearly define business concepts, their relationships, and business rules. Translate conceptual models and business definitions into logical and physical data models. Transform raw data into clean, documented, and reusable datasets for reporting, analytics, and AI applications. Build trustworthy data and semantic foundations that can be consumed by people, applications, and AI systems. Analytics Enablement Work with stakeholders to translate business requirements and business logic into technical solutions. Develop solutions that are traceable, testable, maintainable, and version-controlled. Help make organizational data understandable and usable for analytics and AI-driven applications. Development & Optimization Write efficient and maintainable code in SQL, Python, or another object-oriented programming language. Optimize data transformation pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost within BigQuery and other GCP services. Use AI-assisted development to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, and technical problem-solving. Data Engineering Take ownership of data engineering activities, including: Developing and maintaining data pipelines. Building reliable data ingestion processes and ensuring stable pipeline execution. Working with Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Storage. Performing these activities independently rather than only supporting Data Engineers. AI-Native Engineering Use modern AI development tools as part of your daily engineering workflow . Apply AI to accelerate SQL and Python development, data modeling, debugging, testing, documentation, and code reviews. Use AI to explore alternative technical solutions and reduce repetitive engineering work. Develop effective prompting and context-engineering practices for technical work. Critically evaluate AI-generated code and recommendations rather than accepting outputs without validation. Continuously experiment with new AI capabilities and identify where they can improve engineering speed and quality. Take full ownership of the correctness, security, maintainability, …

items.desc: Ubicación: Las Rozas, Madrid (Calle Jacinto Benavente) Modalidad: Híbrida, con asistencia a oficina 1 día a la semana. Descripción del puesto Desde Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer especializado/a en Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Python y MLOps para incorporarse a un proyecto de Grupo DIA. Buscamos un perfil técnico con experiencia en el desarrollo de modelos predictivos, procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de datos e industrialización de soluciones de Machine Learning en entornos productivos. La persona seleccionada participará en el diseño, desarrollo y optimización de pipelines de datos y modelos, garantizando su escalabilidad, eficiencia y mantenibilidad. Funciones principales Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar soluciones de Machine Learning sobre Google Cloud Platform. Trabajar con Vertex AI para la creación de pipelines, gestión del ciclo de vida de los modelos, Model Registry, Workbench y despliegues en producción. Desarrollar código avanzado en Python siguiendo buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software, modularidad, desacoplamiento y testing. Diseñar y entrenar modelos predictivos con algoritmos como LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost u otros similares. Procesar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos, trabajando con datasets de millones de registros. Construir y mantener pipelines automatizados de entrenamiento e inferencia, optimizando los procesos ETL/ELT. Industrializar modelos mediante prácticas MLOps, incluyendo versionado, reproducibilidad, automatización y monitorización. Implementar procesos CI/CD y gestionar entornos de ejecución mediante Docker y herramientas como GitHub Actions o GitLab CI. Optimizar el rendimiento de consultas y procesos de datos utilizando BigQuery. Colaborar con equipos técnicos aplicando metodologías de desarrollo, revisiones de código y control de versiones. Requisitos imprescindibles Experiencia sólida y demostrable con Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , especialmente Vertex AI y BigQuery. Nivel avanzado de Python , con experiencia en desarrollo de código modular, testeable y preparado para ejecuciones concurrentes. Experiencia desarrollando modelos de Machine Learning con algoritmos como LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost o similares. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y optimizando tiempos de entrenamiento e inferencia. Experiencia en MLOps , llevando modelos desde entornos experimentales hasta producción. Conocimientos prácticos de Docker, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues. Experiencia construyendo pipelines de datos eficientes para procesos de entrenamiento e inferencia. Buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software: Git, testing automatizado, code reviews y gestión de dependencias. Requisitos valorables Experiencia en forecasting y series temporales, especialmente en previsión de demanda con un elevado número de productos o entidades. Conocimientos sobre estacionalidad, promociones, eventos y estrategias de cold-start para nuevos productos. Experiencia con arquitecturas modernas de Deep Learning para series temporales: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), TiDE, PatchTST, TimesFM, Chronos o Transformers. Conocimientos de IA Generativa, LLMOps, RAG, agentes, evaluación de modelos y observabilidad. Experiencia optimizando hiperparámetros con Optuna, Ray Tune o herramientas similares. Conocimientos de paralelización del entrenamiento, optimización de inferencia y reducción de costes computacionales.

items.desc: Revenue Operations Analyst (AI-Enabled GTM Builder) Are you the kind of RevOps analyst who gets frustrated when reports don’t reflect what’s really happening, CRM fields are unreliable, and teams recreate the same report five different ways? Do you enjoy building practical solutions—clean processes, reliable data, and AI-powered workflows—that help revenue teams work faster and with more confidence? At AIMMS, our optimization technology powers mission-critical decisions for global enterprises—from keeping energy grids stable to optimizing complex supply chains. As we scale, we’re investing heavily in operational excellence across Sales, Marketing, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success. We’ve already connected Salesforce, product usage data and other data sources around the business, and teams are actively experimenting with AI. Now we need someone to bring structure, standards, and measurable impact. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst who is hands-on, AI-native, and excited to own the day-to-day reality of our GTM stack—making it trustworthy, usable, and scalable. A Role You Can Shape This is a role with real ownership—not a back-office reporting position. You’ll build, improve and scale how our revenue organization works, partnering with teams across Sales, Marketing, Pre-Sales and Customer Success. What you’ll do Improve processes and workflows: Map how teams work and streamline lead routing, opportunity management, renewals and handovers, making ownership and next steps clear. Document and enable change: Create clear Confluence documentation and deliver training so new processes are easy to follow and changes stick. items.desc: Role Overview We are seeking a highly motivated Data Scientist with expertise in machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics to solve complex business problems across industries. The role involves collaborating with clients and cross-functional teams to develop, deploy, and scale data-driven solutions, ranging from traditional machine learning models to cutting-edge Generative AI and LLM applications. You will work on high-impact initiatives, contribute to R&D, and help organizations unlock value through data and AI. The candidate should be based out of Madrid and open to travel as per business requirements. What You Will Do Key Responsibilities Partner with clients and stakeholders to translate business challenges into analytical and AI-driven solutions. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, insights, and opportunities. Design, build, train, and evaluate machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI models. Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and LLM-based applications. Define model evaluation frameworks, conduct A/B testing, and monitor model performance and drift. Deploy data science solutions through APIs, batch pipelines, and cloud-based platforms. Optimize model inference performance, scalability, latency, and cost. Build accurate, explainable, and responsible AI solutions while minimizing bias and ensuring reliability. Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, product managers, and designers to integrate solutions into production systems. Present insights and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner. Contribute to internal innovation initiatives, research projects, and thought leadership activities. What You BringRequired Qualifications Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL . Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks and the Python data science ecosystem. Experience developing predictive, classification, optimization, and statistical models using structured and unstructured data. Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and model evaluation techniques. Experience with model deployment, monitoring, testing, and productionization. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Preferred Skills Experience with big data technologies such as PySpark, Hadoop, Hive , or similar frameworks. Familiarity with Databricks, Airflow, Kedro, Dask, RAPIDS , or comparable data engineering tools. Knowledge of cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes . Exposure to software engineering best practices and MLOps. Experience deploying AI and analytics solutions in enterprise environments. Consulting or client-facing project experience is highly desirable. Key Technologies Languages: Python, SQL ML & AI: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, LLMs, Generative AI, RAG Big Data: PySpark, Hadoop, Hive Data Platforms: Databricks, Airflow, Kedro Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP DevOps/MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD What We Offer Full-time, on-site position in the vibrant city of Madrid Opportunity to work on cutting-edge data science projects with significant business impact Structured, multi-round interview process designed to assess your skills comprehensively and provide you with insights into our organization Collaborative work environment fostering professional growth and innovation About the Company Our client is a leading organization in the professional services industry, known for its data-driven approach to solving complex business challenges. They are at the forefront of applying advanced analytics and AI technologies to deliver transformative insights to their global client. Job Types: Full-time, Contract Pay: 40,300.00€ - 80,300.00€ per year Education: Bachelor's (Preferred) Language: Spanish (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Madrid, Madrid provincia

items.desc: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our team. You’ll work on projects across the business, from building credit scoring models and improving fraud detection to optimizing field visit schedules and designing A/B tests for targeted user promotions. In this role, you’ll partner with product managers and business leaders to understand the problems they’re trying to solve and find practical ways to use data to improve outcomes. Our ideal candidate is product-minded, scrappy and thinks about data in terms of intuitive user behaviours rather than just inputs to a black box model. In this role you’ll; Be embedded closely with our product and operations teams. Generate insights using customer, merchant and internal data using statistical modelling, data visualization, and machine learning. Design, implement and analyze optimizations for our internal operations, user promos, and agent network to help teams scale and reduce costs. Build data-driven heuristics and machine-learning models to improve user and business outcomes. Take ownership of the analytics process - from project scoping and design to communicating findings to stakeholders. Key details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates. Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $130,600 - $236,200 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirements Education and Experience Minimum Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master's or PhD is a plus. 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or technical analytics roles. Technical Skills Deep expertise with Python, SQL, and data visualization tools Experience in one or more of the following: machine learning, causal inference, statistical modeling, or A/B testing. Experience applying these methods in operational settings with offline components (example: incentive structures for field staff) is a plus. Highly effective written communication and presentation skills A track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholder Fluency in English. French is a plus. You might be a good fit if you Have a bias for action and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive forward progress. Have worked in early stage product teams (or a rapidly scaling product) and are able to drive product decisions. Have excellent focus, prioritizing your research and work using an iterative approach (you know when a project is good enough to stop, and you rarely get lost in details). Are able to compellingly present your findings to technical and non-technical audiences and make proactive recommendations based on data. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. items.desc: AI Product Engineer (Full-stack) Vil du arbejde med AI, softwareudvikling og nogle af de mest spændende teknologier på markedet? Hos Cendo bygger vi AI voice agents til enterprise virksomheder og vores teknologi er allerede en del af hverdagen på mere end 200 lokationer. Nu søger vi dig, der vil være med til at bygge næste generation af vores produkter. Siden 2024 er vi vokset til en af Skandinaviens hurtigst voksende leverandører af AI voice agenter, med en stærk kundebase i bilbranchen. Gennem dybe integrationer til branchesystemer er vores AI agenter en integreret del af kundernes daglige drift og skaber værdi langt ud over selve telefonsamtalen. Vi er i dag et team på seks personer og søger vores syvende kollega, som vil få en central rolle i udviklingen og implementeringen af vores AI-løsninger. Som AI Product Engineer kommer du til at arbejde med både nye og eksisterende kunder samt videreudviklingen af vores egen platform. Rollen er primært fokuseret på softwareudvikling, herunder backend, integrationer og AI agenter, men indebærer også arbejde på tværs af vores teknologier. Du får ansvar for dine egne projekter og forventes at kunne arbejde selvstændigt, men vil samtidig have tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens founders og det øvrige team. Stillingen er på fuldtid med arbejdsplads i Københavnsområdet. Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt fra kontoret, men der er fleksibilitet til at arbejde hjemmefra efter aftale. Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver Udvikle og implementere AI voice agenter til nye kunder Udvikle backend-funktionalitet og integrationer til eksterne systemer Arbejde med telefoni, LLM'er og andre AI-teknologier Videreudvikle vores egen platform samt chatbot- og livechatløsninger Vedligeholde, optimere og videreudvikle eksisterende kundeløsninger Bidrage til den tekniske udvikling af nye produkter Hvem er du? Du har nogle års erfaring med softwareudvikling og et solidt teknisk fundament. Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og finde gode løsninger på tekniske udfordringer. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med Python, backend udvikling, API-integrationer og databaser samt er komfortabel med at arbejde på tværs af en full-stack-løsning. Vores teknologier omfatter blandt andet Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure, telefoni og RAG, men vi forventer ikke, at du har erfaring med dem alle på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt teknisk fundament, hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye systemer og har lyst til at arbejde med AI. Du er nysgerrig på ny teknologi og interesserer dig for, hvordan den kan bruges til at udvikle bedre produkter. Vi søger en kollega, som ikke kun løser de opgaver, der bliver stillet, men også har lyst til at bidrage med egne idéer og præge den tekniske udvikling. Du skal kunne flydende dansk. Hvis du kan norsk og svensk er det en fordel, da vi har kollegaer og kunder på alle tre markeder. Det tilbyder vi Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed i kraftig vækst med store internationale ambitioner Arbejde med de nyeste AI teknologier og udvikle løsninger, der allerede anvendes af mange store virksomheder Stor selvstændighed og ansvar for egne projekter Reel indflydelse på vores produkter og tekniske udvikling Fokuseret team med korte beslutningsveje og tæt samarbejde med stifterne Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og for at lære nye teknologier Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og løn efter kvalifikationer Sådan søger du Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send os dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning. Du er også velkommen til at vedlægge din GitHub-profil eller eksempler på projekter, du har arbejdet med. Vi vurderer ansøgninger og inviterer relevante kandidater til samtale løbende.

items.desc: Location : Amsterdam (hybrid) Employment type : full-time (40 h/week) Seniority level : Senior Consultant (corresponding to a minimum of 5 years of work experience) Visa sponsorship : possible only for candidates <30 years of age A little bit about us Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and has grown into a global team of consultants united by one mission: to help courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We integrate three service pillars - strategy & transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating AI products that Augment Intelligence. We are not a traditional consultancy. We work at C-level with blue-chip companies on the programmes that actually matter, and we are building our Technology Risk practice at exactly the moment the market needs it most. Your role as Applied AI Specialist You'll be an AI Business Specialist in our consulting practice, working hands-on inside the Applied AI consulting team. The person who walks into a client's finance, ops, CX or sales function, understands how the work actually gets done today, and helps redesign it around AI primitives - skills, memory, plugins, connectors, harnesses, agents. You sit at the intersection of business, product, and technology, but you lead with the build. You're a builder first – typically from an engineering, science or technical product background – who has moved, or is moving, into client-facing, product-minded work. Think of it as roughly 60% forward-deployed engineer, 40% strategist. You prototype your own solutions using AI-assisted coding tools and no-code platforms - wiring up connectors, drafting specifications, and testing what works before handing it to engineering to harden. The job is translating between what a customer actually needs and what the AI system has to look like to deliver it. This is partly an AI engineering role, but not one about running high-traffic, mission-critical systems at scale. For this reason, an engineering background is highly preferred but not a must. It is also not a strategy slide-deck role. And it is not a team-management role. Your job is to bring deep specialist craft and ship things, not to run people. What you’ll do Four core mandates, roughly equal weight in year one. Implement AI for clients. Lead Applied AI workstreams on flagship engagements with major European retailers and financial services clients. You'll run discovery, help design the AI Operating System for the function in scope, and ship the first wave of skills, agents and integrations alongside the client team, often turning what you heard in discovery into a working prototype or proposal within a day or two. Outcomes - measurable productivity uplift, redesigned workflows - not slide decks that die in PowerPoint. Implement AI internally at Riverflex. We eat our own cooking. Our internal AI capability platform, our delivery process, the way we run the firm - you'll help redesign our ways of working around AI and ship the building blocks. This is also where most of our reusable IP gets created, and where you'll build your own muscle on the tools before deploying them at clients. Lift the craft of our Applied AI consulting team through your specialist expertise. You're the specialist plugged into client engagements, internal labs and capability sessions. You bring patterns, skills and shipped examples; you coach colleagues through real work; you contribute what you build into our reusable library. The team's craft level rises because you're in it – and you'll sharpen your own consulting craft working alongside our senior consultants. Help build our AI coaching and change propositions. We have new propositions launching across AI coaching, team-building in the era of AI, and AI-native operating models. You'll be hands-on in the productisation: building materials, running early engagements, and feeding learnings back into the offer. The thesis is that 90% of AI value sits in workflow integration - you're part of how we prove it on the ground. Who you are 5+ years of hands-on experience in engineering, data/science, technical product or another builder role, of which at least 2 in AI. An AI engineering background is a plus, not a must. We're equally open to candidates from a strategy or product background who have become substantially more hands-on in building over recent years. Client-facing experience embedded in a business context – consulting, solutions, forward-deployed or customer-facing product work. Formal consulting experience isn't required, but exposure to structured settings beyond early-stage startups is. Demonstrated ability to walk into a function, model how work gets done today, and redesign it. Hands-on experience developing and deploying applications with Claude Code, Copilot, OpenAI, Gemini, or other AI-powered IDEs. You have a solid understanding of "HOW" things are built and distributed to real users. Side and personal projects count …

GENERAL PRIVACY POLICY FOR USERS THAT APPLY FOR A WORK POSITION
This page describes the methods for managing the In-Recruiting portal with respect to the handling of personal information of users that consult and use it in order to submit their job application. The information also concerns the method, time and nature of the information that the owners of the processing must supply to users when the latter are connected to the web pages, no matter what the purposes of the connection are.
The portal gathers CVs, personal information and data, possibly sensitive data, which users, in their capacity as interested persons, choose to supply when inserting or updating their spontaneous application for one of the work positions or for a collaboration offered by the consortium or by consortium members. This data can be directly uploaded on the portal or on some specific internal pages (e.g. lavora-con-noi, job opportunity, etc.) of the public web sites of the consortium, of consortium members, and on multiposting portals.
The computer systems and software procedures that oversee the functioning of this web site acquire, during the course of their normal operation, some personal data whose transmission is implicit in the use of Internet communication protocols. This is information that is not gathered in order for it to be associated to identified interested persons; however, because of its nature, it could allow the identification of users through elaborations and associations with data held by third persons. This category of data includes IP addresses or dominion names of the computers utilized by users who connect with the web site, the addresses in URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) notation of the requested resources, the time of the request, the method used for submitting the request to the server, the dimension of the file obtained in answer, the numeric code indicating the status of the answer given by the server (positive conclusion, error, etc.) and other parameters relevant to the operating system and to the computer environment of the user. This data is used with the sole purpose of obtaining anonymous statistical information about the use of the web site and of controlling its correct functioning, and it is immediately deleted after the processing. items.desc:
About this opportunity
 Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
The Excellerate track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across Sales, Commercial Management, Sourcing, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value. 
This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here . Your journey within the Early Career Program will start as a NMS Sourcing Business Partner . 
 What you will do
 You will join the NMS Sourcing Expert Unit, part of Ericsson’s Network & Managed Services (NMS) Sourcing organization. The team brings together expertise in network and managed services sourcing and works with business teams, suppliers and market areas to develop competitive, cost-effective and compliant sourcing solutions. 
The team combines strategic sourcing with practical problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration. In this graduate role, you will help explore how AI and data can simplify work, improve processes and support better sourcing decisions.
 Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across cost and spend analysis, productification, process improvement and management reporting. 
 Assess how AI can connect data, insights and workflows to streamline activities and improve sourcing decisions 
 Work with stakeholders across Ericsson to test and responsibly implement selected AI solutions. 
 Develop practical AI concepts, prototypes, agentic workflows and reusable playbooks that can be scaled across the organization 
 Support the development of AI competence within Sourcing communities through demonstration, knowledge sharing, and hands-on enablement. 
The skills you bring: 
 A practical interest in generative AI, AI agents, automation and digital product development. 
 Experience or academic exposure to data analysis, process improvement, prototyping, prompt design or translating business needs into digital solutions. 
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex or ambiguous problems. 
 Open-minded, with a willingness to consider new perspectives and approaches. 
 Structured and able to organize ideas, information and tasks effectively. 
 Curious and explorative, with an interest in testing new possibilities. 
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft Frontier Company is redefining how enterprises transform — bringing agentic AI, cloud-scale computing, data, simulation, and human expertise together so customers turn ambition into measurable business impact. As customers look to reinvent how work gets done — redesigning business processes, operating models, and human-agent ways of working across industries and functions — they need more than a platform. They need experts who can understand their business outcomes, reinvent new ways of working, and enable their employees to adopt that change at speed. 
 The AI Workforce Reinvention Architect will be the specialist on the ground with customers developing the new ways of working, deploying agents and AI to enable and reinforce those patterns, and empower customers to own the behavioral transformation as they evolve from AI experimentation to AI-native operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end operations reinvention with the end results being a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a one-off program. You will embed AI-first ways of working into culture, processes, and performance systems, working directly with business, technology and HR leaders, along with Microsoft account teams, industry specialists, and engineers. 
 This is a role for people who do the higher-judgment human work that technology can inform but not perform. You will help customer reimage how people and agents work together – while shaping repeatable patterns specific to industries and functions. If you’re energized by making change stick rather than launching programs that fade, this role is for you. 
 In this role you bring a unique blend of technical, industry, and change management expertise. Your edge is translating a customer’s business outcomes into a tangible operating model, powered by agents, with a clear path for adoption. Customers feel confident investing in frontier transformation because they see a viable plan for their teams to transform in parallel. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Workforce Reinvention 
 Define new ways of working and employee roles based on the customer’s industry, function, and business outcomes/KPIs 
 Design and deploy agents and AI systems that empower and scale employees and teams to execute 
 Deliver retraining programmes ensuring no employee is left behind 
 Embed AI adoption into performance evaluations and onboarding processes 
 Protect employee privacy to maintain trust and stay on the right side of regulations 
 Strategic Change Leadership 
 Design and execute comprehensive operating model changes powered by AI with enterprise scale, structured as a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a fixed, one-off sequence 
 Conduct AI/Agent readiness assessments to identify organisational barriers and enablers 
 Develop AI literacy plans that position AI and agents as new ways of working, not tools 
 Establish and lead AI Council and Champion networks to drive grassroots adoption through the informal networks of trusted peers 
 Adoption Programme Delivery 
 Implement a structured adoption framework powered by workplace adoption analytics and role-based enablement 
 Coordinate communications, training, and champion efforts across thousands of users 
 Drive behavioural change by creating recognition rather than pushing content at them 
 Scale training globally: live sessions, on-demand tutorials, internal support communities 
 Stakeholder Engagement 
 Facilitate business and technology leadership workshops and roundtables to design for required impact and scale 
 Ensure cross-functional collaboration across IT, HR, operations, and business unit leadership on how work will change and their hands-on role 
 Build trust through responsible experimentation and transparent communication 
 Monitor usage statistics and qualitative feedback, adjusting programmes to maintain momentum, and measure success by whether change persists at 90, 180, and 360 days 
 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications 
 Master's OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND several years of experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR equivalent experience. 
 Solid experience in managing multiple projects or portfolios. 
 E xperience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams. 
 Additional or preferred qualifications 
 Solid experience in managing cross-functional teams 
 Demonstrated success leading change programmes across 5,000+ user populations 
 Experience with AI/ML adoption programmes or …

items.desc: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. About the Team The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce’s own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams. Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do. Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings. Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent. Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents. Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering. What it’s like to start here: You’ll join a team that is rebuilding how it works, and you’ll help shape it. You’ll work in real production, on real incidents, with people who will teach you. You’ll start with well-scoped work: triaging cases, investigating failures, following and improving runbooks, and building monitors and automations. As you grow, you’ll own root-cause analysis and a piece of platform reliability. We write down what we learn, and we favor automation over manual effort. Who thrives here: You’re curious, you like finding out why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people. We’ll teach you the platforms and the operating practices. As a Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you’ll independently run day-to-day production support and administration for Salesforce’s enterprise data and analytics platforms, working from established runbooks. You’ll own your case backlog, respond quickly and keep requesters informed, escalate with clear context, and help keep our support documentation accurate. You’ll grow toward owning escalations, root-cause analysis, and platform reliability. What You'll Actually Be Doing Frontline Case, Alert & Escalation Management Working with regional peers and leads , be among the first to respond to key signals and hand-raises from customers, agents, and alerts. Start investigations, open issues, and help triage. Be a frontline responder when an incident starts: connect first, gather evidence and impact, and swarm with the team alongside Incident Command. Follow the runbook to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) when needed. SREs own incident resolution. Provide Tier-2 production support: ticket triage, case management, and keeping backlog health. You are measured on the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART). Support case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS) by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and closing the loop on every case. Escalate cleanly on cases, intake, investigations, and gaps in SOPs: hand off to the right team with the evidence, impact, and steps already taken, and follow the escalation paths and time-zone handoffs in the runbooks. Growing toward owning escalations independently. Platform Administration & Operations Handle user provisioning, role hierarchy, and access management requests. Troubleshoot declarative configuration, validation errors, and data discrepancies. Execute scheduled data updates, bulk data loads and migrations, and basic sandbox maintenance. Deliver moderate declarative solutions (for example Flows and validation rules) and platform enhancements. Problem Management & Reliability Contribute to RCAs, growing toward owning RCA and resolution for application bugs. Help build and tune monitors, alerts, and automations. Flag technical debt and recommend fixes. Process, Documentation & Playbooks Follow and improve lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs), using team templates. Flag gaps and stale content, and draft updates from what you learn on cases. Write knowledge articles and process maps so Tier-1/Tier-2 teams can reuse what you learn. …

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION Keen to have a front-row seat to global equity markets, risk and trading activity? As an Associate in Equities Market Risk, you'll work alongside trading businesses to understand, challenge, and manage market risks across a wide range of equity products. You'll develop deep market expertise, build advanced analytical skills, and help shape the decisions that influence risk-taking across one of the world's leading financial institutions. This is a unique opportunity to combine financial markets, quantitative analysis, data, and technology. Sitting close to trading activity while maintaining independent oversight, you'll play a key role in ensuring risks are understood, controlled, and effectively communicated. Being part of the Equities Market Risk team, you will help identify, assess, and challenge market risks across a broad range of equity products. Working closely with trading businesses, you will provide independent risk oversight, deliver risk insights to stakeholders, and contribute to risk-based decision making. You will participate in scenario analysis, stress testing, and risk reporting while helping enhance risk management tools, analytics, and processes. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in financial markets, quantitative risk analysis, and emerging technologies that support the evolution of risk management. Job responsibilities Provide independent oversight of market risk across equity trading activities. Monitor and assess potential losses arising from movements in equity prices, volatility, correlation, and other market risk factors. Transform complex risk analysis into clear, actionable insights that support business and senior management decision-making. Partner closely with trading desks, providing constructive challenge while maintaining a strong control framework. Lead scenario analysis and stress testing to evaluate the impact of market shocks and identify potential vulnerabilities. Assess tail-risk exposures and emerging market trends to help ensure trading activities remain within approved risk appetite and limits. Contribute to the design and enhancement of risk management frameworks, analytics, and reporting. Build and improve next-generation risk tools using automation, machine learning, data science, and AI technologies. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Strong quantitative skills with confidence working analytically with numbers, models, and complex problems. Demonstrated interest in financial markets and risk management, with a willingness to learn market risk concepts and traded products. Ability to identify process improvements and contribute ideas to enhance existing practices. Ability to manage priorities independently and deliver high-quality results. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Ability to use coding tools for analysis and automation, including working with datasets, building repeatable workflows or tools, and producing clear, auditable outputs. Experience building or meaningfully experimenting with large language model-based solutions, including agentic workflows, with the ability to evaluate outputs critically and apply appropriate controls and judgment. Knowledge of Market Risk and /or Equities products ABOUT US J.P. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. items.card: The role We are hiring a data scientist who ships: someone who takes NLP and LLM work from experiment to production, and owns it there. You will shape how Omniscient reads the world: how large volumes of multilingual signals are cleaned, classified, scored and enriched, and how our agents turn them into analysis an executive can act on. The role sits where research, product and engineering meet. The role is broad by
items.desc: About us Omniscient delivers real-time intelligence that helps organisations and leaders make better decisions, faster. Our platform brings together public and internal data to help corporates, investors and public institutions detect risks, understand shifts in their environment and act with greater confidence. Combining intuitive dashboards with AI-powered analysis, Omniscient turns complex, fast-moving signals into clear, actionable intelligence, from reputation monitoring and geopolitical developments to competitive positioning and narrative change. We help decision-makers track what matters across their ecosystem, benchmark against peers, and stay ahead of emerging threats and opportunities. The role We are hiring a data scientist who ships: someone who takes NLP and LLM work from experiment to production, and owns it there. You will shape how Omniscient reads the world: how large volumes of multilingual signals are cleaned, classified, scored and enriched, and how our agents turn them into analysis an executive can act on. The role sits where research, product and engineering meet. The role is broad by design. Models, agents and data are the core, but a large share of the work is the full-stack and infrastructure that bring them to our users. We are a small team: when the fire is elsewhere, you go there. We need someone who builds reliably, thinks in systems, uses coding agents effectively, and helps the team ship faster without compromising quality. What you will do Product mindset. Understand what an executive or an analyst does with what the models produce. Turn a business need into a task you can measure. Own part of the PO or PM duties on the AI side. Models and scoring. Classification, sentiment, entity recognition and resolution, topic extraction, summarisation, translation and risk scoring, on multilingual text and increasingly on images and video. Pick the right approach for each job: prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings or classic ML. Agents. Design and improve our multi-agent layer: tools, context, orchestration. Connect new data sources and tools to the agents, including through MCP. Retrieval. Embeddings, chunking, indexing and retrieval quality. Give the agents context they can actually use. Evaluation. Build evaluation sets and harnesses. Measure quality, drift, hallucination and cost per call. We want to get to the point where nothing ships without a number, and you will lead that. Data. Explore, clean and label large, messy text datasets. Deduplicate, normalise, find the gaps. Work hand in hand with data engineering on pipelines and data quality. Full-stack development. Own the UX, the back end and all the supporting infrastructure that bring an agent or a model to life for our users. Research. Follow the literature, run experiments, write them up so the team can build on them. Work with academic partners when it helps. Cost. LLM spend is a first-class design constraint: the right model for each job, caching, batching, distillation. Production. Ship models and agents as services (C# and Python), monitor them, own them. You build it, you run it. You take your turn on call. Productivity. Use coding agents wisely. Write skills and routines. Automate what can be automated. Constantly strive to increase the productivity of the team. What we look for Applied NLP and ML. Strong fundamentals, with hands-on experience of modern LLM-based approaches: transformers, embeddings, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval-augmented workflows. Python and SQL. You write production code, not only notebooks, and a statically typed language does not scare you. Shipped and lived with it. At least one model or LLM feature taken into production and maintained afterwards. Research depth, a real plus. A PhD or research experience in NLP, machine learning, computational linguistics or applied mathematics, as long as you want to ship. A builder at heart. You have a genuine passion for shipping slick products. Here, that means crafting a new form of executive intelligence. Agentic development. items.desc: Explorez le potentiel des agents d’IA au service du développement logiciel Nous recherchons un ou une AI Engineer Platform & Agent pour conduire une étude de faisabilité et des explorations techniques autour de l’ Agentic SDLC : l’utilisation d’agents d’intelligence artificielle pour accompagner les différentes étapes du cycle de développement logiciel. À l’intersection du Software Engineering, du Platform Engineering et de l’IA générative, vous aurez pour mission d’expérimenter des approches, d’en évaluer les possibilités et les limites, puis de formuler des recommandations étayées. Votre objectif : transformer des hypothèses techniques en résultats concrets pour éclairer les décisions d’architecture et les prochaines étapes du projet. Vos missions Conduire les études de faisabilité. Analyser les cas d’usage envisagés, identifier les prérequis et les contraintes, challenger les hypothèses techniques et définir les critères permettant d’évaluer la pertinence des solutions. Explorer et prototyper des solutions d’IA générative et agentique. Concevoir des démonstrateurs et des preuves de concept, principalement en Python, pour tester les approches retenues et leur articulation avec les outils et processus de développement logiciel. Évaluer les architectures et leur intégration à la plateforme. Examiner les services cloud et les composants mobilisables, idéalement dans un environnement AWS avec Bedrock et Bedrock AgentCore. Analyser les conditions d’intégration ainsi que les enjeux de sécurité, d’observabilité, de performance et de coût. Produire des recommandations factuelles. Comparer les options à partir des expérimentations, documenter les résultats et les limites observées, puis proposer des orientations argumentées : poursuite, ajustement ou abandon d’une approche. Documenter et partager les conclusions. Rédiger la documentation technique, préparer les supports de décision et animer des ateliers ou des restitutions, notamment en anglais, auprès des parties prenantes. Vous disposez de 4 à 12 ans d’expérience , avec une expérience significative en Software Engineering ou Platform Engineering . Vous savez concevoir des solutions logicielles et comprendre leur intégration dans un environnement technique plus large. Vous savez conduire une investigation technique avec méthode : formuler des hypothèses, définir des tests, analyser les résultats et distinguer ce qui est démontré de ce qui reste à valider. Vous êtes à l’aise pour questionner une orientation et défendre une recommandation sur la base de faits. Vous parlez et écrivez couramment français et anglais . Vous êtes capable de rédiger de la documentation technique et d’animer des ateliers ou des restitutions en anglais . Ce qui fera la différence Votre curiosité technique s’accompagne de rigueur et de pragmatisme. Vous appréciez les sujets exploratoires, savez avancer dans un contexte où toutes les réponses ne sont pas encore établies et rendez vos conclusions compréhensibles et utiles à la décision. Vous souhaitez mettre votre expérience d’ingénierie au service de cas d’usage concrets d’IA agentique ? Parlons de vos réalisations et de votre approche de l’expérimentation.

items.desc: Location: remote, in a time zone that overlaps CET working hours. About us IOMETE is the sovereign data platform for the AI era. Enterprises run our data lakehouse, built on Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, in their own trusted environment: on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid. It is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare and government. Customer data never leaves the customer's trust perimeter, and the AI we build on it stays inside that perimeter too. Position overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our team. We tackle a variety of exciting challenges, from connecting AI tools and models to the lakehouse to diagnosing Spark applications and troubleshooting failures. You'll build agents that run inside the customer's environment, on LLMs the customer provides or, later, on custom models we train for Spark tuning and troubleshooting. You'll also build the framework that defines those agents and the harness that runs, limits, traces and evaluates them. The AI team We are building the AI platform for the lakehouse — Lakehouse Intelligence. The team's roadmap includes, but is not limited to, the MCP Server for AI Agents, which lets AI tools query the lakehouse; the Model Gateway, through which IOMETE's AI features call models; agents for Spark application diagnosis, troubleshooting and onboarding; and SQL AI Functions, which run language models from inside a query. Down the road, you'll also get to fine-tune and build custom models for our platform's specific needs, small enough to run inside a customer's deployment. What you'll do Contribute to and maintain IOMETE's AI services, including the MCP Server for AI Agents, the Model Gateway, SQL AI Functions, and lakehouse-specific agents (such as Spark Application Diagnosis) and their harness. Build AI enablers: extend the IOMETE lakehouse and platform to support more AI-powered features, for example by making Spark job logs, query history and table metadata available to them. Be hands-on with Kubernetes, including the Helm charts that ship our AI services into each customer's deployment. Collaborate closely with external customer engineering teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues and provide guidance for successful adoption of our platform. Participate in design discussions about agents, model access, evaluation, and overall systems architecture. Write the tests, docs and release notes for what you build. A feature is done when it has shipped with all of them. Review your teammates' work and provide feedback. What we're looking for 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering (we’re open to exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate deep systems knowledge and impact). Deep understanding of LLM-based systems in production – tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation, and how they fail. Our AI features are written mostly in Python and Go. The data platform is built on the JVM, in Kotlin and Java, and new platform features are being built in Go. Production experience with any of these languages is a big plus, but we know strong engineers learn a new language fast. Familiarity with distributed systems and their challenges (e.g., data consistency, fault tolerance, scheduling). Fluency in English, both written and verbal — this role involves working with international customers and partners. Based in a time zone that overlaps Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST). Preferred qualifications Hands-on experience across the AI stack: agents and their evaluation, tool protocols such as MCP, model routing and serving, and fine-tuning. Prior exposure to data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, etc. Experience with Apache Spark (especially tuning Spark jobs), Apache Iceberg, or contributing to open-source compute engines. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm. What we offer Exciting projects and challenges. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. Ability to play a key role in shaping the direction, culture, and architecture of a young & growing engineering organization. Competitive compensation and stock options. Hiring process Introduction call — 30 mins max Technical conversation (with a challenge) — 90 mins Team interview — 60 mins Offer

items.desc: The Role: In this role you will work in the Platform team – a function for the deployment and evolution of the backend platform that underpins the core of the Xantura business. Key responsibilities: Own and advance a predictive modelling platform that scales across problem types and tenants, using it to design, implement, and iterate models (embedding-based sequence encoders, temporal survival models, gradient boosted decision trees) that predict key vulnerabilities in housing, health, and other social domains. Track developments in ML and frontier models, running structured experiments to bring promising techniques into production safely. Build robust evaluation pipelines, training datasets, and model infrastructure to support continuous improvement of natural language& predictive analytics. Ensure responsible AI deployment, embedding ethical and regulatory considerations into every stage of development. What are we looking for? Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field – or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of professional experience as an ML Engineer, or related role. Strong programming skills and production experience in Python. Experience building and maintaining data or ML pipelines with an orchestration tool such as Dagster (or Airflow, Prefect, etc.). Hands-on experience with common ML libraries and frameworks, e.g. PyTorch, scikit-learn, and gradient-boosting libraries such as XGBoost or LightGBM. Clear evidence of practical experience defining and deploying containerised systems, i.e.: Implementing APIs for internal services, e.g. via FastAPI; Deploying containerised systems to production, in particular via Kubernetes. In addition, the following would be an advantage: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with a strong publication record in text analytics, representation learning, or applied predictive modelling. Working with vector databases and developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines – experience setting up/configuring vector DBs, as well as using, would be advantageous; Finding and productionising recent AI models (e.g. via Huggingface (transformers), OpenAI APIs); Building agentic systems (e.g. via LangChain, AutoGen, PydanticAI). Evidence of participating in Open-Source Software (OSS) development, public hackathons, or other sharable coding samples. Deep expertise in embedding-based architectures, including bi-encoders, cross encoders, etc. for long-horizon text or temporal prediction tasks. Practical experience building and serving production-ready, asynchronous APIs for embedding and/or other compute-intensive services. Proficiency in Python for building high-performance data and model pipelines, with strong software engineering discipline (testing, versioning, CI/CD). Good familiarity with the Azure ecosystem (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Batch, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault). Location This is a hybrid role based in our office in London. You would be expected to be able to work from the office at least 1-2 days per week. About Xantura At Xantura, we’re on a mission to reduce societal inequality by helping local authorities use data more effectively. Our AI-driven platform empowers frontline workers with the insights they need to prevent complex issues like homelessness or children being taken into care — before they happen. We make this possible by connecting siloed datasets, applying advanced machine learning to enrich the data, and using predictive analytics to identify those most at risk. Our platform then distills this into clear, actionable insights that help frontline staff intervene early and make a real difference. It’s an exciting time to join Xantura. We’re scaling quickly, bringing on new clients, strengthening our platform, and expanding into new areas. While we’re a technology company at heart, our true focus is on improving lives — and we’re looking for people who share that vision.

Lieu : Toulon, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Nos équipes de l’activité Systèmes d’information critiques et cybersécurité fournissent des services et des solutions globales optimisant la performance, la résilience et la sécurité des systèmes d’information afin de faire face aux ruptures technologiques et aux cybermenaces. 
 QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? 
 Rejoindre Thales, c’est intégrer un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans les secteurs de la défense, de l’aérospatial, de la cybersécurité, du numérique et du transport. Fort de plus de 80 000 collaborateurs dans plus d’une cinquantaine de pays, le Groupe bénéficie d’une implantation internationale qui lui permet d’agir au plus près de ses clients. Il s’appuie sur l’expertise de ses collaborateurs pour concevoir des solutions et systèmes critiques, contribuant à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif.
 Thales est un acteur de premier plan dans la recherche, le développement et l’intégration de solutions d’IA spécialisées et poursuit son engagement stratégique à s’imposer comme le partenaire de référence en matière d’IA dans l’industrie sur le long terme. Dans cette dynamique, Thales renforce son ingénierie en IA appliquée aux systèmes navals de défense avec le développement d’une présence accrue à Toulon , au plus près de la Marine Nationale et d’autres acteurs majeurs de la défense navale.

 Ces projets se distinguent par leur forte complexité technique , leur exigence industrielle et l’utilisation de technologies innovantes dans des environnements sécurisés, normés et contraints.
