items.desc:
Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an Machine Learning Engineer has arisen within Airbus Helicopters (Albacete, Spain).
 WHY JOIN US? 
 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - 
 Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast. 
 Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 
 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. 
 ✨THE PROJECT: SHAPING THE FUTURE - Welcome to the Digital Campus , a pioneering ecosystem dedicated to industrial digitalization and innovation. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight. 
 Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. 
 About the Team & the Environment 
 You will join the Digital Innovation Team within Airbus Helicopters’ Transformation Department. Our mission is to bridge the gap between applied research and concrete business value, leveraging technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and Mixed Reality. While you will be the core representative of our Digital Innovation team in Albacete, you will work in a deeply integrated, international environment with our hubs in Marignane (France) and Donauwörth (Germany). Being physically located alongside the Albacete IT teams, you will act as a strategic bridge to ensure our AI innovations are robustly integrated and scaled into enterprise systems. 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help bridge the gap between our Data Science Proof of Value (PoVs) and enterprise-scale production. This is not an exploratory Data Science or pure modeling role. We are looking for a robust hands-on software and ML engineer who understands IT infrastructure, CI/CD, and how to scale AI solutions securely. You will leverage your technical expertise to collaborate with local IT teams, helping to design practical, scalable solutions for deploying AI projects (e.g., ML models, GenAI/chatbots). Alongside this cross-functional integration work, you will also provide hands-on platform support and tooling for our internal Data Scientists. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Industrialization & CI/CD: Collaborate with IT teams to define and implement best practices for transitioning ML models from PoV to production on OpenShift (On-Premise) and GCP. Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to ensure code quality and secure deployments. 
 GenAI & AI Integration: Implement the technical integration of AI solutions (such as chatbots, LLMs, or predictive APIs) into existing business applications. This includes managing complex data ingestion pipelines for RAG architectures, using search engines, and working with vector and graph databases. 
 Monitoring & Resource Optimization: Set up dashboards to monitor model health, API performance, and detect data drift. Optimize compute resources (CPU/GPU) to ensure cost-efficiency across our infrastructure. 
 Platform Support & "Starter Kits": Streamline the work of our Data Science team by creating standardized, ready-to-use templates (Docker/Git) for new PoVs, maintaining optimized environments, and resolving complex dependency issues. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a proactive technical liaison between the international Innovation team (prototyping) and the Albacete IT department (infrastructure). You will translate Data Science compute needs into IT architecture specifications and ensure our projects comply with strict cybersecurity standards. 
 Tech Stack You Will Use 
 Infrastructure: OpenShift AI (On-Premise) as a primary environment, with GCP for cloud deployments. 
 Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes. 
 Databases & Search: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Elasticsearch, and Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j). 
 Programming: Python (Advanced) and standard software engineering practices (OOP, APIs with FastAPI). 
 MLOps & CI/CD: MLflow, Git, GitLab CI/CD (or similar). 
 AI/Data Science Tools: Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, GenAI integration frameworks (LangChain, etc.), and monitoring tools (Grafana/Kibana). 
 Who You Are 
 Experience: 3 to 4+ years of full-time, post-graduate industry experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or Software Engineering. Please note: while we highly value internships, apprenticeships, and academic projects, this specific …

L’analyse d’images issues de la microscopie confocale et à champ large, en lien avec les marquages cellulaires et les zones de transduction. La participation à l’analyse de données transcriptomiques (bulk et single-cell RNA-seq) et de transcriptomique spatiale, en collaboration avec les plateformes et les équipes bioinformatiques. L’intégration des résultats d’imagerie et d’analyse génomique pour aider à cartographier les réseaux neuronaux modifiés suite à l’injection des vecteurs viraux. La documentation des analyses, la rédaction de protocoles, et la participation à la valorisation scientifique du projet (rapports, publications, présentations). Concevoir et développer des applications et outils logiciels dédiés à l'analyse d'images (interfaces utilisateur, plugins, scripts packagés), permettant aux biologistes de l'équipe d'exécuter les pipelines de façon autonome. L'Activité Prétraitement, segmentation et quantification d’images issues d’immunohistochimie et d’immunofluorescence sur tissu cérébral (modèles murins). Utilisation de logiciels tels que Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik, et outils de traitement par scripts personnalisés (Python ou R). Développement ou adaptation de workflows automatisés pour l’analyse d’images en grand volume (batch analysis), incluant la reconnaissance cellulaire, la mesure d’intensité et la cartographie des signaux. Contribution à l’analyse de données transcriptomiques et spatiales, en lien avec les résultats d’imagerie (compétences en visualisation, clustering, annotation cellulaire). Collaboration étroite avec les biologistes, virologues, et bioinformaticiens du laboratoire ainsi qu’avec la plateforme d’analyse de l’IGMM. Participation à l’interprétation biologique des données et à la formulation d’hypothèses sur les effets de la thérapie génique sur les circuits neuronaux. Documentation précise des workflows utilisés, mise en place de procédures reproductibles (versioning, traçabilité), et participation à la diffusion scientifique des résultats. Développement, test et maintenance d'applications d'analyse d'images (par ex. plugins Fiji/ImageJ, extensions QuPath, applications Python), incluant la gestion des versions (Git) et la rédaction de la documentation utilisateur. Votre Profil Compétences Formation et expérience Niveau de formation requis : Licence (bac+3) avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en analyse d'images biologiques. Maîtrise des outils d’analyse d’images (Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik…). Connaissances de base en programmation scientifique (Python, R). Capacité à gérer des workflows analytiques et à produire des rapports clairs et reproductibles. Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique, à l’oral et à l’écrit Compétences attendues : Compétences techniques Maîtrise des outils d’analyse d’images microscopiques : Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik. Compréhension des principes de microscopie fluorescence et confocale ; capacité à dialoguer avec des spécialistes de l’imagerie. Expérience dans le développement ou l’adaptation de workflows d’analyse semi-automatisés. Connaissances de base en programmation scientifique : Python ou R (ex. : gestion d’images, traitement de fichiers, visualisation de données). Une première exposition à l’analyse de données de transcriptomique (bulk/single-cell) ou spatiale est un atout. Capacité à produire une documentation technique claire, à assurer la traçabilité et la reproductibilité des analyses. Expérience en développement d'applications ou d'outils logiciels pour l'analyse d'images biologiques, de la conception à la mise à disposition des utilisateurs. Compétences transversales Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et autonomie dans la gestion de tâches techniques. Curiosité scientifique et volonté d’apprendre des outils et méthodes variés. Bon relationnel et aptitude à travailler en interface avec des biologistes, bioinformaticiens, ingénieurs en imagerie et personnels de plateformes. Your impact Build and own emnify's lead enrichment infrastructure end-to-end: From signal sourcing through Clay, ZoomInfo, and first and second-party data providers, to clean, actionable data landing in Salesforce for the outbound team Drive pipeline coverage improvement : By deploying automated outbound workflows that surface the right accounts at the right time, connected across Salesforce, Amplemarket, and emnify's internal GTM platform Develop AI agents : Using Claude and Clay that automate research, qualification signals, and personalisation at scale — turning hours of manual SDR work into reliable, repeatable flows Own the integration layer between emnify's commercial stack : — Salesforce, n8n, Attention, Weflow, Amplemarket, Sales Navigator — so data flows cleanly and the revenue team spends time selling, not fixing Lead the build-out of emnify's company knowledge infrastructure : Working toward a machine-readable, agent-accessible source of truth that keeps commercial processes documented and up to date automatically What we expect A solid commercial foundation : You understand how leads move through a pipeline, what pipeline coverage actually means, why forecasting is hard in a consumption-based business, and why any of it matters for revenue Demonstrated experience building functioning enrichment flows : You have connected a CRM to data providers, built the logic, and shipped something that the sales team actually used Hands-on Clay experience : This is the core of the role and a genuine must-have; you should be able to walk us through a flow you have built in it Comfort with automation and integration tooling : n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable; once you have worked with one, the others follow An AI-native approach to your work: You reach for Claude, agents, and LLM-powered tooling as a default, not an experiment Experience in a B2B environment : You understand the sales motion, the stakeholder dynamics, and why GTM tooling decisions have commercial consequences Confident enough to push back when a requested solution is the wrong one, and grounded enough to do it without making it a confrontation Coachability — we want someone who is excited to grow with us Your First 6 Months In your first few weeks, you will get hands-on with emnify's existing stack — Salesforce, n8n, Amplemarket, Attention, Clay — understand what has been built, where the gaps are, and where the biggest leverage sits for the outbound team. You will be spending time with the sales team to understand the commercial model, the ICP, and what good enrichment actually looks like for an IoT connectivity sale. By month two or three, you will have shipped your first meaningful enrichment flow end-to-end — connecting signal sources to Salesforce, improving data quality for outbound, and showing measurable improvement in pipeline coverage. You will also have a clear view of where AI agents can start replacing manual steps in the research and qualification process. By the halfway mark, you will own the enrichment and automation layer with real autonomy, be iterating based on what is working in the market, and have begun scoping emnify's company knowledge infrastructure — laying the groundwork for a system that keeps GTM processes accessible and up to date without constant manual upkeep. Why emnify emnify operates on a consumption-based model in a market — global IoT connectivity — that is still in its early innings of enterprise adoption, which means the GTM challenge here is genuinely complex and genuinely interesting. The company is profitable and growing, which gives you a stable platform to build from rather than a runway that is quietly ticking down. The go-to-market AI and automation infrastructure is still greenfield: a lot of the foundational work is yet to be done, which means real creative latitude and real visibility. You will be joining an experienced commercial team that is deeply bought into building this capability — leadership has done it before and knows what good looks like — and you will be part of a Berlin hub where you can collaborate in person rather than building in isolation. items.desc: We are a bank that develops innovative solutions. How we build them is changing: AI tools and agents now do much of the construction, and the scarce skill is framing the problem precisely, specifying the solution, directing the tools, and owning the result. We're looking for a Product Engineer to join our Technology, Product and Innovation division. You'll be an analytical thinker with an engineering mindset who turns ambiguous business problems into working, production-ready solutions. You'll do it largely by writing clear specifications and context that AI development tools execute against, within our internal AI development frameworks. You'll work mostly independently, taking problems from first question to production, and draw on a small group of experts when you need them. This is a fully on-site role based at our Athens office. A background in software engineering is essential, as this role is about specifying product features precisely, directing AI to build them, and taking accountability for what ships. What you will do Take a business problem from vague to precise: ask the right questions, uncover the real need, map the process, data and rules involved, and define what “done” looks like. Write clear, structured specifications (requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria, edge cases and failure scenarios) that AI tools and agents can execute reliably. Direct AI tools through prototyping, building, testing and documenting, and iterate quickly from idea to working proof. Validate outcomes rather than code: define test scenarios up front, confirm the solution behaves correctly against them, and recognize when results don't match intent. Anticipate the exceptions: unusual data, failure modes, integration issues and regulatory edge cases that the happy path never covers. Know when to escalate. Bring in security, architecture, platform or domain experts at the right moment instead of working around gaps. Take solutions through to production and keep improving them using real usage, data and feedback. Present your work with confidence: explain solutions, trade-offs and results to colleagues, senior stakeholders and wider audiences, in meetings, demos and internal forums. Work within our internal AI development frameworks, standards and guardrails, applying them consistently and feeding back what you learn so they improve. Collaborate closely with a small number of experts across product, risk, operations and engineering, while driving execution yourself. Adapt as priorities shift: pick up new projects, join new teams and hand over your work cleanly, with documentation others can build on, as projects change and team members rotate. Requirements What we are looking for Essential A university degree in engineering. You understand how systems, data and integrations fit together and can reason about how they fail. Strong command of C# and .NET, plus solid SQL and data modelling. A firm grasp of system design: APIs, distributed systems, concurrency and security fundamentals. Testing discipline, CI/CD, and experience running systems in production, including observability and incident handling. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents, and a clear view of where they go wrong. Fluency in English, written and spoken. Excellent presentation and public speaking skills, with the confidence to present to groups and senior audiences. Strong social and interpersonal skills. You build relationships quickly and communicate comfortably with technical and non-technical colleagues alike. A track record of delivering complex solutions or projects from concept to production, in any technical or analytical setting. Thinking Strong analytical and structured-thinking skills. You break down ambiguous problems, test assumptions and make pragmatic decisions. Excellent written communication. You can express intent, logic and constraints precisely enough that someone, or something, else can execute them. Sound judgment on risk, quality and trade-offs, and the instinct to spot what's missing or wrong in a solution. Working style Evidence of working with AI tools or agentic workflows, and the ability to learn and operate quickly within a defined framework and its controls. High ownership and autonomy. You drive execution end to end without close direction. Strong teamwork. You work well with a few experts at a time, share knowledge openly and put the team's outcome ahead of individual credit. Agility. You're comfortable when requirements start incomplete, projects change direction and teams rotate, and you get productive quickly with new colleagues and new problems. Curiosity about how AI is changing the way work gets done, balanced by discipline in following the framework. Nice to have: experience in banking, payments or other regulated environments; experience with data, integrations or process automation; prototypes or projects you built that went somewhere. How we work AI is how we build, not what we do. We are a bank, and we use …

Design, build, and operate scalable platform infrastructure and automation that supports agentic AI development. With 25 years’ experience since our foundation in Norway, we’re already #1 in the Nordics; growing rapidly in the UK and we are already seeing some great success in the Netherlands since opening the entity in mid-2024, but our ambition is to become the clear European market-leader in the coming years Why we’re proud Recognised as an Innovation and Growth Leader in the 2025 EMEA Customer Experience Platforms Frost Radar 2024 CX Awards Winner, ‘Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform’ Puzzel was recognised as the 'most innovative European-founded CCaaS provider' and top 3 globally by Frost & Sullivan in 2023 Best Practices Company of the Year 2023 Consistently high Glassdoor rating Puzzel places high importance on work-life balance and flexible working hours - as recognised by Flexa, placing 16th overall for work:life balance in 2025! We are working with Mercer on salary benchmarking, to ensure pay equality and market competitiveness Read more about us here . What you'll do Puzzel is investing in its security function. This role owns the security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate, and owns infrastructure vulnerability management across the company. This role focuses on designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving security controls that protect our product. This role reports to the CISO. What you will own The security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate: network segmentation, firewall policy, system hardening and patching. Infrastructure vulnerability management end to end — scope, triage, remediation tracking and closure. Tenable is one of the tools you will use; owning the outcome matters more than owning the tool. Threat modelling and secure design input for infrastructure change, offered as support rather than imposed as a gate. What you must be able to do The following capabilities are essential in this role, and we will explore all at interview. Threat hunting Threat modelling Vulnerability management Networking We are looking for judgement, not tool administration. Running a scanner is the easy part of this job. The must haves Hands-on infrastructure security in private data centre environment Hands-on cloud security experience in Azure, AWS or both Deep network security expertise: Firewall, VLANs, segmentation, WAF, TLS/mTLS, VPN, workload and configuration security, and system hardening. Virtualisation platforms - VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix or similar. Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration. Application security testing and OWASP or similar frameworks. SOC and SIEM or any infrastructure security monitoring platforms. Cloud security posture management tooling. Vulnerability scanning tools, SAST, DAST and SCA (including, Tenable, Snyk or similar tools). Experience turning scanner and dependency findings into prioritized, tracked and closed work. The nice to haves Terraform, Bicep or similar tools for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Proficiency in programming languages, such as, .NET, Python, Ruby. items.desc: Penetration Tester / Red Teamer About the Company The company is developing autonomous offensive-security agents designed to identify vulnerabilities and demonstrate how they can be exploited. Its mission is to bring together security research and engineering to transform how organisations test and secure their systems. The team combines practical offensive-security expertise with the development of AI-powered tools that can discover, validate and reproduce security vulnerabilities. About the Role The company is looking for a hands-on Penetration Tester / Red Teamer to conduct and support security testing in customer environments, validate findings identified by its AI agents, and help improve its product and research capabilities. This is a mid-level position for someone who enjoys practical offensive-security work and wants to take on more responsibility while working alongside experienced security researchers and engineers. You will investigate real vulnerabilities, test their exploitability and determine whether findings represent genuine, reproducible security issues. Practical ability is valued more highly than certifications. Key Responsibilities Conduct penetration tests across customer applications, APIs and infrastructure, with support on more complex engagements. Support red-team exercises by investigating attack paths, testing weaknesses and contributing to exploitation. Manually validate findings generated by AI agents, distinguishing reproducible vulnerabilities from false positives. Develop clear proof-of-concept exploits demonstrating exploitability, realistic impact and the conditions required for an attack. Produce concise technical reports containing evidence and practical remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineers to improve agent behaviour, testing coverage and the quality of findings. Turn discoveries into scripts, repeatable test cases and research inputs. Work carefully within agreed testing scopes, communicate clearly and exercise sound judgement when working in customer environments. Requirements Hands-on experience in penetration testing, an internal offensive-security team or substantial bug-bounty research. A solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and the ability to exploit them manually, including access-control issues, authentication weaknesses and injection vulnerabilities. Confidence testing web applications and APIs, alongside experience with infrastructure or cloud environments. Familiarity with tools such as Burp Suite and Nmap, including the ability to assess and challenge their results. Ability to write or adapt Python scripts to automate tasks and support security testing. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain findings, reproduce vulnerabilities and demonstrate their impact. Curiosity, persistence and a willingness to seek help when an unfamiliar problem requires a different approach. Desirable Experience Experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous: Active Directory. Privilege escalation. Cloud security. Adversary emulation. Exploit development. Public security research, useful tooling or technical write-ups. Candidates do not need experience in every area to apply. Certifications and AI Experience Certifications such as OSCP are welcome but not mandatory. The company is more interested in how candidates investigate targets, reason through vulnerabilities and demonstrate their impact. Previous AI experience is not required. An interest in how autonomous agents can support offensive-security work is welcomed. What the Company Offers The opportunity to influence the development of an AI-powered security product directly through practical testing. Close collaboration with engineers building autonomous security agents. Exposure to real customer environments and deeper technical investigations. Opportunities to develop offensive-security skills alongside experienced colleagues. Meaningful responsibility within a small team, with the opportunity to help shape the future of automated security testing. Pay: £60,000.00-£75,000.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je mee aan AI-toepassingen die organisaties dagelijks gebruiken. Je hebt je eerste ervaring met AI opgedaan en wilt verder groeien in Generative AI en agentic AI. Samen met ervaren collega's ontwikkel je bijvoorbeeld een kennisassistent, een toepassing voor documentverwerking of een AI-agent die afgebakende taken uitvoert. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en verbetering. Je leert door te bouwen, feedback te vragen en jouw ervaringen met vakgenoten te delen. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Jij bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI kan, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar wat het daadwerkelijk oplevert. Samen met je team ontwikkel je betrouwbare en bruikbare AI-oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkelt toepassingen met behulp van Python, large language models (LLMs) en eigen databronnen. Daarbij werk je aan moderne oplossingen op het gebied van Generative AI, zoals RAG-toepassingen, én aan Agentic AI-oplossingen waarbij agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders. Gedurende het hele proces houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Je test antwoorden en agentgedrag, onderzoekt fouten en hallucinaties en houdt rekening met aspecten als privacy, beveiliging, prestaties en kosten. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de integratie van AI in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en draag je bij aan het succesvol in productie brengen van oplossingen. Ook na livegang blijf je betrokken en gebruik je gebruikersfeedback, resultaten en inzichten om oplossingen continu verder te verbeteren. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Vertalen van klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkeltaken; Het ontwikkelen van GenAI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen; Bouwen van RAG- en Agentic AI-toepassingen; Testen en verbeteren van antwoorden, agentgedrag en betrouwbaarheid; Het integreren van AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en processen; Monitoren, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van oplossingen na livegang. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan; Je werkt samen met ervaren AI Engineers die met je meedenken over code, ontwerp en verantwoorde AI; Jij komt terecht in een hechte community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat via communitydagen, workshops, open podia en intervisiesessies; Je verdiept je in GenAI, Agentic AI, MLOps en andere moderne AI-technologieën en leert hoe je deze betrouwbaar ontwikkelt, test en beheert; Je krijgt toegang tot inhouse trainingen op het gebied van AI, techniek, communicatie en leiderschap, afgestemd op jouw ambities; Ontwikkelt jouw consultancyvaardigheden en deelt actief kennis met collega's en klanten; Je werkt aan uitdagende opdrachten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland, waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan innovatie en betere besluitvorming; Groeit stap voor stap door als AI Engineer, specialist, lead engineer of richting thought leadership; Je werkt in een omgeving waar plezier en professionaliteit hand in hand gaan. items.desc: Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You’ll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny. You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable. Code Development (60%): · Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query · Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic · Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions. · Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports · Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published Research & experimentation (25%): · Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts · Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance · Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels · Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions. System integration (15%): · Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output · Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education · A PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field is required. · A background in Financial services domain is highly desirable. Experience and skills · Preferably at least 2 years of research or industry experience in relevant areas. Must Have: · Strong Python programming skills · Hands on in LLMs RAG implementation · Experience with at least one ML framework (scikit-learn, transformers, etc.) · Familiarity with data structures and algorithms · Git proficiency for collaborative development Highly valued: · Previous work with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar retrieval and agent orchestration frameworks, ideally in a compliance or audit context · Knowledge of multi agent workflow orchestration frameworks. · Experience with NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK, transformers) applied to structured extraction from regulatory or financial reporting documents · Understanding of information retrieval concepts (BM25, TF-IDF, relevance scoring) · Experience with React, Node.js or similar web frameworks · Knowledge of evaluation methodologies for ML systems · Track record of conducting application-driven AI research. · Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary and multi-partner research environments. · Understanding of NAV calculation methodology, fund accounting principles, or second-level control frameworks in asset management · Familiarity with CSSF or ESMA regulatory frameworks governing fund operations, pricing, and oversight obligations Language skills · Fluency in English both oral and written. · Other relevant languages are an asset. items.card: Your mission & challenges At NEURA Robotics, cognitive robots don't just execute commands. They perceive, reason, plan over long horizons, and act autonomously in the physical world. We're looking for an engineer who builds the systems that make that possible: the agent harnesses, planning loops, and orchestration layers that turn a language model into a reliable embodied agent. Agent architecture & harness design:
items.desc: Your mission & challenges At NEURA Robotics, cognitive robots don't just execute commands. They perceive, reason, plan over long horizons, and act autonomously in the physical world. We're looking for an engineer who builds the systems that make that possible: the agent harnesses, planning loops, and orchestration layers that turn a language model into a reliable embodied agent. Agent architecture & harness design: Design and build the core agent harness for our humanoid platform: the control loop, tool/skill interfaces, state and memory management, retries, and guardrails that keep long-running autonomous behavior reliable. Long-horizon planning & orchestration: Build systems that decompose high-level human intent into multi-step plans, orchestrate skills and sub-agents, track execution state, recover from errors, and escalate to human oversight when risk is high. Conversational AI for embodied interaction: Design the real-time voice stack: STT → LLM → TTS pipeline with robust turn-taking, barge-in handling, and addressee detection so the robot knows when it's being spoken to and responds naturally under real-world latency constraints. Backend & platform engineering: Build the production backend behind the agent: well-designed APIs and interfaces, distributed services connecting sub-agents to the main conversational agent, and edge-to-cloud deployment across the NEURA ecosystem. Evaluation & industrialization: Stand up evaluation harnesses and observability that measure whether agents actually complete tasks correctly, and drive promising prototypes through to industrialized, deployed systems. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with hardware/software teams and external partners to take agentic capabilities from concept to reliable end-to-end product. What We Can Look Forward To A strong Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent depth shown through shipped work. Demonstrated experience building production agent systems with measurable impact: agents that plan, use tools, maintain state, and run reliably over long horizons, rather than single-turn prompt work. Deep, hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration such as LangGraph, AgentCore, MCP, or custom orchestrators, and a clear sense of when to use an agent versus a deterministic workflow. Professional backend engineering experience: production services, API and interface design, distributed and microservice architectures, clean code, testing, and DevOps discipline. Cloud and edge-to-cloud experience, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and deploying and serving models and services in production. Strong grounding in LLMs, VLMs, and NLP. Excellent Python. Excellent English. German is a plus.

items.desc: Bouw mee aan een van de nieuwste AI-initiatieven van Technische Unie Technische Unie bouwt aan de dienstverlening van de toekomst voor klanten én medewerkers. Daarom zoeken we een AI Engineer die onderdeel wordt van een nieuw team en vanaf de start meebouwt aan slimme oplossingen met zichtbare impact op onze organisatie. Dit ga je doen Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met collega's uit sales, marketing, data en IT vertaal je commerciële kansen en klantbehoeften naar slimme AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden. Jouw team en impact Je stapt in een nieuw AI-team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Samen met collega's uit de business, data en IT bouw je aan AI-oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor collega's én klanten. Je krijgt veel ruimte om kansen zelf te ontdekken, processen slimmer te maken en ideeën om te zetten in toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Zo draag je zichtbaar bij aan de verdere groei van AI binnen Technische Unie. Wij bieden Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer (https://www.werkenbijtechnischeunie.nl/top-employer-2026/) bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals: Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie- én ATV-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen Variabele beloning en solide pensioenregeling Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings- en opleidingsaanbod Heb jij het in je? Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier. Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken. Met meer dan 2.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je? items.desc: xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business. Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it. Tasks We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems. You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response. What You’ll Own Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs. Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text. Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost. Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred. Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns. Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software. Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture. Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution. Requirements What Makes You a Great Fit You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python. You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline. You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations. You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred. You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate. You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success. You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents. You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software. You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence. You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding. Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems. You May Not Be a Great Fit If Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface. Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, …

items.desc: About Galtea Galtea is building the evaluation platform for AI teams. We help companies ship better AI, faster, by making it easy to test, evaluate, and monitor AI agents and LLM-powered products at scale. We're backed by top-tier investors and working with some of the most sophisticated AI teams in Europe, including major financial institutions and tech companies. We're a small, high-conviction team. Every hire matters. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, owning the technical relationship with our enterprise accounts from day one. You'll be the person who makes sure customers succeed. You'll onboard them, integrate their systems, understand their AI stack, and work directly with their engineering teams to get real value out of Galtea. You'll also build. When an account needs a metric that doesn't exist yet, a judge that doesn't hold up, or a simulator that doesn't behave like a real user, you open a pull request against our AI services and fix it. Reporting the gap is where the job starts. This is a role for someone who loves working with customers and loves getting their hands dirty technically. What you'll do — Own enterprise onboarding. Set up customers on the platform, guide them through their first evaluation runs, and help them integrate Galtea's SDK into their existing pipelines. — Be the technical point of contact for our enterprise accounts. Join customer calls, answer technical questions, debug issues, and build trust with their engineering teams. — Understand customer AI stacks. Learn how each customer is deploying their agents and LLMs, and advise on how to structure evaluations for their specific use cases. — Develop and improve our AI services. Custom metrics, LLM judges, conversation simulators, red-teaming scenarios. You build them for the account in front of you, then harden the ones that generalise so the next customer gets them for free. — Work AI-first on your own job. Coding agents, evaluation harnesses, generated test data, automated triage. One engineer covering four enterprise accounts only works if agents are doing the repetitive half, and we expect you to bring back the workflows that paid off so the rest of the team picks them up. — Bridge customers and product. Systematically capture customer feedback, reproduce issues, and communicate insights to the product team so we build the right things. Ship the fix yourself when it sits in your half of the stack. — Write internal documentation and playbooks. Help the team scale what you learn by creating repeatable processes for onboarding and support. — Collaborate with sales. Bring technical credibility into the room where deals get scoped and won. What we're looking for Must have — 2+ years of software/AI engineering or solutions engineering experience. — Strong Python skills. You can write scripts, read SDK code, and debug integrations comfortably. Your code is good enough to merge into a product other engineers maintain. — Deep understanding of the AI evaluation problem. You know why evaluating LLMs and AI agents is hard, and you have a point of view on how to do it well. — You already work with coding agents daily. You have opinions about where they earn their keep and where they waste your time. — Excellent communication. You can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Spanish and English. — Customer-first mindset. You take ownership of customer problems and don't drop balls. Nice to have — Experience at an enterprise SaaS company or AI/ML tooling company. — Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, or AI evaluation concepts. — You've built LLM-powered components that run in production: judges, agents, RAG pipelines, not just consumed them. — Experience working with large financial institutions or heavily regulated industries. What we offer — A foundational role in a fast-growing AI infrastructure company. — Direct exposure to the most sophisticated AI engineering teams in Europe. — Competitive salary + equity (ESOP). — Hybrid setup in Barcelona. — Paid AI tooling and model credits, and the expectation that you use them. — A small, high-ownership team where your work has real impact from day one.

Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Transfer Pricing Teams wirst du mit einer guten Mischung aus Weitsicht und einem Blick fürs Detail unseren Kunden dabei helfen, alle Belange der Verrechnungspreisgestaltung optimal zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Transfer Pricing Strategien, weshalb wir uns immer über deine innovativen Ideen freuen. Bring dich in unser interdisziplinäres Team ein, nutze die neuesten digitalen Tools und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns innovative Lösungen. items.desc: We are growing. And we are looking for talented people. At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent. We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives. As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams. We are looking for an AI Adoption & Change Management Specialist – Platform Expert ! Mission: Lead the adoption of AI and AI agents within Software Engineering teams, helping evolve their Ways of Working throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role translates technological opportunities into practical changes in team processes, responsibilities, and skills, supporting adoption and evaluating results. The ideal candidate should understand the main concepts of AI applied to software development and be familiar with the different stages of the SDLC. The technical implementation of platforms, agents, and integrations will be carried out in partnership with engineering and technology teams. Responsibilities Understand current Ways of Working and identify opportunities to integrate AI into software engineering processes. Define principles and practices with teams for working with AI throughout the SDLC. Facilitate workflow reviews, helping teams determine where AI can support their work and how to integrate these changes into their daily routines. Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, Testing, and Platform teams to prioritize opportunities and prepare pilot initiatives. Lead change management activities, including stakeholder analysis, communication, training, coaching, and champion engagement. Prepare leaders and teams for new ways of working, clarifying the impact on responsibilities, skills, and collaboration. Gather feedback from pilot initiatives, identify adoption challenges, and coordinate solutions with the relevant teams. Create reusable materials and practices, such as guidelines, reference workflows, and enablement plans. Define, together with the teams, how to monitor adoption, productivity, quality, and developer experience. Follow developments in AI and AI agents for software development and translate relevant advances into adoption opportunities. Track results and support continuous improvement based on quantitative metrics and team feedback. Requirements: Up to 15 years of experience in a relevant role for the service to be contracted. Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Solid experience in change management, organizational transformation, or technology adoption, ideally within engineering, IT, or software development environments. Functional understanding of the SDLC and key software engineering activities, from requirements and design to testing, security, and release. Conceptual knowledge of AI-assisted software development and AI agents, including their use cases, limitations, and implications for teams. Experience designing adoption, training, and communication initiatives, and supporting change after launch. Ability to facilitate workshops and discussions with diverse audiences, from developers and tech leads to managers and senior stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and adapt messages to different audiences. Ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and work effectively in a matrix organization. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with a problem-solving mindset. Results-oriented approach, with the ability to monitor metrics and combine quantitative data with team feedback. Commitment to the quality of deliverables. Ability to work collaboratively with global teams. Fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken. Experience working on strategic projects. Nice to have: Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Jira, and Confluence. Experience in Agile, DevOps, software engineering transformation, or developer experience initiatives. Experience creating communities of practice, champion networks, or training programs. Familiarity with security, quality, and governance practices applied to software development. Experience supporting organizational change in large, distributed, or international organizations. Knowledge of Spanish, both written and spoken. items.desc: Description The opportunity ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences. What You Will Do Work with data scientists and subject matter experts to understand project questions, available data and appropriate outputs. Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks. Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias. Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them. Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts. Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing. What You Will Bring Hands-on experience applying data science through a project, research, internship or commercial work. Experience using Python gained through employment, an internship, research or substantial personal or academic projects. A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation. Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices. Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field. Useful Additional Experience Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation. Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required. Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience. What You Can Expect You will learn from colleagues with a range of technical and subject expertise while contributing to complex, varied projects. We will support your career development through ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to deepen both your data science and consulting skills. As your experience grows, you will take on more responsibility in shaping and delivering solutions. Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship Role We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany , applicants must: Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand). Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided. #Indeed Bot and Third-Party Applications Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. About Us Working at ICF means applying a passion for meaningful work with intellectual rigor to help solve the leading issues of our day. Smart, compassionate, innovative, committed, ICF employees tackle unprecedented challenges to benefit people, businesses, and governments around the globe. We believe in collaboration, mutual respect, open communication, and opportunity for growth. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building an inclusive workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are committed to creating a culture where we embrace our differences in ideas and identities. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. Learn more about what we do and our commitment to inclusion. items.desc: Job Description DXC ayuda a empresas globales a ejecutar sus sistemas y operaciones críticos para el negocio mientras moderniza la TI, optimiza las arquitecturas de datos y garantiza la seguridad y la escalabilidad en nubes públicas, privadas e híbridas. Las mayores compañías del mundo y organizaciones del sector público confían en DXC para desplegar servicios que impulsen nuevos niveles de rendimiento, competitividad y experiencia del cliente en todo su entorno de TI. Contamos con más de 125.000 personas en más de 70 países, en las que nuestros clientes confían la entrega de tecnologías transformadoras para garantizar el éxito, la seguridad y el bienestar de empresas y personas en todo el mundo. Creamos soluciones y generamos mejores resultados para los clientes a lo largo de todo su entorno de IT combinando fortalezas y experiencia a nivel global. Descubre más sobre cómo ofrecemos excelencia a clientes y compañeros en DXC.com. En España somos uno de los principales líderes del mercado de TI. Contamos con cerca de 8.000 profesionales, distribuidos en trece localizaciones, con centros de excelencia en tecnologías de última generación como Cloud, Inteligencia de Negocio, IA o Automatización entre otras, que dan servicio a más de 200 clientes de todas las industrias tanto del sector público como privado. Trabajamos con las principales empresas del país que confían en nosotros para guiar y administrar sus agendas digitales y así transformar sus negocios. Desarrollamos políticas activas de diversidad e inclusión laboral de personas con discapacidad y estamos orgullosos de contar con una representación del 49% aproximadamente de mujeres profesionales. En DXC estamos construyendo una plataforma agéntica de operación cloud: agentes de IA que ayudan a diagnosticar, gobernar y automatizar la operación de entornos cloud complejos, siempre con control humano y trazabilidad. Buscamos a la persona que convierta esas ideas en soluciones que funcionan en producción, trabajando codo con codo con el cliente y con un equipo de cloud pública de alta exigencia técnica. items.desc: ¿Te apasiona la tecnología, la innovación y crear soluciones con impacto real? En Raona ayudamos a las empresas a transformar la forma en la que trabajan a través de tecnología Microsoft, IA, automatización y Digital Workplace. Llevamos más de 20 años anticipándonos al futuro tecnológico y hoy somos un equipo internacional de más de 360 personas repartidas entre España, Andorra, Argentina y Colombia. Trabajamos con grandes compañías de múltiples sectores, desarrollando soluciones innovadoras que mejoran la experiencia de las personas, impulsan la productividad y generan impacto real en negocio. Pero más allá de la tecnología, hay algo que nos define especialmente: nuestra cultura. Apostamos por la autonomía, la flexibilidad, el aprendizaje continuo y un entorno cercano donde las ideas cuentan y las personas pueden crecer de verdad. Si buscas un lugar donde crecer, aportar y rodearte de gente con pasión por la tecnología, sigue leyendo 👇 La oportunidad 🚀 En Raona creemos que la IA no va solo de tecnología. Va de resolver problemas reales, generar impacto y transformar la forma de trabajar de las personas. Por eso buscamos incorporar un/a AI Solution Builder para unirse a nuestro equipo. Estamos buscando un perfil híbrido entre: negocio, producto y tecnología. Una persona capaz de entender los retos de nuestros clientes , identificar oportunidades de mejora y construir soluciones funcionales utilizando IA y herramientas de desarrollo asistido. No buscamos a alguien que documente requisitos para que otros desarrollen. Buscamos a alguien que entienda el problema, construya una primera solución funcional, la valide con los usuarios y la evolucione hasta generar valor real para el negocio. Participarás en proyectos innovadores, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares y siendo parte activa en la definición de cómo la IA transformará la forma de trabajar de nuestros clientes y equipos. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ayudar a convertir ideas, necesidades y retos de negocio en soluciones funcionales basadas en IA, trabajando de forma cercana con usuarios, stakeholders y equipos técnicos. Estas serán algunas de tus responsabilidades: Trabajar junto a áreas de negocio para identificar necesidades, oportunidades de mejora y retos estratégicos. Entender procesos, detectar casos de uso de alto impacto y ayudar a priorizarlos según su valor y viabilidad. Diseñar y construir prototipos, MVPs, agentes y soluciones funcionales utilizando herramientas de IA generativa y desarrollo asistido. Validar soluciones de forma rápida con usuarios y stakeholders, iterando continuamente a partir del feedback recibido. Integrar soluciones con APIs, datos y sistemas corporativos cuando sea necesario. Colaborar con equipos técnicos para evolucionar e industrializar las soluciones validadas. Documentar y comunicar decisiones funcionales, técnicas y de negocio. Compartir conocimiento, buenas prácticas y aprendizajes con clientes y equipos internos. Identificar nuevas oportunidades de aplicación de IA en procesos, productos y operaciones. Participar puntualmente en sesiones de demostración, workshops o iniciativas de innovación. Lo que buscamos en ti 🔍 Nos encantará conocerte si cuentas con: Experiencia trabajando con usuarios, áreas de negocio o stakeholders para entender necesidades y transformarlas en soluciones prácticas. Uso habitual de herramientas de IA generativa como Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot o similares. Capacidad para construir MVPs, prototipos o soluciones funcionales de forma autónoma. Conocimientos técnicos que te permitan trabajar con aplicaciones, APIs, datos y tecnologías modernas. Capacidad para desenvolverte en entornos ambiguos y convertir ideas en resultados tangibles. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración. Mentalidad de aprendizaje continuo, experimentación y mejora constante. Sumarás puntos si además tienes experiencia en... Desarrollo de software y buenas prácticas de ingeniería. Construcción de agentes y asistentes basados en IA. Microsoft Copilot Studio. Power Platform y Dataverse. Microsoft Graph. Azure AI Services. Integración de APIs REST y sistemas de terceros. Prompt Engineering y arquitecturas RAG. Product Management, Product Ownership o metodologías Agile. Sectores complejos como banca, seguros, industria o servicios profesionales. ¿Qué tipo de perfil puede encajar? Valoramos perfiles con trayectorias diversas. Puede que vengas del mundo del desarrollo de software y hayas evolucionado hacia la construcción de soluciones de negocio con IA. O puede que vengas del mundo del producto, la innovación o la consultoría y hayas incorporado la IA como herramienta habitual para diseñar y validar soluciones. Lo más importante para nosotros es tu capacidad para convertir problemas reales en soluciones funcionales que generen impacto. items.desc: Binnen Flynth zetten we de volgende stappen in onze innovatieve reis: het inzetten van AI om processen slimmer, efficiënter en kwalitatiever te maken. Bouw jij hands-on mee! Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer werk je met de nieuwste technologieën, waaronder Microsoft Fabric en Microsoft Foundry. Je krijgt veel ruimte om te experimenteren, te leren en impact te maken. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met interne collega’s en externe AI-partners, waardoor je veel kunt leren van experts in het veld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om zelf AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen die écht verschil maken binnen Flynth. Denk aan het bouwen van AI-applicaties en -agents die werken met zowel gestructureerde als ongestructureerde data om processen te automatiseren, inzichten te versnellen en medewerkers te ondersteunen. Je top 6 werkzaamheden als AI Engineer: Ontwikkelen van AI-applicaties en -agents die bedrijfsprocessen ondersteunen of automatiseren; Bouwen en verfijnen van prompts voor LLM’s (zoals GPT), inclusief iteratief testen en optimaliseren; Samenwerken met externe AI-partners om kennis op te doen en oplossingen te implementeren; Bouwen en door ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen, in lijn met de moderne Azure architectuur van Flynth; Integreren van AI-oplossingen met zowel gestructureerde als ongestructureerde data; Evalueren en monitoren van output van modellen en algehele performance van AI-oplossingen Wat bieden wij jou? Een mooi salaris tussen de €3.356 en €5.632 met daar bovenop vakantietoeslag, een premievrijpensioen, 25 vakantiedagen én 56 flexuren. Winstdeling want we doen het samen bij Flynth, dus alle winst investeren we in onze medewerkers en organisatie. Optimaal verder ontwikkelen door een uitgebreide onboarding, studiefaciliteiten, een eigen performance coach en vrijheid in je werk. Vergoeding van je reiskosten en een thuiswerkvergoeding. Ingerichte thuiswerkplek zodat jij net zo comfortabel thuiswerkt als op kantoor. Laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken. Wat breng je mee? Voor deze functie is het ten minste belangrijk dat jij: Beschikt over een afgeronde HBO opleiding en een sterke basis hebt in software en/of webdevelopment; Ervaring hebt met het ontwerpen van RAG- en/of multi-agent systemen. Ervaring hebt met agentic software engineering en Python. Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit. Je hebt een passie voor AI en LLMs maken al langere tijd een integraal deel uit van je leven. Het spreekt jou aan om te werken aan concrete oplossingen, waarbij je mag werken met externe toonaangevende partners op het gebied van AI. Je weet deze kennis te absorberen, te vertalen naar Flynth context en je collega's daarin mee te nemen. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat je communicatief vaardig bent, graag samenwerkt en initiatief durft te nemen. Bij ons kan jij elke dag met je passie bezig zijn! Jouw werkplek Je werkt in een energiek en ambitieus team waar samenwerking centraal staat. We werken volgens de Agile-methodiek, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor initiatief. Je krijgt de kans om te werken aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten met impact op ondernemers in heel Nederland. Ook krijg je toegang tot moderne tooling en een innovatieve werkomgeving waarin experimenteren wordt aangemoedigd. Dit alles doen we hybride met de flexibiliteit om te werken op een van de kantoren in het land, thuis en wanneer je wilt. Online assessment Flynth vindt het waarborgen van een objectief en eerlijk selectieproces heel belangrijk. Daarom ontvang je direct na jouw sollicitatie een uitnodiging voor ons game-based assessment per e-mail. Door dit assessment kunnen we jouw talenten in kaart brengen, nog voordat we jouw CV en eventuele motivatie bekijken. Uiteraard krijg je zelf ook inzicht in de uitkomsten. Hierdoor bieden we elke kandidaat gelijke kansen. Let op, sollicitaties zullen pas in behandeling worden genomen na het afronden van het game-based assessment. Sollicitatieprocedure Solliciteer via de knop Heb je interesse in deze vacature? Gebruik het formulier om je gegevens achter te laten. Je krijgt direct een uitnodiging voor ons online assessment. Online assessment Je krijgt een uitnodiging om een online assessment te maken. Dit kan thuis op een moment dat voor jou uitkomt. Na afronding nemen we binnen 3 werkdagen contact op. Seit 2017 erfolgreich – und heute Kern einer jungen Unternehmensgruppe mit über 100 hochmotivierten und -talentierten Köpfen Kurze Entscheidungswege, die Möglichkeit, sich einzubringen und etwas zu ändern KI lebt vom Austausch: Wir organisieren Events wie das THINK REACTOR Meetup und sind regelmäßig bei Community-Treffen wie AI Tinkerers dabei. Schau doch mal vorbei und lerne uns kennen! Zugang zu allen aktuellen KIs und KI-Tools (z.B. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) Moderne Büros im Hauptsitz in Bremen und den Coworking-Räumen in Hamburg und Oldenburg. Firmen-Fitness, BusinessBike und ein eigenes Firmenboot Kostenübernahme für E-Learning-Kurse nach Wunsch Regelmäßige Teamevents und jährliche Offsites Namenhafte, internationale Kund:innen aus verschiedensten Branchen Faires, angemessenes Gehalt und Erfolgsbeteiligung 30 Tage Urlaub und Möglichkeit zur Teilzeit Top-Hardware, höhenverstellbare Tische und mehrere Monitore an jedem Arbeitsplatz Selbstverständlich: Bio-Obst/Gemüse, Smoothie-Bar, Eis-Flatrate, Getränke (guter Kaffee, Mate etc.) Über uns Wir schauen nicht nur auf die blanken Zahlen, denn wir suchen insbesondere nach Menschen, die sich durch Talent und Motivation auszeichnen. Wenn du also glaubst, dass diese Stelle genau zu dir passt und wir voneinander profitieren können, du aber (noch) nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. JUST ADD AI (JAAI) hilft Unternehmen dabei, den aktuellsten Stand der KI-Technologie zu verstehen und auf ihr Geschäft anzuwenden. Der Fokus von JAAI liegt dabei auf der Programmierung von skalierbaren KI-Lösungen, die bei unseren Kunden sofort Mehrwerte schaffen. Sobald eine KI-Lösung marktfähig ist und erste Kunden und Umsätze verzeichnet, wird sie in eine Tochtergesellschaft ausgegründet und dort skaliert. Um das Wachstum der Ausgründungen zu sichern, werden in den Tochtergesellschaften Beteiligungen vergeben und strategische Partner an Bord geholt. Das Arbeiten in der JAAI Group zeichnet sich durch eine offene Kommunikation aus. Probleme werden in Teams aus Top-Spezialisten der Bereiche KI-Agenten, Sprachverarbeitung (LLMs), Computervision, Big Data und Robotik, sowie aus erfahrenen IT-Managern und -Architekten, gemeinsam gelöst. Unsere Mission: „Unlock Human Talent“. KI öffnet durch die Automatisierung repetitiver und zeitraubender Tätigkeiten neue Freiräume für die Entfaltung des vollen Potentials menschlicher Talente.

items.desc: KI-Systeme bauen, integrieren und beim Mittelstand zum Laufen bringen. Du baust KI-Systeme, die wirklich laufen – RAG-Pipelines, Agenten, Automatisierungen. Und Du willst nicht im Backlog eines Produktteams verschwinden, sondern direkt beim Kunden sehen, was deine Lösung bewirkt. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bei Neurawork bist Du die technische Instanz in unseren Kundenprojekten im Mittelstand: Du verstehst die Prozesse des Kunden, entwirfst die Architektur, integrierst unsere Standardprodukte tief in seine Systemlandschaft und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende etwas produktiv läuft – nicht nur auf Folien existiert. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Wir setzen auf standardisierte Produkte als Hebel und passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert – und stehen dafür ein. items.desc: Our client, a leading global multi strategy hedge fund, is looking for an AI Engineer in London to build and embed production-grade AI solutions across its Macro and Fixed Income investment business. Sitting within a specialist AI enablement team, the role works directly with portfolio managers, analysts, researchers and trading desks, while partnering with central AI and Data Science teams to turn investment requirements into scalable products. The position exists to close the gap between advanced AI capabilities and practical front-office adoption, improving how investment teams analyse markets, price risk and make decisions across rates, credit and FX. Responsibilities Work directly with Macro and Fixed Income investment teams to identify high-value opportunities for AI, automation and advanced analytics. Build and deploy production-grade LLM, agentic AI and data-driven applications for investment research, pricing, risk and trading workflows. Translate requirements from portfolio managers, analysts and traders into robust technical products that can be iterated quickly and scaled. Drive adoption through practical demonstrations, on-desk collaboration, user education and ongoing product support. Capture feedback from investment users, evaluate emerging AI techniques and influence the development of the wider internal AI platform. Requirements Must have experience supporting front-office users of Macro or Fixed Income markets, including areas such as rates, credit, FX, market data, pricing or investment research. 2+ years of professional software engineering, quantitative development or applied AI experience, Strong Python engineering skills and experience taking AI or machine learning applications from concept through to production. Practical exposure to LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, evaluation, monitoring or model integration within controlled production environments. Strong stakeholder skills, commercial awareness and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and investment professionals. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants their work used directly by sophisticated investment professionals rather than sitting several layers away from the business. You will own meaningful problems from initial conversation through to production, gain day-to-day exposure to Macro and Fixed Income decision-making, and help shape how a major investment platform applies generative AI across the front office. The role offers a strong progression path for someone combining high-quality engineering with product judgement, stakeholder confidence and an interest in financial markets. Why Apply? If you are building production AI systems and want greater ownership, closer investment exposure and a clearer connection between your work and commercial outcomes, please get in touch for a confidential conversation.
