items.desc: Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Steuerberatung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als AI Engineer - Transfer Pricing (w/m/d) . Das erwartet dich Digitalisierung – Du entwickelst innovative, digitale Lösungen und treibst die Umsetzung unserer Digitalisierungsstrategie voran. KI-Systeme – Du entwirfst und implementierst wissensbasierte und KI-gestützte Anwendungen, die Expertenwissen skalierbar machen und komplexe Prozesse intelligent automatisieren. Transfer Pricing – Du arbeitest an komplexen Fragestellungen wie globalen Wertschöpfungskettenanalysen, der Segmentierung heterogener Finanzdaten und der Auswertung internationaler Regelwerke im internationalen Steuerkontext. Projektarbeit – Du bist in der Projektarbeit gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Anwält:innen, Ökonom:innen und Steuerberater:innen an Digitalisierungsprojekten tätig und bringst KI-Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz. Das bringst du mit Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Systementwicklung oder KI sowie betriebswirtschaftlichen Themen. Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Umgang mit LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG-Architekturen, Knowledge Graphs und moderner Full-Stack-Entwicklung. Auch der Einsatz von Caude Claude und Codex gehört für dich idealerweise zum Arbeitsalltag. Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit wirtschaftlichen Kenntnissen und hast Freude daran, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technologie, Business und Beratung zu arbeiten. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit zur klaren und verständlichen Kommunikation mit Fachexpert:innen aus dem Transfer Pricing Bereich ohne IT-Hintergrund. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab. Deine Benefits Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten. Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Transfer Pricing Teams wirst du mit einer guten Mischung aus Weitsicht und einem Blick fürs Detail unseren Kunden dabei helfen, alle Belange der Verrechnungspreisgestaltung optimal zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Transfer Pricing Strategien, weshalb wir uns immer über deine innovativen Ideen freuen. Bring dich in unser interdisziplinäres Team ein, nutze die neuesten digitalen Tools und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns innovative Lösungen. Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung? Melde dich gerne bei Ines Wallenwein unter +49 69 95855225.

items.desc: Vanaf het begin werk je aan uitdagende projecten die je analytische en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden op de proef stellen. Deze projecten kunnen zich in alle onderdelen van Jumbo bevinden, van logistiek tot marketing en van formule tot inkoop. Je bouwt data science producten van begin (ruwe data) tot eind (productieklare modellen). Gemakkelijk 50% van je tijd besteed je aan data-preparatie, exploratie, (geavanceerde) analyses en zelfs wat BI, dus het is belangrijk dat je dat ook leuk vindt naast Machine Learning / het bouwen van AI Agents. We focussen op resultaat, niet op output: klanten veranderen in fans door betere beslissingen op basis van de inzichten die jij ontdekt. Dit ga je doen Analyseer grote datasets om inzichten te ontdekken die beslissingen in winkels, online en supply chain verbeteren. Bouw voorspelmodellen die helpen winkelvoorraad, de vraag naar producten en klantgedrag beter te voorspellen. Onderzoek commerciële kansen door prijs-, promotie- en assortimentsdata te analyseren. Ontwikkel data-agents, dashboards en geautomatiseerde rapportages waarmee je collega’s dagelijks je data science producten gebruiken. Verbeter de datakwaliteit door datastromen te controleren en issues te signaleren en op te lossen. Test, optimaliseer en implementeer machine learning modellen in onze productieomgeving. Vertaal complexe analyses naar begrijpelijke adviezen voor collega’s buiten Data Science. Lever met modellen directe businessimpact, zoals minder derving, betere beschikbaarheid of hogere klanttevredenheid. Jouw werkdag als Junior Data Scientist bij Jumbo: 09.00 – 11.00: Je werkt in DataBricks (PySpark) met onze enorme datasets om het model te verbeteren dat de uitwisselbaarheid van producten inschat, wat een sleutelrol speelt in het selecteren van het juiste assortiment. 11.00 – 12.00: Je bekijkt de laatste resultaten van de machine learning modellen in jouw portfolio. 12.00 – 12.45: Lunchmeeting met je collega’s van DS&A in ons Foodcafé. 13.00 – 15.00: Je doet een peer review van een model dat is ontwikkeld door een collega om onze loyaliteitsaanbiedingen te verbeteren, waarbij je die kennis gebruikt om ons assortimentsmodel te verbeteren. 15.00 – 17.00: Je woont een workshop bij die zich richt op het verbeteren van de differentiatie van winkelindelingen met een data-gedreven aanpak. Een MSc of PhD met uitstekende academische resultaten in Computer Science, Econometrie, Data Science of andere kwantitatieve vakgebieden en 0 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring; Passie voor zowel Machine Learning als Agentic AI en een solide begrip van supervised en unsupervised learning methoden (RF, LGBM, XGB, Lasso/Ridge, SVD, KNN, ALS, LLMs, …), statistiek en tijdreeksanalyse (BSTS, SARIMA-X, etc.) en Agentic packages (LangChain/LangGraph, PydanticAI, OpenAI, AutoGen). Kennis van optimalisatiemethoden (LP / MILP) is een sterke pré; Je weet dat het vakgebied Data Science voortdurend evolueert, dus een leergierige houding is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je beseft dat effectief blijven vraagt om het leren van zowel soft- als hard-skills; Je levert liever code en werkende data-producten dan PowerPoint-slides: Python is vereist, PySpark is een sterke pré. Je bouwt graag data-tools in PowerBI. Ervaring met DataBricks is een sterke pré. SQL en R zijn nice-to-haves; Sterke communicatie- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden: je kunt uitleggen wat de ‘so what’ (en soms ‘waarom’) is van een modelaanbeveling. Je neemt eindgebruikers van je modellen mee in het tempo dat past bij de (on)mogelijkheden van je modellen; Hoewel beheersing van de Nederlandse taal een pré is, is het geen vereiste. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.900 – €5.100 (op basis van 40 uur); Een jaarlijkse bonus van maximaal 5% van je jaarsalaris, gebaseerd op organisatiedoelen; 30 betaalde vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om dagen te kopen of verkopen) en 8% vakantiegeld. Je bouwt pensioen op via deelname aan het Pensioenfonds voor de Levensmiddelenindustrie; Een reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,21 per kilometer met een maximum van 35 kilometer enkele reis). We werken graag samen op kantoor, maar deels thuiswerken is ook mogelijk; Ruimte voor ondernemerschap, groei en ontwikkeling. Niet alleen in je functie, maar ook via onze Jumbo Academy, online trainingen via GoodHabitz en met een opleidingsbudget; Dagelijks verse lunch in ons Foodcafé, goede koffie en vers fruit. Je kunt dagelijks sporten in onze eigen Jumbo Gym tegen een kleine vergoeding; Collega-kortingen zoals 10% korting op je boodschappen (tot €325 per jaar), deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering of kortingen via Benefits at Work. Wil je meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Klik dan hier . Kyon Adriaans +31624151674 kyon.adriaans@jumbo.com

items.desc: We’re looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building useful software and wants to do more than experiment with AI, someone who can turn it into reliable solutions that people actually use. At Boyum IT, we’re exploring how AI can make a real difference across our products and the way we work internally. That might mean building an assistant that helps colleagues find the right information faster, supporting our customer-facing teams with smarter tools, or connecting AI capabilities with our existing products and systems. This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world. You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper. Location: Aarhus, Denmark - regular office presence is required. About the Team: We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development. What You Will Be Doing As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will: Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services. Develop backend services and APIs. Work with LLM-powered applications, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows. Build and improve data pipelines and knowledge bases used by AI applications. Help evaluate AI solutions and improve their quality, reliability and accuracy. Deploy and operate solutions in Azure. Work with Docker, CI/CD and Azure DevOps as part of the development lifecycle. Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions. Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI. Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company. Our current technology landscape includes Python, PostgreSQL/vector, Dagster, Azure, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, Docker and Azure DevOps. What We Are Looking For We think you’ll be a good match if you have: At least 3+ years of software development experience , ideally in backend or software engineering Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software A solid understanding of databases, testing, and maintainable software Curiosity about where AI genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t The ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues to understand a problem before jumping to a solution Nice to Have Experience with any of the following is a bonus, not a checklist: C# Azure or another cloud platform Docker, DevOps, and CI/CD Data pipelines RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents Why Join Boyum IT At Boyum IT, our culture is built around Energy for Life - the belief that people do their best work when they feel energized, supported, and able to balance work with life outside of work. For us, Energy for Life means creating a workplace where people can grow professionally, stay healthy, feel connected, and have the flexibility to be present for family, friends, and personal priorities. What We Offer A culture built around our Energy for Life mindset Flexible work arrangements and respect for work-life balance A diverse, international team with colleagues from more than 45 nationalities A supportive workplace focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and belonging Career development opportunities aligned with your personal goals Helpful, knowledgeable, and collaborative colleagues A workplace where your ideas and feedback are valued Boyum IT committed to responsible business and positive ESG impact Interested? Send us your CV in English or Danish . We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so there’s no need to wait until the last minute. You don’t need experience with every technology listed in the advertisement. What matters most is a strong software engineering foundation, practical experience building with AI, and an interest in taking solutions from an idea into reliable everyday use. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

items.desc: Who We Are Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services. At the AI&Data, we work locally and globally with over 200 Poland-based specialists. Our expertise spans data architecture and sectoral specialization. We collaborate with tech partners like Microsoft, AWS, Google, and Snowflake to implement cutting-edge solutions. We provide comprehensive support from strategy definition to solution implementation and development, covering all aspects of Data & Analytics. THE WORK: You will design, build and maintain cloud-native solutions on AWS, working closely with Solution Architects, engineering teams and client stakeholders. You will develop and integrate AI and Generative AI solutions on AWS, using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI and related services. You will contribute to building enterprise AI platforms / AI Factories, providing reusable capabilities for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. You will implement GenAI patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, Knowledge Bases, guardrails and model integrations, connecting them with enterprise applications and data. You will automate cloud environments and deployments using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, while applying AWS best practices for security, scalability, observability and cost efficiency. You will work with architects and engineering teams to turn technical designs and prototypes into production-grade solutions, troubleshoot complex issues and continuously improve implemented solutions. You will participate in POV and POC initiatives, exploring new AWS and AI capabilities and contributing to reusable assets and engineering standards. Flexible: The work location for this role may include ing on specific project circumstances With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? Work on projects for international clients, expanding your data skill set. Gain insights and support from a diverse team of over 200 Data-enthusiasts. HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Strong hands-on experience building solutions on AWS and good knowledge of core AWS services across compute, storage, networking, databases, integration and security. Good programming skills, preferably Python, and experience developing cloud-native applications, APIs and integrations. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, using technologies such as Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation. Practical experience implementing AI/ML or Generative AI solutions on AWS, particularly with Amazon Bedrock and/or Amazon SageMaker AI. Understanding of GenAI concepts and implementation patterns such as LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG and AI agents. Good understanding of AWS security, scalability, reliability, observability and cost optimization principles. Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and collaborate effectively with architects, engineering teams and client stakeholders. Excellent command of spoken and written English (B2 level or higher). BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Experience building components of an enterprise AI Factory / GenAI Platform, providing reusable AI capabilities for multiple teams and use cases. Advanced experience with Amazon Bedrock, including Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents and/or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Experience implementing production-grade RAG or agentic AI solutions, including integration with enterprise data and APIs. Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, AI evaluation, monitoring, observability and Responsible AI/security controls. Experience with Docker, Amazon ECS/EKS, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven architectures. Experience with modern data platforms, vector databases and semantic search, particularly in support of AI applications. Relevant AWS certifications, particularly AWS Developer, Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer or AI/ML-related certifications. WHAT WE OFFER? A permanent employment contract Individual support of a People Lead and a clearly defined path of professional development, including the possibility of a session with a Coach A comprehensive training package, including: soft skills, technical and language training, access to e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses and certifications Employee Assistance Program offering legal, financial and psychological consultations Employee Share Purchase Plan – employees who own company shares are automatically eligible for quarterly dividends Paid employee referral program Private medical care and life insurance Access to the Worksmile benefits platform (including the Multisport card) WHAT …

items.title: KI‑Ingenieur*in / Expert*in für KI‑Systeme und KI‑Infrastruktur (SALAMI.Team)
items.card: Aufgaben Konzeption, Implementierung und produktive Bereit­stellung neuartiger KI‑Verarbeitungs­ketten (Foundation-Modelle, LLMs, Computer-Vision-Modelle) für unterschiedliche Anwendungsfälle und Hardware­skalen der KI‑Forschungs­infrastruktur; für die einzusetzenden Verfahren existieren teilweise keine marktüblichen Standard­lösungen, sodass bislang nicht verfügbare Lösungs­wege eigenständig erarbeitet werden
items.desc: Seit rund 15 Jahren stehen wir an der Hochschule Rhein-Waal am Niederrhein für eine innovative, inter­disziplinäre und internationale Ausbil­dung junger Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. Wir bieten insgesamt 37 Bachelor- und Master­studien­gänge an den vier inter­disziplinären Fakultäten – Technologie und Bionik, Life Sciences, Gesell­schaft und Ökonomie sowie Kommunikation und Umwelt. Mehr als 90 Partner­hochschulen in 38 Ländern stehen für die internationale Kooperations­stärke der Hochschule Rhein-Waal. So ist die Hochschule in der EUREGIOn verwurzelt und mit der Welt vernetzt. Das Verbund­projekt SALAMI.Team (Scalable Language Model Infrastructure) unter der Leitung der Hochschule Rhein-Waal dient dem Aufbau und der Exploration einer NRW-geförderten skalen­übergreifenden KI‑Forschungs­infrastruktur, die als Basis für ein regionales Innovations­system für Künstliche Intelligenz im Mittelstand fungiert. Das technologische Spektrum reicht dabei von leistungs­starken GPU-Servern (NVIDIA DGX B300) und Workstations (RTX Pro 6000) bis hin zu kompakten Embedded-Systemen. In konkreten Umsetzungs­projekten entwickeln die Kooperations­partner gemein­sam KI‑Anwendungen in den Bereichen Agrar­robotik, Precision Agriculture, E‑Government, Psychologie und Computer-Vision-basierte Schadens­analyse. Dabei werden bevorzugt Open-Weight-KI‑Modelle anwendungs­spezifisch optimiert und skaliert. Das Ziel ist ein minimaler Verbrauch von Speicherplatz, Rechen­leistung und Energie, um den lokalen Betrieb von Modellen erheblich zu vereinfachen. items.desc: Most AI projects end in a slide deck. Ours go live. Lugano, Switzerland or remote within the EU About PHILIPP PLEIN PHILIPP PLEIN is a Swiss luxury fashion group with several brands, stores and online shops around the world. We are AI-first: we rethink how the work is done, then build it with AI. What you build lands directly with our merchandise, allocation, finance and operations teams. What you will do • Learn how our tech stack works end to end and find the weak spots: slow, costly, fragile or outdated. • Fix those spots (speed, cost, stability, security, clean code), then keep them healthy. • Build AI-driven solutions end to end, frontend, backend and database, from first idea to daily use. • Build agents and web apps for business teams; connect product, PLM and sales data (read only). • Run ETL pipelines with Airflow: gather data from all systems, clean it, check it, improve it. • Track every app, agent and pipeline: who did what, errors, cost and quality, so you can fix fast and keep improving. What you bring • Experience: 3 to 5 years as a developer shipping software to production, at least one LLM solution used by real people, fluent English. • Frontend: TypeScript, React or Next.js; clear, fast screens for business users. • Backend: Python (FastAPI) or Node.js; REST APIs, sign-in, background jobs, automated tests. • Databases and data: PostgreSQL, strong SQL, data modelling, migrations, query tuning; ETL orchestration with Airflow, data quality checks, dbt, Snowflake or Databricks. • LLMs and agents: Claude and OpenAI APIs, prompts with cost limits, structured output, MCP, multi-agent with human approval (LangGraph, Pydantic AI or Claude Agent SDK), RAG, embeddings, vector search (pgvector), tool calling. • Data science: pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, LightGBM or statsmodels; forecasts tested on past seasons. • Governance and tracing: access rights, GDPR and Swiss data law, versioned prompts and models; audit trail (who, when, old to new); run tracing (Langfuse or similar), error tracking (Sentry or similar), cost, speed and quality per call, test sets for LLM answers. • AI coding and delivery: Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot every day; you review, test and fix what the tool writes. Docker, Azure or another cloud, CI/CD with GitHub Actions. • Working skills: process mapping; turning what users say into clear specs and tickets. Who you are • You start from the work, not the model. • You ship things people use, then make them better. • You check every number and every AI answer before you trust it. • You explain your work in simple words, so anyone in the company can follow. How to apply Apply here on LinkedIn with your CV and answer one question. 👉 Show us one thing you built with AI coding tools. What did the AI get wrong, and how did you fix it? #AIEngineering #FullStack #LLM #Hiring #Lugano #RemoteJobs

You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. A Day in the Life: Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows. Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements. What to expect: Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution. Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows. Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives. Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence. Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization. Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions. Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes. Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership. Keys to Success: Education BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience. Experience 5+ years of hands-on bioprocessing experience, ideally within Process Development, with strong expertise in downstream processing. Demonstrated experience with downstream purification …

items.desc: About Us HFM is an internationally acclaimed multi-asset broker, delivering cutting-edge trading tools, platforms, and conditions to traders worldwide. We are committed to innovation, transparency, and excellence in the financial markets. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a driven and strategic driven Frontend Enterprise Software Architect to join our team. You will design and build web application architecture and shared frontend foundations, set engineering standards and write code alongside development teams. Responsibilities : Own end-to-end frontend architecture; design, prototype and implement shared foundations for trading and client-facing web applications. Own the shared component library and design system for reuse across product teams. Set standards for application structure, state management, testing and dependencies, enforced through code reviews and automated checks. Define and enforce performance budgets and accessibility (WCAG) as architectural requirements. Own frontend security, including content security policy, dependency supply chain and safe token handling in the browser. Write production code, modernize legacy frontends and resolve complex technical challenges. Collaborate with architects, engineering teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, scalable solutions. Mentor engineers and establish frontend best practices across the global engineering organization. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience. 10+ years of hands-on frontend engineering, including several years architecting large multi-team web applications. Fluency in English; additional languages would be considered an advantage. Expert proficiency in TypeScript and React, with hands-on Next.js experience in high-load production systems. Deep understanding of web performance: Core Web Vitals, bundle budgets, caching and rendering strategy. Practical command of accessibility standards (WCAG) and browser security (CSP, CORS, XSS, CSRF). Experience defining and operating a design system used by more than one product team. Strong background in modern build tooling, monorepo management and frontend CI/CD pipelines. Excellent communicator who can translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders. Resumes must be submitted in English. Applicants must be eligible or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based. Benefits Hybrid Work Model (2 days working from home) Comprehensive Health Insurance Additional Paid Annual Leave Birthday Leave Meal Allowance Udemy Business access Referral Bonus Program Summer Short Fridays (August) Additional Support Visa Sponsorship and Relocation Assistance Sounds like you? Our goal is to keep elderly patients at home, for longer, through both caregiver services, as well as insurance, data and technology. By doing this, the ultimate goal is to support health and social care systems in their path to long-term sustainability. In other words, Qida is not "another" home-care business. It is a business that uses data, tech, and partnerships with public and private institutions to transform how, when and where care is delivered. It works to "fix the health and social care system and on the back of it, creates a good business", not "making a business out of a broken system that remains unfixed." Seven years after inception, we have scaled the business to 100M€ GMV, 250+ office employees, over 5,500 active caregivers, entered profitability (EBITDA 0) and have partnerships with the largest private hospital chain in Spain (QuirónSalud), the largest bank, the largest life insurers in Spain, and over 50 public institutions across the country. We are B Corp and invested by the 3 largest social impact funds in Spain, together with Kibo Ventures, a leading Southern Europe VC. We have plans (and funding) to grow 10x in the next 5 years. And this position is core to this growth and sector transformation we are doing. Your role The Regional Growth Associate is the owner of local growth in every market. Your goal is to maximize market share per market, understanding growth as Sales and Margin. You define and execute the growth strategy of your markets, with autonomy. You report directly to the Regional Director and work hand-in-hand with the Prescription team, Acquisition, Brand, Salesforce Effectiveness and Ops Excellence teams. items.desc: Job Information Date Opened 13/10/2026 Job Type Contract Industry Government & Public Sector Work Experience 5+ years Salary 500 Outside IR35 City London Province Greater London Country United Kingdom Postal Code EC1A Job Description About Scrumconnect Scrumconnect Consulting is a UK-based digital transformation consultancy delivering secure, scalable, and user-centred solutions across government and enterprise organisations. We specialise in agile delivery, cloud platforms, data, and modern engineering practices—helping clients build reliable services that meet high operational and compliance standards. The Role We're looking for a senior Forensic DBA to investigate, reconstruct and explain what has happened inside business-critical databases on a UK public sector programme. You will work with security, delivery and engineering teams to find the root cause of data incidents, preserve evidence, and make recommendations that stop them recurring. At SFIA Level 5 you'll work independently, advise at senior level, and set the standard for how the programme logs, audits and recovers its data. Key Responsibilities Investigate data incidents, such as unexpected changes, deletions, corruption, performance failures and suspected misuse, and establish the root cause. Reconstruct events using transaction logs, WAL archives, point-in-time recovery (PITR), audit logs and replication streams. Preserve and document evidence in a way that can be relied on in security and compliance reviews. Check data integrity and spot tampering or unauthorised access. Advise on audit and logging design (for example pgaudit and database activity monitoring) so future incidents can be traced. Support live incident response, including performance tuning and fault finding on production databases. Review backup, disaster recovery, replication and archiving arrangements. Support database migrations and upgrades, including near-zero-downtime approaches. Write clear investigation reports and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Advise developers and architects on SQL, indexing and schema design. What We're Looking For Essential SC cleared, mandatory. Extensive hands-on experience as a senior DBA, with strong PostgreSQL skills. Experience on AWS managed databases (RDS and Aurora). Proven experience with backup, PITR, logical replication, high availability and disaster recovery. Strong SQL and performance tuning skills, including index strategy. Experience diagnosing live production incidents and finding root causes. Good understanding of database security, auditing and logging. Linux and bash scripting. Strong written reporting and stakeholder communication. Able to work independently at SFIA Level 5. Desirable Experience of database or digital forensics, evidence handling or incident response. Experience in central government or other regulated environments. Infrastructure as code (Terraform). Data modelling and data warehouse experience (3NF, dimensional). Migration experience (for example Oracle or MySQL to PostgreSQL). Git, Docker and Kubernetes. Why Join Scrumconnect Ltd? At Scrumconnect, we are more than just a consultancy. We are a collaborative team focused on delivering impactful digital transformation services across government and enterprise organisations. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Exposure to major public sector digital programmes. A collaborative and inclusive working culture. Hands-on experience working within agile delivery environments. Application Process Submit your CV to recruitment@scrumconnect.com. If shortlisted, you will be invited to interview. Diversity and Inclusion Scrumconnect Ltd is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

items.desc: Data Engineer — Data & IA (F/H) — CDI — Métropole lilloise Construire des données qui servent. Explorer ce qu’elles rendent possible avec l’IA. Sight & Scale est un Data & AI Office. Nous aidons les dirigeants à décider, structurer, transformer, piloter et pérenniser ce qui compte dans leur activité, grâce à la Data et à l’IA. Nous partons de l’activité : ses chaînes de valeur, ses processus, ses décisions. La Data et l’IA viennent ensuite, comme leviers. Derrière les cinq verbes, des métiers concrets : • Décider — diagnostics, arbitrages d’investissement, stratégie Data & IA. • Structurer — gouvernance, architecture et plateformes Data, data engineering, qualité, catalogue. • Transformer — produits et solutions intégrant l’IA, RAG, agents, intégration, mise en production. • Piloter — indicateurs partagés, couches sémantiques, BI, produits Data, MLOps. • Pérenniser — coûts, réversibilité, sécurité, transmission aux équipes. Nous conseillons et nous réalisons : sur mesure, avec des solutions du marché ou avec nos propres produits, car nous sommes aussi éditeur. Sight & Scale est une entreprise IA-native. VOTRE RÔLE Vous construisez les fondations qui transforment des données dispersées en usages fiables : analyse, pilotage, automatisation, modèle ou application IA. Vos réalisations nourrissent les projets de nos clients, nos produits, nos démonstrateurs et nos partages de pratique. CE QUE VOUS CONSTRUIREZ ET APPORTEREZ Cartographier et relier — Cartographier et documenter les sources ; connecter API, fichiers, applications et bases ; organiser les mises à jour et la reprise des traitements, sans doublons ni perte d’historique. Donner un sens commun — Définir entités, relations et règles de calcul : ce qu’est une commande, un stock disponible, une marge. Tenir les référentiels et rendre ces définitions utilisables par une analyse, une application ou une IA. Rendre la fiabilité visible — Qualité, lignage, sécurité des accès : repérer une rupture de structure, une donnée trop ancienne ou un résultat incohérent ; mesurer l’impact sur les usages et savoir reprendre le traitement. Construire avec l’IA et pour l’IA — Éprouver les assistants de développement ; préparer données, documents et interfaces pour des modèles, de la recherche documentaire et des agents ; évaluer les résultats. Élargir votre contribution — Participer à un cadrage, un démonstrateur, un avis d’expertise ou une proposition ; animer un atelier ; contribuer à nos produits. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE Quatre métiers dans une seule entreprise Conseil, intégration, édition, expertise. On part toujours de la chaîne de valeur du client : vous savez pourquoi vous construisez, et pour quelle décision. Vous passez d’un problème métier à un prototype, d’un choix d’architecture à un produit, d’une réalisation à une formation, sans vous enfermer dans un seul rôle. Une entreprise qui pense et travaille avec l’IA Assistants de développement, agents, automatisation, évaluation : l’IA fait partie de notre façon de concevoir et de produire. Vous participez aux essais et aux choix, avec un poste de développement taillé pour vos traitements et des accès IA professionnels. Vous conseillez en toute indépendance Nous restons agnostiques : notre devoir de conseil passe avant toute technologie, tout partenaire et nos propres produits. Proposer plus simple, écrire un désaccord, recommander de ne pas faire : c’est attendu, et c’est un livrable à part entière. Vous apprenez avec de l’appui Vos premières semaines vous font découvrir nos outils, nos méthodes et les travaux en cours. Vous avez un référent identifié et vos premiers objectifs sont définis ensemble. Les travaux qui le demandent se préparent et se relisent à plusieurs ; votre autonomie progresse avec votre pratique. Formations, certifications ciblées et expérimentations font partie du travail, reliées à une réalisation. Ce qui a marché, ce qui a résisté, ce qu’on referait autrement : chaque projet laisse une trace que l’équipe réutilise. Une erreur s’analyse pour ne pas se répéter, pas pour chercher un coupable ; la critique porte sur le travail, jamais sur la personne. Vous signez ce que vous produisez Chaque livrable est signé, daté, sourcé : on sait qui a conçu, relu, validé, et ce que l’IA a fait. Les choix importants font l’objet d’une relecture adaptée au sujet. Votre progression tient compte de l’ensemble de votre contribution : la qualité des réalisations, ce que vous transmettez, ce que vous apportez aux produits, aux méthodes et au développement de Sight & Scale. Vous construisez l’entreprise Vous arrivez parmi les premiers : les pratiques, les outils et les offres se décident avec vous. Nous sommes aussi éditeur : une amélioration, un composant, une idée de produit se propose, s’éprouve, et entre dans nos développements si elle tient. Votre rôle peut grandir vers l’expertise, l’accompagnement technique, le produit ou le développement de l’activité. VOTRE PRATIQUE Vous avez construit des pipelines et des …

items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a IT Operations Specialist We are looking for an IT Operations Specialist to join our IT team. NestAI is growing fast, both in headcount and geographical footprint. This role is the single accountable owner for every device and identity at NestAI, and a key role in the IT & Security team. Reporting directly to IT Operations, you will run and own device management across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android. You will own the full device lifecycle within the hire-to-retire flow. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building and developing things properly: automated, documented and auditable. Security operations, network security and physical security are handled by dedicated colleagues in the same team, and you will work closely with all of them. What you'll work on: As IT Operations Specialist, you'll run and own device management across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android, taking full accountability for the hire-to-retire device lifecycle as NestAI scales. In this role, you will. In this role, you will: Run MDM across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android: enrollment, compliance baselines, patching, disk encryption and EDR sensor health. Own the MDM directory and the IdP interface. Lead upcoming projects centralizing and simplifying Identity and Device management. Automate joiner, mover and leaver flows with our HR system as the source of truth, so access is right from day one and removed on the last day. Manage the device lifecycle and asset inventory across the group, and document everything as clear runbooks that also serve as ISO 27001 evidence. What we're looking for : Solid experience (equivalent to 5+ years) in hands-on MDM and identity administration, ideally in a fast-growing organisation of 200+ people. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Au sein du Groupe Société Générale, vous rejoindrez l'Audit SI qui dépend de la Direction Inspection Générale et Audit. L'Audit SI garantit un contrôle indépendant sur les risques informatiques de l'ensemble des métiers du Groupe. Son principal enjeu : évaluer, contrôler et gérer les risques pris par la banque en France et à l'étranger. Pratique, méthodique et indépendant, l'audit des systèmes d'information mobilise 120 experts IT, des ingénieurs sécurité, des développeurs, des architectes ou des chefs de projets dans le monde. Les 18 000 informaticiens de la Société Générale et l'Audit SI sont porteurs d'enjeux majeurs en termes de performance, de compétitivité, d'innovation et de sécurité pour tous nos métiers. Vous avez envie de prendre des responsabilités en continuant à vous former dans un environnement d'amélioration continue, stimulant et utilisant des outils innovants au service de la maîtrise des risques IT (data analytics, cyberlab, etc.). Rejoignez nos équipes et vivez une immersion dans les différents métiers de la banque en collaboration avec de nombreux acteurs. En tant qu'auditeur en audit IT, vous aiderez les métiers en France et à l'international à renforcer leur gestion des risques liés aux technologies de l'information (cyber-attaques, fraudes, interruptions, erreurs opérationnelles, fuites de données, échecs de projets, etc.). Vous contribuerez ainsi à identifier et réduire ces risques liés aux systèmes d'information, et à améliorer le fonctionnement de la Banque. Votre rôle: Vous participez à la réalisation de missions d'audit, notamment sur les systèmes d'informations, visant à évaluer les risques et apprécier l'efficacité du système de contrôle interne. Associé à l'ensemble des phases de la mission (de la préparation à la rédaction des rapports), vous mettez en œuvre les techniques d'audit afin d'améliorer le fonctionnement de la Banque. Vos objectifs principaux sont les suivants : Recueillir les informations nécessaires à la pertinence de la mission dans un contexte de confidentialité tout en respectant les règles d'éthique Effectuer des contrôles et évaluer les risques Définir les axes d'amélioration et formuler des préconisations Participer aux actions de suivi de la mise en place des recommandations d'audit Organiser votre activité pour atteindre les objectifs de la mission dans les délais impartis Assurer la relation avec les audités en toute indépendance et avec diplomatie Les thématiques IT abordées sont riches et diversifiées, telles que : revue de la stratégie IT et son alignement avec le métier sécurité de l'information continuité d'activité projets de transformation cycle de développement gestion de la production informatique audits thématiques : Cloud, Agile@Scale architecture IT systèmes d'intelligence artificielle (IA) Et si c'était vous ? Vous disposez d'un an minimum d'expérience audit IT ou au minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans le domaine des risques, contrôle permanent des risques IT. Vous disposez d'une expérience dans au minimum deux des domaines suivants : Stratégie et organisation de la fonction informatique, maîtrise des risques associés Gestion de projets d'évolution des systèmes Architectures logicielles, urbanisation des SI Maîtrise d'ouvrage (conception et test fonctionnels, etc.) ou maîtrise d'œuvre (développement .net, C#, Java, Cobol, etc.) Outsourcing/off-shoring, management d'équipes off-shore ou d'activités informatiques sous-traitées/externalisées Idéalement, vous disposez de connaissances fonctionnelles en environnement bancaire (banque d'investissement, de détail, en gestion d'actifs ou banque privée). Vous disposez de bonnes qualités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais et avez démontré votre capacité à échanger avec aisance avec différents niveaux de management dans ces deux langues. Une expérience à l'étranger serait appréciée. Par ailleurs, une connaissance des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Machine Learning constitue un atout. Le candidat doit pouvoir : Comprendre les principes des architectures d'IA (LLM, RAG, agents), Être capable d'identifier les principaux risques associés (biais, hallucinations, confidentialité, sécurité, dérive des modèles), Interagir efficacement avec les équipes data, IT, cybersécurité et métiers dans le cadre des missions d'audit. Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Notre vision est de jouer un rôle moteur dans les transformations positives du monde et de contribuer à un avenir plus écologique, respectueux de la planète ! Choisir Société Générale, c'est intégrer un Groupe où la culture d'entreprise est tournée vers l'inclusion, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe ! C'est construire une carrière dynamique avec la possibilité de changer de poste en moyenne tous les 4 ans, en France et à l'international tout en bénéficiant de formations régulières ! Au regard de vos compétences, une rémunération attractive revue annuellement, composée d'un salaire fixe, d'une part variable individuelle …

items.desc: Market Analyst Gaz Europe / LNG Global F/H À propos de nous (S&EM) Contexte Le Centre d’Expertise Market Analysis (MA) et la plateforme Gas Trading recherchent un(e) Analyste de Marché Gaz Europe / LNG Global . Le poste est basé au sein du trading floor, intégré à une équipe performante composée d’analystes de marché, de data scientists, de météorologues et de développeurs. L’analyste reporte au Responsable de l’équipe d’analyse des marchés gaz et LNG et couvre des horizons allant du day-ahead jusqu’à 3 à 5 ans. Market Analysis est un centre d’expertise au sein de S&EM. Sa mission est de produire des analyses de marché rigoureuses et exploitables afin d’éclairer directement les décisions commerciales et stratégiques d’ENGIE. L’équipe développe et maintient des modèles fondamentaux propriétaires, conçoit des outils quantitatifs et produit des visions de marché sur le gaz, le LNG, l’électricité, les quotas d’émissions, le pétrole et la météo. Elle se situe à la croisée de l’analyse fondamentale, de la data science et du trading. L’équipe Gaz et LNG accompagne les traders dans leur compréhension du marché européen du gaz et des dynamiques mondiales du LNG, en couvrant les équilibres offre-demande, les contraintes d’infrastructures, les moteurs de prix et les interactions entre commodités. L’équipe évolue dans un environnement de salle de marché exigeant : cycles de décision courts, enjeux financiers significatifs et haut niveau d’exigence analytique. Vos missions L’Analyste Gaz / LNG sera responsable de la production d’analyses fondamentales et de visions directionnelles de marché destinées à soutenir directement les stratégies de trading, en collaboration quotidienne avec les traders des desks Gaz et LNG. Au-delà de ces activités, l’analyste sera un partenaire clé pour l’ensemble des plateformes de trading ayant un intérêt significatif dans les marchés européens du gaz et mondiaux du LNG : trading électricité, desk APAC à Singapour, desk US à Houston ainsi que les bureaux en Italie, Espagne, Royaume-Uni, Australie ou Chili. Peu d’organisations offrent une empreinte géographique aussi étendue et une telle diversité de clients internes. Principales responsabilités Construire et maintenir des modèles d’équilibre offre-demande à court et moyen terme sur les marchés européens du gaz et mondiaux du LNG, en intégrant les données d’infrastructures, la météo, les stocks, la flexibilité de la demande et les interactions inter-énergies. Développer et porter des idées de stratégies de trading en collaboration avec les traders, depuis le cadrage analytique jusqu’au suivi de leur mise en œuvre. Suivre les évolutions de la chaîne d’approvisionnement mondiale du LNG (liquéfaction, transport maritime, regazéification, centres de consommation) et les traduire en recommandations exploitables pour les marchés. Produire des contenus d’analyse structurés (notes, tableaux de bord, présentations) à destination des traders, du management et des clients internes. Contribuer au développement de la plateforme de modélisation fondamentale de l’équipe en collaboration avec les data scientists et développeurs. Participer activement à la feuille de route d’intégration de l’intelligence artificielle : identification de cas d’usage à forte valeur ajoutée, prototypage d’outils analytiques et diffusion des meilleures pratiques. Collaborer avec les autres expertises analytiques (électricité, émissions, météo, origination) afin de construire des visions de marché cohérentes et intégrées. Ce que nous offrons Un poste au cœur de l’intelligence de marché gaz et LNG, avec une exposition quotidienne directe aux décisions de trading dans une organisation fortement intégrée aux actifs énergétiques. Une intégration au sein d’une équipe d’analystes expérimentés, reconnue pour la profondeur de son expertise et son esprit collaboratif. L’accès à des infrastructures de données propriétaires, à des sources de données externes de premier plan et à une gamme croissante d’outils analytiques enrichis par l’IA. Une réelle autonomie dans la conduite de vos sujets et le développement de vos axes de recherche. Une culture qui valorise à la fois la curiosité intellectuelle, l’ambition technique et la compréhension commerciale. De solides perspectives d’évolution vers des rôles d’expertise ou de management, en France comme à l’international. Bonne connaissance des marchés mondiaux du LNG : liquéfaction, transport maritime, regazéification, centres de demande et mécanismes de formation des prix. items.desc: Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, GLS France soutient l’égalité Femmes/Hommes et favorise l’insertion professionnelle, l’accès et le maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. ********************** CDI / Temps plein / Statut Cadre au forfait jour / Travail hybride 2 jours de Télétravail/semaine Poste basé à Toulouse au Siège Social ou à Paris (11ème - Nation) Rémunération forfaitaire annuelle brute sur 13 mois : à partir de 50 000 euros Avantages : Titres Restaurant, 10 JTL, Plan Epargne Entreprise, Mutuelle familiale, Prévoyance, Participation, CSE ********************** Qui sommes nous GLS France est un acteur majeur de la livraison de colis jusqu'à 30 kg en France, pour les entreprises (B2B) comme pour les particuliers (B2C, e-commerce). Elle appartient au groupe GLS, l'un des principaux réseaux indépendants de transport de colis en Europe. Elle a connu une forte croissance ces dernières années et affiche l'ambition d'atteindre le milliard d'euros de chiffre d'affaires d'ici 2031, appuyée par un plan d'investissement pluriannuel. L'intégration de la start-up Tousfacteurs (solutions logicielles et SaaS pour la livraison du dernier kilomètre) renforce sa dimension technologique et data, et le rachat de Relais Colis accélère la mise en œuvre de sa stratégie de livraison en point relais. Le contexte du poste L'équipe contrôle de gestion souhaite se renforcer, faire grandir son influence et couvrir plus de responsabilités (chiffre d’affaires, CAPEX, costing, analyse des marges, Out of Home deliveries, deep dives ad hoc…). L’équipe vise également à accélérer les délais de clôtures et à consacrer davantage de temps à l'analyse prospective et à l'aide à la décision. Le poste s'inscrit pleinement dans cette dynamique, avec un usage avancé de l'automatisation et de l'IA dans les travaux de reporting et d'analyse. Vos missions Rattaché(e) au Head of Controlling, vous pilotez la performance financière d'un périmètre et contribuez directement aux décisions de la direction. 1. Clôture et reporting Préparer les clôtures mensuelles de votre périmètre et analyser le P&L : réel vs budget, forecast mois et année précédents Construire les bridges de résultat (effets volume, prix, coûts) et en expliquer les écarts Contribuer au reporting groupe, en anglais, dans le respect des délais et des standards de qualité 2. Buget et prévisions Participer au budget annuel et aux re-forecasts, en lien avec les directions opérationnelles et commerciales Challenger les hypothèses et suivre les plans d'action 3. Analyse de la performance Analyser les coûts unitaires (coût par colis en collecte, livraison, transport, manutention), la productivité et la qualité du réseau Suivre les frais généraux, la masse salariale et les effectifs Analyser le revenu unitaire et la rentabilité par segment, client ou agence 4. Business partnering et aide à la décision Modéliser des business cases (investissements, sites, projets commerciaux) et formuler des recommandations Présenter vos analyses à la direction générale, au Comex et à la finance groupe, avec l’aide de l’équipe et de son directeur Accompagner les managers opérationnels dans la compréhension et l'amélioration de leurs résultats 5. Amélioration continue Fiabiliser et automatiser les processus de reporting (Excel, Power BI, IA) Proposer de nouveaux indicateurs et outils de pilotage Votre profil Vous avez 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion, FP&A ou audit, et l'envie d'avoir un impact visible sur les décisions d'une grande entreprise. Prérequis Diplôme d'école de commerce ou master en finance d'entreprise, contrôle de gestion ou audit 3 à 5 ans d'expérience sur poste(s) similaire(s) (contrôle de gestion, FP&A, audit financier) Français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'écrit comme à l'oral Excellente maîtrise d'Excel (modélisation, formules avancées) et de PowerPoint (présentations de synthèse) Pratique d'un ERP (SAP idéalement) et d'un outil de BI (Power BI ou équivalent). Atouts apprécié Intérêt pour le secteur de la logistique et du transport. Utilisation régulière de l'IA dans un cadre professionnel, ou forte envie de s'y former Business acumen : compréhension des leviers opérationnels et commerciaux derrière les chiffres Familiarité avec les notions de coût unitaire, de rentabilité par segment et d'analyse prix / volume Qualités personnelles Rigueur, sens de l'analyse et capacité de synthèse Aisance relationnelle et capacité à challenger des interlocuteurs opérationnels et seniors Autonomie, curiosité et goût pour l'amélioration des processus Ce que nous proposons Un rôle à fort impact, au contact direct de la direction, dans une entreprise en croissance adossée à un groupe international. items.desc: Pour un grand groupe bancaire français, nous recherchons un Ingénieur de Production DevOps / Cloud. Le poste comprend des astreintes 24/7 et des interventions en heures non ouvrées. Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership. items.desc: Geo: Europe Position: Full-time Experience: 5+ years in DevOps / infrastructure / SRE, 7+ preferred Flexible Location: Remote; hybrid or in office depending on the city Corporate Language: English Hours: Europe hours with US overlap. The role includes substantial on-call responsibility within a small team. Why this role exists Scientists spend a staggering amount of time wrangling data instead of running experiments. We build the AI-native platform that changes that: the system of record and the intelligence layer for R&D labs formulating everything from next-gen batteries to sustainable materials to alternative proteins. Our software doesn't just store lab data, it designs experiments, recommends formulations, surfaces insights, and automates the busywork that stands between a researcher and their next discovery. Alchemy is a multi-tenant enterprise ELN, LIMS, PLM and QC platform used by applied science companies in chemicals, materials and aerospace as well as all CPG categories. Our platform runs on AWS across multiple regions, including regulated environments. Core technologies include Terraform, ECS/Fargate and Aurora MySQL. You’ll help operate and modernize an established cloud platform, expanding Terraform coverage while maintaining existing CloudFormation infrastructure. The role combines ongoing production operations with improvements to reliability, automation, security and cost efficiency. What you'll do You’ll take end-to-end responsibility for infrastructure operations and improvement: Infrastructure as code. Expand and maintain Terraform coverage, safely bring existing resources under code management, diagnose configuration drift and maintain CloudFormation infrastructure as it is progressively modernized. Deployment and release pipelines. Own and improve GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, environment automation and regular releases across our cloud environments. Production reliability. Monitor and troubleshoot application infrastructure, databases, containers and networking. Handle incidents, improve observability and take substantial on-call responsibility as part of a small team. Cloud cost optimization. Improve cloud efficiency through right-sizing, capacity planning, resource lifecycle management and cost visibility. Customer-hosted deployments. Support deployments into customer-managed AWS environments and produce clear technical documentation for customer infrastructure and security teams. Security and compliance. Remediate infrastructure and dependency vulnerabilities, strengthen platform security and support audit evidence and compliance requirements. Internal tooling. Build and improve tools for environment management, deployments and operational visibility. Java or Vue expertise is not required, but practical automation and tool-building skills are essential.” Your impact You’ll help shape how we operate and improve the infrastructure behind an enterprise platform. Your work will improve deployment reliability, cloud efficiency, security and the day-to-day experience of our engineering teams. This is a hands-on role in a small team, with broad ownership across an established platform. You’ll balance infrastructure modernization with production operations, on-call responsibilities and substantial internal engineering support. Requirements Who you are Must have Terraform — modules, state, multi-environment and multi-region layout, and specifically import, state mv/rm, targeted applies, and diagnosing drift on infrastructure you did not create. AWS depth, not breadth — VPC and networking (peering, NAT, security groups, NACLs), IAM, ECS/Fargate, Aurora MySQL including Serverless v2, ALB/NLB, S3, Secrets Manager and SSM, CloudWatch, Lambda, Batch. CloudFormation you can author and deploy, not only read — legacy templates are still load-bearing here and will be for a while. CI/CD ownership — GitHub Actions and Jenkins, building and maintaining pipelines rather than consuming them. Bash and Python for automation, tooling and operational glue. Aurora MySQL operations — sizing and scaling, snapshots, clones and restores, failover, connection and pool behaviour, and reading a slow query. The application's schema is not yours to own. Incident discipline — scope by time window, form a hypothesis, prepare a rollback before you touch anything, write up what happened. Cost awareness as an engineering skill, not a finance report. AI-assisted engineering - Practical experience using coding agents, writing clear guidance for them and building automated checks around their output. Sound engineering judgment and human review of production changes are essential. Clear written English and the habit of documenting so someone else can operate it. Strongly preferred Multi-region operations (EU + US) and data-residency awareness. Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated cloud environments, including controlled access and operational requirements. Deploying a product into a customer's own cloud …

items.desc: Sviluppatore Firmware Embedded & IoT – Progetti AI e Smart Building Sede di lavoro: Trecate (NO) Azienda: T-LAB S.r.l. Contratto: Tempo pieno, preferibilmente a tempo indeterminato Retribuzione: Da definire in base alle competenze e all'esperienza Chi siamo T-LAB è un'azienda italiana specializzata da oltre 15 anni nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di sistemi elettronici per la sicurezza, la domotica e il controllo degli accessi. Progettiamo e sviluppiamo internamente le nostre soluzioni, combinando elettronica, firmware, tecnologie IoT e servizi cloud. Oggi vogliamo ampliare il nostro team tecnico con una persona appassionata di tecnologia, curiosa e desiderosa di contribuire allo sviluppo di una nuova generazione di prodotti intelligenti. Chi cerchiamo Cerchiamo uno sviluppatore firmware embedded , con conoscenza del linguaggio C/C++, da coinvolgere sia nell'evoluzione dei nostri prodotti sia nello sviluppo di nuovi progetti che integrano IoT, connettività e Intelligenza Artificiale. La figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con il nostro team tecnico, partecipando concretamente alla progettazione delle nuove soluzioni. Di cosa ti occuperai Sviluppo e manutenzione di firmware per schede elettroniche a microcontrollore. Programmazione in C/C++ per sistemi embedded. Sviluppo di applicazioni per dispositivi IoT, in particolare su piattaforme ESP32 o equivalenti. Implementazione di comunicazioni Ethernet, Wi-Fi e protocolli MQTT, HTTP/REST e JSON. Integrazione tra dispositivi elettronici, servizi cloud e applicazioni web. Test, debug e ottimizzazione dei prodotti. Supporto tecnico al team e, quando necessario, ai clienti. Partecipazione a progetti innovativi basati sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. Competenze richieste Conoscenza del linguaggio C/C++. Esperienza o formazione nella programmazione di microcontrollori. Conoscenza dei principali strumenti di sviluppo e debug. Comprensione dei protocolli di comunicazione e delle reti. Capacità di affrontare problemi tecnici in autonomia. Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e interesse per l'innovazione. Conoscenza della lingua inglese tecnica. Competenze che apprezziamo particolarmente Non è necessario possederle tutte, ma rappresentano un valore aggiunto: Esperienza con ESP32, STM32 e piattaforme embedded. Conoscenza di FreeRTOS, Linux e Python. Sviluppo di interfacce web con HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Esperienza con sistemi MQTT, API REST e piattaforme cloud. Conoscenza di Git e degli strumenti di versionamento del codice. Familiarità con Home Assistant, Node-RED o n8n. Conoscenza delle API di modelli di Intelligenza Artificiale. Interesse o esperienza nello sviluppo di agenti AI , automazioni intelligenti e integrazione fra AI e dispositivi IoT. Un'opportunità in più: AI e automazione intelligente Stiamo esplorando nuove soluzioni in cui i tradizionali sistemi di sicurezza, domotica e controllo accessi possano dialogare con piattaforme di Intelligenza Artificiale. Ci interessa sviluppare sistemi capaci non soltanto di ricevere comandi, ma anche di interpretare informazioni, interagire con dispositivi connessi e automatizzare attività attraverso agenti AI. Cerchiamo quindi una persona che abbia voglia di sperimentare queste tecnologie e contribuire alla loro applicazione in prodotti reali. Non chiediamo necessariamente esperienza già consolidata nell'AI: cerchiamo soprattutto curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e passione per lo sviluppo tecnologico. Titolo di studio Diploma di perito elettronico o informatico, laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica, Informatica o titolo equivalente. Valutiamo anche candidati con percorsi di formazione differenti, purché in possesso di competenze tecniche dimostrabili. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in una realtà italiana che sviluppa prodotti e tecnologie proprie. Coinvolgimento diretto nello sviluppo di nuovi progetti. Possibilità di crescita professionale e tecnica. Opportunità di lavorare su IoT, cloud e Intelligenza Artificiale. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e dinamico. Computer aziendale e strumenti di sviluppo. Retribuzione commisurata alle competenze. Possibilità di premi legati agli obiettivi. Perché scegliere T-LAB? Perché qui non sarai soltanto un programmatore chiamato a eseguire attività assegnate. Avrai la possibilità di seguire lo sviluppo di un prodotto, dall'idea iniziale fino alla sua realizzazione, contribuendo alle scelte tecniche e sperimentando nuove tecnologie. Se ti appassionano l'elettronica, la programmazione e l'Intelligenza Artificiale applicata al mondo reale, ci piacerebbe conoscerti. Invia il tuo CV a commerciale@tlab-srl.com , indicando nell'oggetto "Candidatura Sviluppatore Firmware & IoT". Entra a far parte del team T-LAB! Retribuzione: €1.400,00 - €1.800,00 al mese Benefit: Bevande gratis Mensa aziendale Parcheggio libero Sede di lavoro: In presenza

Administer feedback collection tools, crash-reporting software, and telemetry collection systems. Build feedback loop with Product Managers and QA to address UX and functionality gaps in future software updates and future products. Your Key Objectives Drive development excellence and surface quality risks by establishing an early validation process and producing usability and user preference reports based on data that support product decisions at critical development milestones. Scale our user testing community, by nurturing an engaged and representative beta tester pool that delivers continuous, high-value field feedback on unreleased products and software updates. Translate usability market insights into a software and physical prototype testing strategy to analyze user experience and establish user experience quality targets for future products. items.desc: A snapshot of your day As a Data Engineer in Finance, you build and run the data foundations and products that Siemens Energy Finance uses for reporting, analytics, automation and AI. Our team covers the whole landscape: platform and product delivery, from source systems to consumption. Depending on your strengths and our priorities, your focus can lean towards platform or delivery, source or consumption. You work closely with product owners, data architects, data governance and literacy specialists and Finance stakeholders. It is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who likes seeing their work used in production. How you'll make an impact Work across the platform (shared ingestion, integration and engineering foundations) and data product delivery (turning Finance requirements into production-grade products). Cover the full data flow, from integrating ERP and other source systems via ETL/ELT to well-modelled data for reporting, analytics and AI. Build maintainable transformations and data models with Snowflake, SQL, Python and dbt. Embed data quality checks, testing, observability and lineage into everything you deliver. Use Git (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) and CI/CD for controlled, repeatable deployments. Own your work end to end, from design to production operation, and fix recurring failures at their root cause. Align with product owners on scope and priorities, and share knowledge through documentation, reusable code and coaching. What you bring 5+ years in data engineering, building and operating production pipelines, platforms or data products. Strong hands-on skills in Snowflake, advanced SQL, Python and dbt. Practical experience with Git (e.g. GitLab, GitHub, Azure DevOps), CI/CD and automated testing. Sound knowledge of data modelling, database design and performance optimization. Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions and to fix production issues. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or a relevant apprenticeship. Nice to have: knowledge of Finance data and processes, semantic modelling, and practical AI skills (e.g. working with LLMs or AI-assisted development). items.desc: ITOM Financial Modeler & Value Case Specialist Role Overview The ITOM Financial Modeler & Value Case Specialist is responsible for building the financial baselines, business cases, cost allocation models, and investment roadmaps necessary to justify and fund IT operating model transformations. This role quantifies the financial impacts of platform restructuring, FTE reallocations, licensing rationalization, and automation/AI capabilities. Key Responsibilities IT Financial Baselining : Analyse current-state IT spend across global, regional, and local entities, categorizing run-the-business vs. change-the-business budgets, software platform costs, and vendor contracts. Transformation Value Case Modelling : Build quantitative financial models detailing one-off implementation costs vs. recurring savings generated by platform-based ITOM transitions. FTE Sizing & Allocation Analysis : Model team sizing, FTE transitions, and location strategy cost implications across business platforms, tech platforms, and central governance units. Transformation Roadmap & Initiative Prioritization : Build financial backlogs, sequence implementation initiatives based on ROI/impact, and establish value realization tracking metrics. AI & Automation Financial Impact : Quantify productivity boost potential and cost impacts of integrating AI/automation tools across the IT value chain. Key Deliverables Global IT Financial Baseline & Cost Pool Analysis ITOM Transformation Business Case & Financial Model (Capex/OpenX, ROI, Payback) FTE Sizing, Target Allocation & Location Costing Model Prioritized ITOM Implementation Roadmap & Initiative Financial Backlog Required Skills & Qualifications Experience : 5–8 years of experience in IT financial modelling, IT management consulting, IT finance (FinOps/TBM), or corporate IT strategy. Financial Modelling Skills : Advanced quantitative modeling capabilities in Excel/financial tooling (e.g., DCF, NPV, recurring vs. one-off cost impacts, FTE cost models). Domain Knowledge : Deep understanding of IT cost structures (cloud/infrastructure, platform licensing, application portfolios, external labor, shared services). Methodologies & Certifications : ITIL Foundation, PMI CAPM/PMP, Apptio/TBMA, or formal financial/policy qualifications. Education : Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Technology Policy, Physics, Engineering, or Business Administration.

items.desc: 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time. Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034. About the role: We are looking for back-end engineers to join our product teams in Stockholm. Rather than hiring for one specific seat, we are hiring for the group. Survey & Design owns the steps where we capture data about a customer's home and turn it into a tailored, carbon neutral energy solution. There is real modelling work here, along with third party integrations that bring in geometric and climate data we have to transform into something our own model can use. Expansion takes the product into new markets and improves how customers convert. New market launches, pricing, conversion flows, solar PV output modelling, and the next generation of our heat pump product. Every new market brings its own rules, and the backend is where most of that lands. Some have dedicated front-end and back-end engineers, others are full-stack across the board. So there is a real home here for a backend specialist, and in the smaller teams there is always the possibility to dip your toes in the web frontend or even our apps if you want to. We will be straight with you about which team is which. Nice to have: Experience at fast-growing companies Experience with gRPC and tRPC Kafka or Kotlin Writing front-end code in React Experience with Kubernetes, Docker or Terraform Our tech stack includes Java (Spring Boot), gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, TypeScript, React, NextJS, tRPC, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform. This is an exciting opportunity to join the Met Office on a 12-month Year in Industry placement, commencing at the start of July 2027, developing your skills and knowledge and ensuring you gain the most value possible from your experience with us. You will have the opportunity to network with our cohort of Industrial Placements all over the Met Office and understand what career opportunities are on offer at the Met Office after you graduate. We’re looking for Observations Research & Development Industrial Placement to help us make a difference to our planet. As our Observations Research & Development Industrial Placement, the job may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in the office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non-contractual arrangement and the location advertised will be your contractual place of work. As an Industrial Placement, we would expect you to attend the office once a week as a minimum. Our opportunity is full time, 37 hours per week. Our people are at the heart of what we do and we'll do our best to agree a working pattern that works for everyone. World changing work From science to technology, from meteorology to management, and from planning to communication, our expertise helps us stand out as the authority on weather accuracy and climate prediction. We help individuals, industries and government to make better decisions to stay safe and thrive. This is the Met Office. This is who we are. We’re a force for good - focusing on our environmental and social impact We’re experts by nature - always learning and developing to do things better We live and breathe it - putting our purpose at the heart of decision-making We’re better together - understanding partnerships and inclusivity make us greater We keep evolving - pushing boundaries to make tomorrow better for our customers Your world of expertise Our Industrial Placement scheme offers ambitious and capable undergraduates the opportunity to gain valuable experience working alongside diverse and highly skilled experts in their field.
