You’ll be working in the Observations Research & Development team to support the application of scientific research to enhance our Observations Capability. This will involve working on data to contribute to protecting our weather radar network from interference from wind turbines. You will be part of a wider team exploring engineering and data-processing solutions to this real-world challenge. There may also be opportunities to engage in work on other observations networks. Your key duties Work with observations scientists, radar specialists and network protection experts to evaluate case studies of real-world impacts to the radar network. Apply geospatial, statistical and visualisation techniques to a variety of datasets to extract meaningful information and metrics. Develop knowledge and skills associated with observations network analysis. Produce regular technical verbal and written briefings for internal colleagues on the findings and recommendations. We are also featured on their ‘Best Workplaces in Tech’ 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 lists, as well as their ’54 Best Workplaces for Women’ 2023 list. However, this is not guaranteed and would be subject to programme availability and a successful application. items.desc: deltaflare is the UK's specialist in Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity for Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) operators. We deliver NIS2 and CAF compliant protection across gas, electricity, water, renewable technology and transport networks — the systems that keep the country running. We work where IT meets industrial reality: inside control rooms, substations and treatment works, helping CNI operators navigate the unique challenges of securing hyper-connected physical systems without disrupting the operations that millions of people depend on. OUR MISSION To enable the safe and cyber secure operation of hyper-connected industrial systems. OUR VISION A world where essential services can deliver digital transformation with confidence, built on a solid cyber-physical security foundation. OUR VALUES We innovate with purpose, focusing on solutions that can be adopted safely and at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Product Solutions Engineer in deltaflare’s Product team, you’ll be the technical anchor between Product, Engineering, Assurance and our customers and partners. You’ll turn what we build into solutions that CNI operators, OEMs and MSPs can buy, deploy and rely on, and make it quick and repeatable for them to get onto phoenix, our SaaS platform for secure remote access, real-time monitoring and compliance reporting. At the heart of the role, you’ll own how phoenix is packaged and released for customers. You’ll build and maintain a controlled, versioned set of standard deployment configurations, and own the technical release gate into Assurance. Once a release passes your gate, our Assurance team independently tests and approves it before it reaches customers. By owning the build, you’ll keep the product roadmap moving and give our customers a stable, repeatable platform. You will report to the Head of Product and Enablement, based in Richmond with travel to customer and partner sites. You’ll take released software from Engineering, hand releases to Assurance, join Sales early in customer and partner conversations, help OEM and MSP partners deploy and support phoenix, and feed customer insight back to Product. You’ll work directly with the people who built phoenix and with some of the UK’s largest infrastructure operators. This is an early-stage role on a fast-growing product. As our pre-sales, customer success and solutions functions grow, you’ll help shape how they work and set the standard for how phoenix is built, released and explained. WHAT YOU'LL DO Your main accountabilities — what you will own and be responsible for delivering. Own our standard deployment configurations ▸ Turn released software and infrastructure capabilities into controlled, customer-ready deployment configurations. ▸ Build and maintain versioned, parameterised configurations, offered as products. ▸ Design configurations that customers, OEMs and MSPs can reuse across their sites with minimal set-up. ▸ Build and troubleshoot containerised apps, including Docker Compose, startup dependencies, networking and resource limits. ▸ Maintain configurations across development, pre-production and customer environments. ▸ Keep customer-specific builds as the exception, agreed with the Head of Product and Enablement. Own the release gate into Assurance ▸ Catch mismatched versions, missing parameters, risky app combinations, and settings that look valid but are wrong, such as a bad IP range or routing. ▸ Review test evidence and decide whether a release is ready to enter Assurance. ▸ Hold a release when configuration or evidence is incomplete, and explain why clearly. ▸ Treat the gate as a readiness check, never as a replacement for Assurance testing. Run controlled change ▸ Manage tagged releases and Git-based reviews. ▸ Compare configurations between versions and environments. ▸ Write release notes, with an auditable reason for every change. Be the technical voice with customers and partners ▸ Join discovery with CNI operators, OEMs and MSPs to understand their sites, assets and requirements. ▸ Design and cost solutions with the client, captured as a defined configuration with clear acceptance criteria. ▸ Help clients build the case for funding and plan their internal rollout. ▸ Bring technical input to quarterly business reviews that supports each customer’s success story. ▸ Get new customers, OEMs and MSPs onto phoenix quickly and repeatably, delivering training and working with Assurance at go-live. ▸ Train customer and partner teams during rollout so they can configure, deploy and run phoenix with confidence. ▸ Run demos that explain both what phoenix can do and its limitations. ▸ Feed customer insight back to Product to shape the roadmap. items.desc: Applications are welcomed for this exciting opportunity to lead the Maudsley’s National and Specialist CAMHS DBT Service. We are one of the most established DBT-A programmes in the UK and in addition to our core clinical offer we also provide training, consultation and supervision to other programmes and CAMHS clinicians. We are research active with a particular focus on adapting DBT for minoritized groups and developing and evaluating novel, DBT-informed interventions for young people and parent/carers that can be offered as early interventions. The successful candidate will provide clinical and operational leadership for the DBT team and these various activities and will also have opportunities to work with the N&S CAMHS Senior Leadership Group on wider organisational developments and to contribute to shaping a culture of collective leadership within the directorate. The successful candidate will support the day-to-day operation of the DBT service. As the clinical lead you will be responsible for ensuring fidelity to the evidence-based DBT model, promoting adherent practice within the team, as well as holding a small caseload of DBT clients. Along with the other senior clinicians in the service, you will provide senior cover across the week by being available when team members require consultation and guidance on managing complex clinical dilemmas relating to risk and safeguarding concerns. You will also lead on certain service developments, evaluations and research and provide training, supervision and consultation to DBT-A programmes and CAMHS colleagues nationally. You will be responsible for monitoring programme outcomes and ensuring Trust performance targets are met. You will also work with the Senior Management Team to ensure the service operates within its budgetary requirements. You will need to have considerable experience of working within a DBT programme at a senior level and an ability to provide effective supervision and support around complex clinical and workforce challenges. You will demonstrate an ability to build strong relationships both within and outside of the team that foster collaboration, respect, and problem-solving of team and organisational dilemmas. You will have a passion for fostering team wellbeing and culture and a capacity to balance consultation to the team with a more directive approach. The National & Specialist CAMHS Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) Service is a well-established and supportive team based at the Michael Rutter Centre, Maudsley Hospital. The multi-disciplinary team of DBT Therapists consists of Clinical Psychologists, a Senior Systemic Psychotherapist, Nurses, a Social Worker, Clinical Psychologists in Training and an Assistant Psychologist. We also have in- house support from a Consultant Psychiatrist and a Higher Trainee Psychiatrist. The service accepts referrals within South London and Maudsley NHS Foundation Trust, Greater London Boroughs and nationally. As a service we offer an intensive psychological assessment and treatment programme, including weekly skills groups for adolescents and parents/carers. Young people aged 13-17 years, with a history of self-harm and suicidal behaviour and difficulties with emotion regulation are eligible for the programme. The service also offers trauma-focused interventions where needed for those who are able to complete the first stage of DBT and we regularly treat young people with other clinical comorbidities. DBT is a NICE guideline recommended evidence-based therapy. DBT has been shown to be effective with clients with self-harm and suicidal behaviours and symptoms associated with emotion dysregulation. Job Purpose: To develop strategy for and lead, manage and plan the delivery of a highly specialist psychological therapy service and personally provide expert clinical input. To be responsible to the relevant professional lead for the monitoring and implementation of professional standards in the practice of psychological therapy in the service and for the systematic and effective provision of professional supervision. To contribute to enabling other staff, service users and carers from diverse backgrounds to flourish by working to create a psychologically safe environment. To ensure the conduct of research, service evaluation and audits relevant to the service and the research agenda To be develop standards for and take a lead in ensuring the good clinical governance, quality and appropriateness of the work of psychological professionals in the service.

Greater Manchester is one of the world's most innovative, original and exciting places to live and work. From the beauty of the surrounding countryside to the heart of the vibrant inner city with great shopping, entertainment and dining options. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a part-time or full-time appointment as an Educator working within the Community Resilience department at SECAmb. The department is seeking to embed educational support for volunteers within the three geographical divisions of Kent, Surrey and Sussex, with a 0.5 whole time equivalent (WTE) in each. The post will therefore suit an individual who wishes to work part time within one of the divisions, or full time whilst supporting two divisions – note that post-holders will work as part of a team to ensure volunteers across the Trust are supported, and therefore may also work outside their allocated division(s) as needed. The portfolio includes Community First Responders, Chaplains, our four Retirement Associations, Community Guardians and Public Access Defibrillators (PAD). There will also be involvement in providing education and support to members of the public, particularly regarding Basic Life Support / CPR training and Automated External Defibrillator familiarisation. Reporting to the Community Resilience Manager, you’ll be immersed in all areas of work in this fast-paced and focused department. The post holder will plan and facilitate the delivery of training and mentoring to all grades of staff (including volunteers) and support individual staff with their development as necessary. To do this, they will ensure their own competency by maintaining the necessary standards defined by the Trust. This role will include acting as the first point of contact for candidates undertaking educational programmes being delivered; and escalating any concerns to the responsible programme lead for the programme being delivered. You will need a flexible approach to meet the needs and demands of volunteers and the public, which at times will include working evenings and weekends in agreement with your line manager. You may also need to travel across the Trust (business expenses paid in line with Trust policy). Option to join NHS pension scheme A minimum 27 days' holiday each year, increasing after 5 years’ service. Personal and professional development and training opportunities. Salary Sacrifice schemes for cars or push bikes. Access to occupational health and counselling services. Award winning wellbeing hub Access to NHS discounts, offering NHS employees a range of money-saving deals. Other than in exceptional circumstances, the starting salary for staff new to the NHS will be the bottom point of the band to which they have been appointed. This is an exciting opportunity to help equip volunteers and their wider communities with the confidence and skills to save lives. As part of our Community Resilience team, you will deliver engaging educational programmes to our network of volunteers to ensure they have the skills and confidence needed to undertake their roles. Programmes included induction courses for new volunteers, mandatory training and annual updates to volunteers already in post, and a programme of Continuing Professional Development and support training to maintain interest and support personal development. Alongside commitments to our volunteers, you will deliver training such as CPR familiarisation and other educational programmes to members of the public to support the Trust’s aim of creating resilient communities who are confident to save lives. Through coaching, mentoring and quality assurance, you will help ensure volunteers are confident, well supported and able to deliver high-quality care in emergency situations. You will support non-patient-facing volunteers with delivering courses to the public, and ensure they are empowered to deliver consistently high quality education. Working across a variety of community settings, you will plan and deliver training sessions, assess learners, provide constructive feedback and ensure every course is delivered to a consistently high standard. You will work closely with colleagues and external partners to coordinate training activity, maintain course logistics and continually improve the quality of our educational programmes. items.desc: About the role: The AVP of Product Management, Private Markets is a versatile and entrepreneurial product leader responsible for cross-cutting platform capabilities that serve multiple private markets asset classes — including private equity, private credit, real assets, and multi-strategy funds. This individual owns loan product areas that span the horizontal layers of our platform: data infrastructure, fund analytics, cross-asset reporting, workflow automation, and emerging capabilities such as AI-assisted due diligence and document intelligence. The AVP will operate at the intersection of loan processing and management, investment operations, technology and business strategy, making this an ideal role for a product manager who thrives in a fast-moving, high-complexity environment. Working closely with CRPM Product, technology, operations and data teams, the successful candidate will explore how data from loan management platforms such as WSO, Versana, Siepe and others can be integrated with CRPM, identify opportunities for bi-directional connectivity and translate complex operational requirements into scalable client solutions. The role requires someone who can balance multiple stakeholder needs while getting into the detail of data and workflows, challenging manual processes and defining practical, reusable integration patterns. This role requires hybrid work model (at least 4 days in the office per week). Key responsibilities: Define and deliver the roadmap for horizontal platform capabilities supporting private markets loan asset classes, including core data services, cross-fund analytics, workflow automation and API-based integration capabilities. Develop a detailed understanding of relevant third-party loan platforms and data structures, including WSO, with particular focus on loan and asset records, security and reference data, income and accruals, positions, reconciliations, cash movements and projected cash flows. Assess how loan data can be consumed and utilised within CRPM, identifying opportunities for bi-directional connectivity that improve data quality, operational efficiency and the client experience across both State Street-serviced and client-hosted environments. Work hands-on with data to validate mappings, identify gaps and exceptions, and translate business and data concepts into clearly defined product, data and engineering requirements. Define and drive the CRPM loan data model and taxonomy, establishing how fund, deal, asset, transaction and investor-level entities relate across the platform and ensuring consistency across workflows, analytics and reporting. Identify high-friction and manual loan-processing activities and develop opportunities for automation, straight-through processing and exception-based workflows. Drive the development of cross-asset portfolio analytics, including exposure and concentration analysis, diversification, performance attribution and analysis across fund vintages. Work with current and potential clients to define standard client analytics and dashboard requirements by combining WSO and other relevant servicing data with accounting ledger, security master, loan reference and transaction-level information. Partner across WSO, CRPM Product, Technology, Operations, Architecture and client-facing teams to validate use cases, prioritise opportunities and move solutions from discovery and concept through to delivery. Define and own strategic approach to integrations with third-party loan servicing and data providers, establishing reusable integration patterns and a scalable blueprint that can support CRPM's broader private markets strategy. Lead agile product delivery, maintaining a prioritised backlog, facilitating appropriate product and agile ceremonies, and working with engineering teams to deliver product increments against agreed outcomes. Define product success measures and appropriate reporting to track adoption, data quality, operational efficiency and business impact, using these insights to inform subsequent product priorities. Document target-state integration architecture, key data flows, priority use cases, product requirements and recommended roadmap, creating a practical foundation for continued development following the WSO secondment. Support the Head of Product and wider Product leadership in strategic planning, OKR development, roadmap prioritisation and cross-functional alignment. What we value : Required skills and qualifications: 5+ years of experience working with loan products within financial services, fintech, or enterprise software — with meaningful exposure to private markets or asset management. Solid understanding of private markets operations across multiple loan asset classes, including fund structures, capital deployment workflows, valuation processes, and investor reporting cycles. Manchester Metropolitan University Library & Cultural Services is seeking an ambitious and innovative Digital Librarian to join our Digital Services team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in developing and enhancing the systems, platforms and services that underpin access to our library, cultural and research collections. As we continue to transform our digital services and explore new opportunities through emerging technologies, AI and automation, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, working collaboratively and using technology to improve the experience of students, researchers and staff. About us Library & Cultural Services supports teaching, learning and research across the University and holds a rich and diverse range of collections, including Library resources, Special Collections, the Poetry Library and the North West Film Archive. We are delivering ambitious plans to modernise our systems and services, ensuring our digital services remain innovative, sustainable and responsive to changing user needs. As part of one of the UK's largest universities, you will join a collaborative and forward-looking team, working alongside colleagues across Professional Services and cultural heritage sectors to create exceptional digital experiences for our community. About the role Reporting to the Digital Services Manager, you will play a key role in the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the platforms, systems and services that support discovery, access and engagement across Library & Cultural Services. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the development and management of library and cultural services systems, digital platforms, websites, applications and databases. Leading the delivery and continuous improvement of electronic resources and digital collections to ensure reliable and seamless access. Contributing expertise in areas such as metadata, discovery services, websites and digital content management. Using data, user insight and UX approaches to inform decision making and improve services. Exploring opportunities to use emerging technologies, AI and automation to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency. You will also contribute to projects that support strategic priorities across Library & Cultural Services, helping to shape the future of our digital infrastructure and ensuring services remain accessible, user-focused and aligned to the needs of teaching, learning and research. About you You will be an experienced library or information professional with a strong interest in digital services, systems and technologies. You will enjoy analysing problems, identifying opportunities for improvement and working collaboratively with a wide range of colleagues and stakeholders. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate: Experience of working with library or cultural services systems, discovery platforms, repositories or related digital services. Enthusiasm for innovation and the potential of new technologies to transform library services. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. A commitment to delivering excellent customer service and continuously improving the user experience. Most importantly, you will be excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of digital library and cultural services within a large and ambitious university. items.desc: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. We're rethinking security beyond traditional military domains, addressing asymmetric threats that impact our technological advantage, economic strength, and democratic institutions. We build Acra – the platform foundation for everything we do as a dual-use technology company. The platform’s name, rooted in the Greek word for citadel (or, fortress), reflects the design and purpose of our infrastructure-agnostic secure enclaves: protecting critical data. Some of the government and commercial workflows include: increased operational resiliency for mission-critical systems and functions; enabling organisations to more quickly and widely adopt emerging technologies while ensuring the integrity of their intellectual property; information flow during disaster response scenarios, and zero-trust / least-privilege environments for M&A, attorney-client privileged communications, etc. And we’ve only scratched the surface. At our core, we're driven by a shared mission and a belief in making a tangible impact on our world. Whether you join our London HQ or the wider global organisation, you’ll be a part of collaborative, high-performing teams, creating cutting-edge software, platforms, and infrastructure. The Role As an AI Harness Engineer at Valarian, you will own the experimental design, evaluation methodologies, and benchmark infrastructure for our AI models and autonomous agentic workloads. In an emerging domain with no standard playbook, you will serve as the bridge between rigorous data science, statistical validation, and production agent scaffolding. You will design robust evaluation datasets, architect calibrated LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and build metrics that accurately capture multi-step agent performance under non-deterministic conditions. Your insights and error analyses will directly drive iterative improvements to our harness scaffolding, tool orchestration, and system safety guardrails. What you’ll do: Architect Evaluation Runtimes & Harnesses: Design and maintain scalable Python evaluation harnesses that measure task completion, trajectory quality, tool-use correctness, cost, latency, and variance across multi-step agentic systems. Design Experiments & Validate Results: Apply rigorous statistical methods—including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, bootstrapping, and power analysis—to determine whether performance changes are true system improvements or stochastic noise. Build & Calibrate LLM-as-a-Judge Pipelines: Develop automated judging systems validated against human ground truth. Measure alignment using agreement metrics (Cohen’s kappa, correlation, precision/recall) and systematically detect judge failure modes such as position bias, verbosity bias, self-preference, and prompt sensitivity. Curate Benchmark Datasets & Rubrics: Define sampling strategies, detailed annotation guidelines, and scoring rubrics. Measure inter-annotator agreement and manage label noise to ensure benchmark integrity over time. Deep Error & Trajectory Analysis: Conduct hands-on failure analysis on agent runs, cluster root causes into actionable error categories, and clearly communicate findings to both engineering teams and stakeholders. Drive Harness Scaffolding Iteration: Translate evaluation results directly into architectural improvements across agent scaffolding, prompt design, tool execution loops, context window compaction, retries, and safety guardrails. What we are looking for: Grounding in Statistics & Experimental Design: Demonstrated expertise in hypothesis testing, bootstrapping, power analysis, and statistical significance within probabilistic machine learning systems. LLM-as-a-Judge Validation: Proven experience building, auditing, and validating LLM judge setups against human annotations, including tracking agreement metrics and mitigating judge biases. Evaluation Dataset Engineering: Strong track record designing evaluation datasets, crafting precise scoring rubrics, managing label noise, and measuring inter-annotator agreement. Evaluation of Non-Deterministic Multi-Step Systems: Deep comfort evaluating complex agent trajectories, tool execution sequences, latency, cost, and variance across repeated runs rather than relying solely on single-shot benchmarks. Metric Design & Integrity: Exceptional judgment in defining metrics tied to real-world outcomes, with a keen eye for detecting benchmark gaming, target drift, or shortcut learning. Rigor in Error Analysis: Ability to dissect complex execution logs, categorize failure modes, and synthesize clear, data-driven recommendations. Hands-On LLM Integration: Practical proficiency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and retrieval systems in Python. Haptiq combines technology, AI, data, and domain expertise to help organizations scale operational excellence, make better decisions, operate more efficiently, and generate alpha across complex enterprise environments while delivering measurable business value. About the Role We’re looking for an innovative AI Engineer to join our AI team and help design, prototype, and operationalize advanced AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, MCP services, and agentic workflows. You’ll work closely with Python Developers and MLOps Engineers to bring AI-powered features from concept to production. Develop AI-powered services using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and Haystack. Implement model validation strategies, including cross-validation, A/B testing, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Experience with prompt optimization tools is a plus. A curious, experimental mindset with a passion for testing emerging AI tools and frameworks. items.desc: Agentic AI Engineer: Rare Disease Drug Discovery 📍 Germany | Full-time The opportunity A fast-growing AI-driven biotech is building the next generation of drug discovery, focused on rare diseases. Most of the thousands of known rare conditions still have no approved therapy. This company brings together AI, large-scale biomedical data and deep pharmacology expertise to find new treatments faster and at lower cost than traditional R&D. They’re now hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to design and build the LLM-powered agents behind their discovery platform. Your work will directly shape which therapeutic ideas move forward for patients who currently have no options. What you’ll be doing Designing and building LLM agents that help scientists generate, prioritise and justify testable therapeutic hypotheses Working with drug discovery scientists to understand their real problems, and judging where an agentic approach adds value and where it doesn’t Connecting agents to a biomedical knowledge graph, in-house analytical methods and the scientific literature so they reason over the right evidence Extending and maintaining the existing suite of GenAI tools as the team’s needs and the wider ecosystem evolve Helping set up evaluation, testing and quality standards for agentic systems Writing clean, well-tested, well-documented Python that others can build on The setup An established Python-based agentic framework is already in place, with workflows in production You’ll report to senior technology leadership and work alongside the technical lead for agentic infrastructure You’ll sit in a cross-functional team of ML engineers, software engineers, bioinformaticians, drug discovery scientists and clinicians There’s clear scope to take ownership of workflows and grow your influence over time Your first six months By month 3: You know the framework and the scientific problems it serves, you’ve shipped your first contributions, and you’re turning scientist feedback into improvements. By month 6: You’ve taken at least one agentic workflow from concept to a production tool used in the discovery pipeline, and you’re owning workflows end to end. What you’ll bring 2+ years’ experience as a software engineer or ML engineer A track record of building and shipping LLM-based agentic systems in production, including tool use, multi-step orchestration and reliable behaviour Strong Python and solid engineering fundamentals Hands-on knowledge of the modern LLM stack: model APIs, prompting, tool calling, RAG, MCP, agent frameworks and evals Enjoyment of working closely with non-technical colleagues to understand what they need Nice to have Experience in drug discovery, biology or another life sciences field Experience with knowledge graphs or reasoning over structured and mixed data sources Experience building evaluation harnesses or test strategies for LLM systems A habit of getting up to speed quickly in unfamiliar domains A genuine interest in techbio and patient impact Why apply? You’ll do meaningful, technically challenging work at the frontier of agentic AI, where the output can change outcomes for underserved patient groups. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-led team that values learning and ownership. If you don’t tick every box but the role excites you, apply anyway.

items.desc: wailand baut eine agentische KI-Plattform für das Engineering im Maschinenbau. Sie läuft bereits produktiv bei Industriekunden. Unser Ziel: Engineering radikal neu denken und die Industrie in Europa technologisch stärken. Jetzt bauen wir aus: tiefere Integration in CAD, PLM und ERP, Knowledge Graph, Laufzeitumgebung für Agents und die Agenten-Architektur selbst. Du entwickelst die KI-Bausteine der Plattform, und das in zwei Welten. Klassische KI leitet aus CAD-Modellen und 2D-Zeichnungen semantische Informationen ab: Geometrie, Features, Maße, Toleranzen. LLM-basierte Komponenten arbeiten auf diesem Kontext: Retrieval, Tool-Calling, Agents. Entscheidend ist nicht, welches Modell du einsetzt, sondern ob das Ergebnis beim Kunden verlässlich stimmt. Deshalb gehört Evaluierung bei uns zur Entwicklung, nicht an ihr Ende. Auch du entwickelst agentisch: Agents schreiben und reviewen den Code, du konzipierst, steuerst, prüfst und gibst frei. Was du bei uns machst Du entwickelst Verfahren, die aus CAD-Modellen, 2D-Zeichnungen und Stücklisten semantische Informationen ableiten: Geometrieanalyse, Feature Recognition, eigene Modelle. Klassische KI, nicht nur LLMs. Du überführst diese Informationen in unseren Knowledge Graph und machst sie für Agents nutzbar. Du entwickelst LLM-Komponenten für die Plattform: Retrieval-Architekturen, Tool-Calling, Agent-Workflows mit State Management und Guardrails. Du entscheidest je Aufgabe, welches Modell passt, Frontier-Modell, lokales LLM oder ein klassisches Verfahren, und begründest das mit Messwerten. Du baust Prüfstände, die Modelle und Agent-Flows gegen Referenzergebnisse messen, und verankerst Evaluierung im Entwicklungsprozess. Du bringst KI-Komponenten in den produktiven Betrieb: skalierbar, reproduzierbar, in der Cloud und OnPrem, auch mit lokalen Modellen. Du arbeitest agentisch: Du beschreibst Aufgaben, steuerst Coding-Agents, reviewst und gibst frei. Du entwickelst unseren Harness mit, vor allem dort, wo Evaluierung und Modellauswahl Teil der Entwicklungsumgebung werden. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Software Architect, den Software Engineers und den Fachleuten aus dem Maschinenbau zusammen, damit die KI zu echten Engineering-Daten passt. Was du mitbringst Must-have Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Machine Learning oder AI Engineering und hast Modelle in produktive Systeme gebracht. Du beherrschst Python und das übliche ML-Ökosystem (zum Beispiel PyTorch, scikit-learn) und kennst klassische Verfahren jenseits von LLMs. Du hast LLM-basierte Komponenten gebaut (RAG, Embeddings, Tool-Calling, Agents) und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du evaluierst systematisch: Datensätze, Metriken, Benchmarks, Regressionstests für Modelle und Prompts. Du arbeitest bereits mit Coding-Agents (zum Beispiel Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) und willst Software konsequent so bauen. Du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Prompts, und gibst direktes Feedback. Nice-to-have Du hast mit Geometriedaten, CAD-Formaten oder technischen Zeichnungen gearbeitet (zum Beispiel STEP, DXF, Zeichnungen als PDF). Du hast lokale LLMs selbst gehostet und optimiert: Quantisierung, Fine-Tuning, Inferenz-Setups. Du kennst Knowledge Graphs, Ontologien oder Graph-Datenbanken. Du hattest Berührungspunkte mit dem Maschinenbau oder mit Engineering-Systemen (CAD, PLM, ERP). Du hast Software OnPrem bei Industriekunden betrieben. Rahmen Dortmund oder Heilbronn, hybrid: Remote ist möglich, bevorzugt treffen wir uns ein- bis zweimal pro Woche im Büro. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch konversationssicher. So entwickeln wir Der Mensch macht bei uns das, worauf es ankommt: die technische und fachliche Konzeption, die Steuerung der Agents, den Prüfumfang und die Freigabe des Release. Die Entwicklungsumgebung dafür, unseren Harness, bauen wir selbst und entwickeln ihn ständig weiter. Wer bei uns entwickelt, denkt KI also doppelt: als Werkzeug im eigenen Arbeitsalltag und als Bestandteil des Produkts. Tech-Stack Python (FastAPI, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV), Java, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Postgres, Vektor-Datenbanken, Graph-Datenbanken, Langchain, LangGraph, Frontier-Modelle (Anthropic, OpenAI) und lokale LLMs (Open-Source-Modelle, selbst gehostet), Claude Code und weitere Coding-Agents, eigener Harness für agentische Entwicklung. Bewerbung Kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns an career@wailand.io , was du gebaut hast, worauf du stolz bist und wo deine Erfahrung zu dieser Stelle passt. Ein paar Sätze reichen für den Anfang. Mehr über wailand, unsere Arbeitsweise und das Team auf unserer Karriereseite.

Véritable catalyseur d’innovation, la FARNum réunit une équipe agile et pluridisciplinaire, dont la mission première est de déployer et industrialiser des solutions numériques à forte valeur ajoutée. L’ADN de la FARNum repose sur une approche résolument pragmatique et orientée résultats. À travers une organisation flexible, l’équipe privilégie la rapidité d’exécution et la création de valeur immédiate, tout en s’adaptant aux besoins concrets du terrain. La FARNum est organisé en 3 pôles : Affaires et projets FAST AI IT Data Ops L’équipe Data OPS de la FARNum porte la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des cas d’usage Data et IA, depuis le cadrage technique du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production, en s’appuyant sur une approche industrialisée, sécurisée et à valeur. Dans ce cadre, l’équipe Data OPS cherche un.e Data Scientist qui concrétisera l’implémentation et l’usage de l’IA performante et industrielle pour répondre aux besoins métiers mais aussi aux enjeux de la DivNum. Missions principales : Implémenter et améliorer la démarche Data pour les cas d’usage : diagnostic des données, collecte et redressement, valorisation et intégration. Identifier les usages d’IA dans les projets métiers dès la phase d’instruction et de cadrage et évaluer leur faisabilité technique et conformité vis-à-vis des standards groupe en amont de tout engagement. Concevoir avec les architectes et les référents technique les architectures de solutions IA de bout en bout : frameworks, choix de l’infrastructure et des modèles, base de données, patterns, exposition, monitoring, alerting, gestion des risques et des dérives. Déployer, optimiser et piloter les produits Data et IA en production, en anticipant les contraintes de performance, de robustesse, de maintenabilité et de coût. Assurer la veille technologique IA et le partage des connaissances au sein de la FARNum et de la DivNum. Mettre en place et diffuser les bonnes pratiques (DataOps,MLOps), le code review, la capitalisation technique ainsi que l’usage de l’IA générative pour les ingénieurs data. Profil souhaité : 6 ans d'expériences minimum en conception, développement et déploiement de projet Data en production Expertise en analyse Data (diagnostic des données, cartographie des sources de données, collecte, mise en qualité). Expertise en modèles IA, Machine Learning et IA générative (LLM, RAG, Agents, Prompts). Expertise en python, SQL et NoSQL, écosystème GitHub, conteneurisation, développement d'API. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (qualité de code, tests, documentation) et de déploiement CI/CD. Bonne connaissance des architectures cloud (GCP, AWS) et on premise ainsi que des patterns de déploiement Data IA. Bonne connaissance de la méthode de travail Agile. Autonomie, sens de la pédagogie, fort esprit d’équipe, de proactivité et de partage. Rémunération attractive selon profil : Rémunération brute annuelle de bas hors primes : de 46 à 57K€, selon diplôme et expérience professionnelle. Package global comprenant : prime individuelle de performance, intéressement et épargne salariale. Avantages selon conditions d’éligibilité : tarif préférentiel sur l’électricité et le gaz, aides aux familles et à la parentalité, dispositifs de mobilité durable, activités sociales et culturelles…. Avantages à nous rejoindre : Un job varié et intéressant Télétravail 2 jours par semaine Une équipe à taille humaine Formation spécifique à la prise de poste et tout au long de la carrière Des possibilités d’évolution au sein du Groupe EDF Dans le groupe EDF, accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap fait partie de notre ADN. Notre objectif est d’ouvrir nos portes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Le poste proposé est donc ouvert à toutes et à tous.

items.desc: Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Bei NEURA Robotics führen kognitive Roboter nicht einfach nur Befehle aus. Sie nehmen wahr, denken, planen über lange Zeithorizonte und handeln autonom in der physischen Welt. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben HUB.KI ist die neueste Ausgründung der JAAI Group – eine souveräne KI-Plattform, auf der Unternehmen KI-Assistenten, digitale Mitarbeiter und automatisierte Workflows erstellen, teilen und produktiv einsetzen. items.desc: Deine Position und Dein Impact Du willst KI nicht nur in Demos sehen, sondern dort, wo sie Menschen den Arbeitstag leichter macht? Dann mach, was Du liebst – bei uns. Als Software Engineer AI bringst Du KI zu unseren Kund*innen. Du baust Features, die in einer gewachsenen Software wirklich ankommen: skalierbar, sicher und so, dass man sie gern benutzt. Dein Spielfeld sind AWS, Bedrock und alles, was ein Agent so braucht. Wie Du dabei vorgehst, entscheidest Du mit Deinem Team. Ihr diskutiert offen, probiert Neues aus und findet gemeinsam die beste Lösung. „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht“ hörst Du bei uns nicht. So entsteht eine Software zum Mitgestalten – in einem Team zum Wohlfühlen. Das sagt André, Software Engineer AI: “An meinem Job gefällt mir besonders die Freiheit, die neuesten Technologien auszuprobieren, Architekturentscheidungen mitzugestalten und vor allem für unsere Kund*innen mit neuen, sicheren und skalierbaren Features echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.” Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Du machst aus KI echte Features: Du bindest KI-Services und -Tools von AWS in unsere bestehende Systemlandschaft ein und bringst AI-native Features von der ersten Idee bis zu unseren Kund*innen. Du baust Dinge, die halten: Deine AI-Cloud-Anwendungen laufen stabil und skalieren mit – auch dann, wenn alle gleichzeitig klicken. Du fühlst Dich im ganzen Stack zu Hause: Im Backend arbeitest Du mit Java 21, Quarkus und dem AWS CDK, im Frontend mit TypeScript und React. Dazu kommen IntelliJ IDEA, Git und Maven. Du redest mit, wie gebaut wird: Das „Wie“ gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deinem Team. Ob AI-Architektur, Cloud-Design oder nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Deine Meinung zählt und Du tauschst Dich regelmäßig mit allen Entwickler*innen aus. Du sorgst für KI mit gutem Gewissen: Du setzt Data-Governance-Richtlinien um und achtest darauf, dass wir Daten und Modelle verantwortungsvoll einsetzen. Dein Profil Vorweg: Niemand erfüllt jede Zeile einer Stellenanzeige. Wenn Du Dich im Großteil wiederfindest, bewirb Dich. Das bringst Du mit: Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre in der Java-Entwicklung gearbeitet, gern im Backend von SaaS-Produkten. Realitätssinn: Du hast AI-Systeme schon in bestehende, gewachsene IT-Landschaften integriert. Greenfield ist schön, Bestandssysteme sind echt. Du kennst beides. AI-Know-how: Du hast praktisch mit RAG-Architekturen gearbeitet, verstehst agentische KI-Systeme und bringst ein solides Machine-Learning-Grundverständnis mit. Schnittstellen: REST und GraphQL sind für Dich kein Neuland, verteilte Systeme auch nicht. DevOps-Mindset: CI/CD, Monitoring (CloudWatch, Prometheus), Docker und Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. Terraform, CDK) gehören zu Deinem Werkzeugkasten. Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und fühlst Dich auch auf Englisch wohl. Wenn Du das auch noch kannst, freuen wir uns doppelt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore oder vergleichbare Agent- und LLM-Runtime-Plattformen AWS (Bedrock, S3, Lambda, ECS, RDS) oder Erfahrung mit vergleichbaren Cloud- und LLM-Plattformen MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling und die Anbindung externer APIs an Agenten LLM Observability und LLM Security Und vor allem: Du bist neugierig auf angewandte AI und probierst neue Tools gern aus. Du packst Dinge selbst an, behältst den Überblick und übernimmst Verantwortung, auch dann, wenn ein Produkt noch in den Kinderschuhen steckt. Das erwartet Dich bei uns! Sicherheit, die nicht stillsteht – Du bekommst eine unbefristete Stelle bei einem Arbeitgeber, der seit über 10 Jahren wächst und trotzdem lieber Neues ausprobiert, als sich auszuruhen. Ein faires Gehalt – Faire Bezahlung ist für uns selbstverständlich: Kein Vollzeitgehalt bei uns liegt unter 50.000 € brutto im Jahr, und mit Deiner Erfahrung wächst es mit. Als Professional Software Engineer bieten wir Dir ein Gehalt von 5.000€-6.000€ brutto/ Monat. Als Senior Software Engineer ein Gehalt von 6.000€-7.500€ brutto/ Monat. Gemeinsam wachsen – 10 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr gehören Dir. Ob neues AI-Framework, Zertifizierung oder Konferenz: Du nutzt sie für das, was Dich weiterbringt. Offene Türen, kurze Wege – Flache Hierarchien und transparente Entscheidungen. Hast Du eine Idee, sprichst Du direkt mit den Menschen, die sie umsetzen können. Eigenverantwortung – Du gestaltest Deine Arbeit selbst und bringst Deine Ideen aktiv ein. Ein Büro, in das Du gern kommst – Stylische, klimatisierte Büros in Würzburg mit neuester Technik. items.desc: Description ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will help deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with subject matter experts to frame questions, analyse evidence and deliver findings. This is a hands-on technical and consulting role: you will discuss needs with specialists, present approaches and results to varied audiences, and contribute to proposals. You will join an established team and work across technically diverse projects. What You Will Do Speak with subject matter experts and clients to define the problem, success measures, data needs and an appropriate analytical approach. Prepare and analyse data, develop and evaluate models or prototypes using statistical methods, forecasting, machine learning or language models where suitable. Present findings, assumptions and limitations to subject matter experts, clients and nontechnical audiences, invite challenge and adapt the work to their feedback. Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines to document work, make results reproducible and develop promising prototypes into reliable solutions. Contribute technical ideas, estimates and evidence to proposals, and manage your work across several concurrent projects. Share methods and reusable approaches with colleagues across the data science team. What You Will Bring Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data. Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures. Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks. Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing. Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use. Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field. Useful Additional Experience Experience working in public policy, government, research or evaluation Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment. Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills. items.desc: Karriere13. Oktober 20261 Min. Lesezeit Du willst KI-Anwendungen bauen, die im Unternehmen wirklich genutzt werden, statt Demos, die nach der Präsentation verschwinden? Als KI-Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du bei ALGEBRA in Stuttgart LLM- und RAG-Lösungen für den Mittelstand: von der Wissenssuche über interne Dokumente bis zu KI-Agenten, die in bestehende Systeme eingreifen. Und zwar so, dass Datenschutz, Berechtigungen und Nachvollziehbarkeit von Anfang an stimmen. DAFÜR KANNST DU DICH BEGEISTERN Konzeption und Entwicklung von RAG-Systemen: Dokumentenaufbereitung, Chunking, Embeddings, Hybrid-Suche und Reranking. Entwicklung von KI-Agenten, die über Schnittstellen und das Model Context Protocol (MCP) mit ERP, CRM, Dateiablagen und Datenbanken arbeiten. Betrieb offener Sprachmodelle im Rechenzentrum des Kunden oder in deutschen Clouds, wenn Daten das Haus nicht verlassen dürfen. Aufbau von Evaluierung und Monitoring: Antwortqualität messen, Halluzinationen erkennen, Kosten und Latenz im Blick behalten. Umsetzung von Berechtigungskonzepten bis ins Retrieval und Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen aus EU AI Act und DSGVO. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen unserer Kunden, vom ersten Workshop bis zum produktiven Betrieb. DAS MACHT DICH AUS Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python, idealerweise auch mit Java, Kotlin oder TypeScript. Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen in Produktion, nicht nur mit Prompts im Chatfenster. Kenntnisse in Vektordatenbanken wie pgvector, Qdrant oder Milvus und in Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex. Du weißt aber auch, wann man sie besser weglässt. Erfahrung mit Docker, REST-APIs und CI/CD, idealerweise auch mit Kubernetes oder Azure. Ein ehrlicher Blick auf Grenzen: Du sagst einem Kunden auch, wenn ein Problem keine KI braucht. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, denn du sprichst direkt mit Kunden. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Projekte mit echten Daten: Du siehst, wie deine Lösung im Alltag des Kunden ankommt. Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege, du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die die Lösung bauen. Gestaltungsspielraum bei Architektur und Werkzeugwahl, ohne Vorgaben aus einer fernen Konzernzentrale. Zeit und Budget, um neue Modelle und Werkzeuge auszuprobieren, bevor sie beim Kunden landen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten mit Büro in Stuttgart und individuelle Weiterbildung. Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung an bewerbung(at)algebra-ec.de. Ein Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem KI-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist, reichen uns für den Anfang. Woran du bei uns konkret arbeitest, zeigt unsere Seite zu KI-Beratung und RAG-Systemen. Alle offenen Stellen findest du auf der Karriereseite. items.desc: Rejoignez une équipe d’experts engagés et passionnés ! Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des solutions numériques ? Si vous avez une passion pour la technologie, l'innovation et une expertise solide d’accompagnement sur des problématiques et enjeux d’architecture technique, alors nous avons une place pour vous au sein de notre équipe SII Méditerranée et plus largement du Groupe SII. Le rôle du Froward deployed AI Engineer ? Transformer les workflows clients en solution IA concrètes, adoptées et créatrices de valeur. Votre mission: Intervenir au plus près des équipes clientes pour comprendre leurs processus, identifier les cas d’usage IA à plus forte valeur, construire les solutions adaptées — agents, chaînes agentiques, assistants, automatisations — puis accompagner leur déploiement jusqu’à l’obtention de résultats mesurables. Le FDE est à la fois capable de prendre de la hauteur sur un problème client et de descendre dans le code pour le résoudre. Analyser les workflows & prioriser les use cases Comprendre les activités réelles des équipes : développement, test, maintenance, support, documentation, knowledge management ou processus métier. Identifier les irritants, tâches répétitives, pertes de temps et opportunités d’augmentation ou d’automatisation. Prioriser selon la valeur, la faisabilité, le risque, le coût et le potentiel de productivité. Définir le bon niveau d’automatisation : assistance, agent spécialisé, workflow multi-agents ou automatisation supervisée. Construire & Intégrer Prototyper rapidement puis industrialiser les solutions qui démontrent leur valeur. Concevoir des workflows agentiques mêlant agents, humains, outils, données et systèmes existants. Intégrer APIs, bases de connaissances, repositories de code, outils métiers et chaînes CI/CD. Mettre en place sécurité, observabilité, évaluation, traçabilité et points de contrôle humain.. Transformer le delivery & accélérer l’adoption : Redéfinir avec les équipes la répartition du travail entre humain, assistant et agent. Accompagner développeurs, QA, Tech Leads et métiers dans les nouveaux workflows. Faire émerger des patterns réutilisables, bonnes pratiques et quality gates. Faire passer les équipes du POC à l’usage quotidien et à l’autonomie. Mesurer La Valeur Produite Définir une baseline et mesurer gains de temps, capacité, délai, qualité et adoption. Suivre le coût réel des modèles, plateformes et infrastructures. Identifier rework, review et supervision induits par l’IA pour distinguer gain brut et gain net. Documenter les REX afin d’alimenter la capitalisation et les benchmarks AI for Delivery. Vous ne serez pas seul pour déployer les solutions. Il apporte l’impulsion, la capacité de conception et de construction, puis aide les équipes à prendre progressivement le relais. Vous êtes ingénieur logiciel / AI Engineer, avec une expérience confirmée et concrète dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions basées sur l’IA générative. Vous maîtrisez notamment Python et/ou TypeScript/JavaScript , l es LLM, les architectures RAG et les systèmes d’agents IA . Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des solutions allant au-delà du simple POC, avec une vraie logique d’intégration et d’utilisation opérationnelle. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons une personnalité : à l’aise dans les échanges avec les clients ; capable de comprendre et challenger un besoin métier ; autonome, pragmatique et orientée solutions ; capable de passer rapidement d’un problème à un prototype puis à une solution utilisable ; attentive à la valeur et à l’impact réel des solutions développées. 👉 Votre différence ? Vous aimez autant comprendre le problème du client que mettre les mains dans le code pour le résoudre. Hard Skills Développement solide en Python et/ou TypeScript / JavaScript. LLMs, APIs de modèles, prompt & context engineering, tool/function calling. Agents et orchestration : LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel ou équivalent. RAG, embeddings, vector databases et knowledge management. MCP, intégration d’outils, APIs REST, webhooks et architectures événementielles. Évaluation des LLM/agents, observabilité, tracing, monitoring, gestion du coût et FinOps IA. RBAC, least privilege, gestion des secrets, sandboxing et sécurité des systèmes IA. Git, CI/CD, containers et pratiques de Software Engineering / DevSecOps. Une expérience cloud ou plateforme IA d’entreprise est un plus. De Montpellier à Saint Tropez, SII Aix Méditerranée accompagne des acteurs majeurs comme Airbus Helicopters, Thales DIS, Naval Group, ASF, Monext, Schneider Electric ou CMA CGM dans leurs projets d’ingénierie et de transformation digitale. items.desc: Job Description Mindset We are seeking a Data Scientist with a growth mindset and passion for turning data and AI into measurable business value. This individual thrives in cross-functional environments, acts as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, and champions a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning. Passionate about using data science, Artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to improve decision-making, customer experiences, and business outcomes. Acts as a catalyst for AI adoption, helping teams identify opportunities, build capabilities, and embed data-driven ways of working. Fully engaged with the Company's mission, demonstrating strong ethics, curiosity, collaboration, and commitment to patient and business impact. Key Responsibilities Partner with business teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver data science, segmentation and AI use cases that generate measurable business value. Design, develop, and deploy advanced analytics, machine learning, GenAI, and predictive solutions to solve critical business challenges. Translate complex business needs into scalable data products, insights, models, and AI-enabled solutions. Act as an AI enabler by promoting adoption of AI technologies, educating stakeholders, facilitating experimentation, and driving responsible AI practices. Develop prototypes, proofs of concept, and minimum viable products (MVPs) to accelerate innovation and validate business opportunities. Leverage modern data platforms, cloud technologies, machine learning frameworks, and generative AI capabilities to improve efficiency and effectiveness across business processes. Collaborate with data engineers, data teams, commercial functions, and business leaders to ensure solutions are sustainable, scalable, and aligned with strategic priorities. Communicate analytical findings and AI opportunities clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, enabling informed decision-making. Foster a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, experimentation, and innovation across the organization. Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI standards. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Business Intelligence, or related fields. Hands-on experience across the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data exploration, preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and value measurement. Experience with Generative AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), AI copilots, AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or similar emerging AI capabilities. Strong programming skills in Python and/or R, with experience in SQL and modern data science frameworks and libraries. Experience translating business opportunities into analytical and AI solutions while managing stakeholder expectations and driving adoption. Consulting, communication, and change management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across different levels of the organization. Experience identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing innovation opportunities using data automation and AI technologies. Knowledge of cloud analytics environments and AI platforms (Azure, Databricks, AWS, GCP, or equivalent) is preferred. Ability to work in agile, cross-functional teams and lead initiatives that drive organizational change and capability building. Fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken. Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. items.desc: Contexte L'intelligence artificielle générative et les agents IA transforment progressivement les usages au sein de Renault Group. Afin d'accompagner leur déploiement à grande échelle, le Centre of Excellence AI développe des méthodologies, des outils et des plateformes permettant d'évaluer, de suivre et d'améliorer en continu les performances des agents IA tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d'études pour contribuer à la structuration et à l'industrialisation des processus d'évaluation des agents IA, depuis leur développement jusqu'à leur monitoring en production. Vos missions Au sein du Centre of Excellence AI, vous participerez à la mise en place d'un cadre commun d'évaluation des agents IA. Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes Cartographier et analyser les processus d'évaluation existants au sein des différentes équipes. Agréger, comparer et synthétiser les méthodes, outils et bonnes pratiques déjà en place. Concevoir et contribuer à l'implémentation d'une plateforme commune d'évaluation et de monitoring des agents IA. Travailler sur les jeux de données d'évaluation et explorer les mécanismes permettant leur mise à jour automatique ou semi-automatique en liens avec les évolutions de la vérité terrain. Collecter, analyser et comparer les métriques utilisées dans l'entreprise pour mesurer la qualité, la robustesse et la performance des agents IA. Participer à la définition de recommandations et de standards d'évaluation pour les futurs développements et leur application aux agents déjà en production. Réaliser une veille sur les frameworks et méthodologies d'évaluation des systèmes d'IA générative. Profil recherché Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou Master 2 avec une spécialisation en Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, NLP (Natural Language Processing), Data Science ou Informatique. Connaissances des technologies d'IA générative : LLM, NLP, RAG, agents IA et techniques d'évaluation associées. Solides compétences en Python et en développement de solutions Data & IA. Conaissances des framework de création d'agent en python (ADK, Langgraph...). Intérêt marqué pour les problématiques d'évaluation, de qualité et d'industrialisation des systèmes d'IA. Capacité d'analyse, esprit de synthèse et autonomie. Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel. Compétences appréciées Expérience avec des frameworks d'évaluation de LLM et d'agents IA (Ragas, Vertex AI Gen AI evaluation service, ...). Connaissance des problématiques de monitoring, d'observabilité et de gouvernance des systèmes IA. Familiarité avec les pipelines de données et les mécanismes d'automatisation. Connaissances de l'environnement cloud GCP. Ce que vous apprendrez Les enjeux de gouvernance et d'industrialisation de l'IA à l'échelle d'un grand groupe. Les mise en pratique d'évaluation des agents IA en production en liens avec des impératifs métier. La conception de plateformes de monitoring et d'observabilité pour les systèmes d'IA générative. La définition de métriques et de standards permettant d'améliorer la qualité des solutions IA déployées en production. La collaboration avec des experts IA, Data Science et Software Engineering sur des cas d'usage stratégiques pour Renault Group.

items.desc: About Searchable Searchable is an agentic marketing platform built for the age of AI search. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews have transformed how people discover information. Brands now need to measure and optimise their visibility across all of the major AI search engines. We help companies grow their organic presence across SEO, AEO, and GEO through a fully agentic platform that identifies opportunities, recommends actions, and automates improvements with Searchable’s AI agent. We’re at $5M ARR in just 10 months, backed by top angels and VCs, and building the team that will define the category. We’re office-based five days a week near London Bridge. If you thrive in a startup culture where people put in hours because they love solving hard problems and taking radical ownership, you'll fit right in. The Role Strategy: Guiding clients (medium to enterprise), understanding strategies, growth, KPIs, roadmaps - identifying gaps in their current strategies against core competitors and providing clear explanations and detailed roadmaps to cover these. Analysis: Analysing prompts, mentions and citations of businesses - translating these into insights and then building actions on how to capture market share for customers. Research: Deep, detailed insight into AEO and understanding why / how LLMs favour websites over others, translating this into actionable insights. Product Specialist: Assist sales on demos with setup of the platform, leading significant parts of these calls and showing potential clients their visibility gaps and highlighting improvements. Product development: Finding product gaps, translating them into tickets and working with development / engineering teams to build this into the product (with proper due diligence) to understand how these will benefit our customers. To emphasise, this is an AI role - not an SEO role. You will be expected to operate at the forefront of AI and its role in Search. You will take everything you've learnt about SEO and upgrade it to function in an AI-native world. We expect you to bring expert-level knowledge of our industry, using this to drive measurable results for large and important companies. You will be expected to find your lever, understanding AI and using this to your advantage to work faster and smarter. What You'll Be Doing Strategy & Client Delivery Owning SEO and AEO strategy for a portfolio of medium to enterprise clients, from audit through to roadmap and ongoing optimisation. Identifying gaps in client visibility across traditional search and AI surfaces, translating these into prioritised, actionable plans. Running client calls, QBRs and strategic reviews with confidence and authority. Building and maintaining clear documentation: roadmaps, recommendations, reporting frameworks and competitive benchmarks. This is consultative, high-touch work. You will be the primary strategic contact for your accounts and expected to operate with the credibility and rigour that enterprise clients demand. But you will also do the work, and will be expected to learn how to leverage your time and scale upwards. Analysis & Insight Analysing how brands, products and topics surface across AI models - tracking prompts, mentions, citations and sentiment. Translating raw data into clear insight: what's happening, why it matters and what to do about it. Benchmarking client visibility against competitors across both traditional SERPs and AI-driven discovery environments. Building repeatable analytical frameworks that can scale across the client base and feed into product development. You should be as comfortable in a spreadsheet as you are in a strategy deck. The ability to move between data and narrative is essential. Research & Thought Leadership Conducting deep research into how LLMs retrieve, rank and surface information - understanding the mechanics behind AI visibility. Staying ahead of how AI search behaviour is evolving across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and emerging platforms. Contributing original thinking to Searchable's methodology and knowledge base. Your research will directly shape how we advise clients and build product. Translating complex AI and search concepts into clear, compelling explanations for clients and internal teams alike. This is a space where the playbook is being written in real time. Your curiosity and depth of understanding will be a competitive advantage - for you and for us. Product & Platform Supporting sales and go-to-market by leading platform demos, setting up client environments and showcasing visibility gaps to prospective customers. Identifying product gaps through your day-to-day client work and translating them into well-scoped tickets for engineering. Working closely with Product and Engineering to ensure new features solve real client problems, with proper due diligence on use cases and expected outcomes. Collaborare con i team di sviluppo per integrare le soluzioni AI nei sistemi applicativi dei clienti. Conoscenza delle API di OpenAI, Anthropic e Azure OpenAI e delle principali piattaforme open source come Hugging Face, Ollama e vLLM. Esperienza con database vettoriali (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Milvus, Qdrant o equivalenti) e tecniche di embedding. Familiarità con metodologie MLOps/LLMOps e con il ciclo di vita delle applicazioni AI. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Spiccata attitudine al problem solving, curiosità tecnologica e propensione all'apprendimento continuo.  CortAIx est la nouvelle entité du groupe dédiée à l'innovation en IA de défense. Cette initiative reflète l'ambition de Thales d'améliorer significativement l'analyse de données et la prise de décision dans des contextes critiques, en répondant à des exigences élevées de cybersécurité, d'embarquabilité et de frugalité.

Cette démarche s'inscrit dans la vision à long terme de Thales pour une IA transparente, explicable, et éthique, affirmant son rôle de pionnier dans le développement de solutions embarquables et sécurisées répondant aux enjeux de souveraineté et de sécurité de ses clients.

items.desc: Descrizione del lavoro Il Gruppo E è alla ricerca di un AI Delivery Specialist Junior che sia in grado di supportare il team AI e cresca fino a gestire in autonomia parti crescenti dei progetti per clienti enterprise, in ambiti diversi: manifatturiero, retail, fashion, media, pubblica amministrazione, sport. La figura, in collaborazione con i colleghi e con il responsabile, si occuperà di garantire qualità e continuità alla delivery dei progetti AI affiancando il Delivery Lead sullo sviluppo, sul rapporto con i clienti e sulle attività di formazione. La persona si occuperà delle seguenti attività: partecipare alla realizzazione delle soluzioni AI: configurazione della piattaforma, sviluppo di assistenti e agenti, basi di conoscenza (RAG), integrazioni con i sistemi del cliente; supportare le fasi di PoC, test, rilascio e messa in produzione; gestire attività di manutenzione, troubleshooting e miglioramento continuo sui progetti già in esercizio; redigere e mantenere aggiornata la documentazione tecnica e di progetto; partecipare a riunioni di avanzamento, raccolta requisiti e workshop con i referenti di business e IT; collaborare con la prevendita nel passaggio dalla proposta alla realizzazione; supportare la preparazione e l'erogazione di sessioni formative sull'AI per i clienti, di livello base e avanzato: materiali, esercitazioni, demo affiancare gli utenti nell'adozione degli strumenti dopo il rilascio (onboarding, Q&A, supporto) Il candidato ideale risponde ai seguenti requisiti: Laurea in ambito STEM (Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o affini) o esperienza equivalente; 0-3 anni di esperienza in ambito IT, sviluppo o consulenza tecnica; buona conoscenza di Python; familiarità di base con i modelli linguistici (LLM) e con i concetti di prompt engineering, RAG e agenti; conoscenza di base di API REST, formati dati (JSON) e database; buone capacità di comunicazione, orale e scritta, e attitudine al contatto con il cliente; italiano madrelingua o equivalente, inglese buono (documentazione tecnica e riunioni) Rappresentano un valore aggiunto le seguenti caratteristiche: esperienza pratica su progetti o prototipi con LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, modelli open source, framework come LangChain o simili); conoscenza dell'ecosistema Microsoft (Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot); nozioni di Docker, ambienti Linux e deploy on-premise; esperienza in attività di formazione, tutoring o presentazioni pubbliche; interesse per i temi di governance e sicurezza dell'AI (AI Act, protezione dei dati); esperienza pratica su progetti o prototipi con LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, modelli open source, framework come LangChain o simili); Vantaggi dell'azienda e benefit aziendali Offriamo: Un inquadramento retributivo commisurato all'effettiva seniority, CCNL Commercio 14 mensilità Inserimento in ambiente dinamico in un settore innovativo e in costante crescita Flessibilità oraria e smart working per una migliore conciliazione vita/lavoro Ticket restaurant da 8,00 €/giorno Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa per visite specialistiche Asset necessari all’espletamento dell’attività lavorativa Opportunità di crescita professionale e costante training grazie alla collaborazione e a piani di incentivazione personalizzati Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico con area relax per favorire la socializzazione e il benessere dei dipendenti

items.desc: Technical Architect (DPO) Paris, Île-de-France Job Summary Solution Architect Role Overview As a Solution Architect – Agentic AI , you will lead the design and implementation of enterprise-grade Agentic Automation solutions within the client environment. You will architect systems where AI agents, robots, and humans collaborate seamlessly , enabling adaptive, intelligent, and scalable business processes. This role goes beyond traditional RPA to deliver autonomous and semi-autonomous enterprise workflows powered by UiPath’s Agentic Automation platform. Ensure solutions are Scalable, Secure and Governed Delivery Oversight Oversee full lifecycle: Design Development Testing Deployment Hypercare Review critical components including Agent logic, Workflow orchestration, Exception handling strategies Ensure alignment between business intent and technical execution . Client Engagement & Advisory Act as a trusted technical advisor to client leadership. Drive adoption of Agentic AI architecture patterns . Conduct demos, technical workshops, and blueprint sessions. Team Leadership Lead and mentor developers and architects. Enable teams to build agent-driven automation solutions . Promote knowledge sharing and capability building. Skill Requirements What You’ll Bring Experience 10+ years in IT with strong development background 5+ years in UiPath / RPA / Intelligent Automation architecture Experience leading teams and delivering enterprise automation programs Agentic AI & Technical Expertise Deep expertise in UiPath platform, including: Orchestrator RE Framework Document Understanding AI Center Apps, Insights, Action Center Strong understanding of: Agentic Automation principles Multi-agent systems Human-AI collaboration patterns Programming & Integration Strong coding skills (C#, VB.NET, Python preferred) Experience integrating: APIs Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP) Enterprise applications (SAP, Citrix, Mainframe) AI & Emerging Tech Exposure to: Generative AI Machine Learning workflows OCR and cognitive automation Ability to embed AI-driven decisioning into workflows Certifications UiPath Certified Professional – Solution Architect UiPath Agentic Automation Associate Certification Other Requirements

items.desc: Vos Challenges Votre mission, en tant que Consultant Expérimenté Forward Deployed Engineer F/H consiste à : Vous accompagnez de grands groupes et ETI dans la définition et le déploiement de solutions Data & IA à fort impact. À la croisée des enjeux métier et technologiques, vous transformez des problématiques complexes en cas d’usage concrets créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle et vos domaines d'intervention : - Comprendre les enjeux métier des clients, animer des ateliers de découverte, de cadrage et de priorisation, puis identifier les opportunités de création de valeur grâce à la Data et à l'IA. - Concevoir et développer rapidement des prototypes et MVP autour de solutions Data, d'IA prédictive et générative afin de valider les hypothèses métier. - Faire le lien entre les décideurs métiers, les équipes produits, les architectes, les data engineers et les experts IA tout au long du cycle de vie des projets. - Travailler directement avec les utilisateurs finaux et accompagner les équipes clientes afin de favoriser l'adoption et l'impact des nouveaux usages Data & IA. - Contribuer à des programmes de transformation ainsi qu'au développement des accélérateurs, assets et offres Data & IA de KPMG. Vos principales missions et responsabilités : - Mener des investigations terrain pour analyser les processus, les points de friction et les opportunités d'automatisation ou d'augmentation, puis traduire les besoins identifiés en solutions Data & IA pragmatiques et mesurables. - Présenter et défendre auprès des interlocuteurs métier la pertinence des analyses réalisées et des options envisagées. - Définir les critères de succès, mesurer la valeur générée et piloter les itérations nécessaires à l'amélioration continue des solutions. - Accompagner l'industrialisation des solutions validées en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et d'architecture. - Produire des recommandations stratégiques, des supports de restitution et des présentations à destination des sponsors clients. - Assurer une veille sur l'IA et les technologies émergentes afin d'enrichir les approches proposées. Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience sur des projets Data, IA, développement logiciel, Product Management ou transformation digitale. Vous avez déjà travaillé au contact direct des métiers et êtes capable d'échanger avec des interlocuteurs aussi bien business que techniques. Vous disposez d’une expérience pratique dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de produits logiciels, de solutions Data ou d’architectures Data. Une expérience en cabinet de conseil, startup technologique ou environnement d'innovation constitue un atout. Vous justifiez de l’utilisation de l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel. Compétences techniques : Bonne maîtrise de Python et des principaux frameworks de développement Data, IA et logiciel. Connaissance des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel Connaissance pratique des technologies d'IA générative : LLM, RAG et AI Agents. Expérience dans le développement rapide de prototypes et de solutions orientées utilisateur. Bonne compréhension des architectures cloud modernes (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et des plateformes Data & IA. La maîtrise de technologies telles que Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric ou équivalent est appréciée. La connaissance des méthodologies Agile, Product Discovery et Design Thinking constitue un plus. Soft skills : Excellent sens de l’analyse et forte capacité à structurer/vulgariser des sujets complexes. Goût prononcé pour la construction rapide de solutions ("builder mindset"). Curiosité intellectuelle et passion pour les technologies émergentes. Forte orientation impact et création de valeur métier. Capacité à évoluer avec autonomie dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution. Excellentes capacités de communication, d'animation d'ateliers et de présentation auprès de dirigeants. Esprit entrepreneurial, pragmatisme et prise d'initiative. N’attendez plus ! Rejoignez un environnement d’apprentissage stimulant, où vous évoluerez au contact d’experts et aurez l’opportunité de contribuer à des projets innovants au cœur des enjeux Data de demain.
