items.desc: Key Highlights: Job Title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Location: Paris, hybrid working Reporting to: Engineering Lead Salary: Up to €70k DOE About Us SaleCycle is redefining how brands convert, engage, and retain customers through AI-driven experiences across the entire customer journey. SaleCycle combines real-time onsite personalisation and intent scoring with offsite activation across email, SMS, and paid channels, enabling brands to identify, engage, convert, and re-engage customers with precision. What we do We provide a full-funnel Agentic Marketing Platform, combining: Real-time behavioural analytics and intent scoring AI-powered search, recommendations, and agentic decisioning Onsite personalisation and A/B testing Cross-channel activation (email, SMS, paid media) CRM/CDP integrations and first-party data orchestration Retail media and monetisation capabilities Who we are We are a global team of 80+ people across the UK, France, Spain, Italy, and Eastern Europe. We are profitable, growing, and operating with a clear mindset: We build, not maintain We prioritise outcomes over activity We operate with low ego and high accountability We challenge ourselves to step outside our comfort zone Our Values At SaleCycle, we care about people; it’s our top priority. We prioritise well-being, growth, and innovation, continuously pushing boundaries as a team and a company. Continuous Innovation: Collaborate, innovate, and celebrate! Premium Execution: Excellence Delivered Every Time! High Curiosity: Embrace your inner child - ask why and listen! Proactive Collaboration: United, we work together and lead the way! Ultimate Passion: Infuse passion into every action! Job Summary As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you'll join a highly collaborative, agile, empowered product delivery team building the SaleCycle platform that powers AI-driven personalisation, intent scoring, and cross-channel activation for e-commerce brands. This is a full-stack role for someone who wants genuine full-stack range rather than staying purely on one side of the stack. You’ll work primarily in your strongest language, shipping features end to end across our React front end and our C#/.NET and Go backend services, with real opportunity to grow into our other core languages over time. We’re flexible on the exact combination. What matters most is the shape: real depth on one side of the stack, solid hands-on experience on the other, and a genuine curiosity to keep learning, comfortable being a generalist rather than a specialist. We’re open to candidates matching any of these profiles: Profile A - Strong C#/.NET background, hands-on experience with React/TypeScript, and keen to learn Go Profile B - Strong Go background, hands-on experience with React/TypeScript, and keen to learn C#/.NET Profile C - Strong React/TypeScript background, working knowledge of C#/.NET or Go, and keen to deepen your backend skills You’ll be joining a small, cross-functional engineering team spanning France and the UK, in an engineering organisation that is still taking shape following the SaleCycle × BEYABLE merger, a great opportunity to influence how we build, not just what we build. Key Responsibilities Shipping features end-to-end across our stack: React/TypeScript front end, C#/.NET and Go backend services Designing and building services and APIs within a multi-tenant SaaS architecture serving e-commerce customers at scale Building clear, responsive UI that surfaces analytics, intent scoring, and decisioning outputs to our brands and internal teams Working across the API boundary to shape clean, well-documented contracts between front-end and backend services Growing your skills in the languages outside your current comfort zone, with support and pairing from the team Writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code following industry best practices (e.g., SOLID principles, testable design) Collaborating within an agile, Scrum-driven team, participating in sprints and planning sessions Contributing to automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring of production systems Engaging in peer code reviews and sharing knowledge across our France and UK teams Essential Skills & Experience Around 6 years of professional software engineering experience Deep, hands-on expertise on one side of the stack in production: C#/.NET or Go on the backend, or React/TypeScript on the frontend Solid, hands-on experience on the other side: React/TypeScript for backend-led profiles, C#/.NET or Go for frontend-led profiles Genuine interest in working across the stack and learning new languages Comfortable in a fast-moving, still-forming engineering organisation post-merger A pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and evolving standards Familiar with git or other distributed source control systems Nice to Have Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems Familiarity with cloud platforms, ideally Azure or GCP Interest in AI-assisted development …

items.desc: Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace Your role at Clorox: We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Integration Platform Engineer to help Clorox accelerate delivery of enterprise AI and agentic AI use cases using the approved end-to-end reference architecture. This role will help convert architecture into repeatable delivery patterns, reusable capabilities, and governed production implementations that safely connect AI platforms, data products, knowledge layers, APIs, automations, workflows, security controls, and systems of record. In this role, you will: This role sits at the heart of Clorox's AI transformation, helping teams scale AI solutions by connecting platforms, data, workflows, and business applications through governed and reusable patterns. Business Impact This role is critical to ensuring AI can move beyond experimentation and deliver real business value. The successful candidate will: Enable AI agents to safely access and act on enterprise systems and data. Build reusable APIs, automations, and integration services that accelerate AI solution delivery across the company. Ensure all AI-driven actions comply with security, governance, identity, and approval controls. Create enterprise-wide integration standards that support future AI and Agentic AI initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design and configure enterprise platforms to enable APIs, MCP endpoints, intelligent automations, and integration services. Build and support integrations across platforms including MuleSoft, Azure APIM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, ServiceNow, UiPath, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Denodo. Implement governance controls for agent actions, including authentication, authorisation, logging, monitoring, and human approval workflows. Establish API, integration, and agent-to-agent (A2A) standards, documentation, and lifecycle management practices. Troubleshoot and optimse integration and automation platforms supporting AI use cases. This role will: Play a pivotal role in delivering Clorox's enterprise AI and Agentic AI strategy. Work on cutting-edge technologies including AI Agents, MCP, A2A architectures, intelligent automation, and enterprise integrations. Influence how AI securely interacts with core business systems globally. Join a high-impact engineering team building reusable platforms rather than one-off solutions. Exposure to a modern technology stack including Azure, SAP, MuleSoft, Databricks, Fabric, UiPath, and emerging AI technologies. Opportunity to shape enterprise standards and architecture patterns that will be used across the organisation. What we look for: 7-10 years of experience in integration engineering, automation engineering, API development, or enterprise platform engineering. Strong expertise in REST APIs, middleware, cloud integrations, SAP integrations, and automation technologies. Experience with MuleSoft, Azure API Management, UiPath, SAP BTP, OAuth/OIDC, Entra ID, observability, and security controls. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#. Ability to collaborate across architecture, security, cloud, data, and product teams in a fast-paced environment. Workplace type: #LI-Hybrid Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive. Learn more . Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive: Competitive compensation Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being Flexible work environment, depending on your role Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing Half-day Fridays, depending on your location Please apply directly to our job postings and do not submit your resume to any person via text message. Clorox does not conduct text-based interviews and encourages you to be cautious of anyone posing as a Clorox recruiter via unsolicited texts during these uncertain times. To all recruitment agencies: Clorox (and its brand families) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Clorox employees, including any members of our leadership team. Clorox is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Diseñar y desarrollar
items.desc: En Acobur Asesores estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de desarrollo y buscamos a alguien con ganas de aplicar la IA generativa a problemas reales: automatizar procesos, construir agentes y llevar a producción herramientas que se usan a diario, tanto en nuestros productos (como WeTender , nuestra plataforma de inteligencia en contratación pública) como en proyectos para clientes. ¿Qué harás? Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones basadas en LLMs (Claude, GPT, modelos open source…) para automatizar tareas y flujos de trabajo. Construir agentes, pipelines de extracción y análisis de documentos, y sistemas RAG. Integrar la IA con nuestros sistemas internos, APIs y bases de datos. Identificar procesos manuales susceptibles de automatizarse y proponer cómo hacerlo. Trabajar codo con codo con un equipo pequeño, con autonomía y visibilidad sobre lo que construyes. ¿Qué buscamos? Grado en Ingeniería Informática o similar. Experiencia programando en Python [y/o TypeScript]. Conocimiento práctico de APIs de modelos de lenguaje, prompting y herramientas como LangChain, MCP o similares. Soltura con Git, APIs REST y bases de datos. Curiosidad, capacidad de aprender rápido y ganas de ver tu trabajo en producción. Se valorará: Experiencia con bases de datos vectoriales / búsqueda semántica (Elasticsearch, pgvector…). Automatización con n8n, Make o herramientas similares. Docker y despliegue de servicios. Conocimiento del sector de la contratación pública. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Modelo híbrido: 3 días presenciales en nuestra oficina de Madrid y el resto en remoto. Contrato indefinido. Proyectos reales de IA desde el primer día, sin capas de burocracia. Formación continua y acceso a las últimas herramientas de IA. Horario de 8:00 a 14:00 y de 15:00 a 17:00. Madrid o alrededores (necesaria disponibilidad para acudir a la oficina algunos días por semana).

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in
items.desc: Role Description gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement: Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics. Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product. Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA. Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one. Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery. Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time. Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder. Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement. Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review. Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation. Technical skills Essential Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus. LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management. Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates. Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them. RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation. Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP. Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage. Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case. Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM. Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability. Strong advantage Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting. Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus. MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns. Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team. LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar). Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: wailand baut eine agentische KI-Plattform für das Engineering im Maschinenbau. Sie läuft bereits produktiv bei Industriekunden. Unser Ziel: Engineering radikal neu denken und die Industrie in Europa technologisch stärken. Jetzt bauen wir aus: tiefere Integration in CAD, PLM und ERP, Knowledge Graph, Laufzeitumgebung für Agents und die Agenten-Architektur selbst. Du entwickelst Komponenten der Plattform: Integrationen zu CAD, PLM und ERP, Backend-Services, Datenpipelines, Agent-Workflows. Entwickeln heißt bei uns agentisch. Du schreibst keinen Code mehr selbst. Du beschreibst die Aufgabe, setzt die Prüfkriterien, steuerst die Agents, reviewst das Ergebnis und gibst frei. Die Verantwortung für das, was zum Kunden geht, bleibt bei dir. Was du bei uns machst Du setzt Features und Komponenten der Plattform um: Integrationen zu CAD, PLM und ERP, Backend-Services, Datenpipelines, Agent-Workflows. Du arbeitest agentisch: Du zerlegst Aufgaben, schreibst Specs und Prüfkriterien, steuerst Coding-Agents und reviewst deren Ergebnisse. Du gibst frei, was zum Kunden geht, und stehst für Qualität und Wartbarkeit gerade. Du baust automatisierte Prüfungen und Prüfstände, damit Agents sicher arbeiten können: Tests, Referenzergebnisse, Evaluierungen für LLM-Flows. Du bringst LLM-Komponenten in produktive Systeme: RAG, Tool-Calling, Agent-Orchestrierung mit State Management und Observability. Du entwickelst unseren Harness mit: Agent-Workflows, Skills, Prüfketten und Tooling, mit denen wir Software bauen. Du sorgst dafür, dass deine Komponenten beobachtbar, testbar und betreibbar sind, in der Cloud und OnPrem. Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen ein und arbeitest eng mit dem Software Architect, den AI Engineers und den Forward Deployed Engineers zusammen. Was du mitbringst Must-have Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung produktiver Systeme, zum Beispiel mit Python oder Java. Du kennst API-Design, Microservices, Container und CI/CD aus der Praxis. Du arbeitest bereits täglich mit Coding-Agents (zum Beispiel Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) und willst Software konsequent so bauen. Du beschreibst Aufgaben so präzise, dass ein Agent sie umsetzen kann, und erkennst im Review, wo das Ergebnis nicht trägt. Du verstehst Datenarchitekturen: relationale Datenbanken, Vektor-Datenbanken, strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten. Du gibst direktes Feedback, hinterfragst Entscheidungen und stehst zu deinen eigenen. Nice-to-have Du hast LLM-Komponenten (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agents) in produktive Systeme gebracht. Du hast mit Graph-Datenbanken oder Knowledge Graphs gearbeitet. Du hattest Berührungspunkte mit Engineering-Systemen (CAD, PLM, ERP) oder dem Maschinenbau. Du hast Software OnPrem bei Industriekunden betrieben. Du hast eigene Agent-Workflows, Skills oder Tooling für dein Team gebaut. Du scheust dich nicht vor agentischer Frontend-Arbeit. Rahmen Dortmund oder Heilbronn, hybrid: Remote ist möglich, bevorzugt treffen wir uns ein- bis zweimal pro Woche im Büro. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch konversationssicher. So entwickeln wir Der Mensch macht bei uns das, worauf es ankommt: die technische und fachliche Konzeption, die Steuerung der Agents, den Prüfumfang und die Freigabe des Release. Die Entwicklungsumgebung dafür, unseren Harness, bauen wir selbst und entwickeln ihn ständig weiter. Wer bei uns entwickelt, denkt KI also doppelt: als Werkzeug im eigenen Arbeitsalltag und als Bestandteil des Produkts. Tech-Stack Python (FastAPI), Java, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Postgres, Vektor-Datenbanken, Graph-Datenbanken, Langchain, LangGraph, Frontier-Modelle (Anthropic, OpenAI) und lokale LLMs (Open-Source-Modelle, selbst gehostet), Claude Code und weitere Coding-Agents, eigener Harness für agentische Entwicklung. Bewerbung Kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns an career@wailand.io , was du gebaut hast, worauf du stolz bist und wo deine Erfahrung zu dieser Stelle passt. Ein paar Sätze reichen für den Anfang. Mehr über wailand, unsere Arbeitsweise und das Team auf unserer Karriereseite.

items.desc: Lancée en 2017, mozzeno est le prêteur belge 100 % digital qui s’est imposé comme acteur clé du crédit. Chaque jour, nous aidons des particuliers et des professionnels à financer leurs projets grâce à un processus simple, rapide et entièrement digital. Notre force ? Une combinaison unique entre technologie et accompagnement humain, nous permettant d’offrir un service efficace et personnalisé. En parallèle, nous permettons à des investisseurs de soutenir activement l’économie réelle en Belgique en finançant les prêts octroyés par mozzeno. Basée à Louvain-la-Neuve et actuellement en pleine croissance, mozzeno recherche un(e) AI Automation Engineer pour concevoir, orchestrer et améliorer nos processus métier grâce à l'IA. Contenu du poste En tant qu'AI Automation Engineer, vous concevrez, développerez et maintiendrez un portefeuille de solutions d'automatisation qui soutiennent les équipes et les processus métier de mozzeno — de plus en plus propulsés par l'IA. Concrètement, vous allez : Construire des automatisations avec Python et PowerShell — scripts, intégrations et services qui connectent nos applications, transfèrent les données, transforment les données, suppriment les étapes manuelles à travers l'organisation. Concevoir et déployer des workflows IA avec Dify (notre plateforme de workflows IA) pour orchestrer des étapes basées sur des LLM (traitement de documents, classification, extraction, rédaction, assistants et agents internes) et les intégrer en toute sécurité dans nos processus métier. Orchestrer des processus de bout en bout à travers nos outils et systèmes — en comprenant comment chaque application contribue à la solution globale, et en construisant les intégrations et la logique qui les font fonctionner ensemble de manière fiable, d'un bout à l'autre. Développer une expertise fonctionnelle de notre architecture de solutions, en explorant la réalité opérationnelle de chaque processus pour identifier les points de friction et formuler des solutions qui améliorent réellement notre façon de travailler. Gérer et tirer le meilleur parti des outils externes utilisés par nos équipes, en les maintenant à jour, bien intégrés et porteurs de réelle valeur ajoutée. Profil et compétences Vous êtes diplômé(e) en informatique, ou autodidacte avec une expérience IT concrète. Vous maîtrisez Python et PowerShell pour l'automatisation, le scripting et l'intégration — à l'aise avec les API, la manipulation de données, et l'écriture de code fiable et maintenable. Vous avez un réel intérêt pour l' IA et les LLMs , et idéalement une expérience pratique dans la construction de workflows avec Dify (ou des outils similaires comme n8n, LangChain, Make, ou d'autres plateformes d'orchestration LLM). Vous êtes familier avec des concepts tels que le prompting, le RAG, les embeddings, les workflows agentiques et le tool/function calling , et vous comprenez comment faire fonctionner un LLM de manière fiable au sein d'un processus métier. Vous êtes à l'aise pour intégrer et orchestrer des systèmes via des APIs , et vous raisonnez naturellement en termes d'articulation des outils et des processus de bout en bout. Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement cloud (Google, AWS). Vous avez une réelle envie de comprendre la vue d'ensemble, de plonger dans les aspects fonctionnels et opérationnels d'un processus métier, d'en saisir les détails et les points de friction, et de formuler des solutions pour les améliorer. Vous avez d'excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes et savez juger quand impliquer des collègues ou des experts. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un grand sens de l'organisation et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et projets en parallèle. Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration, et la capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés au sein de l'organisation. Vous travaillez efficacement en français et en anglais, et la connaissance du néerlandais est toujours un atout. Notre offre Un positionnement professionnel unique, évidemment orienté technologie, mais réellement transversal et business. Un cadre de travail particulièrement agréable, basé en dehors de Bruxelles pour vous éviter les embouteillages inutiles. L’occasion d’intégrer une équipe de passionnés et une entreprise à taille humaine où l’entraide, l’esprit de collaboration et la complémentarité entre les collègues sont hautement valorisés ; Un job dans lequel votre travail a un impact et fait une réelle différence pour l’entreprise et son développement ; Une culture d’entreprise qui valorise la prise de responsabilité et qui vous offre la possibilité d’être formé.e et d’apprendre continuellement ; Un rôle passionnant et stimulant au sein d'une fintech en pleine croissance. Un salaire compétitif et un package d'avantages attractif. Intéréssé(e) ? Alors postulez sur notre site avec ce lien : https://www.mozzeno.com/fr/jobs/ai-automation-engineer/

items.desc: AI Engineer At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In EY puoi dare forma alla tua carriera e contribuire a costruire un mondo del lavoro migliore, insieme a chi lo sta già trasformando ogni giorno. Perché candidarsi in EY? Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti: Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: fin dal primo giorno, eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, disponibili per tutti; Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta; Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente. Un network internazionale su cui poter contare. Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una AI Engineer Descrizione del lavoro L’AI Engineer (Senior) contribuisce allo sviluppo, integrazione e industrializzazione di componenti AI all’interno dei prodotti AI+ Factory, trasformando specifiche architetturali e requisiti di prodotto in soluzioni tecniche robuste, scalabili e manutenibili. Il ruolo lavora a stretto contatto con AI Architect, AI Data Scientist, FullStack Developer, DevOps/MLOps Engineer e Product Manager, contribuendo alla realizzazione di agenti AI, pipeline RAG, integrazioni con modelli LLM, servizi di inferenza e componenti applicative basate su intelligenza artificiale. Responsabilità ▸ Sviluppare componenti AI per prodotti e piattaforme enterprise, inclusi agenti, pipeline RAG, servizi di inferenza, orchestrazioni LLM e integrazioni con modelli pre-addestrati o fine-tuned. ▸ Implementare logiche applicative in Python, TypeScript o linguaggi equivalenti, garantendo qualità, scalabilità e manutenibilità del codice. ▸ Integrare API AI/ML, servizi cloud AI e modelli custom all’interno di architetture applicative e cloud-native. ▸ Collaborare con AI Architect e AI Data Scientist per trasformare modelli, prototipi e specifiche tecniche in componenti production-ready. Engineering, testing e qualità del software ▸ Partecipare alla progettazione tecnica dei moduli AI, contribuendo alla definizione di pattern implementativi, interfacce, API e logiche di integrazione. ▸ Eseguire attività di testing, debugging, profiling e ottimizzazione delle performance dei componenti AI sviluppati. ▸ Applicare pratiche di software engineering, code review, versioning, documentazione tecnica e automazione dei test. ▸ Garantire che le soluzioni sviluppate siano coerenti con gli standard in termini di sicurezza, affidabilità, riusabilità e compliance. MLOps, deployment e industrializzazione ▸ Collaborare con DevOps/MLOps Engineer per integrare i componenti AI nei processi di CI/CD, deployment e monitoraggio in ambienti cloud. ▸ Contribuire alla gestione del ciclo di vita dei modelli, incluse attività di versioning, packaging, configurazione, rilascio e monitoraggio operativo. ▸ Supportare l’industrializzazione di prototipi AI, acceleratori e asset riutilizzabili, portandoli da proof-of-concept a componenti stabili e documentati. ▸ Contribuire alla libreria interna di componenti, template, connettori e accelerator AI della Factory. Collaborazione cross-funzionale e supporto tecnico ▸ Lavorare in team multidisciplinari con Product Manager, FullStack Developer, UI/UX Engineer, Data Engineer, AI Data Scientist e AI Architect. ▸ Supportare la traduzione dei requisiti di prodotto in soluzioni tecniche implementabili, evidenziando vincoli, dipendenze e rischi tecnici. ▸ Fornire supporto tecnico a figure più junior, condividendo best practice e contribuendo alla crescita delle competenze del team. ▸ Partecipare a sessioni di planning, refinement, technical review e retrospettive, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo delle modalità di delivery. Requisiti ▸ 3-5 anni di esperienza in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, software engineering o sviluppo di soluzioni AI/ML in contesti enterprise o tecnologici. ▸ Solida conoscenza di Python e dei principali framework AI/ML, come PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn o equivalenti. ▸ Esperienza con LLM, pipeline RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, model serving o integrazione di modelli generativi. ▸ Esperienza nello sviluppo e integrazione di API REST, servizi applicativi, microservizi o componenti cloud-native. ▸ Familiarità con containerizzazione, Docker, Kubernetes e pratiche di deployment in ambienti cloud. ▸ Conoscenza dei principi MLOps e dei principali strumenti di model lifecycle management, experiment tracking o model monitoring. ▸ Capacità di scrivere codice pulito, testabile, documentato e riutilizzabile. ▸ Capacità di lavorare in team Agile e …

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de Future SOC , dentro del área de Operaciones de Ciberseguridad en Telefónica Tech , trabajamos en dos grandes líneas: 
 SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation and Response) : definición de requisitos, diseño y desarrollo de casos de uso para detección, enriquecimiento de eventos de seguridad y automatización de respuestas adaptadas a cada cliente. 
 Software Engineering Technical Office : desarrollo de productos y servicios software a medida, automatización y gestión de infraestructuras de ciberseguridad, soporte de seguridad al desarrollo para interpretar hallazgos y orientar correcciones, e innovación aplicada a la evolución del SOC.

PDF multi-colonna, tabelle, documentazione tecnica strutturata), applicando strategie di chunking intelligenti; Deploy & MLOps: Containerizzare e orchestrare i servizi AI sviluppati, garantendone la scalabilità e l'affidabilità nei nostri ambienti Cloud; Osservabilità e Valutazione: Monitorare le performance, i costi e la qualità delle risposte dei modelli in produzione (LLMOps), analizzando le tracce e i prompt per un miglioramento continuo. Requisiti Ottima padronanza di Python e dei principali framework per lo sviluppo web (es. FastAPI o Flask) per esporre i modelli tramite API RESTful; Esperienza pratica e consolidata con framework di orchestrazione LLM (es. LangChain, LlamaIndex o integrazioni API dirette); Esperienza pregressa con framework per la valutazione automatica della qualità RAG (es. Ragas, TruLens); Competenza nell'uso di Vector Database (es. Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate o Pgvector) essenziali per le architetture RAG; Conoscenza delle tecniche di Prompt Engineering e delle dinamiche di function calling / tool use per la creazione di agenti; Esperienza con strumenti di tracciamento e osservabilità per LLM, con focus specifico su Langfuse (per monitoraggio prompt, latenza, token usage e user feedback); Disponibilità a fare trasferte internazionali (di breve durata) e ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Plus Graditi Esperienza nella containerizzazione con Docker e orchestrazione tramite Kubernetes; Familiarità con ambienti Cloud Enterprise (Google Cloud Platform o Microsoft Azure); Gestione del versioning e delle pipeline CI/CD tramite GitLab; Competenze in tecniche di parsing documentale avanzato (OCR, layout detection); Conoscenza pratica del fine-tuning di modelli open-source (LoRA, QLoRA); Attitudine al problem solving e capacità di navigare l'incertezza in un settore in rapidissima evoluzione; Mentalità orientata al prodotto: capire come l'AI risolve problemi reali per l'utente finale; Ottime capacità di comunicazione per interfacciarsi sia con il team tecnico che con gli stakeholder di business. items.desc: Avenga is an international engineering firm helping businesses operate with AI at the core. With 6,000+ experts worldwide, we combine engineering expertise with AI-native thinking to turn ambitious ideas into real-world impact across industries, technologies, and markets. At the core of the role Are you a senior tech professional who loves building cutting-edge AI solutions with the latest technologies? We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our team! In this role, you will spearhead the design, architecture, and orchestration of intelligent agentic frameworks and production-ready AI applications. You will bridge the gap between high-level generative AI strategy and robust engineering, creating scalable, reusable AI assets that drive true innovation and deliver significant value to our customers and business. Core Skills You’ll Bring Professional Experience: At least 5+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or ML application development, with a proven track record of delivering complex, reusable AI solutions independently. AI & Agentic Frameworks: Strong hands-on experience designing AI agents, multi-step reasoning flows, and multi-agent patterns. Proficiency with frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen, along with solid knowledge of prompt engineering and model behavior tuning. Modern AI Tech Stack: Practical understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG/CAG), embedding/vector search principles, and conversational AI architecture (state management, chatbots). Cloud & Tools Expertise: Deep familiarity with cloud environments, specifically GCP (Vertex AI) OR Azure (Azure OpenAI, APIM, Cognitive Search). Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Development Skills: Strong Python programming skills, including FastAPI, asynchronous coding, and rapid prototyping (notebooks, sandbox tools). Engineering Best Practices: Solid grasp of the entire ML lifecycle, CI/CD pipelines, automated APIs, performance monitoring (smart caching, latency optimization), and AI-specific security, privacy, and risk considerations. Education & Mindset: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. You have an analytical mind, excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, and a passion for continuous learning in emerging AI trends. You are fluent in English at a communicative level. Czech or Slovak language at an professional level is essential. The impact you'll create Design & Orchestration: Create scalable, reusable AI applications, agent behaviors, and complex routing patterns (e.g., planner–executor) to hook seamlessly into our digital ecosystem. Rapid Prototyping & RAG: Build lightweight PoCs, validate LLM capabilities, and construct early-stage retrieval pipelines focusing on chunking logic, embedding strategies, and context assembly. Prompt Engineering: Develop and refine secure prompts, system instructions, and behavioral templates to ensure consistent, high-quality reasoning. Lifecycle & DevOps Management: Handle CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and security for everything the team delivers. Partner with Data Scientists, Engineers, and Product Managers to optimize the ML lifecycle. Evaluation & QA: Define test sets, run structured checks, interpret results for actionable improvements, and mitigate hallucinations to ensure tool-use correctness. Performance & Architecture Alignment: Boost platform performance using smart latency tricks while partnering with IT architects to ensure all solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. Knowledge Leadership & Enablement: Share best practices on agentic design, review code, maintain documentation, and act as a bridge between design and core application engineering. What supports your journey Pleasant working environment and stable background in one of the largest software development companies Space to work independently and creatively with the possibility to implement your own ideas and opportunities to learn new things and approaches You have the opportunity to influence your direction in the company High quality hardware and software, access to the latest technologies and specific projects Opportunities to improve your language skills, we are a major global player At Avenga, you'll get quality support in your development thanks to a wide range of internal and external training courses, so you can push the boundaries of your competences We offer you benefits such as life insurance and pension contribution, EN/DE/ES lessons, MultiSport card, sick days, meal allowance, lots of company events, offices in Prague Palmovka with quality amenities for lovers of sport, food and coffee, hybrid remote work after mutual agreement, and more People are at the core of Avenga. items.card: What you'll do Get under the hood of each client's architecture, data and integrations. Turn a scoped brief into an agentic system running in the client's own environment, end to end. Lead the engineers on each project and set the technical direction. Be the client's day-to-day technical contact: updates, questions, and the things that were clear on paper but not in practice. Keep several projects moving at once,
items.desc: About Proxify Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Stockholm, Proxify helps 2,500+ companies worldwide scale their technical teams. The Financial Times ranked us as Sweden's 3rd fastest-growing company in 2025. Our clients increasingly need more than extra engineers. They need someone who can find where AI agents actually pay off and ship them into production. The challenge You're the AI engineer our clients have hired. You get close enough to their systems, data and processes to have a real opinion about what's worth automating and what isn't the right fit at the moment. You report to our Senior AI Product Manager and who owns discovery, commercials and scoping. The technical call is yours. Then you build it and lead Proxify engineers on the project, working within the client's existing data, integrations and security setup until it runs in production. You'll sit in our core team in Stockholm with several client builds running in parallel. Around 80% of your week is hands-on building. The other 20% goes to keeping clients up to date and flagging what the product manager needs to know, as well as collaborating with them. What you'll do Get under the hood of each client's architecture, data and integrations. Turn a scoped brief into an agentic system running in the client's own environment, end to end. Lead the engineers on each project and set the technical direction. Be the client's day-to-day technical contact: updates, questions, and the things that were clear on paper but not in practice. Keep several projects moving at once, and surface scope changes instead of agreeing to them on the spot. Must-have 5+ years in software engineering, with a background in computer science, machine learning and generative AI. A track record of shipping LLM, RAG and agentic systems to production and keeping them running, with the depth to work out why a model behaves the way it does. Hands-on with RAG pipelines (vector databases, streaming, multi-tenancy), multiple LLM providers, and frameworks like LangChain, vLLM and PyTorch or TensorFlow. Strong Python, solid engineering habits (version control, testing, code review) and containerized deployments on AWS, GCP or Azure. Quick to pick up an unfamiliar codebase and build inside someone else's stack. A solution-based, consultative approach. You start from the client's problem, not from the tool or product you'd like to sell them. A strong communicator in professional English. You can lead a client conversation and explain technical decisions to people who'll never read the code. Self-directed. You run with a brief without needing someone to check in on you. Nice to have Things you've built on your own time, such as side projects, open source or agent experiments, and the story of why you built them. Real experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or the OpenAI Agents API. Time at a startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly. Why you'll like it You'll see a wide range of companies and problems in a short time, so the work never gets repetitive. There's no fixed playbook, so the ownership is real and the systems you build are yours to get right. You'll work directly with clients, with strong backing from leadership to move fast. Practical details Location: Stockholm preferred Travel: occasional client site visits Interview process: Talent Acquisition call → hiring manager interview → practical AI engineering assessment → final interview

items.desc: À propos de nous Carbon est une société de conseil spécialisée dans le software engineering et l’intelligence artificielle . Aujourd’hui, nous sommes une communauté de 150 passionné(e)s, réunis autour d’une même conviction : pour rester bon techniquement, il faut continuer à apprendre, expérimenter et partager. Et en matière d’IA, il y a de quoi faire. Les modèles évoluent, les architectures se transforment et de nouveaux usages apparaissent en permanence. Mais entre une démo qui fonctionne et une solution IA réellement utile, fiable et capable de passer en production , il reste un vrai défi d’ingénierie. C’est précisément là que nous voulons être. Chez Carbon, nous développons une expertise IA avec une approche profondément engineering : comprendre les modèles, expérimenter rapidement, faire les bons choix d’architecture et surtout construire des solutions robustes qui répondent à de vrais enjeux métiers. Nos bureaux sont situés à Neuilly-sur-Seine et nos missions se déroulent principalement à Paris intramuros et en petite couronne. Ce qui nous anime ? Résoudre des problématiques complexes, maîtriser nos outils, challenger nos choix techniques et rester à la pointe sans courir après chaque nouvelle tendance. Rejoindre Carbon, c’est aussi intégrer une entreprise où apprendre fait partie du métier . Un consultant qui souhaite progresser trouvera toujours des personnes avec qui confronter ses idées, expérimenter et monter en compétences… avant de transmettre à son tour. Ce que tu peux attendre de nous Tu ne rejoindras pas Carbon uniquement pour enchaîner les missions. Tu rejoindras aussi une communauté technique dans laquelle tu pourras approfondir ton expertise, expérimenter de nouvelles approches et participer à la construction de notre savoir-faire autour de l’IA. Concrètement, tu pourras bénéficier de : Formations techniques pour continuer à développer ton expertise. Workshops, retours d’expérience et conférences internes. Temps d’échange avec des profils expérimentés en IA, software engineering, data et cloud . Une culture du partage où chacun peut apprendre, mais aussi transmettre. Des occasions de tester de nouveaux modèles, frameworks et architectures et de partager tes conclusions avec la communauté. Des missions où l’objectif n’est pas simplement de « faire de l’IA », mais de construire des solutions qui fonctionnent réellement en production . Une communauté qui valorise autant la curiosité technique que la qualité d’exécution . Tu interviendras à l’intersection du software engineering, de la data et de l’intelligence artificielle , depuis les premières expérimentations jusqu’à la mise en production. L’objectif : ne pas s’arrêter au prototype. Tu participeras à la construction de systèmes IA pertinents, évaluables, observables, maintenables et capables de fonctionner à l’échelle . Construire des solutions IA Concevoir et développer des applications intégrant des modèles de Machine Learning et d’IA générative . Construire des solutions basées sur les LLM : RAG, agents, assistants intelligents, recherche sémantique, extraction ou génération d’informations. Intégrer les capacités des modèles au sein d’applications et de produits existants. Concevoir des pipelines de traitement, d’indexation et d’enrichissement de données. Développer des services et composants robustes, testables et maintenables principalement en Python. Passer du POC à la production Parce qu’un prototype convaincant n’est que le début. Concevoir des architectures capables de répondre à des enjeux de performance, scalabilité, sécurité et maîtrise des coûts . Industrialiser et déployer des applications IA dans des environnements de production. Mettre en place des mécanismes d’ évaluation, monitoring et observabilité . Mesurer la qualité des réponses, la latence, la consommation de ressources et les coûts associés aux modèles. Participer à la mise en place de pratiques MLOps / LLMOps et CI/CD adaptées aux applications IA. Explorer et challenger Dans un écosystème qui évolue aussi vite, savoir choisir est aussi important que savoir construire. Comparer différents modèles et approches pour identifier la solution la plus pertinente. Expérimenter autour du RAG, des agents, des modèles open source et propriétaires ou de nouvelles architectures. Challenger les choix techniques : faut-il réellement un agent ? Quel modèle utiliser ? Quel niveau de complexité est justifié ? Participer aux réflexions d’architecture avec les équipes software, data et cloud. Faire de la veille, tester, mesurer et partager ce qui fonctionne… et ce qui fonctionne moins bien. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Who we are You. Better. With Alan. Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost center into their most valuable investment. We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system. By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives. We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members , and have reached 770M+ in ARR. Our team of 700 people (still growing) operates across France , Spain , Belgium , and Canada . What you'll build and who you'll work with You would join the product team that builds the AI agents answering our 1M+ members' questions about their health insurance - reimbursements, coverage, claims, account changes and more - instantly and without waiting for a human. Our AI agents already fully resolve more than 50% of members' questions. Your mission is to push that number further, increase the quality of answers and the trust members place in them, and make our agents work with the other AI agents at Alan, such as Mo our health companion. Concretely, you will: Design and ship LLM-powered agents that understand a member's request, reason over their contract, claims and history, and take real actions on their behalf - building the tools, retrieval and context pipelines that give them the right information at the right moment Make our agents interoperate with other AI agents across Alan, such as Mo: handing off conversations, sharing context and calling each other's capabilities, so members get one seamless experience Bring automated resolution to new channels, starting with AI phone support: real-time voice conversations with the same quality bar as written ones Own evaluation: build datasets, automated evals and quality monitoring so we know an agent is right before members see it Measure and improve resolution rate, answer quality and member satisfaction in production, iterating fast on prompts, models and architecture Work hand in hand with care experts and product to identify the next topics the AI can fully resolve Why this role is special Direct Impact: Every point of automated resolution means members get help instantly, when they need it the most - and directly drives Alan's scaling, growth and profitability. Applied AI at scale: You won't build demos. You'll ship AI agents that handle hundreds of thousands of real conversations per month in a regulated, high-stakes domain, where accuracy truly matters. Frontier problems: Agentic workflows, tool use, evaluation, safety and guardrails, cost and latency trade-offs - you'll tackle the hardest open questions in production LLM systems. Ownership & Growth: Influence product direction, mentor other engineers, and lead technical initiatives that shape the future of healthcare access. What we're looking for Technical Requirements: 5+ years building scalable software systems Strong backend experience (Python is a plus) Hands-on experience building products with LLMs (agents, tool calling, RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation) - ideally shipped to production An evaluation mindset: you know how to measure whether an AI system is actually good, and how to make it better What we value: You love turning complex problems into elegant solutions You care about the "why" behind what you build, not just the "how" You stay on top of a fast-moving AI landscape and are pragmatic about what really works Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority) Mission Alignment: Healthcare technology excites you You …

items.desc: AI Commerce Search Sr. Engineer/Architect Location: London Level: Associate Manager About Accenture Song Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. Within Song, our Commerce & AI practice helps organizations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems - embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalization, autonomous merchandising, intelligent discovery, and customer engagement at scale. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song About the AI is rewriting how people find and buy. Discovery is shifting from keyword search boxes to conversational, agent-mediated experiences - across both a brand's owned platforms and the AI surfaces where customers increasingly begin their journey. We are looking for a technically strong architect to lead the design and delivery of Google-powered AI commerce experiences - with intelligent, AI-native search and discovery at the core, extending across the wider set of on-platform agentic commerce use cases. You will work at the intersection of enterprise commerce platforms and Google's agentic AI stack - Vertex AI Search for Commerce, Gemini Enterprise (GECX), Google Cloud Agents, Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK, and the Customer Engagement Suite - translating commerce strategy into production-grade, grounded, and commercially reliable AI systems. This leans into Google Cloud AI platforms as the delivery foundation. Search and discovery is your anchor specialism, but your remit spans the broader on-platform agentic commerce agenda: conversational commerce, personalization, merchandising optimization, product knowledge and content, and the GEO / AI-native discoverability that determines whether a brand shows up accurately in LLM-mediated discovery. You are hands-on, technically rigorous, and comfortable owning the technical design of a solution workstream - making well-reasoned build-vs-buy decisions and translating complex architecture into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior client stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Owning the technical design of AI-powered commerce search and discovery workstreams on Vertex AI Search for Commerce — relevance tuning, ranking, retrieval, merchandising controls, and query understanding — and ensuring the approach is scalable, grounded, and aligned to client constraints. Designing broader on-platform agentic commerce experiences on Google's stack — conversational commerce, guided shopping, personalization and next-best-action, and merchandising optimization — using Gemini Enterprise (GECX) , Google Cloud Agents , and Vertex AI Agent Builder / ADK . Designing the knowledge and data architecture that underpins search and agent intelligence — structured product data, embedding pipelines, vector retrieval, semantic search, and RAG grounded on commerce-specific intent, product relationships, and category hierarchies. Architecting integration between Google AI surfaces and the enterprise commerce stack - OMS, PIM, DAM, CRM, payments, and fulfilment — via APIs, event-driven patterns, and emerging agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, ACP). Leading GEO / AEO and AI-native discoverability design — structuring and exposing product content so brands remain visible, accurate, and preferred across AI-driven discovery surfaces. Contributing to build-vs-buy decisions across Google AI platform services, LLM/model choices (incl. Model Garden), orchestration frameworks, and vector stores — with a well-reasoned technical point of view grounded in delivery experience. Embedding AI governance, observability, and responsible AI into design as first-class concerns - audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation, grounding/hallucination controls, brand safety, and performance monitoring. Providing technical leadership to delivery teams — guiding engineers, reviewing technical decisions, and maintaining architectural coherence across the workstream lifecycle. Leading technical workshops and architecture reviews with client stakeholders — presenting options with clear trade-offs, effort implications, and business outcomes for both technical and non-technical audiences. Supporting the development of Accenture Song's AI commerce capability — contributing to reference architectures, accelerators, and points of view that advance our delivery standards. What We Are Looking For Required Experience ~6 years of professional experience in technical architecture, solution engineering, or software engineering — with meaningful delivery across enterprise platforms and a growing specialism in AI and agentic systems.
